研鑽を目指す者にとっても重要な拠点である
MsgEn:
The fortress, constructed to counter the Orc army.
Led by Commander Leo and Vice Commander Vanessa,
it is defended by the Arisen Corps and serves as a
crucial stronghold to halt the Orc's advance from
the north.
It is also an important base for those aspiring
to become Fighters.

MsgJp:
旧時代、白竜の座であったと伝えられる神殿
セラー湖の水を制御する水門を備えたこの神殿は
ドリード城と同時代、竜と人を繋ぐ場であったと
されている。すでにここを守る神官はおらず
老朽化も進んでいるが、その威容は健在
MsgEn:
A temple said to have been the seat of the White
Dragon in ancient times.
This temple, equipped with floodgates to control
the waters of Lake Cera, was believed to be a
place that connected dragons and humans, just like
Dreed Castle.
Although there are no longer priests protecting
this place and it is deteriorating, its majestic
presence remains.

MsgJp:
バートランドのどこかにあるという
オーク達の隠れアジト
大将モゴックの腹心、戦鬼ゲソムが指揮する
部隊の潜伏地であるらしい
MsgEn:
A hidden orc hideout somewhere in Betland.
It seems to be the hideout of General Mogok's
trusted warrior, Gesomu the War Demon, and their
troops.

MsgJp:
<COL ffdc78>【宝飾】の扉あり</COL>
バートランド平原の西側、山腹の高台にある牢を
兼ねた地下墓地。旧時代、大罪を犯した者が送られ
死してなお外界に出さぬよう秘密裏に葬られたという
近年調査が入るまで長く閉鎖されたままになっていた
MsgEn:
<COL ffdc78>【Jewelry】Door</COL>
Located on the western side of the Betland
Plains, on a hillside, is an underground tomb
that also serves as a prison. In ancient times,
those who committed great sins were sent here
and secretly buried to prevent them
from returning to the outside world.
It remained closed for a long time
until recent investigations were carried out.

MsgJp:
オーク軍が拠点とする北西の荒地
バートランド平原以北は魔物の支配する厳しい地
であるが、ドラワンの民は故郷を守り今日まで暮ら
してきた。また、北にかかる巨大な橋は《禁じられ
た地》に続くとされ、この地の者さえ近づかない
MsgEn:
The barren land in the northwest that serves as
the base for the Orc army.
The area north of Betland Plains is a harsh land
ruled by enemies, but the people of Drawan have
managed to protect their homeland and live to this
day. Furthermore, it is said that the enormous
bridge to the north leads to the "Forbidden Land,"
a place even the locals dare not approach.

MsgJp:
オークの根城に近い辺境の村
人がハイデル平原以南での防衛を決めてからこれ
まで、外部との交流はほとんど途絶えていた
厳しい環境ながら、故郷に残ると決めた者達により
村は守られ、細々と営みは続けられている
MsgEn:
A remote village, located near the orc stronghold.
Has had little contact with the outside world
since the people decided to defend themselves in
the southern Hidell Plains. Despite the harsh
conditions, the villagers who chose to stay in
their homeland have managed to protect the village
and continue their modest livelihood.

MsgJp:
オーク軍が根城とする旧時代の大砦
かつては立派な外堀を持つ騎士団の砦だったが
白竜が墜ちて後オークに占領され、恐ろしい魔物の
城と化した。首領モゴックが手勢を率い、この砦を
起点にハイデルへの侵略を企てている
MsgEn:
Formerly a fortress of the knight's order that
had an impressive moat.
It has now been occupied by orcs after the fall
of the White Dragon, transforming into a
terrifying stronghold of monstrous creatures.
The leader Mogok leads his forces from this
fortress, plotting an invasion of Hidell.

MsgJp:
バートランド北部からセラー湖の岸辺に繋がる
地下道。ガルドノック砦がオークに占領される前
騎士団が通り道や保管庫として作ったものである
らしい。もちろん、現在利用している人間はいない
MsgEn:
An underground passage from the northern part of
Betland to the shores of Lake Cera.
It seems that the knight order built it as a
thoroughfare and storage facility before Gardnox
Fortress was occupied by orcs.
Of course, there are no humans currently using it.

MsgJp:
<COL ffdc78>【宝飾】の扉あり</COL>
《ガルドノック砦》の奥から続き、テゴル川の水を
堀へと引き込むための水廊。未だオークが根城とする
この場所に、侵食の影響を受けた個体が存在している
らしい。脅威が拡散する前に、芽を摘む必要がある
MsgEn:
<COL ffdc78>【Jewelry】Door</COL>
Continuing from the depths of Gardnox Fortress,
this water corridor is used to draw the water
from the Tegor River into the moat.
It seems that there are infected individuals
affected by corruption still inhabiting this place,
which the Orcs still use as their stronghold.
It is necessary to nip this threat in the bud
before it spreads.

MsgJp:
レスタニア最北の《禁じられた地》
かつて黄金都市と謳われたメルゴダは大地ごと
消失しており、深く抉れた大穴だけがその痕跡を
示している。錬金技術で造られた歪な半生物は
大地に残され、今なお徘徊し続けているという
MsgEn:
North of Lestania lies the Forbidden Land, known
as Mergoda, which was once hailed as the Golden
City.
However, it has completely disappeared, leaving
only a deep, gouged hole as its trace.
Twisted, semi-living creatures created through
alchemy remain on the land, still wandering to
this day.

MsgJp:
ザンドラ禁域北端、地上に残った外周部
メルゴダ入り口にあたる区画であり、政治と深く
関わる錬金術研究の中心地であった。そのため
最も警戒すべき場所として、神殿により禁域と
して秘匿されてきた
MsgEn:
Located at the northern border of Zandora
Wastelands, this is the section that corresponds
to the entrance of Mergoda.
It was the hub of alchemized research closely
intertwined with politics.
As a result, it has been concealed as a forbidden
area by the temple, making it the most guarded of
places.

MsgJp:
ザンドラ禁域を東西に結ぶ大地下水路
セラー湖の水をメルゴダへ送るため整備された
水路であったが、現在は恐ろしい魔物の潜む
大迷路と化している
MsgEn:
The Underground Waterway that connects the
Zandora Wastelands from east to west.
Was originally constructed to transport water
from Lake Cera to Mergoda.
However, it has now transformed into a terrifying
labyrinth infested with dangerous enemies.

MsgJp:
旧時代、各地に祭られた白竜の祭壇
白竜神殿に人が集ったことで祠の多くは廃墟化
しているが、中には管理され本来とは異なる用途で
機能しているものもある
MsgEn:
In the olden days, altars dedicated to the White
Dragon were celebrated all over the land.
Due to people gathering at the White Dragon
Temple, many shrines have fallen into ruins.
However, there are some that are still maintained
and used for purposes different from their
original intention.

MsgJp:
<COL ffdc78>【財宝】の扉あり</COL>
《南ザンドラ遺跡群》の一角にある旧時代の井戸
これまではその存在すら忘れられていたが
恐ろしい咆哮が奥から遺跡群一帯に響くようになった
MsgEn:
<COL ffdc78>【Treasure】Door</COL>
An ancient well in a corner
of the South Zandora Ruins.
Its existence had been forgotten until now,
but a terrifying roar can now be heard
from its depths throughout the entire ruins.

MsgJp:
禁じられた地にもっとも近い、探索者の拠点
すでに元の住民はおらず、旧時代の宝や発見を
求める者達が遺跡を再利用し、宿や商店を開いて
いる。この町のよろず屋には剣豪《ウォリアー》
として名高いオリバーが滞在している
MsgEn:
Nearest to the forbidden land, the base of the
explorers.
The original residents are no longer here, and
those who seek ancient treasures and discoveries
have repurposed the ruins, opening inns and shops.
Oliver, renowned as a warrior, resides in this
town's general shop.

MsgJp:
メルゴダ繁栄期、都の一部だった地域
都喪失の後は凶悪な魔物が跋扈し、墓地群は
不死者の彷徨う呪われた地と化した。しかし
数多く残された家屋遺跡は訪れた者に再利用
され、探検拠点として賑わいを見せている
MsgEn:
During the flourishing period of Mergoda, it was
a part of the capital city.
After the loss of the capital, brutal enemies ran
rampant, and the group of graveyards became a
cursed land where the undead wander.
However, many remaining house ruins have been
repurposed by visitors and have become lively
exploration bases.

MsgJp:
セラー湖にそびえる禊の神殿・上層部
禊の神殿内部には、失われた都に続く湖底大通路
が存在すると言われるが、長らくその扉は白竜神殿
により管理、封印されてきた
MsgEn:
The upper echelons of the Temple of Purification
located on Lake Cera, towering over the lake.
It is said that within the temple lies a grand
underwater passageway leading to the lost city.
However, for a long time, the doors to this
passageway have been guarded and sealed by The
White Dragon Temple.

MsgJp:
ザンドラ東部、《死者の丘》と呼ばれる地にある
地下礼拝堂。冥界の王を奉るための場所であり
深部には亡霊騎士が守る呪われた秘宝があると
墓荒らしの間でまことしやかに囁かれている
挑んだ者全てが帰らなかったため、封鎖された
MsgEn:
Eastern Zandora, a underground chapel referred to
as the "Hill of the Dead".
It is a place dedicated to the king of the
underworld, and deep within, it is rumored that a
cursed treasure guarded by a ghost knight can be
found.
Due to the fact that everyone who has challenged
it has never returned, it has been sealed off.

MsgJp:
<COL ffdc78>【財宝】の扉あり</COL>
ザンドラ東部、《死者の丘》ふもとの崖から
近年発掘された旧時代の地下墓地
発見した墓荒らしによると、侵入直後に恐ろしい
までの悪寒に襲われ、命からがら逃げ出したという
MsgEn:
<COL ffdc78>【Treasure】Door</COL>
Located at the foot of the Hill of the Dead
in Eastern Zandora.
A recently discovered underground tomb
from ancient times.
According a grave robber, they were struck
by a horrible chill upon entering
and narrowly escaped with their lives.

MsgJp:
メルガン技師の研究室
技師の中にも、竜を排すという異端思想に傾倒
した者が少なからずいた。そういった思想の信徒が
使っていた研究室は封鎖、監視対象となっている
ここも、何らかの研究のため使われていたようだ
MsgEn:
Laboratory of Engineer Mergan.
Here, there were some who were inclined towards
the heretical idea of rejecting dragons.
The research facility used by those who believed
in such ideas has been shut down and placed under
surveillance.
It seems that this place was also used for some
kind of research.

MsgJp:
護政区の研究者であった錬金術師の家
すでに主は不在だが、研究成果や遺物は
遺されているかもしれない
それが、どういった内容であるかは不明
MsgEn:
The home of an alchemist who was a researcher in
the Security District.
The master is already absent, but there may be
alchemized research results and artifacts left
behind.
It is unclear what the contents are.

MsgJp:
白竜により、かつて大地から切り離された都
レスタニアとは隔てられた異界に漂い、時の流れも
異なっている。現在は地上で見られなくなった
錬金技術が随所にほどこされ、秘術で生み出された
錬魔は今も亡都を守護している
MsgEn:
The city once cut off from the earth by The White
Dragon.
Now drifts in a different realm, no longer seen
in Lestania.
Time flows differently here.
Alchemized technology, which has disappeared from
the surface, is still present throughout, and the
city is protected by guardian spirits created
through secret spells.

MsgJp:
突如レスタニアの沖合に出現したフィンダム
大陸の一部。レスタニアに出現した侵食魔も
ここから飛来しており、この絶海の孤島が
"侵食"という脅威に対抗するための手がかりを
秘めていると予測される
MsgEn:
Phindym suddenly appeared off the coast of
Lestania.
The invading corrupted creatures from the
continent fly in from here.
It is predicted that this isolated island in the
vast sea holds clues to opposing the threat of
"corruption."

MsgJp:
魔赤島における調査のために自然洞窟を
整備して駐屯地とした
侵食が進む魔赤島において、状態が良く
広さも申し分ない洞窟を発見できたことは
調査隊にとってまさに奇跡的な幸運であった
MsgEn:
A natural cave developed and turned into a base
camp for the investigation of Bloodbane Isle.
In the rapidly deteriorating island plagued by
Corruption, it was truly a miraculous stroke of
luck for the research team to discover a cave that
was not only in good condition but also spacious
enough to meet their needs.

MsgJp:
魔赤島中心部に位置する侵食の進んだ洞窟
洞窟入口周辺には溢れ出したかのように大量の
菌胞がはびこっている。内部の侵食がかなり
進んでいることは確実であり、慎重を期した
調査が望まれる
MsgEn:
Located in the central part of Bloodbane Isle,
the cave is heavily corrupted.
In the vicinity of the cave entrance, there is an
overwhelming amount of fungal spores spreading.
The internal infection is considerable, and a
cautious investigation is desired.

MsgJp:
魔赤島の北西部、最も高い断崖に近い一帯
何層にも崖が重なったような複雑な地形を
しており、滑落には特に注意が必要
MsgEn:
A complex terrain resembling layers of
overlapping cliffs found in the northwestern part
of Bloodbane Isle.
Special attention must be paid to the risk of
falling.

MsgJp:
魔赤島の北東部、一際標高が高い一帯
空に渦巻く何らかのエネルギー体に
最も近く、赤く照らされている
MsgEn:
In the northeastern part of Bloodbane Isle, there
is an especially high elevation area,
where some kind of energy body swirls in the sky
close to it and illuminating it in red.

MsgJp:
フィンダムの中でも特に自然の美しさに恵まれた水林
大半の水がエランより湧き出でているとされており
良質な水を守るために周辺の森林についても厳重に
管理されている
MsgEn:
In Phindym, the water forest is particularly
blessed with natural beauty.
Most of its water is said to spring forth from
Elan, and to protect the high-quality water,
the surrounding forests are carefully managed.

MsgJp:
エラン水林を管理するために設えられた科学者の住居
元は恵まれた環境を保全するという側面が強かったが
現在は侵食の被害をいかに食い止めるかという点に
研究の重点が置かれているようだ
MsgEn:
The residence of scientists established to manage
the Elan Water Grove.
Initially, the emphasis was on preserving the
rich environment, but now the focus of research
seems to be on how to halt the spread of
corruption and damage caused by it.

MsgJp:
<COL ffdc78>【財宝】の扉あり</COL>
エラン水林西部にある自然洞窟
陽光の差し込む場所がいくつかあり、小さな虹が舞う
ような幻想的な光景が見られることがあるという
かつては周辺住人にも親しまれた場所であった
MsgEn:
<COL ffdc78> 【Treasure】Door</COL>
A natural cave located in the western part of Elan Water Grove. 
There are several places where sunlight filters through, 
creating a fantastical scene with small rainbows dancing in the air. 
This place used to be beloved by the local residents.

MsgJp:
《<SPOT 931>》の傍にある、大きな滝に
面した広場。地名の由来は滝に虹がかかる
ことからという説の他に、色鮮やかな鳥達が
辺りを舞うからだという説もある
MsgEn:
A plaza facing a large waterfall beside <SPOT 931>
.
The origin of the name of the place is said to be
the rainbow over the waterfall as well as the
brightly colored birds dancing around the area.

MsgJp:
フィンダム大陸中部に広がる平原
起伏が多いフィンダムにおいて、ファーラナ平原は
なだらかで活用しやすい地形をしている
また、他の地域と比較すると侵食の度合は
緩やかなようで侵食魔の数も少ない
MsgEn:
The Farana Plains, located in the central part of
the Phindym continent, are characterized by gently
rolling terrain, making them easy to utilize in
the varied landscape of Phindym.
Furthermore, compared to other regions, the level
of corruption is relatively low, resulting in
fewer corrupted creatures.

MsgJp:
ファーラナ平原に位置する戦士の村
武勇を最も尊ぶ部族が住まい、住人たちは
日々鍛錬と戦いに明け暮れている
力に裏付けされてか、地理的な理由に寄るものか
比較的侵食の影響を受けずに生活している
MsgEn:
A village of warriors located in the Farana
Plains.
The inhabitants, who hold valor in the highest
regard, spend their days immersed in training and
battles.
Whether supported by their strength or due to
geographical reasons, they live relatively
unaffected by corruption.

MsgJp:
かつてはフィンダム中から学者たちが集う学研の場で
あった小塔。魔物の襲撃を受けて放棄されたのち
ピクシーの大きな群れが移住した。位の高い
ピクシーは高所を好むため、小塔の上階には群れ
の長もしくは準ずる個体が生息していると思われる
MsgEn:
A small tower in the midst of Phindym, where
scholars gathered in the past.
After being abandoned due to enemy raids, a large
group of Pixies migrated there.
Pixies of high rank prefer high places, so it is
believed that the leader or a similar individual
of the group resides on the upper floor of the
tower.

MsgJp:
ファーラナ平原の川中に浮かぶ陸地
周辺は水深が浅く、水没してはいるものの
歩き回ることが可能。ただし、汚泥が流れ着く
ことも多いらしく、不浄の魔物がさ迷っている
こともある
MsgEn:
A piece of land floating in the middle of the
river in the Farana Plains.
The surrounding waters are shallow, allowing for
exploration on foot, despite periodic submersion.
However, it appears that mud and debris often
accumulate here, leading to the presence of foul
creatures wandering about.

MsgJp:
《芯なる樹》の最深部
侵食による影響が出るまでは、精霊竜との
謁見などはこの場所で行われていた
精霊竜の守りとして選ばれた者たちが控えていた
集いの間と隣接している
MsgEn:
The deepest part of the "Core Tree".
Until the effects of corruption took hold,
meetings with the Spirit Dragon were held in this
location.
Those chosen as guardians of the Spirit Dragon
awaited in the adjacent Gathering Hall.

MsgJp:
精霊竜が棲む《始まりの洞》下層に位置する拠点
精霊竜の守りをする者たちや訪れた人々が
暫しの休息を得るための場となっている
MsgEn:
Base camp located in the lower level of the
Hollow of Beginnings, where the Spirit Dragon
resides.
It serves as a place for the protectors of the
Spirit Dragon and for those who have visited to
find temporary rest and respite.

MsgJp:
フィンダム随一の森林地帯
樹木や草花、多様な獣といった森の恩恵を
受けられるこの地の特性は、反面侵食の影響が
最も色濃く発現する悲劇を招いた。生命力に
溢れていた森は今や赤く立ち枯れている箇所が目立つ
MsgEn:
The premier woodland region of Phindym, where one
can enjoy the benefits of the forest, including
trees, flowers, and a variety of animals.
However, the characteristic of this land also
brings about the tragic manifestation of the most
intense corruption and infection.
The once vibrant forest now stands with prominent
red decay.

MsgJp:
モロー樹林にある、木々に囲まれた村
代々精霊竜の守りをしてきた一族が住まう
そのせいか理知的な者が多く、学者を多数
輩出してきた。威厳ある族長・ガラダに
よって統治されている
MsgEn:
In the Morrow Forest, there is a village
surrounded by trees, where a clan that has been
guarding the Spirit Dragon for generations
resides.
Perhaps because of this, there are many
intellectual individuals, and they have produced
numerous scholars.
They are ruled by the dignified chieftain,
Gearóid.

MsgJp:
《ノーザナス侵林》入口のある崖の下に
広がる平地。封鎖されている侵林に
引き寄せられているのか、侵食が進んだ
有翼の魔物たちがしきりにこの辺りを
さまよう姿が確認されている
MsgEn:
A flat area of land spreading out under the cliff
where the entrance to the Northerners Infected
Woods is
located.
It is confirmed that winged beasts, infected by
corruption, are frequently wandering around this
area.

MsgJp:
モロー樹林北部、特に侵食が進んだ一帯にある
封鎖された森林。侵食前より森の強者が棲むとされ、
人が迷いこむことが無いようにと封鎖されていた場所
奥を確かめた者はいないが、凶暴な魔物が侵食された
状態にあることは確実であり、危険度は高い
MsgEn:
The sealed forest located in the northern part of
Morrow Forest, where corruption has particularly
advanced.
It is said to be inhabited by powerful beings of
the forest, and it was sealed off to prevent
people from getting lost.
No one has ventured deep inside, but it is
certain that ferocious monsters have been
infected. The level of danger is high.

MsgJp:
細長くうねった川と切り立った崖で構成された峡谷
古代からの遺跡が多くのこる地域であり、文化的に
重要な地帯である。この辺りに住む人々も、伝承や
習慣などを重視した生活を送る傾向にある
MsgEn:
An area composed of a narrow, winding river and
steep cliffs, forming a gorge.
It is a region with many ancient ruins remaining,
making it culturally significant.
The people living in this area tend to prioritize
traditions and customs in their way of life.

MsgJp:
キンガル峡谷に位置する村
近くに多数のこる遺跡や神殿などの古代文明に
畏怖の念を抱き、古くからの伝統や伝承などを
現在に伝え継いできた一族が住んでいる
村の掟として、村人が遺跡に近づくことを禁じている
MsgEn:
Village located in Kingal Canyon.
Nearby are numerous ancient ruins and temples
that belong to a long-lost civilization.
The villagers, who have lived here since ancient
times, hold a deep reverence for these sites and
their traditions and legends.
As a village rule, the villagers are forbidden
from approaching the ruins.

MsgJp:
キンガル峡谷に悠然と佇む古代神殿
数百年前に遺棄されたものの、当時満ち満ちていた
竜力によって未だ壮麗な姿をそのままにしている
遺棄された理由は、恐らく精霊竜自身が神殿よりも
《芯なる樹》の傍にあることを好んだためだろう
MsgEn:
Standing gracefully in the Kingal Canyon, the
ancient temple remains magnificent, even after
being abandoned hundreds of years ago.
It still retains its grandeur, thanks to the
Dragon Force that once thrived here.
The reason for its abandonment was likely because
the Spirit Dragon preferred to be near the "Core
Tree" rather than the temple itself.

MsgJp:
元々はフィンダムの大地へ、そして竜のために季節
ごとの舞踊が奉納されていた広場。侵食によって
フィンダム全域での危険度が増したことでこれらの
行事は中止され、以来本来の使い方をされることは
無くなった
MsgEn:
A square originally dedicated to seasonal dances
dedicated to the dragon.
Due to the increase in danger throughout Phindym
caused by the Corruption, these events were
canceled and have since ceased to be used for
their original purpose.

MsgJp:
600年ほど前に建造された砦
アッカー家が並み居る地方豪族を倒して
大陸統一を果たした後に、対オーク用に強化されて
現在に至る。長く役目を果たしていたが"悪しき竜"
出現直後にオーク軍に占拠された
MsgEn:
A fort that was built about 600 years ago.
After the Acre family defeated the local feudal
lords, they strengthened it to fend off the Orcs
and it has remained that way to this day.
It had served its purpose for a long time, but
was occupied by the Orc army shortly after the
appearance of the "Evil Dragon."

MsgJp:
解放軍が拠点として使っている小さな集落
元はきこりが使っていたらしき空き家を中心に、
逃げ延びた人たちがテントを張って暮らしているが
いつオークに攻め込まれるかわからない状況にある
MsgEn:
The small settlement used as a base by the
Liberation Army.
It originally consisted of vacant houses,
seemingly once occupied by lumberjacks.
Now, people who managed to escape have pitched
tents and are living there, constantly facing the
uncertainty of when they will be attacked by Orcs.

MsgJp:
翡翠湖を臨む、長くロスギル家が治める地方の中心地
魔物が多い地帯ならではの重装家屋が見られる
王族アッカー家から一帯の守護を任されてきた
ロスギル家の末裔を長に頂き、忠誠心に篤い人々が
暮らしている
MsgEn:
Overlooking Emerald Lake, in the heart of a
region long ruled by the Rothgill family.
One can see the sturdy houses characteristic of
this land abundant in enemies.
Tasked with protecting the entire area by the
noble Acre family, descendants of the Rothgill
family serve as its leaders, with loyal and
devoted individuals living here.

MsgJp:
かつては蛮族の地と呼ばれた南部地方に睨みを
きかせる要衝として建造された
アッカーシェラン大陸ではメガド離宮、王都メガドに
次いで古い建造物。城主はアッカー家の当主だが
実質的な管理者である"城番"は兵士が就くことが
できる最高位とされている
MsgEn:
In the southern region, which was once called the
land of barbarians, a strategic point was built to
intimidate the surrounding area.
It is the third oldest structure in the Acre
Selund continent, following the Megado Detached
Palace and the Royal Capital Megado.
While the lord of the Acre family is the castle
owner, the "Castle Sentinel", who is the actual
administrator, is considered the highest position
that soldiers can hold.

MsgJp:
戦禍を逃れてきた人たちが、森の中で
息を潜めるように、しかししたたかに支え合って
暮らしている非常に小さな集落
避難民の中に統率力に優れる者がいるらしく
今のところ比較的安定した生活を送っている
MsgEn:
A very small settlement where people who have
escaped from the ravages of war live hidden in the
forest.
They support each other cunningly yet quietly,
living together.
Among the refugees, there seems to be someone
with exceptional leadership skills, and they are
currently leading a relatively stable life.

MsgJp:
アッカー家が南西方面からの敵を迎え撃つために
建造した砦。"悪しき竜"が現れてからは魔軍の拠点
として使われている。オークたちが西方で集めた
食料や物資の集積場と考えられており、周辺には
防衛点が点在している
MsgEn:
The fortress built by the Acre family to fend off
enemies from the southwest.
It is now being used as a stronghold for the
Demon Army since the appearance of the "Evil
Dragon."
It is believed to be a gathering place for food
and supplies collected by the Orcs in the west,
and there are defense points scattered around.

MsgJp:
メガド周辺を警備する目的で使われる監視塔
すでに地上階は魔軍により占拠されているが
魔物たちは地下階の存在には気付かなかったようだ
地下階には、メガド陥落の折に逃げ延びた兵士たちが
救援を信じ、息を殺すように潜んでいる
MsgEn:
A surveillance tower is used to secure the
surroundings of Megado.
The ground floors have already been occupied by
the demon army, but it seems like they were
unaware of the existence of the underground
floors.
Soldiers who managed to escape during the fall of
Megado are hiding in the underground floors,
holding their breath as they believe in the
possibility of rescue.

MsgJp:
城塞都市メガドにて一般市民が住まう居住層
メガド全体から見ると下層にあたり、大陸の人口の
過半数が暮らしていた
長きに渡り繁栄を誇っていたが、魔軍の急襲に
よって蹂躙され、多くの住民が命を落とした
MsgEn:
In the residential layer of Fortress City Megado,
where ordinary citizens reside, it is known as the
lower level and where over half of the continent's
population lived.
It had been prosperous for a long time, but it
was devastated by a sudden attack from the Demon
Army, and many residents lost their lives.

MsgJp:
霧の森の中にある焼け野原
忌まわしい考えに取り付かれたある女が
多数の犠牲者を洗脳し、自ら炎の中へと
飛び込ませたという事件が起こった場所
事件から何十年と経過しているが、未だに
土は焼けたままであり草木も回復していない
MsgEn:
A burnt field in the Forest of Mist.
This is where a woman obsessed with abominable
thoughts brainwashed numerous victims and forced
them to jump
into the flames themselves.
Decades have passed since the incident, yet the
soil remains burned and the grass and trees have
not recovered.

MsgJp:
アッカーシェラン大陸の南部にアジトを構え
定住しつつ活動するベルタ盗賊団とは異なり
通称"北の盗賊"と呼ばれる彼らは、一定期間ごとに
アジトを変えて活動している。その姿勢からも
わかる通り、警戒心が強く、自らの存在を徹底的に
隠す傾向にある
MsgEn:
Unlike Bertha's Bandit Group, who have a
stronghold in the southern part of Acre Selund,
they are known as "Northern Bandits" and change
their hideout at regular intervals.
They are very cautious and tend to conceal their
presence thoroughly, as can be seen from their
attitude.

MsgJp:
《聖炎の参竜道》へと続く扉の前に
急きょ設営された野営地。厳しいウルテカ山岳の
環境に負けず、宿やよろず屋といった覚者隊のための
設備を維持すべく、王家に仕える兵のみならず
盗賊も手を貸している
MsgEn:
In front of the door leading to the "Sacred Flame
Path," a temporary camp has been hastily set up.
Despite the harsh environment of the Urteca
Mountains, the facilities for the Arisen Corps,
such as inns and general shops, are being
maintained not only by the soldiers serving the
royal family, but also with the help of bandits.

MsgJp:
本来はアッカーシェランを統べる火竜が休息を
取るための場であり、聖なる場所と目されていたが
今は悪しき竜が成り変わるかのようにねぐらとして
いる。火垂れ山の中でも最も多くの竜力が
集まる場とみなされている
MsgEn:
Originally, it was a place for the Fire Dragon,
who ruled over Acre Selund, to rest and was
considered a holy place.
Now it serves as a den for the Evil Dragon,
transforming it.
It is considered the place where the most Dragon
Force gathers within Firefall Mountain.

MsgJp:
戦徒リュカによって導かれた先の島の入り江
空には常に暗雲が厚く漂い、島の位置はおろか
現在の時間すら推し量ることができない
岩場の険しさや荒れ果てた様子から、生者が
居ないことだけは確かなようだ
MsgEn:
Led by the Myrmidon Luca, we arrive at an inlet
on the remote island.
The sky is always filled with thick dark clouds,
so much so that it is impossible to even determine
the current time.
The treacherous cliffs and desolate appearance
suggest that there are no living beings present.

MsgJp:
産まれたばかりのマンドラゴラ
頭部は柔らかく様々な植物の種が付着しており
吸収する養分によって異なる植物が発芽する
同様に個体の性格や特性も変化することがあり
養分と進化の関係は未だ未解明の部分が多い
MsgEn:
Newborn Mandragora have soft heads with seeds of
various plants attached to them.
Different plants germinate depending on the
nutrients they absorb.
Similarly, individual personalities and
characteristics can change.
The relationship between nutrients and evolution
remains largely unresolved.

MsgJp:
最も基本的な成長を遂げたマンドラゴラ
古代文献によると祖先は危険性の高い植物
だったが、古代人が長い年月と多くの犠牲を
払い改良した結果、狂気の叫喚と引き換えに
活動的な手足と人懐こさを得たのだという
MsgEn:
Mandragora in its most basic growth.
Ancient literature says that its ancestors were
highly dangerous plants, but that the ancients
improved them over time and with much sacrifice,
and that they gained active limbs and friendliness
in exchange for their crazy screams!

MsgJp:
栄養の偏りにより
花を咲かせず成長したマンドラゴラ
この生育状態の個体は丈夫で世話もしやすく
エランの村では親が子供の遊び相手として
与えることも多かったという
MsgEn:
Mandragoras that have grown without flowering due
to nutritional imbalances are hardy and easy to
care for in this state of growth.
In the village of Elan, parents often gave them
to their children as playmates.

MsgJp:
固有種の花を咲かせたマンドラゴラ
フィンダムの大地を離れた場所で成長すると
本来の花色である白が強く発色される
かつてエランにいたマンドラゴラ愛好家たちは
この状態から様々な花色の栽培を始めていた
MsgEn:
Mandragora that bloomed the unique species
specific to Phindym.
Blossoms with its true color, white, intensified
when grown in a place away from the earth of
Phindym.
Mandragora enthusiasts who once resided in Elan
began cultivating various colors starting from
this state.

MsgJp:
フィンダム固有種の花を咲かせたマンドラゴラ
野生のマンドラゴラは、大地に染み込んだ
"芯なる樹"の樹液により青い花が
咲きやすいが、原生地以外の土地で
育った個体に青色の花が咲くことは非常に稀
MsgEn:
Mandragora that bloomed the flower unique to
Phindym.
The wild Mandragora, soaked in the essence of the
"core tree" embedded in the earth, tends to
produce blue flowers.
However, it is extremely rare for individuals
grown outside of their native land to bloom blue
flowers.

MsgJp:
フィンダム固有種の花を咲かせたマンドラゴラ
マンドラゴラの赤い花は、恋の花として知られ
フィンダムの若者たちの間で特に人気があった
赤色の花は自然界にはほぼ存在しないため
養根家というブリーダーにより栽培されている
MsgEn:
Mandragora that bloomed the unique species
specific to Phindym.
The red flower of the Mandragora is known as the
flower of love, and it was particularly popular
among the young people of Phindym.
As red-colored flowers are almost non-existent in
nature, they are cultivated by a breeder called
the Mandragora Root Master.

MsgJp:
フィンダム固有種の花を咲かせたマンドラゴラ
追肥の微かな偏りによって咲くことが多い
一部の地域では黄色は陽の加護色とされ
本種を飼ったり黄マンドラフラワーを髪飾りに
するなどの、お守り植物として愛されていた
MsgEn:
The Mandragora, a unique species only found in
Phindym, often blooms due to subtle variations in
its fertilization.
In some regions, yellow is considered a color
that represents the blessings of the sun.
People have cherished this species as a
protective plant, keeping them as pets or adorning
their hair with Yellow Mandragora Flowers.

MsgJp:
フィンダム固有種の花を咲かせたマンドラゴラ
花としては育ちきっているため、この段階から
花色が変化する可能性は無いとされる
フィンダムでの価値は低いが、白竜の治める
レスタニアにおいては最も注目度が高い
MsgEn:
Mandragora that bloomed the unique species
specific to Phindym.
Since it has fully grown as a flower, there will
be no chance for the color to change from this
stage.
Although its value in Phindym is low, it is
highly regarded in Lestania, where the White
Dragon reigns.

MsgJp:
フィンダム固有種の花が群生したマンドラゴラ
マンドラゴラの花の青色はフィンドブルーと
呼ばれ、格別に重宝されていた
"芯なる樹"の特に濃厚な樹液を吸収した
個体のみが、青く美しい花を群生させる
MsgEn:
Mandragora with clusters of flowers endemic to
Phindym.
The blue color of mandragora flowers is called
Phindymian Blue and is exceptionally valued.
Only individuals that have absorbed the
particularly thick sap of the "core tree" produce
beautiful blue flowers in clusters.

MsgJp:
フィンダム固有種の花が群生したマンドラゴラ
養分豊富でなければ進化の難しい希少種
婚前の娘の家でマンドラゴラがこの種に
進化すると、精霊の祝福を受けたことになり
一族は末永く幸福を得るという
MsgEn:
Mandragora with clusters of flowers endemic to
Phindym.
It is a rare species that requires rich nutrients
in order to evolve.
If a Mandragora evolves in the house of a
daughter before marriage, it is said that the
family will receive the blessings of the spirits
and will prosper and be happy for generations to
come.

MsgJp:
フィンダム固有種の花が群生したマンドラゴラ
有機成分の多い土で進化することの多い種
黄花はモスが集まるため、衣類素材には適さず
粗悪な養根家が誤って進化させた本種を
エラン水林に大量遺棄する事件もあった
MsgEn:
Mandragora with clusters of flowers endemic to
Phindym.
Often evolves in soil rich in organic compounds.
The yellow flowers do not suit clothing materials
as they attract moths.
There have been incidents where careless planters
mistakenly caused the mass abandonment of this
species, which evolved by accident in the Elan
Water Grove.

MsgJp:
フィンダム固有種の花が群生したマンドラゴラ
マンドラゴラフラワー属の最成長した姿で
花が枯れると、根部に新たな種が４つ作られる
古い種の落ちる瞬間を見ると眼病を患うという
伝承もあるが実際は不気味なだけで無害である
MsgEn:
Mandragora with clusters of flowers endemic to
Phindym.
Forms a dense cluster of flowers.
When the flowers wither, four new seeds are
produced in the roots.
According to legend, those who witness the moment
the old seeds fall will suffer from eye disease,
but in reality, they are just eerie and harmless.

MsgJp:
胞子が付着し、キノコを成したマンドラゴラ
マンドラゴラの頭皮はクッション状で厚く
侵食胞子の根が脳まで届くことはない
菌を青く発色させるための肥料は希少なため
同系種の中でも特に価値が高い
MsgEn:
Mandragora that became a mushroom by attachment
of spores.
The scalp of the Mandragora is thick and
cushion-like, the corruptive roots of the
infecting spores will not reach the brain.
Fertilizers that make the fungus turn blue are
rare.
Thus, the species is particularly valuable.

MsgJp:
胞子が付着し、キノコを成したマンドラゴラ
キノコ部分は猛毒が含まれているが
適切に処理することで、精力剤の原料にもなる
鮮やかな赤い傘は、観賞用として残す愛好家も
いるが、多くの場合は切り取って処分される
MsgEn:
Mandragora that became a mushroom by attachment
of spores.
Although the mushroom part contains a deadly
poison, it can also be used as an ingredient for
aphrodisiacs if handled properly.
Vibrant red caps are often kept for ornamental
purposes by enthusiasts, but in most cases they
are cut off and disposed of.

MsgJp:
胞子が付着し、キノコを成したマンドラゴラ
キノコ部分には、強力な幻覚作用があり
病気などの鎮痛用ハーブに混ぜて使用される
比較的容易に育てられるため
狩りで使用する毒餌に入れることもある
MsgEn:
Mandragora that became a mushroom by attachment
of spores.
Has a potent hallucinogenic effect.
It is mixed with herbs used for pain relief in
diseases and is relatively easy to cultivate.
It is also sometimes used as a poisonous bait for
hunting.

MsgJp:
胞子が付着し、キノコを成したマンドラゴラ
モスの幼虫にキノコが寄生したものは
滋養強壮に良いハーブとして重宝されているが
生きたマンドラゴラに寄生することもある
与えた肥料の成分はキノコ部分に蓄えられる
MsgEn:
Mandragora that became a mushroom by attachment
of spores.
One where the mushroom parasitizes the moss larva.
It is highly valued as a herb for nourishing and
fortifying the body.
It can also parasitize a living Mandragora.
The nutrients from the fertilizer are accumulated
in the mushroom part.

MsgJp:
侵食胞子によるキノコが群生したマンドラゴラ
フィンダーエントの足元で発生することが
観測されており、成長には樹液が関係している
凝縮された竜力とエランの天然水成分は
生物が摂取するには強過ぎるため、毒である
MsgEn:
Mandragora with clusters of mushrooms caused by
invasive spores.
Have been observed growing at the feet of
Phindymian Ents.
The growth is related to the sap.
The condensed power of dragons and the natural
water components of Elan, if consumed by living
beings, are too powerful and thus poisonous.

MsgJp:
侵食胞子によるキノコが群生したマンドラゴラ
赤いキノコは"ゲキリンタケ"と呼ばれており
竜の逆鱗のように触れてはいけないものとされ
素手で触れば燃えるような痛みに襲われる
地温の高い、火山地帯に発生しやすいという
MsgEn:
Mandragora with clusters of mushrooms caused by
invasive spores.
The red mushrooms are known as "Gekirintake" and
are said to be forbidden, like touching a dragon's
scale.
If touched barehanded, they cause a burning pain.
It is said that they are more likely to appear in
volcanic areas with high ground temperature.

MsgJp:
侵食胞子によるキノコが群生したマンドラゴラ
頭部のキノコは、水浴び場や調理場にも発生し
フィンダムの一般家庭では駆除対象である
基本的な養分さえあればどこでも育つため
マンドラゴラ栽培により収穫されることが多い
MsgEn:
Mandragora with clusters of mushrooms caused by
invasive spores.
These mushrooms can also grow in bathing areas
and kitchens, making them a target for eradication
in ordinary households. They can thrive anywhere
as long as the basic nutrients are available,
which is why they are often harvested through
Mandragora cultivation.

MsgJp:
侵食胞子によるキノコが群生したマンドラゴラ
マンドラゴラの頭皮は菌の温床にもなりやすく
その性質を利用したキノコ栽培法も存在する
マンドラゴラキノコを上手く群生させるには、
豊富な原菌と十分な湿度が不可欠である
MsgEn:
Mandragora with clusters of mushrooms caused by
invasive spores.
The scalp of the Mandragora easily becomes a
breeding ground for fungi, and there are
cultivation methods that exploit this
characteristic.
To successfully cultivate a group of Mandragora
mushrooms, abundant mycelium and sufficient
humidity are essential.

MsgJp:
固有種の花を咲かせたマンドラゴラ
マンドラフラワーの発色は、肥料から吸収する
色素の他に土壌の状態にも左右される
無機・有機成分のバランスを保つことで
珍しい色の花を発見しやすいという
MsgEn:
Mandragora with endemic flowers.
Absorbs pigment not only from fertilizers but
also from the condition of the soil.
By maintaining a balance of inorganic and organic
components, it becomes easier to discover flowers
of rare colors.

MsgJp:
固有種の花を群生させたマンドラゴラ
マンドラフラワーの色変化は非常に繊細で
マンドラブーケ種の全ての花を均一な色味に
育てることは難しく、特に紫など非原色系の
花は色がぶれやすいため高い技術が必要である
MsgEn:
Mandragora with endemic flowers growing in
clusters.
The color variation of Mandra Flowers is
extremely delicate.
It is difficult to raise all the flowers of the
Mandra Bouquet species to a uniform color,
especially non-primary colors like purple, as the
color easily becomes blurred, requiring high skill
and expertise.

MsgJp:
異国の落葉樹が生えたマンドラゴラ
雑多な種子らの中から芽生えた異国の苗木は
種子から推定すると花を持つ落葉樹と思われる
この樹木は豊富な有機肥料と無機肥料そして
時折の水分補給によって美しく開花するという
MsgEn:
Mandragora with an exotic deciduous tree
sprouting from a miscellany of seeds.
The exotic sapling appears to be a flowering
deciduous tree based on the seeds.
The tree blooms beautifully with abundant organic
and inorganic fertilizer and occasional hydration.

MsgJp:
異国の樹花を咲かせたマンドラゴラ
花芽の生育期には水を豊富に与え、邪魔な枝を
剪定することで満開の花を咲かせることできる
この樹花を持つマンドラゴラはその花や香りで
周囲の生き物の心を和ませ、穏やかにする
MsgEn:
Mandragora with exotic tree blossoms.
The flowering buds can be watered abundantly
during the growing season and pruned out of the
way to allow for full bloom.
Mandragora with these blossoms will soothe and
calm surrounding creatures with its flowers and
scent.

MsgJp:
異国の樹花が満開に咲いたマンドラゴラ
この樹花の花弁が散る姿は異国情緒があり
一部の愛好家たちに絶大な支持を得ている
花を同時に満開にさせるには
観賞できる期間も短いため非常に価値が高い
MsgEn:
Mandragora with exotic tree flowers in full bloom
The petals of this tree flower falling is exotic.
It has a huge following among some enthusiasts.
Is very valuable because of the short time it can
be viewed with the flowers in full bloom at the
same time.

MsgJp:
侵食キノコを成したマンドラゴラ
怪しく艶やかなその傘は、しばしば暗闇で
人々を驚かせるため"ゴーストマッシュ"とも
呼ばれているが、生態には特筆すべき点は無く
染めたい色の色素を集中して与えればよい
MsgEn:
Mandragora forming an invasive mushroom.
Its suspiciously glossy umbrella often startles
people in the dark, hence the name "ghost
mushroom", but there is nothing special about its
ecology.
Just give it a concentrated amount of dye of the
color you want to dye it with.

MsgJp:
侵食キノコを成したマンドラゴラ
その漆黒の傘は有害物などで出来ており
衛生的にあまり良いとは言えないものである
しかし、本人はあまり一般的ではない渋い色に
誇りをもっているため非常に扱いにくい性格
MsgEn:
Mandragora grown from corrupted mushrooms.
Its pitch-black umbrella is made of hazardous
material, and it is not hygienically suitable.
However, the individual takes pride in its
unconventional, deep color, making it a
challenging personality to handle.

MsgJp:
侵食キノコを成したマンドラゴラ
自然に馴染む茶色い傘は柔らかく水分を含み
商店などでも野菜として並び始めている
水分や成長剤などで容易に育ち

MsgJp:
レスタニア中部に広がる大平原
白竜が墜ちた地として神殿が築かれ、人々が集った
ことから、全ての民にとって寄り所と言える地域に
なった。そのため、比較的魔物の勢力は弱いが
オークなど強力な魔物の侵入は脅威となる
MsgEn:
A large plain spread across central Lestania.
A temple was built where the White Dragon fell,
and it became an area that can be said
to be a stronghold for all people.
Therefore, although nearby monsters
are relatively weak, the intrusion of more
powerful demons such as Orcs pose a threat.

MsgJp:
白竜が座すレスタニアの中心地
覚者と白騎団の本拠地であるだけでなく、神殿周囲
には商店区、宿場区、港が築かれ都市となった
３００年に渡り、人々はこの地で竜に寄り添い
暮らしを営んでいる
MsgEn:
Not only the home of the Arisen,
the White Dragon sits at the center of Lestania.
With a temple built around them,
over 300 years a bustling city grew,
with a relay station, harbor,
and shopping district.

MsgJp:
ハイデル平原南部に位置する村
ワインなど果実酒造りが盛んだったが、近年は不作
と原因不明の病により活力が落ちつつある
この異変には、廃屋化したハイデル教会が何らか
の形で関わるのではと噂されている
MsgEn:
A village located in the southern part
of Hidell Plains. Viticulture of fruit wines
was a thriving trade, but in recent years,
trade and health have declined from bad crop
harvests and a mysterious disease.
After rumors about the nearby Hidell Chapel's
involvement surfaced, the chapel has since
been abandoned.

MsgJp:
ハイデル平原とミスリウ森林を繋ぐ橋は以前の
水害で損壊したが、テルで資材手配が可能
となり、ようやく修復された
これでポーン郷、リンウッド方面との往来は
回復するだろう
MsgEn:
The bridge that formerly had connected
the Hidell Plains and Mysree Forest
was destroyed by flood damage,
but resources can be arranged at Tel Village
to repair the broken bridge.
With this, the traffic to and from
Lynwood will be restored.

MsgJp:
ハイデル南部、テル村に近い石造りの橋
ダウ渓谷方面との往来が盛んだった頃、この橋を通る
行商人が多かったことから、その襲撃に味を
しめたゴブリンにより度々占拠されるようになった
退治する者と小鬼のイタチごっこは現在も続いている
MsgEn:
A stone bridge near Tel Village
in Southern Hidell. When traffic to and from
Dowe Valley was thriving, there were many
peddlers passing through this bridge,
which led goblins to occasionally occupy it.
Those who exterminate the small demons
on the bridge may still continue to do so.

MsgJp:
テルの東にあるハイデル教会地下墓地
以前は祈りの場として訪れる者も多かったが
廃屋化して後、扉が開かれたことはない
夜間徘徊する亡者の目撃談もあり、今では誰も
教会に近づかなくなっている
MsgEn:
Hidell Chapel catacombs located to the east
of Tel village. Previously visited by many
as a place of prayer, the doors to the catacombs
have not been opened since its abandonment.
Eyewitnesses report sighting the deceased
wandering the grounds at night;
nobody has approached chapel since.

MsgJp:
テル村、廃墟の地下倉庫に存在する目的不明の
地下道。民家の地下室にこのような場所がある
ことを巡り、その昔ある事件があったらしいが
語る者はおらず、忘れられようとしている
MsgEn:
An underground warehouse of unknown purpose
near Tel village, which exists in the ruins.
There is a place like this in the basement
of many a house, but there seems to have been
an incident in the past, and there is no one
to speak of it, as it is trying to be forgotten.

MsgJp:
平原中央付近の河原。グリッテン砦以北の川上から
さまざまな物――戦場の残がいや遺体――が流れ
つくことから、その名で呼ばれるようになった
血の臭いに魅かれたリザードマンが棲みつくように
なり、現在は危険地域に指定されている
MsgEn:
The riverbank near the central plains.
It came to be called that because various things,
such as remnants of battlefields and corpses,
flowed down from the upstream of the river
north of Fort Gritten.
Saurians, who were drawn to the smell of blood,
settled there and it is now designated as a
dangerous area.

MsgJp:
ハイデル街道全域を脅かす野盗《黒狼団》のアジト
強力な首領が束ねており、騎士団や覚者と度々
衝突してきた。結果、アジトは戦陣のように物物しく
なっている。街道を通る際は彼らへの警戒を
忘れてはならない
MsgEn:
The hideout of the bandit group "Black Wolf Gang"
threatens the entire Hidell Highway.
They are led by a powerful leader and have
frequently clashed with the Knight Order
and the Arisen. As a result,
their hideout has become like a battlefield.
When passing through the highway,
one must not forget caution.

MsgJp:
ハイデル地下霊廟には、疫病で死んだ者や罪人
のみを埋葬する下層階が存在する
より強い瘴気が溜まっており、特別な用でも
ない限り足を踏み入れるべき場所ではない
MsgEn:
In the Hidell Catacombs, there is a lower level
where only those who died from disease
or criminals are buried.
It accumulates a stronger miasma,
so it is not a place to step into lightly
without a special reason.

MsgJp:
ハイデル地下霊廟には秘密の最下層があり
邪教の礼拝堂があるとも噂されていた
その噂は過去にテルで起こった事件から
発したものであるらしいが、真相は不明
MsgEn:
In the Hidell Catacombs, there is said to exist
a secret lowest level; it is rumored
to be used as a cult's chapel.
The origin of this rumor seems to stem
from an incident that occurred in Tel in the past,
but the truth remains unknown.

MsgJp:
テルの西、《アーク》に近い通路
元は特筆すべきこともないただの通路だったが
付近を通りかかった人々から、ここで耳慣れぬ
金属が擦れるような音を聞いたという噂が
流れ始めたため、調査の対象となった
MsgEn:
In the western part of Tel, near the Ark,
there was a passage with nothing particularly
notable about it.
However, rumors started circulating among
the people who passed by that they heard
unfamiliar sounds, like the scraping of metal,
coming from this hallway. Because of this,
it became the subject of investigation.

MsgJp:
旧時代、各地に祭られた白竜の祭壇の一つ
動乱のおりに一度は廃墟化したものの
現在は見習い騎士や新人覚者の修行場として
新たな役割を担っている
MsgEn:
In the olden days, one of the altars of
the White Dragon, worshiped in various places,
was once in ruins during the upheavals.
However, it is now fulfilling a new role
as a training ground for apprentice knights
and novice Arisen.

MsgJp:
テル村の外れにある廃屋の地下室
度々周囲で魔物が目撃され、夜は不気味な
物音が響くこともしばしば
今では近寄る者はほとんどいない
MsgEn:
The basement of an abandoned house
on the outskirts of Tel Village.
Frequently, monsters are sighted in the area,
and at night, eerie sounds are often heard.
Nowadays, hardly anyone approaches it.

MsgJp:
ハイデル平原とミスリウ森林を繋ぐ自然洞窟
以前は狩人により頻繁に使われていたが
テルの南に橋が建造されてからは安全面の
問題から立ち入り禁止になっていた
MsgEn:
The natural cave that connects the Hidell Plains
and Mysree Forest was previously
frequently used by hunters.
However, since a bridge was built south of Tel,
it has been prohibited to enter
due to safety concerns.

MsgJp:
テル村の裏手にある枯れ井戸
使われなくなって久しいが、たまに妙な物音
や悪臭が中から漂ってくることがある
MsgEn:
A dried up well behind Tel village.
It has been unusable for a long time,
but occasionally strange sounds and rank odors
may drift out from inside.

MsgJp:
ハイデル街道の傍にある枯れ井戸
リザードマンや、時にはさらに恐ろしい魔物が
潜伏していることもある
まだ見習いの覚者や騎士は、下手に内部を
探査しないほうがよい
MsgEn:
Next to Hidell Road, there is a dried-up well.
Sometimes, Saurians or even more
terrifying enemies lurk around.
Apprentice Arisen and Knights are advised
not to venture into its depths without caution.

MsgJp:
ハイデル平原、グリッテン砦に近い川沿いの
小墓地。古い時代から存在しており、それほど
広くないものの現在は彷徨う死者の目撃例が
絶えず、近寄る者はいない
MsgEn:
A small cemetery along the river
near Fort Gritten in Hidell Plains.
It has existed since ancient times and,
although not very large, there are constant
sightings of wandering souls.
No one dares to approach.

MsgJp:
ハイデル平原、倒壊した家の地下室
周囲に猿獣が群れていることが多いため
内部にも入り込んでいる可能性が高い
MsgEn:
The basement of a collapsed house
in the Hidell Plains. Brute apes are often
seen flocking around the cellar,
so it is highly probable they are also inside.

MsgJp:
天空より飛来した異様な石の塊《大石塊》
圧倒的な存在感は他に比類するものがなく、この
物体が現在レスタニアに存在するあらゆる技術
魔術の域を大きく凌駕していることは間違いない
MsgEn:
A massive boulder-like object that descended
from the sky, with an incomparable,
overwhelming presence.
There is no doubt that this object surpasses
all existing technological advancements
and magickal artes in Lestania.

MsgJp:
<COL ffdc78>【宝飾】の扉あり</COL>
テルの西に落下したアークの裏側から続く別階層
表側とは異なり、こちらには恐るべき危険性を
秘めた大型の錬魔も確認されたという。後に神殿を
攻める足がかりとして準備されていた可能性がある
MsgEn:
<COL ffdc78>A door requiring a "Jewelry" key.</COL>
Another layer that continues from the back
of the Ark that fell west of Tel.
This passage is far more dangerous
than the front. A strange odor is present
here as well. It's possible that this location
was prepared as a foothold in case of attack.

MsgJp:
レスタニア西部の海岸地帯
白い砂浜が続く景色は美しいが、時には思いも
よらぬものが浜辺に流れ着くことも。温暖で湿った
気候から、乾燥しがちのハイデル平原とは植生や
生息する魔物も異なる
MsgEn:
A coastal zone in western Lestania.
The view of the white sandy beach is beautiful.
With its dry climate, the flora and fauna
found there differs from the Hidell Plains.

MsgJp:
ブリア海岸地域の漁村
比較的おだやかな環境に恵まれ、海が近く人々も
おおらか。しかし、海が村にもたらすものは魚や貝
だけではない。座礁船や、時には海竜といった脅威
が姿を現すこともある
MsgEn:
Breya Coast region's fishing village.
It is blessed with a relatively calm environment
and a close proximity to the sea,
making the people easy-going.
However, what the sea brings in
to the village is not just fish and shellfish.
There are also threats such as stranded ships
and sometimes even sea dragons that appear.

MsgJp:
ブリア海岸の岬に立つ古い灯台
洋撃船や漁船の標として、レスタニアの海を
照らし続けてきた。灯台守は代々、退役騎士が
務める習わしとなっており、現在の守番は高名な
《シールドセージ》、ルドルフォである
MsgEn:
The old lighthouse on the cape of Breya Coast.
Shining over the sea of Lestania as a beacon
for foreign ships and fishing boats.
It is a tradition for retired knights
to serve as lighthouse keepers, and the current
guardian is the renowned Shield Sage, Rudolfo.

MsgJp:
ローテスに近い岸壁裏の小さな浜
人目に付きにくく、村や街道にも近いため、ならず者
が野宿をしたり盗品の一時保管に使う事も多い
覚者がローテスに立ち寄った際は、浜に異変がないか
確認しておいたほうがいい
MsgEn:
A small beach behind the quay near Rotes.
It is hidden from view and close to the village
and the road, so it is often used by rogues
to camp out and temporarily store stolen goods.
When Arisen stop by Rotes, they should check
the beach to see if there is anything unusual.

MsgJp:
ブリア海岸、岬に近い断崖地帯の大岩群
多数のハーピーが棲息しており、彼女らの巣が
密集していることから、村人達からその名で呼ばれて
いる。灯台に用がある時以外、鳥寄せ岩の付近を
通らぬよう村人は子供の頃から教えられている
MsgEn:
An outcropping of rocks in the cliff area
near the cape of the Breya Coast.
Infested by Harpies, it is rife with their nests.
As a result, it has been dubbed "Birdcall Rock".
The villagers have been taught since childhood
not to pass near Birdcall Rock unless
they have business at the lighthouse.

MsgJp:
海辺にある朽ちた廃屋の地下倉庫
魔物やならず者の溜まり場になりやすい
ことから封鎖されたが、何者かが侵入
したらしい形跡や物音が最近しばしば
確認されている
MsgEn:
An abandoned underground storehouse
beneath a decaying shack by the seaside.
Monsters and rogues tend to gather here, 
which is why it was sealed off.
However, there have recently been sightings
of a trespasser and strange noises.

MsgJp:
南の海岸へ続く谷道にある、小鬼のキャンプ地
残虐で体格の大きなホブゴブリンの目撃があり
村人にとって不安の種となっている
また、このキャンプを境に南側は強力な魔物が
多いため、むやみに近づかない方がいい
MsgEn:
There have been sightings of vicious
Hobgoblins in the valley path leading
to the southern coast, where the 
smaller goblins have set up their camp.
This has become a cause of concern
for the villagers. Additionally, there are
powerful enemies to south of this camp,
so it is best to remain cautious.

MsgJp:
数十年以上昔に魔物に襲われ、廃村と化した集落
白竜の力が弱まって後、恐ろしい魔物の襲撃にあい
抵抗の術もないまま一夜にして滅んだらしいが、
現在は当時の本当の経緯を知る者はいない
MsgEn:
Decades ago, this village was attacked
by monsters and abandoned.
After the power of the White Dragon waned,
the village suffered a terrifying monster raid.
It is said that the village was destroyed
overnight without any means of resistance.
But no survivors remain to tell the tale.

MsgJp:
ブリア海岸、南部に広がる浜辺
かつてはここも漁民にとって生活の場であったが
今や完全に魔物が徘徊する危険地帯となっている
特に近頃は大型の魔物が居付いてしまったようだ
MsgEn:
A beach that stretches out
in the southern part of Breya Coast.
Though fishermen once resided here,
it has since become the domain of beasts.
Lately, the monstrosities here have further
grown in size and strength.

MsgJp:
ブリア海岸のはずれ、断崖の中腹に入り口を
もつ自然洞窟。絶えず水音が聞こえることから
潮騒洞窟と呼ばれ、奥の滝は霊験あらたかとの
噂だが、ある事件をきっかけに封鎖されていた
MsgEn:
On the edge of the Breya coast,
midway 'twixt the clifftop and waves
lies the entrance to a natural cave. 
It is known as the Roaring Tide Cave
due to the constant sound of rushing water.
There are rumors that the waterfall deep
within it possesses a mysterious power.
However, following an incident,
it has been sealed off.

MsgJp:
《灯台下の古井戸》を覗き込んだ者が何か煌めく
ものを見たという噂が流れたが、古井戸の中には
投げ捨てられた廃棄物や動物の死骸などもどこかに
溜まっているであろうことから、内部に入ってまで
噂の元を探ろうとする者はいないようだ
MsgEn:
Rumors say that if one peers down
the "Lighthouse Old Well",
a slight glimmer can scarce be made out.
However, the accumulated waste 
and animal effluvia ward away any who would
be willing to investigate.

MsgJp:
モルトバ灯台の傍にある古井戸
水が引いて後はリザードマンなどの魔物が
出入りするようになった
機能しているかは不明だが、魔物の侵入を
防ぐための古い装置が残っている
MsgEn:
An old well next to the Moltova Lighthouse.
Long gone dry, numerous Saurians have made
their nests here. There are still old traps
that might deter Saurians and their ilk,
though it is unclear if they still function.

MsgJp:
青爪浜にある廃村ルフローの地下室
ブリア海岸の奥は強力な魔物が多いため
とっさに逃げ場のない地下室の探索時は
準備をしておく方がいいだろう
MsgEn:
It would be wise to prepare before exploring 
what lays beneath the deserted village
of Ruflow in Blueclaw Beach.
The depths of Breya Coast are home
to many powerful enemies.

MsgJp:
<COL ffdc78>【竜力】の扉あり</COL>
ブリア海岸傍の灯台下の井戸の中に入口が発見された
忘れられた古代の水路遺跡。長く閉鎖され未踏の地
であったため、独自の生態系を保持した環境と
なっているようだ
MsgEn:
<COL ffdc78>【Dragon Force】Door</COL>
An entrance has been discovered within a well
beneath the lighthouse near the Breya Coast.
It seems an ancient aqueduct,
long ago forgotten. A unique ecosystem
has arisen in mankind's absence.

MsgJp:
レスタニア南部の広大な森林
多くの動植物、人、そして魔物が住み、それを可能
にするだけの恵みに満ちている。また、森のいたる
所に自然洞窟や旧時代の遺跡なども存在するため
探索には事欠かない地域である
MsgEn:
A vast forest in southern Lestania.
A rich land with a wide variety of animals,
plants, people, and creatures.
Moreover, the terrain is adorned
with natural caves and ancient ruins
scattered throughout, making it ideal
for exploration.

MsgJp:
ポーンの民が集い、新しき覚者との契約を待つ聖堂
聖堂はレスタニアと異界との接点を守るために
偉大な覚者が大昔建造したと伝えられている
現在は里長アルヴァーが管理者を務めており
《プリースト》の導き手カミュも滞在している
MsgEn:
The holy temple where pawns gather,
awaiting a contract with the newly Arisen.
It is said that the temple was built
by a great Arisen in ancient times to strengthen
the bonds between Lestania and other realms.
Currently, it is managed by the village elder,
Alvar, and the Priest, Camus, who resides there.

MsgJp:
ミスリウ森林中部にある、狩人と木こりの村
獣革や木材、薬草類など森は資源が豊富なため
素材を扱う者にとって重要な村である
ただし森には遺跡や自然洞窟も多く、そこをねぐら
とする魔物への警戒は常に必要だ
MsgEn:
A village of hunters and woodcutters.
Located in the centre of Mysree Forest,
this village is important for those who work
and trade in animal hides, lumber,
and medicinal herbs. However, the forest's ruins 
and natural caves serve as lairs for beasts.
Letting down one's guard is a risky proposition.

MsgJp:
魔女エメラダが住む森林の家
彼女に教えを請うことで
《ソーサラー》として破壊の魔術の
深淵により近づくことができるだろう
MsgEn:
The house in the forest where the Witch
Emerada lives. By seeking her guidance,
one can grow nearer the forbidden heart
of destructive magic treasured by Sorcerers.

MsgJp:
ポーン郷からリンウッド方面に繋がる
木造の橋。南ハイデル大橋と同時期の水害で
破損したが、住民の手が回らず復旧が遅れていた
放置された理由は、ポーン郷へ行く覚者の多くが
リム転移を用いるためらしい
MsgEn:
A wooden bridge that connects
from Pawn Cathedral to Lynwood.
Damaged during the same flood as the South
Hidell Bridge, restoration was delayed
as the residents lacked the resources.
The reason for its abandonment seems to be
because many Arisen who go to Pawn Cathedral
opt to use the Rift Teleport.

MsgJp:
森林北部にあるフォレストゴブリンの集落
カボチャの栽培や狩猟だけではなく、ここには
人や家畜を襲って得た物品も集められている
特に長である《緑鬼グリッガ》とその手下達は
好んで人を襲うため、警戒しなければならない
MsgEn:
A Forest Goblin settlement in the northern part
of the forest. In addition to pumpkin cultivation
and hunting, they also gather items
what they can from travelers and livestock.
In particular, Gurigga the Green Demon
and his minions, who are especially skilled,
relish preying upon those unwary,
so we must be cautious.

MsgJp:
祭祀場にはさまざまな魔物が出没するが、このほど
特に攻撃性の高いエントの出現が確認された
以前も起こったこの特異なエントの出現は
さらに大きな脅威に繋がる可能性がある
早急な討伐と監視が必要だ
MsgEn:
Various monsters have been appearing in the
ritual hall, but recently, the emergence of an
especially aggressive Ent has been confirmed.
The recurring appearance of this peculiar Ent
could potentially lead to an even greater threat.
Swift subjugation and surveillance are necessary.

MsgJp:
リンウッドほど近くにある地下水路
魔物が巣くい使われなくなって久しいが、以前は
この水路で河川の水位を調整し水害に備えていた
リンウッドが水路を閉鎖した後も魔物は増え、
時に凶暴な大猿が出没することもある
MsgEn:
An underground waterway near Lynwood.
Although long abandoned, in the past,
this waterway was used to adjust the water level
of the river to prepare for floods.
After Lynwood closed the waterway, the number
of monsters increased, and at times,
ferocious apes begin to haunt the area.

MsgJp:
注意すべきドレッドエイプ、《唸り猿》が
縄張りにしている廃屋
廃屋の周囲は食い散らかされた動物の残骸が
散乱しており、恐ろしい上非常に臭い――
MsgEn:
The Dread Ape, known as the "Howler Ape," has
taken over this abandoned house as its territory.
The surroundings of the abandoned house
are littered with cast-off remains
of devoured animals, making it both terrifying
and extremely foul-smelling.

MsgJp:
特に危険なドレッドエイプ、《裂き猿》が
巣くっている廃屋
廃屋の周囲は正体不明の死肉が散乱しており
不気味な様子を醸し出している
MsgEn:
In the rundown building where the ferocious
Dread Ape, "Ripper Ape," resides, there are
unidentified carcasses and offal scattered about,
an eerie atmosphere to be sure.

MsgJp:
とりわけ獰猛なドレッドエイプ、《豚喰い猿》が
ねぐらにしている廃屋
廃屋の周囲は攫われた家畜や野豚が
多数溜めこまれている
MsgEn:
The abandoned house that the particularly
ferocious Dread Ape, the "Pig-Eating Ape,"
has made its lair. Around the abandoned house 
lay the remains of numerous abducted livestock
and wild boars in varying states of decay.

MsgJp:
ミスリウ森林の外れに位置する広大な鍾乳洞
そのあまりの深さと、そこをねぐらにする
凶悪な魔獅子の存在から立ち入り禁止になった
奥にはさまざまな魔物や資源があるだろう
MsgEn:
Located on the outskirts of Mysree Forest
is a vast limestone cave.
Access to the cave has been prohibited
as it is incredibly deep and a demonic lion
that has made it their den.
There are likely many foes and useful treasures
laid deep within the winding caves.

MsgJp:
リンウッドからミスリウ森林深部へと向かう一本道の
中ほどにある、少し開けた場所。背の高い木々が多く
鬱蒼としている上に靄が出やすく、開けた印象の割に
視界が悪い。そのためか盗賊や魔物が潜みやすく
森を抜ける際の一番の難所と言われる
MsgEn:
In the middle of the road leading from
Lynwood to Mysree Grove in the Mysree Forest,
a clearing can be found. Here, there are many
tall trees shrouded in a dense fog.
Visibility is poor, making it easy for bandits
and enemies to prowl about, hidden in wait.
It is said to be the most challenging place
to pass through the forest.

MsgJp:
ポーンの民が渡る、この世ならざる空間
世界の淵辺にあたるとされ、普通の人間には足を
踏み入れるどころか、入口を見ることすらできない
"異界歩き"と呼ばれるポーンがなぜ覚者に応え
現れるのか、それを知るのは竜のみである
MsgEn:
The space where pawns wander,
a realm unlike this world.
Believed to exist on the edge of the world,
ordinary humans cannot see the entrance,
let alone step inside. Only the dragons know
why the pawns, called "striders of other worlds"
answer to the Arisen.

MsgJp:
ミスリウ森林南西の大洞窟
深部にある巨大空洞には、名の由来でもある
《燐光虫》という虫が棲息し、星空に迷い込んだかの
ような美しさであると言われる。しかし、鬼人や
エイプの住処ともなっており危険は大きい
MsgEn:
Mysree Forest, located in the southwest,
holds a truly massive cave.
Deep within lies a breathtaking vista
named after the "Glowworms" that reside there;
looking upon its heights is reminiscent
of getting lost in the starry sky. However,
it is also known to be a dangerous dwelling
for Demons and Apes.

MsgJp:
森の南部に位置する小洞窟
内部にはそこそこ開けた空間があり
魔獣の類が巣にしているらしい
時おり、外にまで唸り声が聞こえるという
MsgEn:
In the southern part of the forest,
there is a small cave. Inside, there is
a fair-sized passage in which magical beasts
have made their nests. Occasionally,
their growls echo forth from the depths.

MsgJp:
普通の人間には入口を見ることすらできない
世界の淵辺にあたるとされる空間の深層部
この空間がどのようにして成り立ち、どこに
続いていくのか未だ知る者はいない
MsgEn:
Invisible to ordinary folk,
it connects to a space considered to be
the edge of the world.
No one yet knows how this space is formed
or where it leads.

MsgJp:
<COL ffdc78>【宝飾】の扉あり</COL>
ミスリウ森林から深部へ続く洞穴に埋もれていた古い
地下墓地。夜間、どこからともなく森に現れる不死者
達はこの墳墓から彷徨い出たものらしい。長く封じら
れていたため、あまり見ない魔物が潜む可能性が高い
MsgEn:
<COL ffdc78>【Jewelry】Door</COL>
A hidden underground cemetery buried deep
within the caves leading from the Mysree Forest.
The undead that appear in the forest at night
seem to have emerged from this tomb.
In these rooms having been sealed long ago,
many adversaries likely await you.

MsgJp:
最大標高を誇るボルド山を主とした山岳地帯
鉱石の名産地であり、古くから採掘師と武具職人
にとっては中心地だった。さらに、現在活動
は見られないもののボルド山は火山であり、温泉や
毒を含んだ液体なども多く噴出する
MsgEn:
A mountainous region centered around
Mount Volden, which boasts the highest peak.
A rich mining site and a central location
for miners and blacksmiths since ancient times.
Although currently inactive, Mount Volden
often erupts a variety of substances,
from heated, mineral-rich groundwater,
to toxic sulfrous ooze.

MsgJp:
ボルド鉱山ふもとに広がる温泉町
湯あみ場《キノザ鉱泉》を中心に、古くから採掘者や
武具職人になじみの強い地として有名だった
近年鉱山に強力な魔物が出現したことで、
坑道の開発に支障をきたすようになった
MsgEn:
A hot spring town at the foot of Volden Mines.
It is famous for its strong connection to miners
and weapon craftsmen from ancient times.
In recent years, powerful enemies have
appeared in the mines, disrupting their trade.
The heart of this town is Kinoza Mineral Springs,
where people come to soak and relax.

MsgJp:
鉱山の町キノザを象徴する大温泉
労働者から富裕層まで男女問わず広く愛される
レスタニア随一の保養地である。３種ある浴室は
それぞれ内装や泉質が異なり、誰もが一度は
最高級の湯を夢見る
MsgEn:
The great hot spring that embodies
the mining town of Kinoza is considered
the finest resort in Lestania.
It is loved by all, from laborers to the wealthy.
There are three types of baths, which differ
in adornment and the quality of the water.
Everyone dreams of experiencing
the highest quality hot spring at least once.

MsgJp:
自然洞窟を利用したゴブリン族のねぐら
《貪欲のギルスタン》を王とし、多くのゴブリンが
洞穴に出入りしている。王の蒐集癖のせいか
生き残りのためか、洞穴に住まうゴブリン達は
人間との対立を避けているようだ
MsgEn:
Goblin tribe's lair, utilizing a natural cave.
Gilstan, the King of Greed, leads them.
Many goblins come and go from the cave.
Perhaps due to the king's hoarding habit
or for the sake of survival, the goblins dwelling
within seem to avoid confrontation with humans.

MsgJp:
ボルド鉱山とダウ渓谷の境には、南壁谷と
呼ばれる谷道があるが、その中ほどにあるのが
《南壁のひび》と呼ばれる洞窟である。採掘に
出向いた者がことごとく戻らなかったことから
キノザにより入り口は閉ざされた
MsgEn:
Southern Wall Gorge, on the border
between Volden Mines and Dowe Valley.
In the middle of that gorge is a cave
known as the Southern Wall Fissure.
Those who brave its depths to mine its quarry
have never returned, leading to its closure.

MsgJp:
レスタニア最大鉱山、中腹の坑道
最盛期には百人とも言われる鉱員が採掘に勤しん
でいたが、崩落と巨人の出現により閉山されて
いた。それでも良質鉱石の産地であることに
変わりなく、再開発を望む声は多い
MsgEn:
Lestania's largest mine, the tunnel
on the mountainside. During its heyday,
it was said that about a hundred miners
worked diligently in the excavation.
However, due to cave-ins and the appearance 
of encroaching Giants, it was closed down.
Nevertheless, it remains a steady source
of high-quality ore, and there are many
who hope for its redevelopment.

MsgJp:
ボルド小坑道へ続く山道。坑道に住む強力な
オーガ《坑道荒らし》の返り討ちに合い、派遣された
騎士団の骸が残されていることから、そう呼ばれて
いる。小坑道は採掘がまだ可能だが、現在は
近づく鉱員はほとんどいない
MsgEn:
The mountain path continues towards
the Volden Narrow Tunnels.
It is called so because the remains of a knight
from the old order were left behind after being
defeated by the powerful Ogre, "Tunnel Thief,"
who so aptly resides there. Although mining
is still possible in the narrow tunnels,
few miners are so foolhardy.

MsgJp:
ボルドの野盗、ムジナ団がアジトにする廃坑道
長らく封鎖されていたものの、鍵が破壊された
らしく再び盗賊の活動が活発化してきた
身ぐるみ剥がされる覚悟がなければ
近づかない方がよいだろう
MsgEn:
Volden's bandits, the Badger Gang,
has made an abandoned mine their hideout.
Sealed long ago, the lock was recently broken.
It seems that the activities of the thieves have
once again intensified. Pray, give a wide berth,
lest ye lose all ye own.

MsgJp:
山頂の小堂が無人化して後、グリフィンが居付き
巣を作ってしまった。そこには、レスタニア各地から
巨鷲の「目に適ったモノ」が集められており、その
多くは人力では撤去できないが、主の不在を狙えば
思わぬ宝物が手に入る――かもしれない
MsgEn:
After the summit chapel became unmanned,
a Griffin settled in and made its nest there.
The nest is littered with a wealth of baubles
whose glint caught the Griffin's eye.
Many of these items are too large to be quickly
carried off, but in the owner's absence,
one could possibly obtain a smaller trinket.

MsgJp:
《ボルド大坑道》の最奥、地層の硬さにより掘削が
見送られた洞穴部。数々の問題を解決して再開発を
行おうとした矢先、不気味な噂が流れて鉱員が
逃げ出し、再び開発の手が中断されることとなった
MsgEn:
In the depths of the Volden Large Tunnels,
mining was halted upon reaching bedrock.
While in the process of finding new veins,
eerie rumors were spread and the miners fled,
terminating all mining operations.

MsgJp:
キノザ近くに存在する元治水路
今は治水路としての機能はなく、鉱毒が溜まる
危険な場所になっている
向かうなら、毒への備えが必要だろう
MsgEn:
Former flood control channel
near Kinoza has many obstacles.
Formerly a drainage channel, 
it is now filled with toxic minerals.
If you plan to go there,
be amply prepared for poison.

MsgJp:
ボルド大坑道と同時期に開発された坑道
ここも以前は鉱員の出入りが多かったが
人喰い鬼が出現するようになり寂れてしまった
たびたび騎士団が派遣されているが
いまだ退治完了の報告はない
MsgEn:
This tunnel was developed around
the same time as the Volden Large Tunnels.
The appearance of man-eating demons
have put a halt to mining operations.
The knight order has been dispatched to investi-
gate, but progress is slow and the work bitter.

MsgJp:
周辺を荒らす悪鬼たちが群れる岩窟
ホボリックの小鬼達と対立するゴブリン集団
のほか、凶悪な人喰い鬼もこの洞窟をねぐら
にしている
MsgEn:
The evil demons that freely rampage
in the surrounding areas flock to the cavern.
In addition, there is a group of goblins
in conflict with the Hobgoblins
that also make this cave their lair.

Beware!

MsgJp:
ボルド大坑道で採掘が盛んだった頃
鉱員がダウ渓谷との連絡用に使っていた坑道
使われなくなって久しいものの、南壁谷の
道がなんらかの事情で塞がった場合は
唯一の交通路となる
MsgEn:
During the time when mining was thriving
in the Volden Large Tunnels,
miners used this tunnel as a means
of communication with Dowe Valley.
Although it has been unused for a long time,
it serves as the only passage if the 
Southern Wall Gorge road becomes blocked
due to any circumstances.

MsgJp:
旧時代、各地に祭られた白竜の祭壇の一つ
ボルド鉱山の頂き近くにあり、キノザからもその
姿を見ることができる。まだ参拝者もいるが
巨鳥が近くに巣くってしまい、悩みの種と
なっている
MsgEn:
In the past, White Dragon altars
were erected throughout the land.
One of them is located near the peak
of Volden Mines, and can be seen
from as far as Kinoza. There are still visitors,
but a giant bird has nested nearby recently,
causing much troubles and vexation.

MsgJp:
<COL ffdc78>【財宝】の扉あり</COL>
《ボルド大坑道》の内部で発見された旧坑道
地熱の影響で坑内の気温が非常に高くなることが
あり、鉱員により早期に封鎖されていた
内部で希少な鉱石が採れるのではと推測されている
MsgEn:
<COL ffdc78>【Treasure】Door</COL>
Inside the Volden Large Tunnels,
an old tunnel was discovered.
Geothermally active, the temperature inside
the tunnel is extremely high, and as a result
it was sealed off by miners early on.
Many speculate that rare minerals abound inside.

MsgJp:
平原と山岳地帯の中ほどに位置する大渓谷
渓流と針葉樹林の茂る美しい景観が最大の魅力
自然だけではなく、旧白騎団の古城、見張り塔
など遺構も数多く存在し、かつてここが繁栄の地で
あった事を偲ばせる
MsgEn:
A large valley located in the middle
of a plain and mountainous region.
The most significant charm of this place lies
in its beautiful landscape with flowing streams
and lush coniferous forests.
It's not only the natural beauty but also
the numerous remnants of the old
White Knights' castle, watchtowers,
and other structures that evoke memories
of the past prosperity of this area.

MsgJp:
険しい渓谷にしがみつくように残された小村
かつて、ドリード城主が健在だった時代は賑わって
いたが、北部オーク軍の動きが活発化した頃から
強力な魔物の襲撃もあり、徐々に人が離れた
しかし、景観や古城に魅せられる探訪者は多い
MsgEn:
Nestled in a treacherous ravine,
a small village ekes by. Once thriving
in the days when Lord Dreed ruled, it gradually
lost its inhabitants as the movements
of the Northern Orc army intensified.
Nevertheless, many visitors are still enchanted
by the scenery around the ancient Dreed Castle.

MsgJp:
ひょうきんな軽業師、チェスターが住む家
登ることと身ごなしにかけては卓越した
技能を誇る彼に師事すれば、《シーカー》
としてより高みを目指すことができるだろう
MsgEn:
The house where the playful acrobat Chester, 
who excels in climbing and agility, lives.
If you study under him, you will be able to aim
for greater heights as a Seeker.

MsgJp:
旧時代、ドリード城と周辺の警戒のため建てられた
監視塔。ダウが関所で封鎖される前は、騎士団詰め所
として前時代と同じく利用されていたが、侵入した
オーク軍との一戦により壊滅、再び廃墟と化した
現在は、死肉に集ったハーピーが占拠している
MsgEn:
In the olden days, a surveillance tower was built
to guard Dreed Castle and its surroundings.
Before Dowe was sealed off at the checkpoint,
it was used as a knights' headquarters, just like
in the previous era. However, it was destroyed
and turned into ruins again due to a battle
with the invading Orc army. Currently,
it is occupied by Harpies gathering dead flesh.

MsgJp:
ダウ渓谷の滝近くにある浅瀬。ここはもともと
サルファーリザードの棲息地帯だが、とりわけ
大きく強力な個体が確認された。この個体
《タイガーテール・サルファー》については
特に注意する必要がある
MsgEn:
There is a shallow area near the waterfall
in Dowe Valley. This place was originally
a habitat for Sulfur Saurians, but particularly
large and powerful individuals have been
confirmed. Special attention is needed for one
individual specifically, the "Sulfur Tiger-Tail."

MsgJp:
崖上にある自然洞窟
各種鉱石の採掘場として人の手が入った
時期もあるものの、過去に恐ろしい魔物
の住処となったことで封鎖されていた
MsgEn:
On the cliff, there is a natural cave that has
been used by human hands as a mining site for
various ores.
It has been sealed off due to becoming a dwelling
place for terrifying creatures in the past.

MsgJp:
ドリード城近くの地下墓地
城が白衛騎士団の本拠地であった頃、処罰された
罪人や獄死した者を葬っていた場所であり
今なお重く冷たい空気が漂っている
MsgEn:
Near Dreed Castle is an underground cemetery.
It was a place where convicted criminals
and those who died in prison were buried
when the castle served as the headquarters
of the White Knight Order. Even now,
a heavy and chilling atmosphere lingers.

MsgJp:
ダウ渓谷東部、最も標高の高い崖上に、石象の並ぶ
奇妙な空間がある。そこに、昔ジンゲンに甚大な
被害を出したスフィンクスが再び姿を現した
《妖歌のローレライ》と呼ばれるこのスフィンクスを
確認した際は、急ぎ手を打つ必要がある
MsgEn:
In the eastern part of the Dowe Valley,
on the highest cliff, there is a strange space
lined with stone statues. There, the sphinx
that once caused enormous damage to Jingen
has reappeared. This sphinx, known as the
"Demon Songstress Lorelei" must be dealt with
urgently if it is confirmed!

MsgJp:
ダウ渓谷、カタコンベ付近の木立
逃げ惑う姿勢のまま石と化した人影が木陰に
多数紛れているのが発見され、ジンゲンの
村人を恐怖に陥れた
MsgEn:
Numerous figures, frozen-like statues
in a posture of fleeing, were discovered
hidden among the trees near the Catacombs
in Dowe Valley. This discovery plunged
the villagers of Jingen into deep fear.

MsgJp:
廃墟の地下食糧庫。腐った食べ物を求めて
不死者がぞろぞろ入り込んだという噂があり
ジンゲンの民は気味悪がっている
MsgEn:
A ruined underground supply store.
Rumors have circulated that undead creatures
have swarmed in, seeking rotten food.
The people of Jingen are feeling uneasy about it.

MsgJp:
渓谷の一軒家の裏手にある井戸
まだ掘削中らしく、水源には届いて
いないようだ
MsgEn:
There is a well in the backyard of the Lone House
in the Valley.
It seems that they are still in the process of
digging, and it appears that they have not yet
reached the water source.

MsgJp:
ドリード城にほど近い廃墟の地下ワイン庫
かつては城に献上するワインが集められて
いたそうだが、現在は見る影もない
MsgEn:
The underground wine cellar,
located near Dreed Castle,
is now nothing more than a ruin.
It used to store wines that were once offered
to the castle, but now there is no sign
of its former glory.

MsgJp:
廃墟傍にある古井戸
なぜ「閉ざされた」と呼ばれているかに
ついては詳しく知られていない
MsgEn:
The old well near the ruins is called "closed,"
but the detailed reasons are not well known.

MsgJp:
ドリード監視塔の地下、かつて白衛騎士団
の詰め所だった跡地
ハイデルに神殿が築かれてからもダウを守る
要所だったが、二十年以上前オークに攻められ
無人になった。今も騎士の骸が彷徨っている
MsgEn:
Underground of the Dreed Watchtower,
the site of the former Headquarters
of the White Knight Order. It was a key point
in Dowe's fortifications even after the temple
was built in Hidell, but it was attacked
by Orcs over 20 years ago and left uninhabited.
The remains of the knights still wander around.

MsgJp:
ダウ渓谷、一軒家に近い崖際にある坑道
中には鉱員のなれの果てや野盗、小鬼
などが住みついている
ところどころ、爆薬があれば破壊できる
岩壁が存在する
MsgEn:
In the Dowe Valley, there is a tunnel
located near the cliff, close to a house.
Inside, miners, bandits, and small demons,
among others, have taken up residence.
There are occasional rock walls that can be
destroyed with explosives.

MsgJp:
旧時代、各地に祭られた白竜の祭壇の一つ
渓谷深くにひっそりとたたずんでいるが
風景と相まって廃墟化した今も美しさが残る
MsgEn:
In the olden days, this was one of the altars
of the White Dragon, which was celebrated
in various places. It stands quietly,
deep in the valley, but even now,
amidst its ruins, it retains its beauty,
blending in with the landscape.

MsgJp:
ダウ渓谷にそびえ立つ古城廃墟
３００年前は騎士団長が城主を務めレスタニアの
守りを担っていたが、白竜が墜ちた後に捨てられ
今に至る。内部には住みついた魔物だけでなく
旧時代の遺物も多く残されているらしい
MsgEn:
Standing tall in the Dowe Valley
is the ancient castle ruin. 300 years ago,
it was the stronghold of the knight commander
who protected Lestania. However, it was
abandoned after the fall of the White Dragon,
and it remains deserted to this day.
Inside, not only are there lurking demons,
but also numerous relics from the past era
are said to be preserved.

MsgJp:
ダウ平原中央に存在する水路跡
内部には川の水が流れ込んでおり、同時に周囲
に生息するサルファーリザードも多数
入りこんでいる
MsgEn:
Located in the central part of the Dowe Plains,
there is a trace of a water channel.
Inside, the water from the river flows in,
and at the same time, there are also many
Sulfur Saurians living in the surrounding area.

MsgJp:
かつて、ドリード城主がドリード監視塔と城を
繋ぐために作ったと言われる地下道
そのため入口の一つは塔の近くに、もう一つは
城のどこかと繋がっているらしい
罪人の墓地としても利用されたようだ
MsgEn:
It is said that the underground passage
was once created by the Lord of Dreed Castle
to connect the Dreed Watchtower and the castle.
As a result, one entrance is said to be near
the tower, and the other one is apparently
connected somewhere within the castle.
It appears that it was also used
as a graveyard for criminals.

MsgJp:
かつてドリード城からハイデルへの物資搬入
などに使われていた地下通路
ドリード城が捨てられると同時に封鎖され
現在は朽ちた物資もそのままになっている
MsgEn:
Once used for the transportation of goods
from Dreed Castle to Hidell,
an underground passage now lies sealed
since the abandonment of the castle,
leaving the decaying supplies untouched.

MsgJp:
ドリード城内、《地下通用口》から繋がる水路
もとはドリード城と河川の運搬路を繋ぐ連絡路
であったようだが、城の牢で獄死した者の骨や
入りこんだ魔物、瘴気が溜まり本来の機能は
失われて久しい
MsgEn:
An underground waterway connected
to the "Underground Side Entrance"
within Dreed Castle. Originally, it served
as a passage linking the castle and the river
for transportation purposes. However,
it has long lost its original function due to
the accumulation of bones of those
who perished in the castle's prison,
as well as the presence of invading monsters.

MsgJp:
<COL ffdc78>【宝飾】の扉あり</COL>
ダウ渓谷の北にある関所のすぐ裏手にある井戸
何年も前に井戸としての機能を失い、不便な場所に
あったこともあって、修理もされずに放置されていた
いつしかその存在すら忘れられていた
MsgEn:
<COL ffdc78>【Jewelry】 Door</COL>
There is a well located just behind
the Checkpoint to the north of Dowe Valley.
It lost its function as a well many years ago
and was left unattended due to its
inconvenient location. Its existence
had been forgotten over time.

MsgJp:
ミスリウ森林奥地の湿地林
イニアス湖を中心としたこの森は、リンウッド周辺
とはまた別の表情を見せる。湖の周囲には神秘的
な遺跡が点在し、ここが人とは異なる者の生活圏で
あったことを今に伝えている
MsgEn:
The Mysree Forest,
located deep in the wetland forest,
presents a different facade
from the surroundings of Lynwood.
Mysterious ruins are scattered around the lake,
telling us that this place was once a habitat
for beings different from humans.

MsgJp:
旧時代、各地に祭られた白竜の祭壇の一つ
ミスリウ森林深部を見守る管理者がおり
森深くを訪れる者にとっては大切な
憩いの場所である
MsgEn:
In the old days, there was a shrine
of the White Dragon that was celebrated
in various places.
In the deep part of Mysree Forest,
there is a guardian who watches over it,
and it is an important place for visitors
who delve into the depths of the forest
to find solace and relaxation.

MsgJp:
凄腕のマタギ、イヴァンが住む山小屋
彼の腕は《ハンター》としてレスタニア随一
であると、知る人ぞ知る有名人
だが気難しい性格のためか、戦技を教えて
もらえる者はまれらしい
MsgEn:
Ivan, a skilled Hunter,
resides in a mountain cabin.
His prowess as a Hunter is renowned
throughout all of Lestania.
However, due to his difficult personality,
it is rare for anyone to receive instruction
about his combat techniques.

MsgJp:
森林奥地へ続く山道の崩落が除かれた
これで、さらに深い樹林に踏み入ることも可能に
なった。奥地は秘境のため、十分準備をして
向かうべきだろう
MsgEn:
The collapsed mountain path that leads to
the depths of the forest has been cleared away.
With this, it is now possible to venture further
into the dense woods.
As its interior is an uncharted territory,
it would be advisable to make
thorough preparations before heading there.

MsgJp:
森林深部、イニアス湖の北岸に密猟者がキャンプを
構えている。たちの悪いことに、密猟者が獲物とする
のは獣だけではなく、狩人や旅人も含むという
不意の狙撃に合わぬよう、十分な警戒が必要だ
MsgEn:
In the deep part of the forest,
poachers have set up a camp
on the north shore of Lake Inias.
Unfortunately, the poachers target
not only animals as their prey,
but also hunters and travelers.
To avoid unexpected sniper attacks,
it is necessary to be vigilant and cautious.

MsgJp:
イニアス湖西側、浅瀬と草地の混じったこの場所は
ブルーニュートが多く出没する。その中で、近年
強力な電撃を纏った変異種が現れるようになった
これら《コバルトニュート》と遭遇した場合
討伐が推奨されている
MsgEn:
On the western side of Lake Inias,
in this area mixed with shallow waters
and meadows, there are many Blue Newts.
Among them, in recent years,
a mutated species enveloped in powerful
electric shocks has started to appear.
In case of an encounter with these
"Cobalt Newts," subdue them at once.

MsgJp:
住居跡らしき神秘的な遺跡
廃墟と化してなお、緑生い茂るたたずまいは
壮麗さを残している。内部には不思議な装置が
あり、奥に進むには仕組みの理解を要する
MsgEn:
Mysterious ruins that seem
to have served as a place of residence.
Even in its state of being in ruins,
it retains its splendid beauty,
with lush greenery surrounding it.
Inside, there are peculiar devices,
and understanding their mechanism
is necessary to proceed further.

MsgJp:
霊泉のテラス深部に純白の獅子が現れた
その姿は大理石のように淡く輝き、瞳と口は血と
魔力で赤く濡れているという。フォレストゴブリン
が聖獣として崇めるこの白獅子が村に出てゆく前に
何とか対処しなければならない
MsgEn:
A pure white lion appeared in the depths
of the Sacred Spring Terrace.
Its figure was pale and radiant like marble,
and its eyes and mouth were said to be wet
with blood and magick, creating a red hue.
This white lion, revered by the Forest Goblins
as a sacred beast, must be dealt with
before it leaves for the village.

MsgJp:
いつ存在し、いつ滅びたかも不明な廃村。村の
跡地は緑に覆われ、今や完全に人の気配はない
だが、付近で人のすすり泣きのような声を聞いた、
怪しい人影を見た、といった噂が狩人の間で
囁かれているらしい
MsgEn:
A deserted village whose purpose of existence
and demise are equally uncertain.
The site of the village is now covered
in greenery, and there is no trace
of human presence whatsoever.
However, there are rumors circulating
among Hunters that they have heard voices
resembling a person crying and have seen
suspicious figures nearby.

MsgJp:
森の南、ディナン山道への途中にトロールの寝所
がある。かつて覚者に撃退されしばらく姿を見せな
かった巨人ヨトンがどうやら戻ってきたらしい
人を憎み襲うこの巨人は非常に危険なため
近くを通る時は最大限の警戒が必要だ
MsgEn:
On the way to the Deenan Mountain Road
in the southern forest, there is a troll's territory.
The giant Jotun, who was once repelled
by an Arisen and had not been seen for a while,
seems to have returned.
This giant, who hates humans and attacks them
on sight, is extremely dangerous, so exercise
maximum caution when passing by.

MsgJp:
イニアス湖南側、《霧幻のテラス》付近にて
霞んだような人影に声をかけられたという噂が
続出するようになった。声に応じようとしても
返答が返ってくることはなく、その不気味さ故に
近くを通る者はさらに減少したという
MsgEn:
At Lake Inias on the southern side,
near the Misty Illusion Terrace,
rumors have been spreading that people have
been approached by a figure shrouded in mist.
Despite trying to respond to the voice,
there is no reply, which has only increased
the area's eerieiness and caused
even fewer people to pass by.

MsgJp:
緑に侵食された廃墟の地下倉庫
密猟者が、食糧の貯蔵や寝食に潜むことが
ある。近くには彼らのキャンプもあるため
可能であれば近づかないほうがよい
MsgEn:
Underground storehouse in the ruins,
overrun by greenery. Poachers may hide here
for food storage and rest.
Their camp is also nearby,
so it's best to avoid approaching if possible.

MsgJp:
ミスリウ森林深部、西側にある古い遺跡
内部もまた緑で覆われ、野獣や森小人が
現在の主となっている
MsgEn:
In the deep part of Mysree Forest,
there is an ancient ruin on the west side.
Its interior is also covered in greenery,
and animals and forest spirits
have become its current inhabitants.

MsgJp:
ミスリウ森林深部、南端にある遺跡
特に様々な森の獣が集まる場所であるが、
その理由は遺跡内に存在する霊泉の活力
によるものであるそうだ。また、その奥は
恐るべき白獅子の住処であったという
MsgEn:
In the deep depths of Mysree Forest,
located at the southern end is an ancient ruin.
It is particularly known as a gathering place
for various forest creatures.
The reason for this is said to be the vitality
of the sacred spring that exists within the ruins.
Furthermore, it is said that deep inside,
there was the dwelling of a fearsome white lion.

MsgJp:
<COL ffdc78>【昌石】の扉あり</COL>
ミスリウ深部、イニアス湖の南で新たに発見
された森民の遺跡。湖からくる湿気のせいか
白く靄がかかっている。靄は遺跡の外にまで
漏れ出し、全ての輪郭を朧にしている
MsgEn:
<COL ffdc78>【Gemstone】Door</COL>
A newly discovered forest tribal ruin in the
depths of Mysree, located south of Lake Inias.
Perhaps due to the moisture from the lake,
a white mist hangs in the air,
obscuring the outlines of everything,
even leaking beyond the boundaries of the ruin.

MsgJp:
レスタニア最奥、樹海に閉ざされた秘境
樹齢数百年にのぼる巨木が生い茂るこの森は
以前エルフ族が住み、その都を築いた場所である
森の名もまた、エルフ族の言語が元であると
言われている
MsgEn:
In the deepest part Lestania, there lies
a hidden paradise secluded in the forest.
This forest, over hundreds of years old,
is densely populated by towering ancient trees.
It used to be the home of the Elves,
where they built their capital city.
The name of the forest is also said
to originate from the language of the elves.

MsgJp:
ディナンの森唯一の住民が暮らす遺跡
エルフの文化や戦闘術を学びたい者に
とっては特に重要な拠点となるだろう
MsgEn:
The only inhabited site in the Deenan Forest.
An especially important base for those
who want to learn about Elven culture
and their art of warfare.

MsgJp:
エルフの言葉で"森の淀み"を意味するこの場所
には、汚れた土や不純な精気が溜まりやすい
という。それらは時に形を持ち魔物化する
ため、見かけた場合は討伐し浄化したほうがよい
MsgEn:
In the Elven language, this place means
"the stillness of the forest." It is prone
to accumulate unclean soil and impure energy.
Occasionally, these can take shape
and turn into enemies, so it is advisable
to defeat and cleanse them when encountered.

MsgJp:
エルフ族の大規模な住居跡
いくつもの広場や部屋で構成されており、相当数の
エルフがここで暮らしていたことを物語っている
遺跡内部には、特別な水を湛えた井戸が
あるという
MsgEn:
The remains of a large dwelling of the Elves.
Consisting of multiple plazas and rooms,
telling the story of a significant number
of Elves who once lived here.
Inside the ruins, there is said to be a well
with special water springing forth.

MsgJp:
ディナン南部を意味する河岸一帯
銀色の毛を持つ凶暴な猿鬼が徘徊するように
なったようだ
その銀の猿鬼は、エルフ族が森でもっとも
出会いたくない魔物筆頭であったらしい
MsgEn:
The riverbank area that signifies
the southern part of Deenan.
Seems to have become a place
where a ferocious monkey demon
with silver fur wanders.
It seems that this silvered demon
is the foremost creature that the Elves
did not want to encounter in the forest.

MsgJp:
ディナン低地には美しい霊水を湛えた泉がある
その生命力に魅かれ、度々肉体を持たぬ者が
彷徨い出ては命ある者に襲い掛るという
不自然に白い人影を見かけた場合、泉には
近寄らぬほうがいいだろう
MsgEn:
There is a spring in the lowlands of Deenan
that holds beautiful sacred water.
Drawn to its vitality, beings without
physical forms often wander and attack
those of the living.
If you happen to see a strangely white figure,
it's best to stay away from the spring.

MsgJp:
エルフの都《エルテ・ディナン》一角にあるという
住居群の一つ。広大な区画らしいが、長らく閉ざ
されており、内部がどうなっているかは不明
出入り口が閉ざされたのには、なにか理由が
あるのかもしれない
MsgEn:
One of a group of dwellings located
within a corner of the Erte Deenan,
the Elven capital. It appears to be a vast area,
but it has been closed off for a long time,
and what awaits in its interior remains unknown.
There may be a reason for the entrance
to be sealed.

MsgJp:
森の中でも有数の大樹がそびえ立つ広場
まるで大樹に守られているかのような静かな
空間だったが、突如この場で暴れはじめた
エントが確認され、状況は急変しつつある
MsgEn:
In a clearing where one of the largest trees
in the forest stands tall, it was a peaceful space
as if protected by the great tree.
However, suddenly, an Ent, a rare sight
in this area, started rampaging,
and the situation is rapidly changing.

MsgJp:
かつて森の民が使っていたディナン深層林と
ミスリウ森林を繋ぐ自然洞窟
長らく閉ざされていたため、内部が
どうなっているか知る者はいない
MsgEn:
A natural cave that connects the deep forests
of Deenan and Mysree, which were once used
by the people of the forest.
It has been closed off for a long time,
so no one knows what it looks like inside.

MsgJp:
ディナン深層林、南西にあるエルフ族の住居跡
聖なる泉、エルネア・スプリングに近い穏やかな
地のはずが、今や他と同じく野獣の住処に
なっている
MsgEn:
The remains of the Elves who once resided
in Deenan Woods, located in the southwest.
What used to be a peaceful land near the sacred
Elnea Spring has now become a dwelling
for wild animals, just like everywhere else.

MsgJp:
巨木に覆われ、緑の葉影が美しい遺跡
遺跡内に生えた巨木の中には、入る者
を拒みエント化したものもあるという
MsgEn:
Covered by towering trees, the ruins are adorned
with the beautiful shade of green leaves.
It is said that some of the gigantic trees
that grow within the ruins have become Ents,
refusing entry to anyone who approaches them.

MsgJp:
南部、水辺近くにあるエルフ族の住居跡
かつては水面に映る月が美しい場所であると
エルフ達の人気も高かったようだが、
今やその面影はない。水の運用に関しては
最も進んだ設備を備えていたらしい
MsgEn:
Dilapidated uins of the Elves' residence
near the water's edge in the southern region.
It used to be a beautiful place where
the moon reflected upon the water
was once highly esteemed by the Elves.
However, now there is no trace of that beauty.
It seems they had the most advanced facilities
for managing water.

MsgJp:
エルフ族が築いた壮麗なる都
しかし、エルフ族が姿を消して以降美しさはその
ままに、ゆっくり時と共に森に呑まれつつある
彼らの神秘的で精緻な技は、今なおエルテ・ディナン
のいたるところに遺されている
MsgEn:
A magnificent city built by the Elves.
Even after their disappearance,
their structures' beauty remains,
gradually being retaken by the forest
with the passage of time.
Their mystical and exquisite craftsmanship
is still left everywhere in Erte Deenan.

MsgJp:
どこかにあるという、エルフ達が築いた
美しい地下水路
遺跡で見つかった書物に存在が記されていた
MsgEn:
According to a book found in the ruins,
there is a beautiful underground waterway
built by the Elves somewhere in the area.

MsgJp:
エルフの都《エルテ・ディナン》内にある
区画の一つ。蝶印のついた鍵で閉ざされて
いるため、立ち入るのであればまずは
鍵の入手が必要になる
MsgEn:
Located within the Elven capital, "Erte Deenan,"
this is a section of the city.
In order to enter, one must first obtain a key
marked with a butterfly symbol.

MsgJp:
<COL ffdc78>【宝飾】の扉あり</COL>
深いディナンの森で新たに発見された森民の遺跡
鳥の鳴き声や羽ばたきが四方から響いている
内部はかなり複雑な構造になっているらしく、元は
エルテ・ディナンに次ぐ規模の居住区だったようだ
MsgEn:
<COL ffdc78>【Jewelry】Door</COL>
A recently discovered forest dwelling of the
forest people in the depths of Deenan.
The sounds of birds chirping and wings flapping
echo from all directions.
The interior seems to have a quite complex
structure, and it appears that it was once a
residential area of considerable size, second only
to Erte Dinan.
