お前、クラリッサに内緒で
あの侵食ベヘモットを
討伐してきてくれないか？
MsgEn:
Yeah. Can you, without letting Clarissa know, go
and defeat that Corrupted Behemoth for us?

MsgJp:
今までも大型の侵食魔を何体も
相手にしてきたお前なら、きっと倒せるはずだ！
こんな大物とやり合う機会もそう無いぞ！
どうだ？　気になったらあらためて声をかけてくれ
MsgEn:
You've faced numerous large Corrupted Beasts in
the past, and I believe you can defeat it!
Opportunities to challenge such a formidable foe
are rare. So, what do you say? If you're
interested, let me know, and we can discuss it
further.

MsgJp:
良いニュースがあるぞ！
調査が進んだことで
レスタニアからの物資を運ぶルートの整備も
ずいぶんと捗ってな！
MsgEn:
I have good news! With the progress of the
investigation, the maintenance of the route for
transporting supplies from Lestania is coming
along quite well!

MsgJp:
今後はより良い支援物資が安定して
送られてくるそうだ
これで、お前の隊も少しは楽になるだろう
MsgEn:
They're going to be sending a steady stream of
better relief supplies from now on.
This should make things a little easier on your
squad.

MsgJp:
それにしても、お前がいなければ
今頃この島の調査もここまでは進んで
いなかっただろう！
MsgEn:
Still, without you, we wouldn't have made this
much progress in our survey of the island by now!

MsgJp:
魔赤島調査にかける熱意、そして実力――
どれをとっても抜きんでた働きだ！
今後も期待しているぞ！
MsgEn:
The passion and skills dedicated to the
investigation of Bloodbane Isle are exceptional!
We are expecting great things in the future!

MsgJp:
俺のところに来るとはな――
話を聞こうじゃないか
MsgEn:
You've come to see me. 
Well, let's hear what you have
to say.

MsgJp:
自分が無知であることを知るのは難しいことだ
「己の無知を知っている」と思うこと自体が
そうでないことの証明かも知れないだろう
MsgEn:
It is difficult to know that one is ignorant.
Thinking "I know my own ignorance" 
might be evidence that it is not so.

MsgJp:
世界は一つではない――
こう聞いた時、お前は何を思う？
MsgEn:
There is more than one world. 
What do you think when you hear
this?

MsgJp:
自分の知らない国があるかも知れないと思うか？
それとも人々の相互理解の難しさを考えるか？
あるいは自分には見えない何かの存在を信じるか？
MsgEn:
Do you think that there might be countries you
don't know? Or do you think about the difficulty
of mutual understanding among people? 
Or do you believe in the existence of something
that you can't see?

MsgJp:
お前の見ている世界と
俺の見ている世界は違うかもしれないぜ
MsgEn: So don't hesitate, come here anytime.

MsgJp:
それを見ている人間が違うんだから
目に映る世界自体が違うと言えなくもないだろう
MsgEn:
Since the person looking at it is different, 
it could be said that the world that
is reflected in their eyes is itself different.

MsgJp:
お前はもっとたくさんのことを
知るようになるだろう――
MsgEn: You will come to know more things.

MsgJp:
知識が増える、といったことじゃない
お前の目はたくさんの世界を見ることになる――
そう、何かを追い求める限りな
MsgEn:
It's not about gaining knowledge.
Your eyes will see many worlds— 
Yes, as long as you pursue
something.

MsgJp:
お前の身体はひとつだ――
いかな勇者とてそれは変わらない
MsgEn:
Your body is one, and no amount of bravery will
change that.

MsgJp:
まずは、挑むべき試練に集中するべきだ
慌てる事はない
MsgEn:
First, we should focus on the trials we need to
take on. No need to panic.

MsgJp: これはこれは、レスタニアの覚者様
MsgEn: Well met, Arisen of Lestania.

MsgJp:
レスタニアの方の目には
フィンダムはどのように映るのですか？
MsgEn: How does Phindym appear to the people of Lestania?

MsgJp:
私はフィンダムが気に入っていますよ
いえ、他の地に赴いたことはありませんが――
MsgEn:
I like Phindym. No, I have never been to another
country—

MsgJp:
ここを離れることはおろか
フィンダム以外の地があることすら知りませんでした
私にとっての唯一の場所なのです
MsgEn:
Not only leaving this place, but I didn't even
know that there were other places besides Phindym.
It is the only place for me.

MsgJp:
視線が気になりますか？
何せ我々はレスタニアの人々を初めて見るもので――
MsgEn:
Are you concerned about the stares? After all, we
are seeing the people of Lestania for the first
time.

MsgJp: ん？　何か用かな？
MsgEn: Hmm? Do you need something?

MsgJp:
レスタニア――
不思議な響きだな
新鮮な感じがするよ
MsgEn:
Lestania— It has a mysterious sound, It feels
fresh.

MsgJp:
僕は旅好きでね
親には良い顔をされなかったけど
しばらくダナを離れて色んなところを回ったんだ
MsgEn:
I love traveling, you know. Even though my
parents didn't approve of it, I traveled to
various places for a while, leaving Dana behind.

MsgJp:
いつかレスタニアにも行ってみたいものだな
自分の知らない場所があると思うと
それだけでワクワクしてくるよ
MsgEn:
I would like to visit Lestania someday. It
excites me just thinking about unknown places.

MsgJp:
いつか、レスタニアの話を
ゆっくり聞かせてくれ
君らの手が空いた時でいい
MsgEn:
One day, when you have a moment, please take your
time to tell me about Lestania.

MsgJp: あっ、レスタニアの覚者さん！
MsgEn: Ah, Lestania's Ser Arisen!

MsgJp:
ボク、鳥を飼ってたんだ
でも連れてこられなくて――
元気にしてるかなぁ――
MsgEn:
I used to have a bird, but I couldn't bring it
with me... I wonder if it's doing well...

MsgJp:
ボクもおばあちゃんも、別の村に住んでたんだ
侵食のせいで住めなくなっちゃって――
それでここに逃げてきたんだよ
MsgEn:
Both me and my grandmother were living in a
different village. We couldn't live there anymore,
because of the corruption. That's why we came here
to escape.

MsgJp:
おばあちゃんはいつか帰れるっていうけど
ホントかな――
MsgEn:
They say grandma will come home someday. I wonder
if that's true—

MsgJp:
角が珍しい？
触ってもいいよ
MsgEn:
Is it unusual to have horns? You can touch if you
want.

MsgJp:
――レスタニアの人って
角が無くて困らないの？
何かスカスカした感じ、しない？
MsgEn:
Don't Lestanians find it hard
living without horns? Doesn't it
feel like something's missing?

MsgJp:
最近は変なことばかり――
これから一体どうなるんだろうね――
MsgEn:
Lately, there have been nothing but strange
things happening - I wonder what will happen from
now on.

MsgJp:
おぞましい魔物が現れたり、
異世界の覚者が来たり――
一体どうなっているのやら
MsgEn:
Hideous monsters appear,
Arisen ones from another world come--
What on is happening?

MsgJp:
いえ、あなた方を悪く言うつもりはなくてね
ただ、心配なだけで――
MsgEn:
No, I don't intend to speak ill of you all. I'm
just worried, that's all...

MsgJp:
私はね、私の家族を守りたいんだよ
孫を守るためならなんだってするし
孫を連れてどこまでも逃げるよ
MsgEn:
I, you know, I want to protect my family. I'll do
anything to protect my grandchildren. I'll run
away with my grandchildren anywhere.

MsgJp:
心配性かも知れないけど、
何よりも孫が大切なんだ――
誰にだってそういうもの、あるだろ？
MsgEn:
I may be anxious, but above all, my grandchildren
are important— Everyone has something like that,
don't they?

MsgJp:
大切なものを守りたいっていう気持ちは
誰にだってあるものさ
失ってしまったら自分がどうなるかわからない
そんな大切なものが――
MsgEn:
The feeling of wanting to protect something
important is something that everyone has. If we
were to lose it, we wouldn't know what would
become of ourselves. That's how precious it is -

MsgJp:
あら、レスタニアの方
河を渡りたいのかしら？
MsgEn:
Oh, you're the one from Lestania. Want to cross
the river?

MsgJp:
トレアサにはもうお会いになった？
彼女、少し人見知りなんだけど
本当はとっても良い人なのよ
真面目で、温厚で、仕事熱心で――
MsgEn:
Have you met Treasa already? She's a bit shy,
but she's actually a very nice person. She's
diligent, gentle, and dedicated to her work.

MsgJp:
ここ、エラン水林は
綺麗なところでしょう？
空気も清浄で――
MsgEn:
Here; Elan Water Grove is a beautiful place,
right? The air is also clean――

MsgJp:
やっぱり水が多いからなのかしら？
ね、船の上で深呼吸してみて
きっと気持ちがいいわ
MsgEn:
Is it because there is a lot of water after all?
Well, try taking a deep breath on the boat. It
will surely feel good.

MsgJp:
はぁ、何だかお腹減ってきちゃった――
結構力仕事なのよねぇ
MsgEn:
Ugh, I'm starting to get hungry... It's quite a
physically demanding job, you know.

MsgJp: 何か御用？
MsgEn: Do you need something?

MsgJp:
ミューセルお姉様は、その、ちょっと――
考え事や調べ物に熱中されがちだから
わたしができることはお手伝いしてるの
MsgEn:
Sister Mucel tends to be a bit—absorbed in her
thoughts and research, so I try to help where I
can.

MsgJp:
あまりミューセルお姉様の手を
煩わせることはしないでね
MsgEn: Please don't bother Suster Muselle too much

MsgJp:
わたしがミューセルお姉様の弟子なのかって？
違うわ
――そうなれたらいいんだけど
MsgEn:
Am I Sister Mucel's disciple? No, that's not it.
――I wish I could be though.

MsgJp:
狭いところだけど、旅人さん用の寝床もあるの
お代として<VAL PRICE_INN>もらうけど
いいかしら？
MsgEn:
It's a small place, but there is a sleeping space
for travelers as well. I will take <VAL PRICE_INN>
as payment, is that okay with you?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
旅人さん用の寝床も
毎日ちゃんと整えてるのよ
泊まっていくの？
MsgEn:
We also have a sleeping area for travelers and we
set it up properly every day.
Are you staying the night?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
《弱化の治療》、ね！
ミューセルお姉様に教えてもらったから
ちゃんとできるはず――！
お代は<VAL PRICE_WEAK>よ、どうする？
MsgEn:
"Treat Weakness," right? I learned it from Miss
Mucel, so I should be able to do it properly!
It'll cost you <VAL PRICE_WEAK>. What do you say?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
うーん？
弱化してないみたいだけど――
気分が優れないなら
少し休んでいくのはどうかしら
MsgEn:
Huh? It seems you're not weakened, but if you're
not feeling well, maybe taking a little rest would
be a good idea.

MsgJp:
レスタニアの覚者か
どうかしたか？
MsgEn:
Is it the Arisen of Lestania? Is there something
wrong?

MsgJp:
レスタニアには覚者がたくさんいるって？
――レスタニアの竜は、覚者を一人に
選びきれなかったのか？
MsgEn:
Are there many Arisen in Lestania? - The dragon
of Lestania couldn't choose just one Arisen?

MsgJp:
俺は覚者ではないが、
精霊竜とフィンダムを守るための
鍛練は欠かしたことがない
MsgEn:
I may not be an Arisen, but I've never neglected
my training to protect the Spirit Dragon and
Phindym.

MsgJp:
覚者こそは竜に選ばれし者だが、
選ばれなくたって竜を敬う気持ちに
変わりはないからな
MsgEn:
Arisen are the ones chosen by the dragons, But
even if you're not chosen, the feeling of
respecting the dragons does not change, you know.

MsgJp:
何だ？　俺が珍しいのか？
ここではお前たちの方がよっぽど珍しいが――
MsgEn:
What is it? I'm unusual? You're much rarer here
than I am, but...

MsgJp: よぉ！　何か用かね？
MsgEn: Yo!　What can I do for you?

MsgJp:
フィンダムの飯はどうだ？
口に合うといいんだがな
MsgEn:
How's the food in Phindym? I hope it suits your
taste.

MsgJp: 腹減ったな――
MsgEn: I'm hungry――

MsgJp:
ダナ村ってところがあってな、
そこらへんで採れる野菜は味が濃くてウマイ！
なんというか、力強い味だ
MsgEn:
There is a place called Dana Village. The
vegetables that grow around there have a rich and
delicious taste! It's kind of like a strong and
powerful flavor.

MsgJp:
腹いっぱい食ってこそ、
この筋肉も仕事する気になってくれるってもんよ
MsgEn:
Only if you eat a full meal will these muscles be
willing to work!

MsgJp: レスタニアの覚者か――
MsgEn: Ser Arisen of Lestania—

MsgJp:
何か用か？
手合せしたいというなら、手加減はしない
MsgEn:
Do you have any business? If you want to play, I
won't go easy.

MsgJp:
魔物にできた腫れ物のような、
寄生植物のような――
あの気持ちが悪いものを見たか？
MsgEn:
Did you see that grotesque, tumor-like thing? It
looks like a parasitic plant, resembling an enemy?

MsgJp:
どうやら、ああなると正気を失ってしまうようだ
気を付けたいものだな
MsgEn:
Apparently, you lose your mind when you get like
that. I'd watch out for that.

MsgJp:
魔物を異形化させるアレ――
実は、我々もアレを発症する可能性があるらしい
あんな惨い姿にはなりたくないな――
MsgEn:
That thing that deforms demons—Actually, I heard
that we can develop it too. I don't want to look
that miserable—

MsgJp: あら、レスタニアの方ね？
MsgEn: Oh, you're from Lestania, aren't you?

MsgJp:
実は、侵食魔のあの腫れ物のようなアレ――
プリーストの祈りによって治らないか
試してみたことがあるのよ
MsgEn:
Actually, I have tried to see if the swelling,
like a tumor caused by corruption, can be healed
by the prayers of a Priest. No luck there though.

MsgJp: まぁ、治らなかったわね
MsgEn: Well, it just didn't heal.

MsgJp:
侵食魔にばかり目をとられがちだけど
植物や土の状態もひどいものよ
MsgEn: White Dragon, please get well!

MsgJp:
侵食魔が噴き出しているあの"胞子"――
あまり吸い込まないようにした方がいいわ
MsgEn:
Those "spores" of the corrupting demon are
erupting— It's better not to inhale them too much.

MsgJp:
――レスタニアの覚者ですね
船に乗りたいのですか？
MsgEn:
You're an Arisen of Lestania. Do you want to
board the ship?

MsgJp:
モルは少し変わったところがあるでしょう？
人の話をあまり聞いていないように見えたり
なぜかいつもお腹を空かせていたり――
MsgEn:
Moles are a little different, aren't they? It
seems like they don't listen to people's stories
much and they're always hungry for some reason—

MsgJp:
良い子なんですけどね
あれで中々しっかりしているんですよ
MsgEn:
They're a good kid, though. They're quite
reliable with that.

MsgJp:
――なんですか
あまりジロジロ見ても
いいことはないですよ
MsgEn: — What is it? Staring too much won't do any good.

MsgJp:
川のそばだから、この辺りはひんやりするでしょう
涼むにはぴったりなんです
MsgEn:
Because it's by the river, this area will be
cool, won't it? It's perfect for cooling off.

MsgJp:
あっ、覚者さま！？
自分にご用でしょうか？
MsgEn: Ah, Ser Arisen! Do you have any business with me?

MsgJp:
本日はお日柄もよく――
って、何を言っているんだ、俺は
MsgEn:
The sun is shining today—What am I saying, I'm
not...

MsgJp:
い、いえいえ！
ちょっと緊張してしまいまして！
MsgEn: No, no, no! I was a little nervous!

MsgJp: すみません、何をお話すれば良いのやら――
MsgEn: I'm sorry, I don't know what to tell you--

MsgJp: ん？　ああ、覚者さまじゃないですか
MsgEn: Hm? Oh, it's the Arisen.

MsgJp:
アッカーシェランに力を貸してくださり
ありがとうございます
MsgEn:
Thank you for lending your strength to Acre
Selund.

MsgJp:
この先平和になったらでいいんです
いつか、レスタニアのことを教えてください
MsgEn:
Just when there's peace down the road. Someday,
please tell us about Lestania.

MsgJp: ――そろそろ動く頃でしょうか
MsgEn: I wonder if it's time to start moving soon.

MsgJp: やあ、元気かい？
MsgEn: Hey, how are you doing?

MsgJp:
堅苦しいことは嫌いでね
なんでこの任務に呼ばれたんだろう
MsgEn:
I don't like to do anything too formal. I don't
know why I was called for this assignment.

MsgJp: そろそろ一息つきたいもんだ
MsgEn: I'd like to take a break soon.

MsgJp:
覚者さんも疲れたら
ちょっと休みなよ
MsgEn:
When you're tired, Master Arisen; Take a little
break.

MsgJp: よう、どうした？
MsgEn: Hey, what's up?

MsgJp:
自分から盗賊に話しかけて
アンタにマズいことは無いのか？
MsgEn:
Talk to the bandit yourself. Is there anything
wrong with you?

MsgJp:
覚者サマってのは
意外と気取らないもんなんだな
MsgEn: Master Arisen is surprisingly unpretentious

MsgJp:
さすがにこの状況だ
アッカーシェランが無くなっちゃ
困るからな
MsgEn:
This is indeed the situation.
If we lose Acre Selund, we're in trouble.

MsgJp: 悪くいいたくはないが――
MsgEn: I don't mean to be rude, but...

MsgJp:
王子は結局のところ
甘やかされて育ったお坊ちゃま――
そんなところかね
MsgEn:
In the end, the prince was raised as a spoiled
brat-- I suppose that's how it goes.

MsgJp:
今まで多くの者たちがその行方を追っていたが
――サマラの指輪はおまえを選んだ
MsgEn:
Many have pursued its whereabouts, but the Ring
of Samara has chosen you.

MsgJp:
俺たちがおまえに協力することになったのも
何かの力が働いてのことかもしれんな
MsgEn:
The fact that we are cooperating with you may
also be the result of some higher power at work.

MsgJp: ああ、何かあったのか？
MsgEn: Ah, something happened?

MsgJp: 盗賊ってのはどこにでもいるからな
MsgEn: Thieves are everywhere.

MsgJp:
俺はさ――別に何でもよかったんだよな
生きるために畑耕すのも
盗みに入るのもおんなじだったんだ
MsgEn:
I was--I didn't really care about anything else.
I was just as likely to plow a field to survive as
I was to steal from it.

MsgJp:
アンタも覚者が嫌ンなって
行き場が無くなったら盗賊団に来なよ
MsgEn:
If you don't like being an Arisen and have
nowhere else to go, come join the bandits.

MsgJp: ふん――
MsgEn: Hmph――

MsgJp:
あまり気安く話しかけるな
俺たちは盗賊だ、あんたらとは違う
MsgEn:
Don't talk to me so casually. We are bandits,
different from you all.

MsgJp: どうしてこんなことになったんだかな
MsgEn: I wonder how things ended up like this.

MsgJp: ――楽しくお喋りしてやる気はない
MsgEn: I'm not in the mood to chat happily.

MsgJp:
うん？
あ、俺？　俺に話しかけてんのか？
MsgEn:
Huh?
Oh, me? Are you talking to me?

MsgJp:
話してやれることなんか
特に無いんだよな――
MsgEn: There is nothing in particular that I can do -

MsgJp:
やめろ、何かを期待して
何度も話しかけるのは
MsgEn:
Stop it. Repeatedly talking to me with
expectations...

MsgJp:
む――
頭領に、よそものと
あんまり馴れ合うなって言われてるからよ
MsgEn:
I'm not--
my chieftain told me not to get too friendly with
strangers.

MsgJp:
いやぁ――勘弁してくれ
俺、ユーモアってやつが無くてよ
あんたを笑かしてやれたらよかったんだがなぁ
MsgEn:
No... Please spare me.
I lack a sense of humor, you know.
I wish I could have made you laugh.

MsgJp:
あっ、いらっしゃい！
何か食べていってよ！
MsgEn: Oh, come on in! Please have something to eat!

MsgJp:
みんなのために食料――
なんとかしないと――
MsgEn:
For the sake of everyone, we need to do something
about the food situation ――

MsgJp: なんだかおなか空いてきちゃった
MsgEn: I'm kind of hungry.

MsgJp:
あ――
でも勢いだけの拾い食いは危険だからね～
MsgEn:
Ah-- But it's dangerous to just pick up and eat
with such alacrity～!

MsgJp:
瓦礫だらけでホコリっぽいし
できたら空気、入れ替えたいけど――
MsgEn:
There's rubble everywhere and it's dusty. I'd
like to change the air if I could, but--

MsgJp:
よく考えたらこの部屋――
窓ないよね？
MsgEn:
When I think about it, this room—doesn't have a
window, does it?

MsgJp:
ここで一人火を眺めてると
色々と思い出しちゃうな――
MsgEn:
Here, as I gaze at the fire alone, Various
memories come rushing back...

MsgJp:
なんかさ――
火ってすごいよね
MsgEn: You know... fire is amazing, isn't it?

MsgJp:
おいしいごはん作ってくれることもあれば――
大事なもの何もかも奪ってくことだってあるし
MsgEn:
They can cook you a delicious meal, or they can--
take away everything that's important to you.

MsgJp: ははは！
MsgEn: Hahaha!

MsgJp: ちょっと！
MsgEn: Hey!

MsgJp: えぇ！？
MsgEn: Eh!?

MsgJp: うーん
MsgEn: Hmm...

MsgJp: うーん
MsgEn: Hmm...

MsgJp: ダメ、もうホントに無理
MsgEn: No, it's really impossible now.

MsgJp: よし！
MsgEn: Alright!

MsgJp: ねぇ！
MsgEn: Hey!

MsgJp: ねぇ！
MsgEn: Hey!

MsgJp: ハァイ
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: そっか――
MsgEn: I see...

MsgJp: 何か無いかなぁ？
MsgEn: Is there anything?

MsgJp: こうなったら――！
MsgEn: If it becomes like this—!

MsgJp: これは食べられそうだね！
MsgEn: This looks edible!

MsgJp: ふぅー
MsgEn: Phew

MsgJp: 待ってよー！
MsgEn: Wait a minute!

MsgJp: 待ってよー！
MsgEn: Wait a minute!

MsgJp: こっち来ないでってば！
MsgEn: Don't come over here!

MsgJp: あっち行きなさいよ！
MsgEn: Go away!

MsgJp: アタシ、おいしくないって！
MsgEn: I'm not delicious!

MsgJp: 今日は何する？
MsgEn: What are you doing today?

MsgJp: 今日は何する？
MsgEn: What are you doing today?

MsgJp: どうしようか
MsgEn: What should I do?

MsgJp: どうしようか
MsgEn: What should I do?

MsgJp: お願い――
MsgEn: Please...

MsgJp:
今日できることは全部やれたみたい
また明日も来てくれると嬉しいな！
MsgEn:
I was able to do everything I could do today. I
would be happy if you could come again tomorrow!

MsgJp:
ローナやブラッド――
それに砦の兵隊さんまで
大食堂の修復手伝ってくれてるんだよ！
MsgEn:
Lorna and Brad, and even the soldiers in the
fort, are helping with the restoration work!

MsgJp: なんか"チーム"って感じだよね？
MsgEn: It feels like a 'team,' you know?

MsgJp: もちろん、あなたも！
MsgEn: And you, of course!

MsgJp:
あ！
なんか名前付けたいなー
MsgEn: Ah! I want to name it.

MsgJp:
ね！
何がいい？
MsgEn: Hey! What would you like?

MsgJp:
瓦礫はまだ残ってるけどさ
食料庫が復活しただけで
力が湧いてくるんだぁ
MsgEn:
The debris is still there, but the pantry is back
up and running. It gives me strength!

MsgJp:
ローナにね
最初にどこを直すか聞かれたから
でっかい声で――
MsgEn:
Lorna, huh.
When asked where to fix it first,
I shouted loudly――

MsgJp:
「食料庫！　食料庫がいい！！」
――って叫んじゃった
MsgEn: "Food storage! Food storage is good!" - I shouted.

MsgJp:
大食堂って壁に囲まれてるから
食料守るのには向いてるんだけど――
MsgEn:
The big dining hall is surrounded by walls, so it
is suitable for protecting food, but...

MsgJp:
お料理焦がしちゃったときとか
部屋中煙だらけになって
鼻の奥までコゲ臭くなるんだよね
MsgEn:
When the cooking gets burned,
and the room becomes filled with smoke,
it even smells burnt inside the nose.

MsgJp:
バレないように
壁にこっそり穴あけちゃおうかな？
MsgEn:
Shall we discreetly make a hole in the wall so
that we won't get caught?

MsgJp:
ペコ、ずっとここにいることにしたみたい
まぁ――初めて食堂に来た人は
ちょっとびっくりしてるけどね
MsgEn:
Peco seems to have decided to stay here forever.
Well, people who come to the Dining Hall for the
first time might be a little surprised, though.

MsgJp:
あの子ってばゴブリンなのに
妙に気が弱かったりするからさ
アタシとしても、ここで元気にしてるの
見られる方が気が楽だよ
MsgEn:
She's a goblin, but she's strangely timid. As for
me, it's easier for me to see her here doing well.

MsgJp:
復旧してから色んな人が来てくれるんだ
おかげで忙しくって、賑やかで
毎日やることだらけだよ
MsgEn:
Since we've been back up and running, we've had
all kinds of people coming in. It's kept us busy
and buzzing. There's so much to do every day!

MsgJp:
ヘザーとアイダンも盛り上げてくれるし――
ペコも居ついちゃって、何だか自分なりに
仕事みたいなことしてるしね
MsgEn:
Heather and Aidan are also uplifting―― Peco has
settled in too, and in a way, is doing something
like work

MsgJp:
――さぁ、もっともっと頑張って
戦士のみんなに力付けてもらわないと！
ここからラスニテを――
ううん、アッカーシェランを元気にしていきたいんだ
MsgEn:
Alright, we need to push ourselves even harder,
We have to get support from all the soldiers! From
here on, let's restore Rath-- No, I want to bring
back the vitality of all of Acre Selund!

MsgJp:
大食堂、もうすっかり元通りだよ！　
――ううん、元の大食堂よりも良い感じかも
何ていったって皆で作り上げた食堂だからね！
MsgEn:
The Dining Hall is back to normal now! No, it might
even be better than before. After all, we all
built this Dining Hall together!

MsgJp:
あなたにもいっぱい協力してもらったよね
お陰で、ここまでやってこれたこと
とっても感謝してる！　本当にありがとう！
MsgEn:
You've helped me a lot.
Thanks to you, I've made it this far.
I'm very grateful!　Thank you so much!

MsgJp:
あなたは何が好き？
思い出の味とか、あるでしょ？
MsgEn:
What do you like?
Do you have a taste for memories?

MsgJp: ウ、ウガ？
MsgEn: U, uga?

MsgJp:
食ベモノ、集めタ！
キャリーうれしい？
MsgEn: Food and collectibles! Carrie, are you happy?

MsgJp: ココにいる、楽しイ！
MsgEn: It's fun being here!

MsgJp:
誰モ、イジメナイ――
ペコ――悪いコト、シナイ
MsgEn:
Whoever is in the armor, if they show up in front
of me, I'm just going to fight!

MsgJp:
次の作戦は――こっちでいくか
いやいや、逆にあっちの方が――
MsgEn:
The next strategy is...shall we go this way...
No, the other way around is better...

MsgJp:
ボクは、よく独り言を言ってるらしいんだけど
みんなが言うほどの実感がなくってね
MsgEn:
I often seem to be talking to myself, but I don't
really feel it as much as everyone says.

MsgJp:
普段から、まわりに誰かいるかとかは
特に気にしてはいないけど
ボクにとっては自然なことさ
MsgEn:
I usually don't pay much attention to whether
someone is around me or not. It's just natural for
me.

MsgJp: ――これは、独り言じゃないよね？
MsgEn: This isn't just talking to myself, right?

MsgJp:
展望城に自分の部屋はないのかって？
ああ、それなら以前
一度作ってもらったことがあってね
MsgEn:
Lookout Castle, isn't there a room for me there?
Ah, well, it's because I had one made before.

MsgJp:
でも、城内って広くて複雑でさ
部屋に戻るたびに迷うのに飽きてしまって
気が付いたら場所を忘れてたんだよ
MsgEn:
But the castle is so big and complicated. I got
tired of getting lost every time I went back to my
room and realized I'd forgotten where I was.

MsgJp:
今覚えてる場所は――
城の入り口と、王宮層と
あとはシチューのある食堂だけさ！
MsgEn:
The only places I remember now are—the castle
entrance, the royal layer, and the Dining Hall with
the stew!

MsgJp: ボクは、作戦というものは"生き物"だと思ってる
MsgEn: I think that a strategy is like a living creature.

MsgJp:
いくら事前に完璧に計画したつもりでも
その場の状況でいくらだって変わるし
思い通りに行く方が珍しいくらいさ
MsgEn:
No matter how perfectly you plan it in advance,
it can change at any moment, and it's rare that
things go the way you want them to.

MsgJp:
まぁ、そこが面白いところなんだけどね
何でも思った通りになるなんて
つまんないだろ？
MsgEn:
Well, that's the interesting part about it, you
know? It's boring for everything to just go as you
think.

MsgJp: 準備はいいかい？それじゃ行こう
MsgEn: Are you ready? Let's go.

MsgJp: 準備はいいかい？　それじゃ行こう
MsgEn: Are you ready? Let's go.

MsgJp: きっと、何かあるはずさ
MsgEn: There's got to be something.

MsgJp: きっと、何かあるはずさ
MsgEn: There's got to be something.

MsgJp: ふんふん、なるほどね
MsgEn: Hmmm... I see.

MsgJp: いや、待てよ？
MsgEn: No, wait, could you?

MsgJp: いや、待てよ？
MsgEn: No, wait, could you?

MsgJp:
そうか！　そういうことか！
やはり僕は、天才だね！
MsgEn:
Ah, I see! So that's how it is! As I thought, I
am a genius!

MsgJp:
おかしいなぁ――
今日はちょっと調子が悪いらしい！
MsgEn:
Hmm, that's strange... It seems like I'm feeling
a little unwell today!

MsgJp:
おかしいなぁ――
今日はちょっと調子が悪いらしい！
MsgEn:
Hmm, that's strange...
It seems like I'm feeling a little unwell today!

MsgJp: ほら、僕の思った通りだろう？
MsgEn: See, it's just as I thought, isn't it?

MsgJp:
はっはっは！
たまにはこんなこともあるさ！
MsgEn: Hahaha! Sometimes things like this happen!

MsgJp:
はっはっは！
たまにはこんなこともあるさ！
MsgEn:
Hahaha!
Sometimes things like this happen!

MsgJp: あー、キミキミ
MsgEn: Oh, you, you.

MsgJp: あー、キミキミ
MsgEn: Oh, you, you

MsgJp: ちょっといいかな？　隊長
MsgEn: Can I have a word with you?　Captain.

MsgJp: ちょっといいかな？　隊長
MsgEn: Can I have a word with you?　Captain.

MsgJp: おかしいなぁ――
MsgEn: Hmm, something is strange.

MsgJp: やはり僕は、天才だね！
MsgEn: I am a genius, after all!

MsgJp: それじゃあ行こう！
MsgEn: Let's go then!

MsgJp: ここにはもう何もなさそうだ
MsgEn: There doesn't seem to be anything here anymore.

MsgJp: さて、帰るとしよう！
MsgEn: Now, let's go home!

MsgJp: ああ、もう――だめだ――
MsgEn: Oh, no—it's no use—

MsgJp: アハハハ！
MsgEn: Ahahaha!

MsgJp: アハハハ！
MsgEn: Ahahaha!

MsgJp: んんっ！？
MsgEn: Huh?!

MsgJp: んんっ！？
MsgEn: Huh?!

MsgJp: えぇっと――
MsgEn: Um...

MsgJp: はぁ～
MsgEn: Ha～

MsgJp: はぁ～
MsgEn: Ha～

MsgJp: あれ――
MsgEn: That—

MsgJp:
ここにはもう何もなさそうだ
僕の勘がそう囁いているのでね
さて、帰るとしよう！
MsgEn:
There doesn't seem to be anything else here.
That's what my instincts are whispering to me, you
know. Well, let's go home!

MsgJp:
やったね！
僕らがいれば敵無しなんじゃないか！？
MsgEn:
Great job! If we're together, we have no enemies,
don't we?!

MsgJp:
あー、ごめん
今ちょっと考えなきゃいけないことが
あってね、忙しいんだ
MsgEn:
Oh, sorry. There's something I need to think
about right now. I'm busy.

MsgJp:
ありがとう！　助かったよ！
よしよしこれで――
MsgEn: Thank you! I'm saved! Good job—

MsgJp:
もう終わったの？
さすが、頼りになるね！
MsgEn:
Is it already over? As expected, you're
dependable!

MsgJp: さて、何をする？
MsgEn: Now, what to do?

MsgJp: さて、何をする？
MsgEn: Now, what to do?

MsgJp: やあ
MsgEn: Hey

MsgJp: やあ
MsgEn: Hey

MsgJp: よく来たね
MsgEn: Nice to see you

MsgJp: よく来たね
MsgEn: Nice to see you

MsgJp: はあはあ、久しぶりの戦は体に応えるなぁ
MsgEn:
Ha ha! It's been a while since the last battle,
it's taking a toll on my body

MsgJp: ちょっと待った、少し休憩させてくれ
MsgEn: Wait a moment, please let me take a short break.

MsgJp: あれ、体が重いぞ、こんなはずじゃあ
MsgEn:
Oh, my body feels heavy. This is not how it
should be.

MsgJp: や、やっぱり僕は室内で策を練ってる方が――
MsgEn: I think I'd rather be indoors, planning...

MsgJp: 少しは、動けるようになってきたぞ――
MsgEn: I've become a little more mobile.

MsgJp: ああ、でもまだ苦しい、ちょっと休憩
MsgEn: Ah, but I'm still hurting, I need a little break.

MsgJp: キミから見て、今の僕ってどうかな？
MsgEn: How do I look now from your point of view?

MsgJp: もうちょっと頑張れそうな気も――ううん
MsgEn: I think I can do a little more -- no.

MsgJp: あははは、どうだい僕の動き、軽やかだろう？
MsgEn: Ha-ha-ha, how's my movement, light, isn't it?

MsgJp: 風のように走り、雷のように刺す！
MsgEn: Running like the wind, piercing like thunder!

MsgJp: なに、前はちょっと腕が鈍ってただけさ！
MsgEn: No, I was just a little rusty before!

MsgJp: ふふ、戦える参謀官っていいよね
MsgEn:
Hehe, having a capable staff officer who can
fight is nice, isn't it?

MsgJp: え、見つかった！？
MsgEn: Wait, it was found!?

MsgJp: さすが隊長だ！
MsgEn: As expected, Captain!

MsgJp:
ハッ――
驚いた、何か用？
MsgEn:
Ha-- You scared the hell out of me. What can I do
for you?

MsgJp: 悪いけど、楽しく世間話する気分じゃないんだ
MsgEn:
Sorry, I'm just not in the mood for pleasant
small talk.

MsgJp:
こんな状況だから――
子供だからって何もわからないわけじゃないよ
MsgEn:
Because of this situation ―― Just because I'm a
child doesn't mean I don't understand anything.

MsgJp:
もっと悪いことになったら
生きていくのが難しくなるかもしれない
そんな時に、走り回って遊べる？
MsgEn:
If things get worse... It might be difficult to
survive. Can you run around and play at such
times?

MsgJp: ああ、どうも
MsgEn: Oh, thank you.

MsgJp:
家の中に閉じこもったり
洞窟に隠れたりできればいいんですが
そういうわけにもいかないでしょう
MsgEn:
I wish I could lock myself in my house or hide in
a cave, but that's not going to happen.

MsgJp:
ちょっとした用がありましてね
ある程度、覚悟して家を出てきたんです
――いや、甘かったです
MsgEn:
I had some business to attend to, and I left home
with some degree of determination, but I
underestimated it.

MsgJp:
今も商人が来てくれる村もありますが
そうじゃない小さな村もたくさんありますから
危険を承知で外に出ざるを得ないんです
MsgEn:
There are some villages that still have merchants
coming to them, but there are many small villages
that don't, so we have to go out there and take
the risk.

MsgJp:
え、なんだって？
すまないね、最近耳が遠くて――
MsgEn:
What? What did you say?
I'm sorry, I've been a little hard of hearing
lately.

MsgJp:
竜が倒された――
言ってしまえば、ただ一つの事件が
起こっただけで、この有様だ
MsgEn:
The dragon has been defeated—To put it simply,
only one event has occurred, resulting in this
state.

MsgJp:
竜と――それに連なる王家を
もっと守っておけば
こうはならなかったのかね――
MsgEn:
If only we had protected the dragons and the
royal family that follows them more, would it not
have come to this?

MsgJp:
王家に仕えてた人たちは
一体何をしてるんだか
まったく情けない話だよ
MsgEn:
I don't know what the hell the people who served
the royal family are doing. It's utterly pathetic.

MsgJp: ふぅん、君が覚者ですか
MsgEn: Oh, are you an Arisen?

MsgJp:
――何でもチャンスとして見ないと
我が家の家訓でしてね
MsgEn:
-- I have to look at everything as an
opportunity. It's a family tradition.

MsgJp:
自分の暮らしは自分で守らないと、ですよ
そういった努力ができない者は
まぁ、痛い目を見ても――仕方ないのでは？
MsgEn:
If you don't protect your own life, well, it
can't be helped if you suffer the consequences.

MsgJp:
我々の一族は、万が一の時のために
人脈を広げ、貯蓄してきましたから
そういったことをしていない人は
まぁ、今大変なんじゃないですか
MsgEn:
Our family has been networking and saving in case
of an emergency, so if you haven't done those
things, well, you're in a tough spot right now.

MsgJp:
こんにちは
あのぅ、えっと――
MsgEn: Hello, umm, well...

MsgJp: わたし、これからどうすればいいんでしょう
MsgEn: What am I going to do now?

MsgJp:
母に逃げてって言われたんです
それでここまで来たんです――
MsgEn: My mother told me to run away, so I came here...

MsgJp: ちょっと疲れちゃった――
MsgEn: I'm a little tired...

MsgJp:
ん？　何？
言いたいことがあるなら言いなよ
MsgEn:
Huh? What is it?
If you have something to say, go ahead

MsgJp:
今までも辛いことはたくさんあったんだ
今回だって、絶対に乗り越えられる――
MsgEn:
I've been through a lot of hard times in the
past. I'll get through this one, too--I promise.

MsgJp:
眠る場所と、食べる物――
あとは、守りたいもの
それだけあればしばらく大丈夫、私はね
MsgEn:
A place to sleep, something to eat-- and
something to protect That's all you need for a
while, for me.

MsgJp:
この通り、剣持って戦えはしないけど
逃げ足はまぁまぁ速い方だと思ってるからさ
MsgEn:
As you can see, I can't fight with a sword, but I
think I'm a reasonably fast runner.

MsgJp: ああ、どうも――
MsgEn: Ah, thank you.

MsgJp:
あの、旅をしていらっしゃるなら――
若い夫婦を見ませんでしたか？
MsgEn:
Um, if you are traveling--
have you seen a young couple?

MsgJp:
息子夫婦と一緒に暮らしてたんですが
オークの襲撃から逃れる時に
はぐれてしまったんです
MsgEn:
I was living with my son and his wife when we got
separated while fleeing an orc raid.

MsgJp:
命は助かっても、独りで暮らすのは
堪えるものです――
MsgEn:
Even if your life is spared, living alone can be
unbearable--

MsgJp: あら、どうかして？
MsgEn: Oh, what's wrong?

MsgJp:
みんなで力を合わせて立ち上がれば――
でも、上手くいかないものね
なかなか協力してくれる方がいなくて
MsgEn:
If everyone were to come together and work as a
team, but it's not going so well. It's hard to
find people willing to cooperate.

MsgJp: ふぅ、私だってやればできるわ
MsgEn: Phew, I can do it too if I try

MsgJp:
少し休もうかしら
誰も手を貸してくれないんだもの
MsgEn:
Maybe I should take a short rest. Since no one is
lending a hand.

MsgJp: な、なんでしょう？
MsgEn: Yes, what is it?

MsgJp:
もう、命からがら逃げてきたんです
な、何も持ってませんよ
勘弁してください
MsgEn:
Hey, I don't have anything. I've already escaped
with my life. Give me a break!

MsgJp:
この体以外、何も手元に残りませんでした
せめて親父の形見くらいは
持ってきたかったんですけど――
MsgEn:
I was left with nothing but this body.
I wanted to bring at least a memento of my dad's,
but--

MsgJp:
腹も減ったし、喉も乾いてますよ
どこか落ち着ける場所を探さないと
MsgEn:
I'm hungry and thirsty. I need to find a place to
settle down.

MsgJp:
はぁ、少し休みたいわ
ここまで逃げてくるのに精一杯で――
MsgEn:
Sigh, I want to rest a little. I'm exhausted from
running away this far.

MsgJp:
どこか、わたしを
受け入れてくれる村は無いかしら
ねぇ、ご存じない――？
MsgEn:
I wonder if there is a village somewhere that
would accept me.
Hey, do you know of any--?

MsgJp:
とにかく少しだけ休みたいの
そうすれば、次に何をすればいいか
考えられそうだから
MsgEn:
I just want to rest for a while. That way, I can
think about what to do next.

MsgJp:
村のみんな
無事かしら――
MsgEn: I hope everyone in the village is safe—

MsgJp:
あ、はい――
何かご用、ですか？
MsgEn: Ah, yes―― Do you need anything?

MsgJp:
ぐすっ――
ここがどこか、わからないんです
MsgEn: I don't know where this is.

MsgJp:
前を向いて走るのに必死で―ー
後ろにいたお母さんがいつの間にか
いなくなってたのに気付かなかったんです
MsgEn:
I was running desperately, facing forward, and I
didn't even realize when my mother, who was behind
me, disappeared.

MsgJp:
どこに、行けばいいんでしょう
しくしく――
MsgEn: Where should I go, sob sob...

MsgJp: むぅ、なんだなんだ！？
MsgEn: What is it, what is it!?

MsgJp:
この剣は王家へ捧げたもの！
今に名を残す英雄のように
それは勇ましく振るってみせよう
MsgEn:
This sword is dedicated to the royal family! Just
like the renowned hero who will be remembered,
let's swing it valiantly.

MsgJp:
いつかは王都メガドの護衛に
選ばれるツワモノにと夢見てきたが
今は手の届く範囲で戦うのに必死！
――だが、それも悪くない
MsgEn:
I once dreamt of being one of the elite chosen to
guard the capital, Megado. But now, I'm just
struggling to fight within my reach. But even that
isn't so bad.

MsgJp:
ん？　この盾が気になるのですかな？
素晴らしいデザインでしょう
MsgEn:
Hm? Are you interested in this shield?
It has a splendid design.

MsgJp: うん、話なら聞くよ
MsgEn: Yeah, I'll listen if you want to talk.

MsgJp:
魔物は私たちよりも鼻が利くし
もちろん耳だっていい
――まぁ、だから人間を
甘くみてるところもあるんだろうね
MsgEn:
Enemies have a better sense of smell than us, and
of course, their hearing is also good. Well,
that's why they might underestimate humans
sometimes.

MsgJp:
臨機応変に対処できるってのが
人間の一番の強みなんじゃないかな
MsgEn:
The ability to adapt to different situations is
probably the greatest strength of a human, don't
you think?

MsgJp:
魔物を追う時は
マズい場所に誘いこまれてないか
気を付けた方がいいよ
MsgEn:
When pursuing enemies, it's better to be careful
and make sure you're not being led into dangerous
places.

MsgJp: ああ、少し話すか？
MsgEn: Ah, would you like to talk for a bit?

MsgJp:
もう少しいい装備が欲しいところだが
贅沢は言ってられないか
MsgEn:
I would like to have better equipment, but I
can't afford to be extravagant.

MsgJp:
――なんだって？
すまない、大砲の音のせいか
ここのところ耳が遠くなったみたいだ
MsgEn:
— What did you say? I'm sorry, it might be
because of the sound of the cannons. I think I'm
going deaf these days.

MsgJp:
ここのところ戦いに出る日が続いて
なかなか武具の手入れができないのが、な――
戦場で壊れでもしたら、終わりだ
MsgEn:
Lately, I have been going out to battle for
consecutive days and it's been difficult to
maintain my equipment, ah— If it were to break on
the battlefield, it would be the end.

MsgJp: はい、どうかしました？
MsgEn: Um, what's wrong?

MsgJp:
あなたも、きっとお強いんでしょうね
私はまだまだで――
MsgEn:
I'm sure you must be very strong, too. I'm not
ready to--

MsgJp:
もっとがんばらないといけませんね
今度こそ、人を支えられるように
なりたいんです
MsgEn:
I have to work harder. This time, I want to
become someone who can support others.

MsgJp:
解放軍には入ったばかりなんです
――元から剣を持っていた人たちとは
やっぱり実力の差を感じますね
MsgEn:
I have just joined the Liberation Army. Compared
to those who already had swords, I can definitely
feel the difference in skill.

MsgJp: はっ、任務中ですので手短にお願いします！
MsgEn: Uh, please keep it brief as I am on a mission!

MsgJp:
オークとの戦いに散った者も数知れず――
遺された家族のことを想うと
胸が潰れそうになります
MsgEn:
Countless others have scattered in the battle
against the orcs--
My heart breaks for the families left behind.

MsgJp:
オークは、仲間が死んでも
何とも思わないのでしょうか？
――それとも――
MsgEn:
Do orcs think nothing of when their friends die?
Or--or--don't they?

MsgJp:
はっ、気弱になってはいけないと
自分に言い聞かせております
MsgEn:
H-hold on, I mustn't lose heart—- I keep
reminding myself

MsgJp: よう、元気か？
MsgEn: Hey, how are you doing?

MsgJp:
まぁ、お互い身構えずに行こうぜ
俺も盗賊になったばっかりだけど
君が腕の立つ人だってことは、見りゃわかるよ
MsgEn:
Well, let's go without being too cautious—- I've
only just become a bandit. But I can tell that
you're skilled, just by looking at you.

MsgJp:
人生何が起こるかわからないものだよな
起こっちまってから「まさか」と思うんだよ
MsgEn:
You never know what can happen in life—You think
"it couldn't possibly happen," but then it does.

MsgJp:
家族はいるのか？
はぁ、ポーンがいる――
なんか哲学的な答えだな
MsgEn:
Do you have a family? Huh, there's a Pawn――
That's quite a philosophical answer.

MsgJp:
ん、なになに？
呼んだ？
MsgEn: Hmm, what is it? Did you call me?

MsgJp: さーて、どうしよっかな
MsgEn: Well, what should I do?

MsgJp:
ねぇねぇ～
何かおいしい話、知らない？
MsgEn: Hey, hey～ Do you know any interesting stories?

MsgJp:
あーあ
どっかにすんごいお宝、転がってないかなぁ
そしたらセルマの姐さんに見直してもらえるのに
MsgEn:
Oh dear. I wonder if there might be an amazing
treasure hidden somewhere. If so, Sister Selma
could take another look at it for me.

MsgJp: おお、どうかしたかい？
MsgEn: Oh, is something wrong?

MsgJp:
いやぁ、久しぶりに持つ剣は重いな
前はもうちょっと、こう――
MsgEn:
Oh, it's been a while since I held a sword. It
feels heavy now. It used to be a little lighter,
like...

MsgJp:
こう見えても俺、前に
剣士を目指したこともあるんだぜ！
まぁ、子供の頃の話だけど
MsgEn:
You see, I once tried to become a swordsman!
Well, that was when I was a kid.

MsgJp:
盾もずっと持ってると重いんだよな
もうちょっと軽い盾を買えばよかったかなぁ
MsgEn:
Shields are also heavy when you hold them all the
time. I guess I should have bought a lighter one.

MsgJp: ぬっ！？　何かご用でも――
MsgEn: Huh!? Is there something you need—

MsgJp:
己自身を見つめ直すため
戦に乱れた各地を行脚しておるのです
MsgEn:
To reflect on oneself, I am wandering around
various places that have been disturbed by war.

MsgJp:
荒廃した景色、それを見て己が心に
湧きあがるもの――
私はそれを見極めたい
MsgEn:
The devastated landscape, what wells up in my
heart when I see it—I want to find out what it is.

MsgJp:
一時は世を捨て、隠遁生活を送ったことも
ありますがね――そうしたところで
私には何も見えてこなかったのです
MsgEn:
I even left the world for a time and went into
seclusion
- and I didn't see anything!

MsgJp: 何？　じろじろ見ちゃって
MsgEn: What? You're staring at me.

MsgJp:
面倒事はごめんよ
――そりゃ、義理や礼儀は通すけどさ
それ以外でってこと
MsgEn:
I don't want to be a bother— that is, I'll be
polite and respectful, but other than that, I
mean.

MsgJp:
どうしたの、誰か探してるの？
いえ、そんな風に見えたってだけなんだけど
MsgEn:
What's wrong, are you looking for someone? No, it
only seemed that way.

MsgJp:
――あたし、どうも面倒事に
まきこまれやすい気がするのよね
どうしてだろう
MsgEn:
--I feel like I get into trouble a lot.
I don't know why.

MsgJp: まあ、どうなさいました？
MsgEn: Well, what happened?

MsgJp:
私でお力になれることなら
よろこんで手をお貸ししますわ
MsgEn:
If there is anything I can assist you with, I
would be delighted to lend a hand.

MsgJp:
私の故郷は離れていますし
小さいながらも守りの固い城に
住んでおりますから、家族も無事ですよ
MsgEn:
My hometown is far away. And even though it is
small, it is a securely fortified castle, So my
family is safe.

MsgJp:
このような時こそ
周りの方に手を差し伸べるべきだと――
そう思って、はるばるこちらへ参りましたの
MsgEn:
It is at times like this that we should reach out
to those around us--
That's why I came all the way here!

MsgJp:
《英霊眠りし道》についての伝承は多いのです
子供もおとぎ話を通して知っていますよ
MsgEn:
There are many legends about the "Heroic Spirit
Sleeping Path," and even children are familiar
with it through fairy tales.

MsgJp:
中は土砂で埋まっているので
いわゆる"墓場荒らし"もここにはやってきません
MsgEn:
The inside is filled with earth and sand, so the
so-called "grave robbers" won't come here either!

MsgJp:
王家ゆかりの地であるのに、番人が
自分一人なのはそのせいですね――
MsgEn:
It's a place associated with the royal family,
but that's why there's only one guardian.

MsgJp:
自分も中には何度か足を踏み入れています
管理のこともありますから――
まぁ、土砂が無いところまで覗く程度ですが
MsgEn:
I've stepped inside a few times myself because of
the management-- Well, I've only peeked in to
where there's no sediment.

MsgJp:
はっ、覚者様！
ようこそおいでくださいました
MsgEn: Hah, Ser Arisen! Welcome, please come in

MsgJp:
英霊眠りし道は普通のダンジョンとは異なります
ある程度の武具を揃えて挑まなければ
踏破は難しいのではと――
MsgEn:
The Epitaph Road is different from a normal dungeon.
It may be difficult to conquer without equipping
a certain level of weapons and armor.

MsgJp:
また、内部は土砂で埋まっている通路もあります
もう土砂が流れ込むことはありませんから
一度でも撤去できればいいのですが
MsgEn:
Furthermore, there are also passageways that are
filled with sediment internally. There will no
longer be any inflow of sediment, so it would be
good to remove it just once.

MsgJp:
覚者様、お気をつけて――
危険を感じられたら
すぐに戻ってきてくださいね
MsgEn:
Arisen, please be careful-- If you feel any
danger, Please come back immediately.

MsgJp:
開拓後の場所から
再突入できるようになりましたよ！
これで内部の調査がより捗るかと
MsgEn:
You can now re-enter from your pioneering
location! I thought this would help us make more
progress in our investigation of the interior.

MsgJp: 開拓後の場所から再突入しますか？
MsgEn:
Do you want to re-enter the place after
development?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
パーティーリーダーが行き先を
選ぶまで、少々お待ちください
MsgEn:
Please wait a moment while the party leader
selects the destination.

MsgJp:
パーティーリーダーが待っていらっしゃいますよ
《英霊眠りし道》へ突入しますか？
MsgEn:
The party leader is waiting.
Will you enter the Epitaph Road?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
内部へ向かわれる際は十分に注意してください
まずは状況確認など、いかがでしょう？
MsgEn:
Please be careful when heading inside.
How about a status check first?

MsgJp: ダンジョンに入る
MsgEn: Enter Dungeon

MsgJp: 開拓状況確認
MsgEn: Check Reclamation Status

MsgJp: 報酬取得状況確認
MsgEn: Check Acquired Rewards Status

MsgJp: まさか、全ての道を拓かれるとは――！
MsgEn:
I can't believe all the roads have been opened
up—!

MsgJp:
実は――伝承では
全ての道を拓くことで
最後の試練が受けられると言われているんです
MsgEn:
Actually, in the legend, it is said that by
opening up all paths, one can receive the final
trial.

MsgJp:
覚者様が全ての道を拓いたと同時刻に、
開かずの扉に変化が起きました
まるで、共鳴するみたいにです
MsgEn:
At the same time that the Arisen paved the way
for everything, a change occurred in the unopened
door, as if it were resonating!

MsgJp:
最後の試練が待ち受けるのは
きっと開かずの扉の先なのでしょうね
――最後の試練に向かわれる時は
ぜひ声をかけてください
MsgEn:
The final trial is surely waiting beyond the
sealed door. When you're ready to face the last
trial, please don't hesitate to contact me.

MsgJp:
内部へ向かわれる際は十分に注意してください
まずは状況確認など、いかがでしょう？
MsgEn:
Please be careful when heading inside.
How about a status check first?

MsgJp: ダンジョンに入る
MsgEn: Enter Dungeon

MsgJp: 開拓状況確認
MsgEn: Check Reclamation Status

MsgJp: 報酬取得状況確認
MsgEn: Check Acquired Rewards Status

MsgJp: 最後の試練に挑む
MsgEn: Challenge Final Ordeal

MsgJp:
最後の試練に向かわれるのですね
それでは、扉の封印を解除しておきます
MsgEn:
I see that you are heading for the final ordeal.
I will now unseal the door.

MsgJp:
あの先には、今までより困難な試練が
待ち受けているかもしれません
MsgEn:
Beyond that point, more difficult challenges than
ever before may await you!

MsgJp:
心して向かってください
ご武運をお祈りします
――覚者様のお戻りを信じておりますので！
MsgEn:
Please proceed with caution. We pray for your
success. We believe in the return of the Arisen!

MsgJp:
覚者様、申し訳ありませんが
そのような武具で内部に進まれるのは
かなり危険かと――
MsgEn:
Ser Arisen, I'm sorry but it is quite dangerous
to proceed inside with such weaponry.

MsgJp:
番人として、覚者様をみすみす危険に
晒すわけにはいきません
武具を整えてから、もう一度いらしてください
MsgEn:
As a guardian, I cannot simply expose the
esteemed Arisen to danger. Please come again after
preparing your equipment.

MsgJp: やあ、あんたが白き竜の覚者さんか
MsgEn: Hey, are you the Arisen of the White Dragon?

MsgJp:
このほこらに分散している
私の力を集めて
ここまで持ってきてくれないかい？
MsgEn:
Can you gather the power scattered at this shrine
and bring it here?

MsgJp:
そうすれば、あんたに力を貸してやれる――
何せ今は何の力も無くってね
MsgEn:
If you do that, then I can lend you my
strength—after all, I don't have any power right
now.

MsgJp:
ありがとう、よく集めてきたね
おかげで何かといい感じだよ
MsgEn:
Thanks, you've done a great job collecting them.
It's made me feel like I'm on to something.

MsgJp:
見たところ、あんたなら
もっと深くまで潜ることもできそうだし――
MsgEn:
From what I can see, you could probably delve
even deeper -

MsgJp:
さぁ、見てな
土砂ごとき、力さえ戻ればこんなもんさ
MsgEn:
Now, look here.
Just some earth and sand.
If only I regain my strength, it's nothing.

MsgJp:
どうだい？
土砂をどけて、道を作っておいたよ
これで先に進めるだろう
MsgEn:
How about it? I cleared away the debris and made
a path. You should be able to proceed now.

MsgJp:
あんたほどの実力があるなら
この先に眠る宝物にもたどり着けるんじゃない？
MsgEn:
If you're as good as you say you are,
you'll get to the treasures that lie ahead, won't
you?

MsgJp:
期待してるよ――
ああ、久しぶりに楽しかった
MsgEn:
I'm counting on you— Ah, I haven't had this much
fun in a while.

MsgJp:
すまないけど、思ったより
土砂が詰まっててね
さすがに時間がかかってしまってるんだ
MsgEn:
Sorry, it's more packed with sediment than I
thought. It's taking longer than expected.

MsgJp:
もう少しだけ時間をくれない？
なに、目途は立ってるからさ
MsgEn:
Can you give me a little more time? No, I've got
a plan.

MsgJp:
ふふふ、そう怪訝な顔をしないで
あんたの力になりたいだけさ
MsgEn:
Hahaha, don't make such a bewildered face. I just
want to support you.

MsgJp:
まだ王子は幼いんだろ？
そうそう、ネド王子――
MsgEn:
The prince is still young, right? Yes, Prince
Nedo—

MsgJp:
そう気を遣わなくていいさ
私だってそんな大層な人間じゃないからさ
昔ね、腕っぷしが強かっただけだよ――ハハハ
MsgEn:
You don't have to worry about it because I'm not
that extraordinary either. In the past, it was
just that I was strong physically - Hahaha.

MsgJp:
あれ、あんたの仲間は
すでに道を拓いてるんじゃない？
MsgEn:
Oh, your companions, aren't they already carving
their own path?

MsgJp:
これなら仲間の力をたどって
一時的に道を開くことができそうだよ
MsgEn:
If you follow the power of your companions
you may be able to temporarily open the path

MsgJp: 通常開拓する
MsgEn: Explore normally.

MsgJp: 仲間の力をたどる
MsgEn: Follow the power of your companion

MsgJp:
ふふ、ごきげんよう
遠いところからやってきた覚者さん
MsgEn:
Ah, good day. You, the Arisen who has come from a
distant place.

MsgJp:
ねぇ、もうわかってるんでしょう？
この辺りに散らばった力を集めて
わたしにくれないかしら
MsgEn:
Hey, you already know the answer to that, don't
you?
You're going to gather all the power scattered
around here and give it to me.

MsgJp:
今のわたしたちは
こうして姿を現すだけで精一杯――
だけど、あなたに協力したいのよ
MsgEn:
Right now we're doing our best just showing up
like this--
but we want to help you!

MsgJp:
ありがとう、少しの間動くなら
これで十分よ
MsgEn:
Thanks, if it works for a little while, this
should be enough.

MsgJp:
さて、あなたにはもっと深くまで
行ってもらわないとね――
MsgEn: Now, I need you to go deeper—

MsgJp:
あなたに協力することが
王家のためになるはずですもの
さぁ、邪魔な土砂は吹っ飛ばしてしまいましょう
MsgEn:
It should be beneficial for the royal family for
me to assist you. Now, let's blow away that
obstruction.

MsgJp:
土砂を片付けたわよ
これなら通れるでしょう？
MsgEn:
I've cleared away the debris. This should be
passable, right?

MsgJp:
あなたの力を見込んで言うわ
もっと深くまで、諦めずに進んでね
MsgEn:
I'll say this, counting on your strength, go
deeper without giving up.

MsgJp:
エゴといわれても仕方ないけど――
まだ、この国の終わりをみたくは無いの
MsgEn:
Call me egotistical, but-- I don't want to see
the end of this country just yet.

MsgJp:
ごめんね、急いではいるんだけど
もう少しかかりそう――
MsgEn:
I'm sorry, but I'm in a hurry, so it might take a
little longer...

MsgJp:
だけど、きっとやり遂げるわ
あなたに協力することが
王家のためになるはずですもの
MsgEn:
But I'm sure we'll get it done.
Helping you will be for the good of the royal
family.

MsgJp:
わたしたちがこうしていられるのも
ようするに、この地に充満した
竜力みたいなモノのお陰――
そういう力が溜まりやすいのよね、ここって
MsgEn:
The reason we can exist like this is essentially
because of the Dragon Force that pervades this
place. It's easy for that kind of power to
accumulate here.

MsgJp:
出られるものなら、わたしたちだって
ここを飛び出して行くわ――
でも、ここでしか姿を保てないんですもの
MsgEn:
If we could go, we would also venture out of
here— but we can only maintain our presence here.

MsgJp:
わたしはイゼル――
あなたはきっと、私の名をご存じないだろうけど
MsgEn: I am Isel-- You probably don't know my name.

MsgJp:
この弓で何度、王家を狙う不届き者を射抜いたことか
でも、今はそうすることもできないのよね
歯がゆいわ
MsgEn:
Worrying is not in my nature. Let me go where the
fighting is.

MsgJp:
あら、あなたのお仲間さんは
もう道を拓いているようね
MsgEn:
Oh, looks like your fellow is already blazing a
trail.

MsgJp:
お仲間さんの力をたどって
一時的に道を開くこともできるわよ
どうする？
MsgEn:
We can temporarily open a path by following the
power of your comrades. What do you want to do?

MsgJp: 通常開拓する
MsgEn: Explore normally

MsgJp: 仲間の力をたどる
MsgEn: Follow the power of your companion

MsgJp:
私はアッカー王家に仕えてきた
ダーマードという――
貴殿をこの先へ導こう
MsgEn:
I have served the Acre royal family.
My name is Damard.
I will guide you from now on.

MsgJp:
ほこらの中にただよう力を
私の元まで集めてきてくれないか
さすれば、ここを埋める土砂を一掃してみせよう
MsgEn:
Gather the power that lies within the dust and
come to me, and I will sweep away the sediment
that fills this place!

MsgJp:
――よくやってくれた
これだけの力が戻れば
この道を拓く程度のことはできるだろう
MsgEn:
You did well. If only this much strength can
return, we should be able to clear this path.

MsgJp:
土砂を一掃し、二度とこの道が
埋まらぬよう力を尽くそう
かつて王の剣であったこの魂にかけても
MsgEn:
Let's clear away the debris and do our best to
ensure this path won't be blocked again. I swear
it on the soul of the sword that once belonged to
the king.

MsgJp:
先へ進むといい、白き竜の覚者よ
アッカーシェランにかかる霧を払ってくれ
MsgEn:
Go ahead, White Dragon's Arisen, and dispel the
fog that hangs over Acre Selund.

MsgJp:
道を通すまでの間
しばし待つことだ、白き竜の覚者よ
MsgEn:
Until the road is cleared, it is necessary to
wait for a while, O Arisen of the White Dragon.

MsgJp:
この道は必ず拓いてみせる
かつて王の剣であったこの魂にかけても
MsgEn:
I will definitely open up this path.
I swear on the soul that once belonged to the
king's sword.

MsgJp:
貴殿が力を求め、《英霊眠りし道》を
訪れたこと――我らにとって僥倖であった
MsgEn:
Your choice to visit the Epitaph Road,
though in search of power, was fortunate for us.

MsgJp:
ご存命の王族は
ネド王子ただお一人、か――
MsgEn:
The only surviving member of the royal family is
Prince Nedo.

MsgJp:
この道をさらに進むことで
貴殿は力を得よう
私にできるのは、その道を拓くことのみ
MsgEn:
By advancing further down this path, you will
gain power. All I can do is pave the way for you.

MsgJp: 貴殿の仲間はすでに道を拓いている
MsgEn: Your comrades have already opened up the path.

MsgJp:
仲間の力をたどり、一時的に
この場を通ることも可能だろう
――貴殿の考えを聞こう
MsgEn:
It would be possible to trace the power of our
friends and temporarily pass through this place.
--Let's hear your thoughts!

MsgJp: 通常開拓する
MsgEn: Explore normally

MsgJp: 仲間の力をたどる
MsgEn: Follow the power of your companion

MsgJp:
覚者さま、こちらはフェルヤナ地方の
《英霊眠りし道》です
MsgEn: Master Arisen, this is the Epitaph Road in the Feryana region.

MsgJp:
あの――
すでにご存じかとは思いますが
《英霊眠りし道》は特別な場所です
武具の準備が万端でないと、厳しいかと――
MsgEn:
Um... I'm sure you already know this,
but "The Epitaph Road" is a special place.
If you're not properly equipped,
it's going to be tough...

MsgJp:
並の武具では、そう簡単に奥へは進めません
――そもそも土砂で埋まってもいます
どうにかして土砂を撤去できるなら、あるいは――
MsgEn:
Can't get far with regular equipment.
Besides, it's buried in rubble.
If there's any way to remove the debris,
then perhaps...

MsgJp:
進まれるんですね、覚者さま
お気をつけて――
無事のお戻りを祈っております
MsgEn:
You are making progress, Arisen.
Please take care. I pray for your safe return.

MsgJp:
開拓した場所から再突入できるようになりました！
きっと英霊のご加護のおかげですね
MsgEn:
We can now re-enter the area
from where we explored! I'm sure it's thanks
to the blessings of the war spirits.

MsgJp: 開拓した場所から再突入されますか？
MsgEn: Reenter the unsealed area?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
パーティーリーダーが行き先を
選ぶまでお待ちください――
MsgEn:
Please wait for the party leader to choose the
destination.

MsgJp:
パーティーリーダーがお待ちのようです
《英霊眠りし道》へ突入されますか？
MsgEn:
The party leader is waiting for you.
Would you like to enter "Heroic Spirit Sleeping
Path"?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
覚者さま、まずは開拓状況や
装備品をご確認の上で進まれてはいかがでしょう？
MsgEn:
Dear Arisen, first, would you like to check the
development situation and equipment before
proceeding?

MsgJp: 《英霊眠りし道》に入る
MsgEn: Enter 《Epitaph Road》

MsgJp: 開拓状況確認
MsgEn: Check Reclamation Status

MsgJp: 報酬取得状況確認
MsgEn: Check Acquired Rewards Status

MsgJp:
あれだけの土砂を
全て撤去されたのですね！
覚者の力というのは、我々には
想像も及ばないものです――
MsgEn:
All that rubble has been completely cleared! The
power of an Arisen is something beyond our
imagination.

MsgJp:
全ての道を踏破した者には
最後の試練が待ち受けているそうです
MsgEn:
According to those who have conquered all paths,
there awaits the ultimate trial.

MsgJp:
ええ、信じがたいことですが――
開かずの扉が開いています
ここにまつわる伝承は、真実だったのですね
MsgEn:
Yes, it's hard to believe, but the sealed door is
open. The legends surrounding this place were
indeed true!

MsgJp:
最後の試練に向かわれる時は
ぜひ、私に声をおかけください
出発の手筈を整えさせていただきますから
MsgEn:
When you're ready to face the final trial, please
don't hesitate to call on me. I'll make the
necessary preparations for your departure.

MsgJp:
覚者さま、まずは開拓状況や
装備品をご確認の上で進まれてはいかがでしょう？
MsgEn:
Dear Arisen, first, would you like to check the
development situation and equipment
before proceeding?

MsgJp: 《英霊眠りし道》に入る
MsgEn: Enter 《Epitaph Road》

MsgJp: 開拓状況確認
MsgEn: Check Reclamation Status

MsgJp: 報酬取得状況確認
MsgEn: Check Acquired Rewards Status

MsgJp: 最後の試練に挑む
MsgEn: Challenge Final Ordeal

MsgJp:
――"最後の試練"がどのようなものか
知っている者はおりません
この地に伝わる伝承でも
"最後の試練"については語られていないのです
MsgEn:
Nobody knows what the 'Final Ordeal' is like.
Even the legends passed down in this place do not
speak of the 'Final Ordeal.'

MsgJp:
しかし、私は――多分、他のみんなも――
覚者さまであれば、その"試練"も
乗り越えられることと信じております
MsgEn:
However, I, and perhaps everyone else, believe
that with the Arisen, even this "trial" can be
overcome.

MsgJp:
それでは、お進みください
覚者さまのご武運をお祈りしています
MsgEn:
With this bow, I've pierced many insolent people
who aimed at the royal family. But now I can't do
that anymore. It's frustrating.

MsgJp:
覚者さま！？
装備品をお間違えではないでしょうか――
MsgEn:
Ser Arisen!? Your equipment, could it be a
mistake—

MsgJp:
その、今お召しになっている武具で
この先に進むのは大変危険です
相応の装備でないと、ここを
お通しすることはできません
MsgEn:
With the equipment you are currently wearing,
it's very dangerous to proceed further. Without
the appropriate gear, you won't be able to pass
through here.

MsgJp:
伝承が本当なら――
私のような新兵一人が
ここの警備を任されるべきでは
ないと思うのですが――
MsgEn:
If the legends are true, I don't think a rookie
like me should be entrusted with guarding this
place alone.

MsgJp:
《英霊眠りし道》はアッカーシェラン大陸の
各地にあるそうです――
いくつあるのか、ですか？
私はその、不勉強なんですが――
MsgEn:
I've heard that there are "Epitaph Roads"
scattered throughout the Acre Selund continent.
How many are there, though?
I wouldn't know...

MsgJp: なぜだか、ここは少し冷えます――
MsgEn: For some reason, it gets a little cold here--

MsgJp:
やあ、白き竜の覚者さん
アッカーシェランはどうだい
MsgEn:
Hello, Arisen of the White Dragon.
How do you find Acre Selund?

MsgJp:
さて、この土砂をどうにかしなきゃいけないな
近くに散らばった力を集めてきてくれないか？
MsgEn:
Now, we need to figure out what to do with this
earth and sand. Could you gather the scattered
power nearby for me, please?

MsgJp:
俺たちの精神力――いや、魂というのかな
そういったものは、辺りを流れる竜力と
混じって曖昧なものになってるんだ
MsgEn:
Our spiritual power - or soul, I guess you'd call
it - is mixed up with the Dragon Force that flows
around us, and it's all a blur.

MsgJp:
だから、一度俺自身が使える力として
集めてきてもらわないと動けなくてね
MsgEn:
So, I can't move without first gathering power as
something I can use myself.

MsgJp: よしよし、これで何とかなるはずだ
MsgEn: Good, good. This should work somehow.

MsgJp:
なに、君をこの先へ導くことが
王家のためになるというならば
土砂をどける程度のこと――
MsgEn:
Well, if it's in the best interest of the royal
family to lead you beyond the dirt and sand--

MsgJp:
ここにあった土砂か？
――恐らく、衝撃で吹き飛んでいったようだ
この先で土埃になって舞い散ってるんじゃないか？
MsgEn:
Is this the sand and soil that was here? It seems
like it was blown away by the impact. Could it be
turning into dust and scattering ahead?

MsgJp:
ああ、俺のことは気にしなくていい
用が無くなれば、また眠りにつくことになる
早いとこ寝かせてくれよ、ハハハ
――この国を頼んだぜ
MsgEn:
Oh, don't worry about me. When I have no more use
for you, I'll go back to sleep. Let me sleep
early, hahaha—I'm asking for this country, man!

MsgJp:
すまない、今は都合が悪いんだ
少し時間をおいてから
また来てくれないか
MsgEn:
I'm sorry, it's inconvenient for me right now.
Could you come back later, after some time?

MsgJp: 悪いね――
MsgEn: Sorry---

MsgJp:
おっと、君の仲間は
すでにこの先に行ったことがあるようだな
MsgEn:
Oops, it seems like your companions
have already gone ahead.

MsgJp:
仲間の力をたどって
一時的にここを通ることもできるが――
どうしたい？
MsgEn:
You can temporarily pass through here by
following the power of your comrades, but what do
you want to do?

MsgJp: 通常開拓する
MsgEn: Explore normally

MsgJp: 仲間の力をたどる
MsgEn: Follow the power of your companion

MsgJp:
確かに生きてる頃は王の一番傍にいたし
それなりに国に尽くしたつもりだけど――
俺はいわゆる"王の乳兄弟"ってやつでさ
MsgEn:
I was the closest thing to the king when he was
alive, and I've served the country in my own way,
but-- I'm what you might call the "king's baby
brother."

MsgJp:
歴史に名を残すような、ものすごいことを
成し遂げたわけじゃないと思うんだよな
まさか、こんなに丁寧に葬られることになるとはね
MsgEn:
I don't think I've accomplished anything
incredible that will be remembered in history. I
never expected that I would be buried so carefully
like this.

MsgJp:
ところで、君は死んだ人間と話すことに
慣れてるみたいに見えるな
MsgEn:
By the way, you seem accustomed to talking to the
deceased.

MsgJp: 君を巻き込んですまないと思ってるんだ、俺は
MsgEn: I'm sorry for involving you, I am

MsgJp:
おお――
異大陸の覚者様
ようこそここまでいらっしゃいました
MsgEn:
Oh--
Dear Arisen of Another Continent.
Welcome to this place!

MsgJp:
申し上げにくいことですが、覚者様に
ご協力するための"力"を
集めてきていただかねばなりません
MsgEn:
I am sorry to say this, but we need you to go and
gather the "power" to help us!

MsgJp:
我々の存在は今や希薄なものです
どうぞよろしくお願いします
あなた様の道を拓くためなのです――
MsgEn:
Our existence is now rare.
Nice to meet you!
We are here to pave the way for you--

MsgJp:
確かに――
さぁ、先へお進みください
MsgEn:
Certainly--
Now, please proceed!

MsgJp:
この道が通れるようになったことも、ひいては
あなた様ご自身のお力によるものです
そのお力で――幼き王子をよろしくお願いします
MsgEn:
The fact that this road is passable is, in turn,
due to your own strength.
With that strength - please take care of the
little prince!

MsgJp:
どうぞ、先へお進みください
この道は二度と土砂に埋まることはないでしょう
MsgEn:
Please, continue ahead.
This path will never be buried in sand and earth
again.

MsgJp:
申し訳ございません、今は――
少し時間をおいてから
おいでください
MsgEn: I apologize, please come back after a few hours.

MsgJp:
異大陸の覚者様
お仲間はすでにこの先を
通っていらっしゃるようです
MsgEn:
Arisen from a different land. It seems that your
companions have already passed through this point.

MsgJp:
お仲間の跡を辿り、この場でのみ
先へ行くことも可能です
いかがいたしましょう？
MsgEn:
You can also follow your comrades' trail and
proceed further from this place alone. What would
you like to do?

MsgJp: 通常開拓する
MsgEn: Explore normally

MsgJp: 仲間の力をたどる
MsgEn: Follow the power of your companion

MsgJp:
ネド王子――
御年12歳の王子に
なんと過酷な運命でしょう――
MsgEn:
Prince Nedo--
What a harsh fate for a prince of 12 years of
age--

MsgJp:
ネド王子に寄り添い、お支えする者すら
いないままとは――
なんという――
MsgEn:
To think there is no one to be by Prince Nedo's
side and support him... What a situation...

MsgJp:
ネド王子は――
まだ、覚者となるには
あまりにも早すぎました
MsgEn:
Prince Nedo――
it was still too early for him to become an
Arisen.

MsgJp:
来たわね、白き翼の加護を得し覚者さん
さ、どうする？
MsgEn:
You're finally here; the Arisen who received the
protection of the white wings. So, what will you
do?

MsgJp:
ここまでお疲れ様！
だけど、あなたたちはもっともっと先に
進まないといけない――
MsgEn:
Good job so far!
But you guys need to go on much, much further--

MsgJp:
もうわかってるわよね？
私がここの土砂を片付けてあげるから
そのための力を集めてきてちょうだい
MsgEn:
You already know that, don't you?
I'll clean up the sediment here for you.
Go gather the strength to do so.

MsgJp:
うん、ありがとう
おかげで私も、もう一働きできたわ
MsgEn:
Yes, thank you. Thanks to you, I was able to work
one more shift.

MsgJp:
――こういうの、本当は
よその国の人に任せるべきじゃないと
思うんだけどさ
MsgEn:
I really don't think that this kind of thing
should be left to people from other countries.

MsgJp:
だけど、今戦うことができる覚者は
あなたしかいない――
だから、頼んだわね
MsgEn:
But, the only one who can fight now is the
Arisen―― So, I'm counting on you.

MsgJp:
さぁ、行ってちょうだい
あなたが力を得ることが
この国の未来に繋がるんだから
MsgEn:
Go ahead, go ahead. Your empowerment is the
future of this country.

MsgJp: ごめんね、今手一杯なんだ――
MsgEn: Sorry, I've got my hands full right now—

MsgJp: また時間置いてから来てよ！
MsgEn: Come back after some time!

MsgJp:
ふぅん、あなたのお友達は
もうこの先に行ってるみたいよ
MsgEn:
Hmm, it seems like your friends have already
moved on ahead.

MsgJp:
お友達の力をたどって、一時的に
あなたもこの先へ行けるけど
どうする？
MsgEn:
Following the power of your friends, you can
temporarily go this way, but, what will you do?

MsgJp: 通常開拓する
MsgEn: Explore normally

MsgJp: 仲間の力をたどる
MsgEn: Follow the power of your companion

MsgJp:
私がまたアッカーシェランのために働くのは
もっともっと、ずっと遠い未来のことかと思ってた
MsgEn:
I thought that working for Acre Selund again
would be something for a much, much more distant
future.

MsgJp: 国が潰えるのって、一瞬なのね
MsgEn: It only takes a moment for a country to crumble.

MsgJp:
自分の命はなくなっても
国っていうのは未来永劫続くような気がしてたの
MsgEn:
Even if my life were to disappear, I always felt
like the country would continue forever.

MsgJp:
私たちが大切に育んできたアッカーシェランが
こんな姿になった時にしか目覚めないなんて
ちょっと損な気もするわ
MsgEn:
When our beloved Acre Selund has become like
this, and only awakens in such a state, it feels
like a bit of a loss.

MsgJp:
もっとこう――
華やかに栄えたアッカーシェランを
見たかったのに
MsgEn:
I would have liked to have seen a more--
gloriously prosperous Acre Selund.

MsgJp:
アデライデ様の頃のアッカーシェランは
それは活気に満ち溢れた美しい国だったの
MsgEn:
During the time of Lady Adelaide, Acre Selund was
a vibrant and beautiful country overflowing with
energy.

MsgJp:
私は――あまり長くはお傍にいられなかったけど
この国の未来は明るく素敵なことばかりって
そう信じて、疑うこともなかったわ
MsgEn:
I couldn't stay by your side for long, but I
believed in a bright and wonderful future for this
country, and I never doubted it.

MsgJp: ワイは第八のたかし。工事担当者や。
MsgEn:
I am Takashi the eighth. I'm in charge of
construction.

MsgJp: ここを拡張するなら、納品してや
MsgEn:
If you're going to expand this place, you're
going to have to deliver.

MsgJp: たしかに受け取ったで。
MsgEn: Certainly, I received it.

MsgJp: 工事が終わったら、来週には入口のおっさんが
MsgEn:
Once the construction is finished, the old man at
the entrance will let you know next week!

MsgJp: 教えてくれるで！
MsgEn: They'll tell you!

MsgJp: ここはすでに工事済みやで！
MsgEn: This place is already under construction!

MsgJp:
すまん・・・
今週はワイらほかの工事で手いっぱいやねん。
MsgEn:
Sorry...
We're really busy with other construction work
this week.

MsgJp: また来週な！
MsgEn: See you next week!

MsgJp: ワイは第九のたかし。工事担当者や。
MsgEn:
I am Takashi the ninth. I'm in charge of
construction.

MsgJp: ここを拡張するなら、納品してや
MsgEn:
If you're going to expand this place, you're
going to have to deliver.

MsgJp: たしかに受け取ったで。
MsgEn: Certainly, I received it.

MsgJp: 工事が終わったら、来週には入口のおっさんが
MsgEn:
Once the construction is finished, the old man at
the entrance will let you know next week!

MsgJp: 教えてくれるで！
MsgEn: They'll tell you!

MsgJp: ここはすでに工事済みやで！
MsgEn: This place is already under construction!

MsgJp:
すまん・・・
今週はワイらほかの工事で手いっぱいやねん。
MsgEn:
Sorry...
We have our hands full with other construction
this week.

MsgJp: また来週な！
MsgEn: See you next week!

MsgJp: ワイは第十のたかし。工事担当者や。
MsgEn:
I am the tenth Takashi. I am in charge of the
construction.

MsgJp: ここを拡張するなら、納品してや
MsgEn:
If you're going to expand this place, you're

MsgJp: たしかに受け取ったで。
MsgEn: Certainly, I received it.

MsgJp: 工事が終わったら、来週には入口のおっさんが
MsgEn:
Once the construction is finished, the old man at

MsgJp: 教えてくれるで！
MsgEn: They'll tell you!

MsgJp: ここはすでに工事済みやで！
MsgEn: This place is already under construction!

MsgJp:
すまん・・・
今週はワイらほかの工事で手いっぱいやねん。
MsgEn:
Sorry...
We're really busy with other construction work
this week.

MsgJp: また来週な！
MsgEn: See you next week!

MsgJp: ワイは第十一のたかし。工事担当者や。
MsgEn:
I am Takashi the eleventh. I am in charge of the
construction work.

MsgJp: ここを拡張するなら、納品してや
MsgEn:
If you're going to expand this place, you're
going to have to deliver.

MsgJp: たしかに受け取ったで。
MsgEn: Certainly, I received it.

MsgJp: 工事が終わったら、来週には入口のおっさんが
MsgEn:
Once the construction is finished, the old man at
the entrance will let you know next week!

MsgJp: 教えてくれるで！
MsgEn: They'll tell you!

MsgJp: ここはすでに工事済みやで！
MsgEn: This place is already under construction!

MsgJp:
すまん・・・
今週はワイらほかの工事で手いっぱいやねん。
MsgEn:
Sorry...
We have our hands full with other construction
this week.

MsgJp: また来週な！
MsgEn: See you next week!

MsgJp:
あなたが噂の覚者様ですね
話は聞いております――（仮）
MsgEn:
You must be the renowned Arisen, I've heard
stories about you

MsgJp:
この先はとても危険な場所です
武具はある程度揃えてからが良いでしょう――（仮）
MsgEn:
This area ahead is very dangerous. It's best to
have your equipment at a decent level before
proceeding.

MsgJp:
どうやら英霊が力を貸して、
深層に続く道を切り拓いてくれたようです――（仮）
MsgEn:
It seems that the spirits of the dead have helped
pave the way to the depths--

MsgJp:
深層に進む際はご注意ください
より強力な魔物が潜んでいるかもしれません――（仮）
MsgEn:
Please be careful when delving deeper. There may
be more powerful enemies lurking.

MsgJp: この先は１人で進むにはとても危険です――（仮）
MsgEn: It is very dangerous to go on alone ahead.

MsgJp: 他の仲間が来るまで少々お待ちください――（仮）
MsgEn:
Please wait a moment until the rest of the group
arrives.

MsgJp:
私は代々アッカー王国に仕えてきた、
タカシという――（仮）
MsgEn:
I have served the Acre Kingdom for generations,
My name is Takashi.

MsgJp:
このほこらに漂っている
「英霊の魂」を集め私に捧げたら、
力を貸してあげよう――（仮）
MsgEn:
If you collect the
"Souls of Heroic Spirits" floating in this dust
and offer them to me,
I will lend you my power--

MsgJp:
これだけの魂を、良く集めてきたな
おかげで私の力が戻ったようだ――（仮）
MsgEn:
You've done a great job collecting all these
souls.
Thanks to you, I seem to have my strength back

MsgJp: お前なら更なる深層に潜ることもできそうだな――（仮）
MsgEn:
You seem capable of delving deeper into the
depths as well

MsgJp:
少しだけ時間をくれたら、
この土砂をどけておくよ――（仮）
MsgEn:
Give me a minute and I'll get this sediment out
of the way.

MsgJp: 土砂をどけて道を作っておいたよ――（仮）
MsgEn: I cleared away the earth and made a path.

MsgJp:
君のような覚者なら、
この先に眠るお宝にたどり着けるかもね――（仮）
MsgEn:
If you are an Arisen,
You might be able to reach the treasure that lies
ahead

MsgJp:
すまない、想定より
時間がかかってしまっているんだ――（仮）
MsgEn:
Sorry, it's taking
longer than expected

MsgJp: もう少しだけ時間をくれないか――（仮）
MsgEn: Just give me a little more time.

MsgJp:
はっ、覚者様でしたか
何のご用でしょう？
MsgEn: Oh, it's an Arisen. What brings you here?

MsgJp:
そういえば、先日一人で歩いてる
子供を見かけまして――
声をかければよかったと、今でも後悔してるんです
MsgEn:
You know, I saw a kid walking alone the other
day--
and I still regret that I did not call out to him!

MsgJp:
少し腹が減りませんか？
ああ、温かいスープでも飲んで
一息つける場所でもあれば――
MsgEn:
Hungry for a little something?
Oh, if only there was a place where you could
have a hot bowl of soup and
take a breather--

MsgJp:
覚者様ほどの方でも
後悔されることって、あるんでしょうか？
MsgEn:
Is it possible that even someone as wise as you
would regret it?

MsgJp:
ちょっと、今忙しいんだけど――
手短になら話を聞こう
MsgEn:
Hey, I'm kind of busy right now--
I'll talk to you if you'll be brief.

MsgJp:
ん？
この程度の傷、舐めておけば治る
MsgEn:
Hmm?
A wound like this, just lick it and it will heal.

MsgJp:
私がこの大剣を振るうことで
ほんの少しでも状況が変われば
良いと思ってな
MsgEn:
I hope my wielding of this great sword will
change things even a little.

MsgJp:
その佇まい――
覚者殿はかなりの鍛練を積まれた方と見える
MsgEn:
The way you look--
you seem to be a very well-trained person, Master
Arisen.

MsgJp:
やらねばならないことが
たくさんありますから――
MsgEn: There's a lot of work to be done, so--

MsgJp:
解放軍もずいぶん減ってしまいましたから
いつも手一杯ですよ
でも、誰かがやらねば――
MsgEn:
The Liberation Army has dwindled down so much
that we always have our hands full. But someone
has to—

MsgJp:
――おっと、すみません
よそ見をしておりました
MsgEn: --oops, sorry. I was looking at the stranger!

MsgJp:
どこへ行ってもオークの臭いがするのは
気にしすぎなのでしょうか
MsgEn:
Is it "too much" to worry about smelling Orcs
everywhere I go?

MsgJp: どうかなさいましたか？
MsgEn: What's wrong?

MsgJp:
覚者さま！
お噂はかねがね――
MsgEn: Ser Arisen! I have always heard rumors about you—

MsgJp:
覚者さまの噂を耳にするたび
勇気付けられているんです
こうしてお会いできるなんて――
MsgEn:
Whenever I hear rumors about the Arisen, I feel
encouraged. To be able to meet like this...

MsgJp:
こうして今、わたしの命があるのも
覚者さまのお陰ですね
MsgEn:
And so now, the reason I am alive is thanks to
the Arisen's grace.

MsgJp: はい、何でしょう？
MsgEn: Yes, what is it?

MsgJp:
王家の方々のお役に立てるなら
――何でもします
MsgEn:
If I can be of service to the royal family, I
will do anything.

MsgJp:
一人の力は小さくとも
みなが力を合わせれば――！
MsgEn:
Even though one's power may be small, if everyone
combines their strength――!

MsgJp: 雑談は苦手でして――
MsgEn: I'm not good at small talk---

MsgJp: ご用でしょうか、覚者様
MsgEn: May I help you, Master Arisen

MsgJp:
すぐに状況が良くなるとは思っていません
明日、今日より悪くならないようにと
解放軍に加わったんです
MsgEn:
I don't think the situation will improve
immediately, so I joined the Liberation Army to
ensure that tomorrow won't be worse than today.

MsgJp:
私個人が覚者さまの
お役にたてそうなことは――
今のところ思い浮かびませんね
MsgEn:
As for me personally, I can't think of anything
that I can do for Ser Arisen at the moment...

MsgJp: オークどもめ――
MsgEn: Orc scum--

MsgJp: ん？　今呼びました？
MsgEn: Hm? Did you call for me just now?

MsgJp:
いや、覚者さまに自分ごときが
声をかけられるなんて、と思いましてね
MsgEn:
No, for someone like me to be approached by an
Arisen, I couldn't believe it.

MsgJp:
あんまり雑談してると
後で叱られそうなんで、この辺で！
MsgEn:
If we keep chatting too much, I might get scolded
later, so let's stop here!

MsgJp: この戦争、いつ終わるんですかね――
MsgEn: When will this war—when will it end?

MsgJp: まったく、落ち着く暇もないわね
MsgEn: Not a moment to relax at all.

MsgJp:
なに？
特に話題も無いのに話しかけてこないで
MsgEn:
What is it? Don't talk to me when there's nothing
to talk about.

MsgJp:
少しでもいいから休憩したいのよ
足が棒みたいよ
MsgEn:
I need a break, even just a little one. My legs
feel like sticks.

MsgJp: はぁ――あんたも懲りないわよね
MsgEn: Sigh... You never learn, do you?

MsgJp: 何だ？
MsgEn: What?

MsgJp: お前と個人的に話すような話題は無いな
MsgEn:
There's no personal topic I would talk to you
about.

MsgJp: 何か面白い話でもしてくれるってのか？
MsgEn: Do you have any interesting stories to tell me?

MsgJp: 楽して儲けられる話なら歓迎するがな
MsgEn:
If it's a story that can make money easily, then
I welcome it.

MsgJp: 王家に協力することになるとはな
MsgEn:
I never thought I would be cooperating with the
royal family.

MsgJp: 人生、何が起こるかわからんもんだ！
MsgEn: You never know what will happen in life!

MsgJp: ま、こういうのも悪くはないぜ
MsgEn: Well, this isn't too bad either.

MsgJp:
俺たちが今まで盗みを働いた件を
チャラにするって話には――ならないか
MsgEn:
I'm not sure if you're talking about making
amends for all the times we've stolen from you...

MsgJp: 話しかけてくるなんて珍しいね
MsgEn:
It's rare for someone to come and talk to me like
this.

MsgJp:
アンタ、覚者ってやつなんでしょ？
何かすごいことしてみせてよ
空を飛ぶとか――
MsgEn:
You're one of those Arisen, right? Why don't you
show us something amazing, like flying in the sky
or something?

MsgJp:
王家側も、まさかアタシたち盗賊に
協力を要請するようなことになるなんて
思わなかっただろうね
MsgEn:
Even the royal family, never would have thought
they would end up asking for cooperation from us
bandits...

MsgJp:
アタシとしても
国は平和な方がいいからさ
MsgEn: For me too, I prefer the country to be peaceful.

MsgJp: お呼びですか？
MsgEn: Are you calling for me?

MsgJp: ううん、何か話をと言われましても――
MsgEn: No, even if you ask me to talk about something -

MsgJp:
そうそう、もしロスギルに行かれた際は
翡翠湖を眺めていってくださいね
観光の目玉ですから
MsgEn:
Oh yes, if you happen to visit Rothgill, please
make sure to take a look at the view of Emerald
Lake. It's a popular tourist attraction.

MsgJp:
困りましたねぇ
有益な情報でもお話できれば
良かったんですが――
MsgEn:
I'm stumped. I wish I could share some useful
information with you.

MsgJp: はい、なんでしょう？
MsgEn: Yes, what is it?

MsgJp: あ、私語はちょっと――
MsgEn: Oh, I'm sorry, I don't want to talk about—

MsgJp: ここに来ているのは任務なので――
MsgEn: I'm here on a mission, so...

MsgJp: む、ええっと、雑談をお望みなので――？
MsgEn:
Um, well, since you're looking for some small
talk...?

MsgJp: はっ、ご用は何でしょうか
MsgEn: Ha, what can I do for you?

MsgJp:
申し訳ございませんが、私から
お伝えできる情報は無いのです
MsgEn:
I'm sorry, but I don't have any information to
share with you.

MsgJp: ロスギルはまだオークの襲撃を逃れていますよ
MsgEn: Rothgill is still avoiding Orc attacks.

MsgJp:
す、すみません
護衛としてまいりましたので
私は本当に何も知らないのです
MsgEn:
Um, sorry. I came as a guard, so I really don't
know anything.

MsgJp: チチッ！　チューッ！
MsgEn: Tch! Tsh!

MsgJp: キッ　キッ
MsgEn: Kch Kch.

MsgJp: （耳を静かに動かしている）
MsgEn: (Moving ears quietly)

MsgJp: フゴッ　プギプギ
MsgEn: Fuh～ Piggly

MsgJp: モォ～～～
MsgEn: Mooo～

MsgJp:
フィョ？　キーッキーッ
コココ――
MsgEn:
Huh? Kikkikk
Cococo--

MsgJp: キュッ　ピィ！
MsgEn: Qee Pyi!

MsgJp: プィ？
MsgEn: Pyi?

MsgJp: キャーーッ！
MsgEn: Kyaa!

MsgJp:
フィフィ？
クキュキュ――
MsgEn: Fifi? Kokyukyuu-

MsgJp:
ああ、覚者さんか
何だい？
MsgEn: Ah, are you an Arisen? What's up?

MsgJp:
ココだけの話、キャリーの飯って
とびきり美味いわけじゃないんだよな
MsgEn:
Speaking confidentially, Carrie's cooking isn't
particularly delicious, you know.

MsgJp:
でも、なんだか力が湧いてくる味なんだ
覚者さんもそう思わないか？
MsgEn:
But, it somehow has a taste that gives me
strength. Don't you think so, Arisen?

MsgJp:
出かけるんなら、キャリーに言って
何か包んでもらっていくといい
MsgEn:
If you're going out, tell Carrie and have her
wrap something for you to take.

MsgJp:
こんな状況だから、飯なんて
食えればいいと思ってたけど――
MsgEn:
Because of this situation, I thought it would be
enough to just be able to eat dinner, but...

MsgJp:
できたてのあったかいものを食べると
ほっとするんだよ
それが嬉しいんだ
MsgEn:
When you eat something freshly made and warm, you
feel relieved. It makes you happy.

MsgJp:
まぁ、こういう作業も
嫌いなわけじゃないよ
MsgEn:
Well, it's not that I don't like this kind of
work.

MsgJp:
人手不足だから色々とやることはあるんだが
なぜかここに足が向くんだよな
MsgEn:
Because there is a shortage of manpower, there
are various things to do, but for some reason, my
feet always gravitate towards here.

MsgJp:
別に、何か食べ物にありつけないかって魂胆で
ここら辺うろついてるわけじゃないんだ
MsgEn:
I'm not wandering around here with the intention
of finding something to eat or anything like that.

MsgJp:
これも縁ってやつだ
大食堂が完全に復旧するまで協力するよ
MsgEn:
This is also fate. I'll help until the big dining
hall is fully restored.

MsgJp:
なんていうかさ
"居場所"を見つけるとほっとするよな
MsgEn:
You know, it's just like when you find your
"place to belong". It's such a relief, you know.

MsgJp:
生きるために戦場を転々としてきたから
そんなもん探す余裕もなかったけど
MsgEn:
I've been in so many battles to stay alive that I
didn't have time to look for that stuff.

MsgJp:
さて――
まだまだやることはたくさん残ってるね
MsgEn:
Well―― There are still plenty of things left to
do, right?

MsgJp:
ここに来ると、なんというか――
ティネス砦を取り返したって実感が湧くよね
MsgEn:
When you come here, it's like... you feel a sense
of accomplishment, right? Like, we've taken back
Fort Thines.

MsgJp:
変な話だけど、ここってなぜだか
ゴブリンがウロウロしてるんだ
MsgEn:
It's a strange story, but for some reason, there
are goblins wandering around here.

MsgJp:
当のゴブリンが妙に楽しそうにしてるから
みんな何となく見て見ぬふりしてるよ
どうもキャリーに懐いてるみたいだし――
MsgEn:
Since the Goblin seems oddly happy, everyone is
pretending not to see and just watching. It seems
like he's attached to Carrie, so...

MsgJp:
覚者さんも時間があれば
座っていきなよ
MsgEn:
If you have time, Master Arisen, please have a
seat

MsgJp:
私もブラッドと一緒にここに残って
キャリーを手伝うことにしたよ
MsgEn:
I've decided to stay here with Brad and help
Carrie.

MsgJp:
これでもハンターとして
罠仕掛けたり弓扱ったり
手先は器用な方だしね
MsgEn:
I'm still a hunter; setting traps, handling bows,
and I'm good with my hands.

MsgJp:
キャリー見てるとさ
なんか不思議とこっちも"やらなきゃ"
って思えるんだよね
MsgEn:
When I watch Carrie, it's strange, but I also
feel like I should do something.

MsgJp:
ん？
覚者さんもそう思うのかい？
MsgEn: Huh? Do you feel the same way, Arisen?

MsgJp: この大食堂って、かなり期待されてるんだね
MsgEn: This Dining Hall, it's been highly anticipated.

MsgJp:
大食堂を直してる話をしたら
自分も手伝うって人が結構いてさ
MsgEn:
When I told them I was fixing up the big dining
hall, there were a lot of people who wanted to
help out too.

MsgJp:
あそこにいる二人もそうで
修理をお願いしてるところさ
MsgEn: Those two over there are also asking for repairs.

MsgJp:
ブラッドとは長い付き合いでね
ちょっと人にきつく当たることもあるけど
根はいいやつだよ
MsgEn:
Brad and I have been together for a long time.
Sometimes he can be a bit harsh with people, but
deep down he's a good guy.

MsgJp:
以前ここへ荷物を運ぶ途中
ゴブリンたちに襲われたときも
なんとか私を逃がそうとしてくれたし
MsgEn:
Before, when I was on my way here to deliver the
package, even when I was attacked by goblins they
somehow managed to help me escape.

MsgJp:
こんな世の中だけど
助け合って生きていく喜びを感じられるのは
唯一いいことだと思えるよ
MsgEn:
Despite the way the world is, I believe that the
only good thing is being able to feel the joy of
helping each other and living together.

MsgJp:
いつ戦いになるか分からないからね
弓の手入れは入念にやってるよ
MsgEn:
You never know when you'll be in a fight. I'm
meticulous about taking care of my bow.

MsgJp:
もしまたティネスに――
魔物が入り込んで来るようなことがあったら
全力でいくって決めてるんだ
MsgEn:
If an enemy were to sneak into Fort Thines again,
I'm determined to go all out.

MsgJp: はいはーい、何かご用？
MsgEn: Yes, hello, can I help you?

MsgJp:
さー、食べて飲んで
楽しくいきましょ！
MsgEn: Well, let's eat and drink and have fun!

MsgJp:
皆の楽しそうな顔を見てると
私も幸せな気持ちになってくるわ
こういう場があるって、大事だよね！
MsgEn:
Seeing everyone's happy faces makes me happy too.
It's important to have a place like this!

MsgJp:
キャリーちゃんのご飯、もう食べた？
元気の源、補充していってね！
MsgEn:
Have you eaten Carrie's food yet?
Please replenish the source of your energy!

MsgJp:
私は大食堂の元の姿を知ってるから――
初めて奪還後のココを見た時は
ちょっとショック受けちゃった
MsgEn:
Because I know what the Dining Hall looked like in
its original form-- When I first saw this place
after it was recaptured, I was a little shocked.

MsgJp:
大食堂の復旧、頑張ろうね！
ティネス砦の名物だったんだから
MsgEn:
Let's do our best to restore the dining hall! It
was the pride of Fort Thines, after all.

MsgJp:
ああ、早く人がいっぱいの
元通りの大食堂で働きたいな――
MsgEn:
Oh, I can't wait to work in a Grand Dining Hall full
of people, back to normal--

MsgJp:
キャリーちゃん、無理してないかな
大丈夫かな――
MsgEn:
Carrie, are you sure you're not pushing yourself
too hard? I hope you're okay--

MsgJp: ふふ、どうかした？
MsgEn: Hmmm, what's wrong?

MsgJp:
美味しいものを楽しむのは
気分転換にぴったりよね
MsgEn:
Enjoying delicious food is perfect for a change
of mood.

MsgJp:
活気があるところって大好きなの
ティネス砦に来られて良かったわ
MsgEn:
I love places with a lively atmosphere. I'm glad
I came to Fort Thines.

MsgJp:
さぁ、覚者さんも何か食べましょうよ
それとも、飲みたい気分？
MsgEn:
Now, let's get you something to eat, Arisen. Or
would you like something to drink?

MsgJp:
ヘザーから聞いたんだけど
元の大食堂って、常に笑顔の人でいっぱい
だったんですって
MsgEn:
Heather told me that the original diner was
always full of smiling people

MsgJp: そんな光景、もうずっと見てないなって――
MsgEn: I haven't seen anything like that in a long time.

MsgJp:
まだまだやることはあるんでしょう？
くじけていられないわよね
MsgEn:
There's still a lot to do, right? I can't afford
to be discouraged.

MsgJp: さぁ、何でも手伝うわよ！
MsgEn: Now, I'll help with anything!

MsgJp:
え？　踊りを見たいって――？
ふふ、後でね
MsgEn:
Huh? You want to see me dance?
Hehe, maybe later

MsgJp:
シッ――
あまり大きな声を出すな
MsgEn: Shhhh—Don't speak too loudly.

MsgJp: 誰かにつけられてはいないだろうな？
MsgEn: You're not being followed by anyone, are you?

MsgJp:
よぉ相棒
わざわざ足を運んでもらって、悪いな
MsgEn:
Hey, partner. Sorry for making you come all this
way.

MsgJp:
クルト家の今後は
まだどうなるか分からないんだ
<NPC 681>は家族をもうけなかったようでな
MsgEn:
I'm not yet sure what the future holds for the
Kurt family. <NPC 681> didn't seem to have a
family of their own.

MsgJp:
だが、次の当主がどんな人間でも
俺は支えていくつもりだ
それが――俺なりの、恩返しだと思ってさ
MsgEn:
But I'm going to support the next head of the
family, no matter who he is. That's how I'm going
to repay him.

MsgJp: 手短にな
MsgEn: To make it brief.

MsgJp:
メガドは、アッカー王家が直々に治める街だが
実質的に政治を動かしているのは
クルト侯爵家なんだ
MsgEn:
Megado is a city ruled directly by the Acre Royal
Family, but in practice, the one wielding
political power is the Marquis Family, Kurt.

MsgJp:
メガドの夜は、昼とは異なり
渾沌とした一面を持っている
――<NPC 681>が爵位を継いでから
行った政策のせいだ
MsgEn:
The night in Megado is different from the day and
has a chaotic aspect
-- due to the policies that<NPC 681>has
implemented since he took over the knighthood.

MsgJp:
メガドにいる間は、昼間だからといって
油断しない方がいい
MsgEn:
While you're in Megado, don't let your guard down
just because it's daytime.

MsgJp:
どこに<NPC 681>の手先が
潜んでいるか分からないからな
MsgEn:
You never know where <NPC 681>'s minions might be
lurking.

MsgJp: さっさと済ませるぞ
MsgEn: Let's finish it quickly.

MsgJp: やっと片付いたか
MsgEn: Finally finished.

MsgJp: 無駄な戦闘は、できるだけ避けたいんだがな
MsgEn:
I want to avoid unnecessary battles as much as
possible.

MsgJp: 騒ぎになると面倒だな
MsgEn: It's troublesome when it becomes a commotion.

MsgJp: チッ、雑魚どもめ
MsgEn: Tch, you useless trash!

MsgJp: 油断するな、迅速に片付けよう
MsgEn: Don't let your guard down, let's clean up quickly.

MsgJp: 仲間を呼ばれる前に、確実に息の根を止めよう
MsgEn: Take them out before they call their friends.

MsgJp: さすがは覚者サマ、といったところだな
MsgEn: Indeed, as expected of an Arisen.

MsgJp: まずいな、オークを片付けるぞ！
MsgEn: First of all, we need to take care of the Orcs!

MsgJp: 急ぐぞ、嫌な予感がする――
MsgEn: Let's hurry, I have a bad feeling—

MsgJp: さぁ、今日もやるか
MsgEn: Now, shall we do it today as well?

MsgJp: ――何をしに来た
MsgEn: -- What did you come here for?

MsgJp:
その顔を見ると虫唾が走る――
なんだ、敗者を笑いに来たのか？
MsgEn:
The look on your face makes me salivate--
What, are you here to laugh at the losers?

MsgJp:
頼む、もっと部屋を明るくしてくれないか
暗闇に――
MsgEn:
Please, can you make the room brighter? In the
dark...

MsgJp:
暗闇に兄上の姿が見えるのだ――
うぅぅぅぅ
私は、わたしは――
MsgEn:
I can see the figure of my older brother in the
dark - Uuuuuuu I, I...

MsgJp:
私は誰よりもこの街を、この国を想っていた
貴様さえいなければ――
貴様さえいなければ、オークにも負けぬ
堅強なメガドを作り上げていたというのに！
MsgEn:
I loved this city and this country more than
anyone else. If it weren't for you— If it weren't
for you, I would have created a strong Megado that
could even defeat the Orcs!

MsgJp: ――はい？
MsgEn: Yes, what is it?

MsgJp: どうされましたか、覚者殿
MsgEn: What can I do for you, Master Arisen?

MsgJp: はい、なんでしょう
MsgEn: Yes, what is it?

MsgJp:
何かございましたら
お気軽にお申し付けください
MsgEn:
If you need anything else, please feel free to
contact us!

MsgJp:
私は、王家から侯爵家への伝令や
屋敷の警備などの任務を与えられております
MsgEn:
I am entrusted with tasks such as delivering
messages from the royal family to the Marquise's
family and guarding the mansion.

MsgJp:
何かお気付きになったことがあれば
遠慮なくお申し付けください！
MsgEn:
If you happen to notice anything, don't hesitate
to report it!

MsgJp:
メガドの執政を担うクルト侯爵家の
当主が不在の今、オークに狙われれば
混乱は避けられないでしょう
MsgEn:
With the current Maquis of the Kurt Family, who
leads Megado's administration, absent, if the orcs
target us, chaos is inevitable.

MsgJp:
緊張は高まるばかりです
――ふぁぁ
MsgEn: Tension is only growing. --whew!

MsgJp:
<NPC 681>元侯爵は
正式な裁判にかけられるまで
この屋敷の牢に捕えております
MsgEn:
<NPC 681> was the former Marquis.
He is being held in the prison of this mansion
until his formal trial.

MsgJp: 何かご用でしょうか
MsgEn: Do you have any business here?

MsgJp: こちらは異常ありません！
MsgEn: There is no abnormality here!

MsgJp: これは覚者様――！
MsgEn: This is an Arisen—

MsgJp: 牢に何かご用でしょうか？
MsgEn: Is there something you need at the prison?

MsgJp: 私は<NPC 681>様――あっ
MsgEn: I, Lord <NPC 681>――Ah.

MsgJp:
囚人<NPC 681>・クルトの監視任務を
与えられています！
油断ならない人物だということですから――
MsgEn:
I've been assigned the task of monitoring the
prisoner <NPC 681> Kurt! He's a person we can't
afford to underestimate.

MsgJp: 任務お疲れ様です
MsgEn: Good job on your mission

MsgJp:
囚人に面会する際は
くれぐれもご注意ください
MsgEn:
When meeting with prisoners, please be very
careful.

MsgJp:
ある者は、囚人に近付きすぎて
鼻をかじられたという噂もあるんだとか――
MsgEn:
Some people say they got their nose bitten by
getting too close to the prisoner—

MsgJp:
任務に私情は挟みません
ですが――
MsgEn:
I do not involve personal feelings in my mission.
However, -

MsgJp:
あの<NPC 681>様が
このような立場になるとは――
正直、未だに信じられません
MsgEn:
I still can't believe that Mr.<NPC 681> would be
in this position--
Honestly, I still can't believe it!

MsgJp: 何だ？
MsgEn: What's up?

MsgJp: 何だ？
MsgEn: What's up?

MsgJp: 何だ？
MsgEn: What is it?

MsgJp: 何だ？
MsgEn: What is it?

MsgJp: 何だ？
MsgEn: What is it?

MsgEn: What is it?

MsgEn: What is it?

MsgEn: What is it?

MsgEn: What is it?
