in the hidden room of this clan base--but--I'm
sure you'll be able to check them out.

MsgJp:
そうそう、《手がかり》は
クランメンバーで共有されています
――皆さんで手分けして探してみては？
MsgEn:
Oh yeah, the 《Clue》 is shared by
clan members
-- maybe you guys should split up and look for it?

MsgJp:
あ、覚者様――
何かご用ですか？
MsgEn:
Ah, Ser Arisen――
Do you need something?

MsgJp:
今、考えてるんです
この前手に入れた古い装飾品のことを――
MsgEn:
I'm thinking now
about the old decoration I obtained the other
day――

MsgJp:
人が造り、手入れして、受け継ぎ
――あるいは隠し忘れ去られて
それからまたこの時代に現れた
MsgEn:
Created and cared for by people, passed down
―― or forgotten and hidden
then appeared in this era again

MsgJp:
そう――全ての骨董品は運命を背負い
そして運命に導かれてボクのところに
現れるんです
MsgEn:
Yes――all antiques bear a fate
and they appear to me, guided by fate

MsgJp:
ボクは骨董品が好きなんですけどね
何もそれらをとにかく集められたら
いいってわけじゃありません
MsgEn:
I like antiques, you see
but it's not necessarily good to collect as much
of them as possible

MsgJp:
その品が、よりふさわしい誰かのところに
行きたがっているとしたら――
MsgEn:
If that item wants to go to someone more
deserving--

MsgJp:
喜んで送り出したいと思ってるんですよ
――そう、喜んでね
MsgEn:
I'd be happy to send you on your way.
-- yes, gladly.

MsgJp:
骨董というものは、元々の価値だけでなく
時間や歴史の価値を纏って形作られているんです
時を経てこそ人の心に残る
そんな芸術と言いましょうか――
MsgEn:
Antiques are not only of original value
but are also clothed in the value of time and
history.
It is only with the passage of time that they
remain in people's hearts.
I would say that they are such art...

MsgJp:
だからこそ奥深く
いや、果てが無い――
――悩ましいものです
MsgEn:
That's why it's so profound
No, it's endless--
--it's troubling.

MsgJp:
ん――？
覚者様、今別のことを
されているんじゃないですか？
MsgEn:
Hmmm--?
Arisen, are you not busy with something else
right now?

MsgJp:
ボクは、ご紹介するダンジョンには
きっちり集中して
挑んでいただきたいんですよね――
MsgEn:
I'd like you to
concentrate on the dungeon
that I'm going to introduce you to--I'd like you
to concentrate on the dungeon--and not on the
dungeon.

MsgJp:
うぅん――申し訳ないんですが
他のミッションを終わらせるか
辞退なさってから、もう一度
来ていただけるでしょうか――
MsgEn:
Ummm--I'm sorry, but
can you finish your other mission or
decline and then come back
again--I'm sorry.

MsgJp:
ハァイ！
なになに？　私にどんなご用かしら！
MsgEn:
Hi! How goes it?
What can I do fer ya?

MsgJp:
実はね、覚者様との接点がほしくて
クラン執務官に志願してたのよ
だけど、かなり前からあの二人――
セバスチャンとメアリーに決まってたらしくて
MsgEn:
Actually, I wanted to make a connection with the
Master Arisen.
I volunteered to be a Clan Steward but it was
decided a long time ago that those two -Sebastian
and Mary - would be the best choice.

MsgJp:
私だって覚者様に憧れる気持ちは
変わらないんだから！
私は私なりに、お役に立ってみせるわ
MsgEn:
I too have a longing for the Master of the Arisen
and that won't change!
I'll try to be useful in my own way.

MsgJp:
たくさんの覚者やポーン、
それに騎士団員を見てきたけど――
やっぱり使命を帯びた人って素敵だわ！
MsgEn:
I've seen a lot of Arisen, pawns,
and knights--
and it's still wonderful to see people on a
mission!

MsgJp:
――うん、やっぱり実戦に出ている人の
ボディラインって違うわねぇ
体幹がしっかりしてるっていうか
MsgEn:
--I think the body line of a person who is in a
real battle is different.
I think they have a strong core.

MsgJp:
私もホラ、結構鍛えてるのよ
そこそこ引き締まってると思うんだけど――
どうかしら？
MsgEn:
I work out a lot, too,
I think I'm pretty toned there--
What do you think?

MsgJp:
あら、お疲れだったら
ココの仮眠室にご案内するわ！
備品の維持なんかに結構かかるから
<VAL PRICE_INN>いただくけど、いいかしら？
MsgEn:
Ah, well, if you're tired,
I can show you to a nap room.
It costs a pretty penny to maintain the equipment,
so I'm asking for <VAL PRICE_INN> if you don't mind.

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
覚者様、お疲れだったら
ココの仮眠室にご案内するわよ！
私が管理させてもらってるんだけど
今は誰もいないから――無料でどうかしら？
MsgEn:
Master Arisen, if you need rest,
I'll take you to our sleeping quarters!
I oversee them personally,
and they're vacant now - my treat?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
《弱化の治療》ね、任せて！
ここで働きたくて、必死で覚えたの！
<VAL PRICE_WEAK>かかっちゃうんだけど
いいかしら？
MsgEn:
I'll take care of it!
I learned it the hard way
because I wanted to work here!
It's going to cost you <VAL PRICE_WEAK>.
How about it?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
あら？　えっと――
《弱化》してないみたい
ふふ、もしかして――冗談だったの？
MsgEn:
Hmm? Um...
It seems you haven't been weakened
Hehe, were you kidding by any chance?

MsgJp:
よし、話を聞こう
どの武器の力を引き出したいんだ？
MsgEn:
Alright, let me hear your story
Which weapon's power do you want to bring out?

MsgJp:
武具の力を引き上げること――
それはお前の力に、そして明日の命に
直結する
MsgEn:
To raise the power of your equipment――
It is directly connected to your power and your
life tomorrow

MsgJp:
長い旅だった――
とても一言では、言い表せない旅だった
MsgEn:
It was a long journey――
It was a journey that couldn't be expressed in a
few words

MsgJp:
平和になったらいつか聞いてくれ
この話はとびきり長くなるからな
MsgEn:
Ask me when it becomes peaceful someday
This story will become very long

MsgJp:
オレは――前線で戦うよりも
装備品の力を引き出すことで
覚者隊全体の戦闘力を上げることを選んだ
MsgEn:
I chose--rather than fighting on the front lines,
I chose to increase the combat power of the entire
Arisen Corps by drawing on the power of the
equipment.

MsgJp:
決して戦うことに疲れたわけではない――
ただ、神殿のため――ひいては白竜のため――
今後に繋がることをしたいと、そう考えた結果だ
MsgEn:
It's not that I'm tired of fighting--
just that I want to do something for the temple--
and by extension, for the white dragon--
that will lead to the future, that's what I
thought. That's what I thought.

MsgJp:
ふむ――良い武具だな
これをどう鍛えたいんだ？
MsgEn:
Hmmm--good armor.
How do you want to train this?

MsgJp: 覚者様、本日はどのようなご用件でしょうか？
MsgEn: Ser Arisen, what can I assist you with today?

MsgJp:
各種お手続きの際は
必ず冒険手帳をご用意くださいね
MsgEn:
Please make sure to have your Adventure Handbook
ready at
for all procedures!

MsgJp: 冒険手帳とは？
MsgEn: What is Adventure Handbook?

MsgJp: あなたは？
MsgEn: You are?

MsgJp:
冒険手帳とは、日々お忙しい覚者様を
お手伝いすることを目的に作られた
小さな手帳です
MsgEn:
The Adventure Handbook is a small notebook
designed to help
busy learners in their daily activities.

MsgJp:
この手帳の素晴らしさをご説明いたしますと――
こちら、実は――白竜様より授かった
微量の竜力が込められているのです
MsgEn:
Let me explain the magnificence of this notebook--
This is actually--
given to me by the White Dragon and contains a
trace amount of dragon power!

MsgJp:
一方、わたしは微量の竜力が込められた
ボードを神殿より支給されています
MsgEn:
I, on the other hand, am supplied by the temple
with a
board containing a small amount of dragon power!

MsgJp:
この２つはお互いに通信が可能
つまり、たとえ覚者様がどこにいらしても
わたしとやり取りすることができるのです
MsgEn:
The two can communicate with each other
which means that no matter where you are
you can communicate with me!

MsgJp:
いえ――どこでも、は言いすぎました
洞窟、荒野、山奥などでは
なぜか竜力が遮断されやすいのでご注意ください
MsgEn:
No--everywhere is an oversimplification
Please note that in caves, wilderness, deep in
the mountains, etc.
for some reason dragon power is easily blocked!

MsgJp: それでは覚者様、冒険手帳を――
MsgEn:
Well then, Arisen, please take this Adventure
Handbook――

Hmm?
--What?

MsgJp:
覚者様――
まさか、冒険手帳をご存じないのですか！？
MsgEn:
Master Arisen-
Don't tell me you don't know about the Adventure
Handbook!

MsgJp:
す、すみません
てっきり、神殿からお知らせが
いっているかと思い込んでいて――
MsgEn:
I-I'm sorry.
I thought the Temple had sent you a notice
already――

MsgJp:
それでは、冒険手帳について
くわしくご説明させていただきますね
MsgEn: Let me explain more about the Adventure Handbook.

MsgJp:
覚者様！
今日は良いお知らせがありますよ！
MsgEn:
Arisen!
I have good news for you today!

MsgJp:
神殿より、いつもレスタニアのため
働いてくださっている覚者様へと
特別褒賞が届いたんです
MsgEn:
The Temple has sent
a special reward to those who have always worked
for Lestania!

MsgJp:
受け取れるように手続きしておきましたので
あとで冒険手帳を開いてくださいね
MsgEn:
I have made the procedures for you to receive it,
so please open your adventure notebook later, Lord

MsgJp:
あら？
もしかして――
自己紹介、まだでしたか？
MsgEn:
Oh?
Could it be that...
Introductions, you haven't done it yet?

MsgJp:
わたくし、冒険手帳の窓口係として参りました
リサと申します
MsgEn:
My name is Lisa and I am the contact person for
the Adventure Handbook at

MsgJp:
冒険手帳に関することは
なんでもお申し付けくださいね
MsgEn:
If you have any questions about the Adventure
Notebook, please contact us at
We're happy to help you with anything!

MsgJp:
覚者様は、お部屋に帰られたら
何をなさるんですか？
くつろぎの時間に持つ、趣味と言いますか――
MsgEn:
What do you do when you go back to 
your room?
I'd say it's a hobby that I have during 
my relaxation time...

MsgJp:
わたしはレスタニアワインの利き酒が好きですね
定番はテルの辺りのものですけど
たまに手に入るリンウッド産のものも
野性味が強くて良いんですよ！
MsgEn:
I like to taste Lestania wines
The standard ones are from the Tell area but 
the occasional Lynwood ones you can get 
are also good with a strong wild flavor!

MsgJp:
お出かけになられた先でも
冒険手帳を使ってわたしにご連絡いただければ
クラフト指示やバザー出品を代行いたします
MsgEn:
Even when you are away, you can contact me 
using your Adventure Handbook and I will be 
happy to give you craft instructions and 
bazaar items on your behalf.

MsgJp:
冒険手帳からメールを
お読みいただくこともできるんですよ！
でも、添付されたアイテムの受け取りまでは
できないみたいなんです――
MsgEn:
You can also read mail from your Adventure
Log! But it seems you can't receive
attached items there—

MsgJp:
ワイルドハントの依頼をご覧にいらしたんですね
どうぞ、じっくりご確認ください
MsgEn:
I see you've come to see our Wild Hunt request.
Please take the time to review it.

MsgJp:
今日のワイルドハント、いつもより
少し報酬の良い依頼が来ています
さ、ご覧になってください！
MsgEn:
Today's Wild Hunt,
a slightly better paying request than usual.
Come on, take a look!

MsgJp:
あ、覚者様！
今日はなかなか歯ごたえのある依頼が来ていますよ
内容も報酬も、覚者様にぴったりな依頼だと
思っていたところなんです
MsgEn:
Ah, Arisen!
Today, a quite challenging request has arrived.
Both the content and the reward seem to be
perfect for you, Arisen.
That's what I thought.

MsgJp:
――お待ちしておりました！
今日は覚者様のために、とっておきの
珍しい依頼を取り揃えておいたんです！
ぜひご覧になってくださいね
MsgEn:
――I have been waiting for you!
Today, I have prepared some special and rare
requests just for you, Ser Arisen!
Please take a look.

MsgJp:
ワイルドハントについてのご説明が
まだでしたよね？
MsgEn:
Did you still need an explanation about 
the Wild Hunt?

MsgJp:
一度きちんとご説明しておかないことには
依頼をご紹介できません
フィールドに出ていただく以上
万が一の危険もありえますから！
MsgEn:
I must first give you a full explanation
before presenting the request.
Once you are out in the field, there 
is always a chance of danger!

MsgJp:
竜の加護が常に
あなたと共にあらんことを
MsgEn:
May the blessings of the dragon
be with you always.

MsgJp:
あなたと絆を結んだ竜の力が
いつかその身を助けることもあるはずです
MsgEn:
The power of the dragon you have bonded with
may save you one day.

MsgJp:
ソニアとは異なる方法で
覚者殿をお助けするようにと
遣わされました
MsgEn:
I have been sent to help the Arisen
in a different way than Sonia.

MsgJp:
今、お役に立てることが無くとも
きっと近い将来、私がなすべきことが
示されるはずです
MsgEn:
Now, even if I can't be of help,
in the near future, I'm sure I'll be shown what I
should do

MsgJp:
素材はその土地その土地
とれるものが違うんだ
MsgEn: The materials differ depending on the area

MsgJp:
そうだ、近くを散策して何か拾ったら
持ってきてくれ
使えるものは引きとらせてもらうよ
MsgEn:
Yeah, take a walk around the neighborhood and if
you pick up anything
bring it to me
and I'll take back what I can use.

MsgJp: どうだい、必要なものはあるかい？
MsgEn: So, do you have what you need?

MsgJp:
やぁ、見てってくれ
各種素材を扱ってるよ
MsgEn:
Hey, take a look at
I deal with all kinds of materials.

MsgJp:
雨の日は露店だと困るんだよね
商品は濡れちゃうし、地面も冷たいし
MsgEn:
It's a problem when it's a stall on a rainy day.
The products get wet and the ground is cold.

MsgJp: 外もじめじめした魔物が出やすいのよ
MsgEn: Damp enemies are more likely to appear outside

MsgJp:
ここは神殿に近いからねぇ
覚者さんが立ち寄ってくれるだけ
まだ安心だよ
MsgEn:
We're so close to the temple here.
I'm sure the memorandum will just stop by.
I'm still relieved.

MsgJp:
ここは海があるからね
海の幸ならうちが一番さ
MsgEn:
We have the ocean here.
We're the best when it comes to seafood.

MsgJp:
崖際に海岸に灯台に、ちょっくら
足を延ばしてみたらどうだい？
MsgEn:
Why don't you go to the cliffs, the beach, the
lighthouse, just for a
moment and see what it's all about?

MsgJp:
こんにちは
採取道具に日用品まで、いろいろ揃えてるよ
MsgEn:
Hello
, we have various collection tools and daily
necessities available

MsgJp:
休憩していってはどうですか？
魚料理もついて、一泊
<VAL PRICE_INN>ですよ！
MsgEn:
Why don't you take a break?
It's
<VAL PRICE_INN> per night, including a fish dinner!

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
おお、お疲れですか？
あなたのお部屋は常に準備してますとも！
さ～、どうぞ休憩はご自由に
MsgEn:
Oh, are you tired?
Your room is always ready for you!
Well, feel free to take a break!

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
おや覚者さま、《弱化の治療》ですか
では代金として
<VAL PRICE_WEAK>ほど、お願いします
MsgEn:
Oh, Lord
, is it 《treat weakness》? In that case, please
give me around
<VAL PRICE_WEAK> as payment

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
おやおや、覚者さまはお元気そうです
《弱化》にはかかっていませんよ！
MsgEn:
Well, well, well, well... The Arisen looks well.
I'm not "weakened" by it!

MsgJp:
この村ローテスは魚が旨い！
ワインもテルから取り寄せてます
ささ、ゆっくりと滞在していってくださいよ
MsgEn:
This village, Rotes, has great fish!
Wine is also brought in from Tel
Please take your time and stay with us!

MsgJp:
覚者さま、冒険者の宿として
一通りの準備はできますよ
ご用はありませんかな？
MsgEn:
Dear Arisen, as an adventurer's inn, I can set
you up in one piece.
Can I help you?

MsgJp:
村で上がった問題は《クエストボード》に
貼っております
ぜひ、お力をお貸し頂けるとありがたい！
MsgEn:
The issues raised in the village are posted on
the 《Quest Board》 at
We would be grateful for your help!

MsgJp: ようこそ、海竜亭へ！
MsgEn: Welcome to the Sea Dragon's Inn!

MsgJp:
ブリアには、表の浜辺の南側にも
《青爪浜》って浜辺があるんだよ
MsgEn:
Breya has another beach -
they call it Blue Claw Shore,
south of the main waterfront.

MsgJp:
そこには昔、《ルフロー》っていう村があったんだが
一夜にして誰も居なくなったそうなんだ
MsgEn:
There used to be a village there called Leflor.
They say that overnight there was no one there.

MsgJp: 何があったか知らんが、おっかない話だよ
MsgEn:
I don't know what happened, but it's a scary
story.

MsgJp:
海岸にはまれに思わぬものが
漂着することがある
毎日歩きゃ、面白い物が見つかるかもしれんぜ
MsgEn:
Rarely does something unexpected
wash up on the beach.
Walk it every day and you might find something
interesting!

MsgJp:
浜辺で長い影を見たら注意しろよ
とんでもなく恐ろしい海竜が
ふらっと姿を現すこともあるからな
MsgEn:
If you see long shadows on the beach, be careful.
The most terrifying sea dragons
can wander in and out of sight.

MsgJp:
海岸沿いの断崖に灯台があるだろ？
そこの灯台守の爺さんは、昔名うての
神官騎士だったって話だ
MsgEn:
You know that lighthouse on the bluff along the
coast?
The old lighthouse keeper there used to be a
famous
priest-knight.

MsgJp: ああ、こんにちは
MsgEn: Oh, hello.

MsgJp:
前に綺麗な貝を拾ったの
海岸を歩いてたらたまに見つけられるのよ
MsgEn:
I picked up a beautiful shell once
I can find them sometimes when I'm walking along
the beach.

MsgJp:
時間があるなら浜辺にいってみたら？
いい気分転換になるわよ
MsgEn:
If you have time, why don't you go to the beach?
It's a nice change of pace.

MsgJp: 外にいたら髪がべたべたになっちゃう
MsgEn: My hair gets sticky when I'm outside.

MsgJp:
ご機嫌いかが？
ゆっくりしていってよね
MsgEn:
How are you?
Take your time.

MsgJp:
あっ、覚者さん！
そういえば良いニュースがあるんだ
MsgEn:
Ah, Ser Arisen!
By the way, I have good news.

MsgJp:
ブリアにある《辺境の礎》ってやつが
全部使えるようになったらしいよ！
MsgEn:
I heard that the sub-crystal in Breya is now
available at
all of them!

MsgJp:
俺はアレの使い方、いまいちわかってないんだけど
何でも、覚者さんが今までに触ったことのない礎も
このブリア内にある分は全部使えるんだってさ
MsgEn:
I'm not quite sure how I'm supposed to use that
thing, but whatever.
Even the Keystones that the Arisen has never
touched before,he can use all of the ones in Breya.

MsgJp:
覚者さんがよくブリアに来るからって
神殿の人たちが手配してくれたんだ
今まで行きにくかった場所にも
一瞬で行けるんだってね
MsgEn:
The people at Temple arranged it because Arisen
often come to Breya.
They said he can go to places that have been hard
to get to in an instant.

MsgJp:
探索しやすくなったブリアを
そしてローテスを、これからもよろしく！
MsgEn:
Keep up the good work with Breya
and Rotes, which is now easier to explore!

MsgJp:
そうそう、覚者さんにお願いしたいことがあってさ
ルドルフォ爺さんの家の近くに古い井戸があるだろ
その奥に光るものを見たって人がいるんだ
MsgEn:
Oh yeah, I've got a request for you, Arisen.
You know that old well near Grandpa Rudolfo's
house.
Some people say they saw something shiny at the
back of it.

MsgJp:
もしかして、もしかしたらだよ
井戸の底にお宝が眠ってたりしたら――！
お宝って意外とああいう地味なところに
ありそうだしさ！
MsgEn:
Maybe, just maybe
there is a treasure at the bottom of the well..!
Treasure can be found in such a humble place

MsgJp:
ってわけで、よかったら中を見てきて欲しいんだ
行く前には一声かけてくれ
井戸底に沈む青い光、気になるじゃないか
MsgEn:
So, I'd like you to come take a look inside if
you'd like.
Give me a shout before you go.
The blue light at the bottom of the well, it's
curious, isn't it?

MsgJp:
覚者さん、この前も見てきてもらった
《灯台下の古井戸》なんだけどさ
奥に封鎖された扉があっただろ？

あれは古い遺跡に繋がる扉らしいんだけど
俺がエリアマスターになった時には
既に封鎖されててね
奥がどうなってるかは誰も知らないんだ
MsgEn:
That's supposed to be a door that leads to an old
ruin
but by the time I became Area Master
it was already sealed up
and no one knows what's going on in the back.

MsgJp:
でも、ずっと封鎖したままっていうのもなんだし
今は覚者さんもよく寄ってくれるから
思い切って封鎖を解いてみたんだ
MsgEn:
But I didn't want to keep the blockade up
forever, so
I took the plunge and unblocked it,
since I've had a lot of Arisen people stop by now.

MsgJp:
海は男のロマンだけど
封鎖されていた遺跡っていうのも
何というかくすぐられるものがあるだろ？
MsgEn:
The ocean is a man's romance, but
there's something tantalizing about a site that's
been sealed off, too
isn't there?

MsgJp: 覚者さん、ちょっと内密に話が――
MsgEn: Arisen, let's talk in secret for a moment...

MsgJp:
い、いや、隠さなきゃいけないような
話じゃないんだけどさ
この前封鎖を解いた《モルトバ遺跡》――
出る、らしくって――
MsgEn:
No, no, I'm not talking about the kind of
story that needs to be hidden.
The Moltova Ruins, which we broke the blockade on
the other day--
I'm going to go out there, and it seems--

MsgJp:
何が出るって、そりゃもちろんアレだよ！
竜だよ！　水竜ってやつさ
MsgEn:
What's coming out, of course, is that thing!
A dragon!　A water dragon.

MsgJp:
覚者さんが居るからと思って
封鎖は解いたけど
中の竜に暴れられるのは困るんだ
MsgEn:
I thought because the Arisen is here I've broken
the blockade, but
I don't want the dragon inside to get out of
control.

MsgJp:
外に出てくる気配が無いか見てきてもらえないかな
出発前に声かけてくれると助かるよ
MsgEn:
Could you go see if there's any sign of them
coming outside
I'd appreciate it if you'd give me a shout before
you leave.

MsgJp:
覚者さんがブリアに寄ってくれるようになって
本当に助かってるんだ
いつもありがとう！
MsgEn:
Arisen, thank you so much for coming to Breya
I really appreciate it
Thank you always!

MsgJp:
俺も少しは覚者さんの力になりたいからさ
今まで以上に良いものを渡せるように頑張るよ
MsgEn:
I also want to be of help to you, Arisen
I'll do my best to give you even better things
than before

MsgJp:
今や覚者さんあってのブリアだからさ！
今後ともよろしく頼むよ！
MsgEn:
Now it's thanks to you, Arisen, that there is
Breya!
I'll rely on you from now on too!

MsgJp:
覚者さん、《クエストボード》見てくれよ！
手伝ってもらえたらローテスも大助かりさ
MsgEn:
Arisen, please check the "quest board"!
If you can help, it will be a great help to Rotes
too

MsgJp: 岬のモルトバ灯台へはもう行ったか？
MsgEn:
Have you already been to Moltova Lighthouse on
the cape?

MsgJp:
ルドルフォの爺さんに会ったら
よろしく伝えといてくれ
MsgEn:
If you see old Rudolfo, tell him I said
hello.

MsgJp:
海のロマンはやっぱでっかさだろ！
たまに来る漂流船なんか最高さ！
MsgEn:
The romance of the sea is the size of it!
The occasional drifting ship is the best!

MsgJp:
でも、どっから来るんだろうな
神殿の洋撃船でもなさそうだが
MsgEn:
But I wonder where it's coming from.
It doesn't look like it's the Temple's Western
blasting ship.

MsgJp:
――もう、何ていうかさ
あんたがローテスに来てくれて
本当に良かったよ
MsgEn:
-You know, I was really glad when you came to
Rotes.

MsgJp:
今まで騎士団も神殿も、ここまで
親身になってくれた人はいなかったしな
俺も、できる限りあんたの力になるよ
MsgEn:
No one has ever been so
kind to me before, not the Knights or the Temple,
and
I'll help you as much as I can, too.

MsgJp:
こんにちは、あらためて自己紹介ね
俺はこの一帯、ブリア海岸の
エリアマスターをやってるオニールだ
MsgEn:
Hi, I'd like to introduce myself again.
I'm O'Neill, the
area master for this part of the Breya Coast.

MsgJp:
自慢の海と砂浜は見てくれたかい？
ちょっとばかりのんびりした気分に
なってしまうけど、見た目よりずっと危険だよ
MsgEn:
Have you seen our boastful ocean and sandy
beaches?
It makes you feel a little more relaxed
but it's a lot more dangerous than it looks!

MsgJp:
海の影響だろうけど魔物もハイデルや
ミスリウとは違うから気をつけてくれ
MsgEn:
I know it's probably the influence of the ocean,
but be careful, the demons aren't the same as
Hidell or
Mysree.

MsgJp:
あとは――目下の問題と言えば
海賊まがいのならず者《ブリア宝奪団》だな
今はそれが一番の悩みの種だね
MsgEn:
The other thing - the problem at hand is
the pirate-like ruffians, the Breya Treasure
Robbers.
That's the biggest problem we have right now.

MsgJp:
まあ、わからないことがあったら
とりあえず聞いてくれよ
MsgEn:
Well, if there's something you don't understand,
please ask me
for now

MsgJp:
いやー、さすが覚者さん！
何かと任せちゃって申し訳ない
これからもよろしくな
MsgEn:
Wow, you're truly an Arisen!
I'm sorry for relying on you so much
From now on, please take care of me as well

MsgJp:
やぁ、ありがとう
また仕事手伝ってくれよな
MsgEn:
Hey, thank you
Please help me with my work again

MsgJp: 来てくれたら支援品をあげるからさ！
MsgEn: I'll give you support items if you come

MsgJp:
やぁ、ありがとう
また仕事、手伝ってくれよな
MsgEn:
Hey, thank you
Please help me with my work again

MsgJp:
あ、覚者さん聞いてくれよ
村のすぐ裏にある《隠れ浜》なんだけどさ
MsgEn:
Oh, Arisen, listen to me:
There's a "Hidden Beach" right behind the village.

MsgJp:
特に最近、そこにガラの悪そうなのが
ちょいちょい出入りしてるみたいなんだよ
例の《ブリア宝奪団》の奴らかなぁ
MsgEn:
Especially lately, there seems to be a lot of bad
guys
going in and out of there every now and then.
I wonder if they're from the Breya Treasure Troop.

MsgJp: とにかく、怪しいのがいたら何とかしてくれよ
MsgEn:
Anyway, if you see something suspicious, please
take care of it.

MsgJp:
お、そうだ！
あんたに渡すものがあったんだ
MsgEn:
Oh, yeah!
I had something for you.

MsgJp:
見てくれ、今日は結構良い物があってさ
持ってってくれよ！
MsgEn:
Look, I've got some pretty good stuff today.
Take it!

MsgJp:
覚者さん、海岸を少し行ったところに
廃墟があるんだけどさ
そこに地下倉庫があるのを知ってるか？
MsgEn:
Arisen, there's an abandoned house little ways
down the coast.
Did you know there's an underground warehouse
there?

MsgJp:
村のみんなが《海辺の地下室》って
呼んでる場所だよ
危ないから封鎖してたんだけど
MsgEn:
The villagers all call that place
the "Seaside Cellar".
It was sealed off because of the danger though.

MsgJp:
その中から、話し声が聞こえてさ
どうも誰かが入り込んでるみたいなんだ
中を見ようと思ったけど勇気が無くて――
MsgEn:
I heard voices coming from within.
It seems that someone is inside.
I wanted to look in, but I didn't have the
courage--

MsgJp:
もし通りかかったら見てみてくれよ
今度こそ《ブリア宝奪団》かもしれないな
MsgEn:
If you're passing by, take a look.
It may be the "Breya Treasure Bandits" this time.

MsgJp:
顔出してくれてありがとうな
そうだ、これ使ってくれよ
何かの足しにはなるだろ
MsgEn:
Thank you for showing up.
Oh yes, please use this.
It may be of some help.

MsgJp:
覚者さん、ちょっと相談乗ってくれよ
ハーピーの営巣地、知ってるか？
ほら、《鳥寄せ岩》
MsgEn:
Arisen, a little advice for you.
Do you know where the harpies are nesting?
You know, the birdbath rock.

MsgJp:
あそこに、卵を抱えた親ハーピーが
群がるようになってさ
《マーテル・ハーピー》って言って、普通の
ハーピーより凶暴なんだよ
MsgEn:
There, the parent harpies with their eggs
started swarming
and they are called "Martell Harpies" and they
are more ferocious than the normal
harpies.

MsgJp:
このままだとルドルフォの爺さんに
配達にいくのも大変だ
手が空いたらでいいから、退治頼めないかい？
MsgEn:
If this keeps up, it's going to be hard to get
old Rudolfo to
deliver the goods.
When you get around to it, can you ask him to
exterminate them for you?

MsgJp:
丁度いいとこにきたな
これ、余りものだけど持ってってくれ
MsgEn:
You've come to the right place.
Here, take this, it's a leftover.

MsgJp:
いやー、さすが覚者さん！
何かと任せちゃって申し訳ない
MsgEn:
Lord, you're amazing!
I'm sorry to keep asking you for things

MsgJp:
もっと良い物渡せるように頑張るからさ
これからもよろしくな
MsgEn:
I'll do my best to get you better items, so
please continue to take care of me

MsgJp: ああ、覚者さん良い所に！
MsgEn: Ah, you're in a good place, Arisen!

MsgJp:
南の浜辺――《青爪浜》には行った事が
あるかい？
MsgEn:
Have you ever been to the southern shore, Blue
Claw Beach?

MsgJp:
そこへ行く途中のキャンプ跡に
いつの間にかホブゴブリンが居付いちゃった
ようなんだ
体格も大きいし、村の方に来たら大変だ！
MsgEn:
On the way there, we came across the remains of a
camp
and before we knew it, a hobgoblin had settled
there.
It's a big guy.
He's big, and if he comes towards the village,
it's going to be a big problem!

MsgJp:
もし見かけたら退治してくれよ
騎士団にも連絡したんだけど、なかなか
返事が来なくてさ
MsgEn:
If you see him, please exterminate him.
I've contacted the Knights of Columbus, but they
haven't gotten back to me
.

MsgJp: そうだ覚者さん、ビッグニュースだよ！
MsgEn: Hey, Arisen! I have big news!

MsgJp:
例の財宝なんだけど
ありそうな場所が分かったんだ！
MsgEn:
I found the treasure
and I think I know where it might be!

MsgJp:
結論から言うと、それは
ルフロー近くにある《潮騒洞窟》――
MsgEn:
As it turns out, it's
the 《Tidal Caverns Cave》 near LeFlore--

MsgJp:
なぁ、興味あるよな？
探しにってみないかい？
MsgEn:
Hey, you're interested, right?
Would you like to come and look for it?

MsgJp:
ずっと封鎖されてたんだけど
今は入れるようにしておいたから
行くってなったら俺に話しかけてくれよ
財宝について詳しく話すからさ
MsgEn:
It was sealed for a long time,
but I've opened it for you now.
Let me know if you decide to go and
I'll tell you more about the treasure.

MsgJp:
か、覚者さん――
ちょっと聞いてほしいことが
あ、あるんだけどさ――
MsgEn:
Ah, Arisen--
There's something I'd like to,
ah, speak with you about--

MsgJp:
――え！？
いや、俺は特になにも――
っていうか全然怖がってないけど！
MsgEn:
--What?
No, I'm not particularly scared of anything--
I mean, I'm not scared at all!

MsgJp:
とにかく聞いてくれよ
ほら、南の浜辺に廃村があるって話は
前にしただろ？
MsgEn:
Anyway, listen,
see, I told you before
that there's an abandoned village on the southern
beach, right?

MsgJp:
ルフローっていうだいぶ前に滅んだ村さ
行ったことはあるかい？
MsgEn:
There's a long-defunct village called Leflor.
Have you ever been there?

MsgJp:
一夜で滅んだことだけははっきりしてるけど
大波が来たのか、魔物にやられたのか
本当のところは謎なんだ
財宝の件もまだ分からないんだけどさ
MsgEn:
The only thing that's clear is that it was
destroyed overnight.
Was it a big wave or did the demons get it?
The real story is a mystery.
We still don't know what happened to the
treasure, either.

MsgJp:
で、そのルフロー付近で、何か呟きながら
彷徨う人影を見たって
昨日宿に寄った旅人が言ってたんだよ――
MsgEn:
So, near that Leflor, a traveler who stopped by
the inn yesterday
said he saw a figure wandering
around, muttering something--.

MsgJp:
――これって、もしかして幽霊――？
ほら覚者さんも気になるだろ？
だからさ、ほら。確かめてきてくれよ
MsgEn:
-Is this, perhaps, a ghost...?
Hey, Arisen, I'm sure you're curious too, right?
So, come on. Please go and check it out.

MsgJp:
――もう、何ていうかさ
あんたがローテスに来てくれて
本当に良かったよ
MsgEn:
-You know, I was really glad when you came to
Rotes.

MsgJp:
今まで騎士団も神殿も、ここまで
親身になってくれた人はいなかったし
俺も、できる限りあんたを支援するよ
MsgEn:
No Knighthood or Temple has ever been so
accommodating, and
I'll support you as much as I can, too.

MsgJp: これからも、よろしくな！
MsgEn: From now on, count on me!

MsgJp:
大変だ、覚者さん！
《青爪浜》にすごく強そうなサイクロプスが
現れたらしいんだ
MsgEn:
Oh my God, Arisen!
A very powerful Cyclops has appeared on the Blue
Claw Beach.

MsgJp:
もしかしたら、そいつがルフローを
一夜で壊滅させた魔物なのかなぁ！？
MsgEn:
Maybe that's the demon that destroyed LeFlore
in one night!

MsgJp:
もしそんなのがローテスへ来るような
ことがあったら――
MsgEn:
If such a thing
were to come to Rotes--

MsgJp:
頼むよ、大変だとは思うけど
なんとかできるとしたら、覚者さんくらいしか
思いつかないんだ
そいつをどうにか撃退してくれよ！
MsgEn:
Please, I know it's a lot to ask, but the only
person I can think of who can do something about
it is the Arisen!
I can't think of anything else.
You've got to fight that guy off somehow!

MsgJp:
よう！　ブリア海岸近辺の事なら
何でも聞いてくれ
MsgEn:
Yo!　If you're in the vicinity of the Breya Coast,
, ask me anything you want.

MsgJp:
そ、そうだ！
灯台の方にいくなら、《鳥寄せ岩》の
近くは気を付けたほうがいいよ
MsgEn:
Oh, yeah!
If you're going towards the lighthouse, you
should be careful near the "Birdcage Rock"

MsgJp:
気が立った親ハーピーが巣を作ってて
通りかかった人が襲われることも
あるらしいんだ
MsgEn:
I've heard that sometimes the crazed parent
harpies build nests
and attack passersby
.

MsgJp:
し、心配だ！
海から化け物がきたらどうしよう！
MsgEn:
I'm worried!
What if a monster comes from the sea?

MsgJp:
ううーん、裏の浜辺から何かの
唸り声が聞こえる気がする――
MsgEn:
Ummm, I think I hear something
roaring from the beach out back--

MsgJp:
見晴らしが良くても敵に見つかり
そうだし、悪くても何か潜んでそうだ
ど、どうしたら！
MsgEn:
If the view is good, the enemy will find it
likely, and if it's bad, something will be lurking
which, what to do!

MsgJp: あ、ああ、僕に何か用？
MsgEn: Ah, ah, do you need something from me?

MsgJp: 今日の晩ご飯のお魚なにかな
MsgEn:
I wonder what fish we're having for dinner
tonight.

MsgJp:
海沿い歩くの大好き！
水が気持ちいいよね
MsgEn:
I love walking by the sea!
The water feels so good

MsgJp:
知ってる？　崖の上の灯台
かなり昔からあるんだって
MsgEn:
Do you know? The lighthouse on top of the cliff
has been there for a long time

MsgJp: こんにちは！
MsgEn: Hello!

MsgJp:
あら、冒険者の方？
もし良ければなのですが、奥にいるアニスに
外の話を聞かせてやってくれません？
MsgEn:
Oh, are you an adventurer?
If you don't mind, could you go inside and tell
Anise
the news from outside?

MsgJp:
アニス――
私の子は足が不自由で
可哀そうな想いをさせてしまっているんです
MsgEn:
Anise--
my boy is crippled
and I feel sorry for him.

MsgJp:
冒険者さん、あなた方は色々な所へ
旅されているんでしょうね
MsgEn: Adventurers, I know you guys travel a lot

MsgJp:
あら、こんにちは
わざわざ来て下さってありがとう
MsgEn:
Oh, hello
Thanks for coming all the way out here!

MsgJp:
まったく、そこの《隠れ浜》は厄介だ
追い払っても追い払っても、不逞の輩が
たむろして――
MsgEn:
Indeed, the "hidden beach" there is a nuisance.
No matter whether you drive them away or not, the
tramps
hang around and--

MsgJp:
せっかく捕った魚を奪われては
たまらんよ
MsgEn:
I can't
let them take all the fish we've caught.

MsgJp:
浜のあたりにハーピーが増えて
船小屋まで行きにくくなってしまった
まったく迷惑なやつらだよ
MsgEn:
More harpies around the beach
and it's harder to get to the boathouse
They're totally annoying!

MsgJp:
ヒュージブルが居なかった時は、もっと沖まで
船が出せたというし、深い海でも泳げたそうだ
MsgEn:
They say that when Huge Bull wasn't around, they
could
sail farther out to sea and swim in deeper water!

MsgJp:
が、そんな昔のことを知っとる奴は
もうおらんな
MsgEn:
But who knows about those old days
any more?

MsgJp:
漁はほそぼそと続けとるよ
ヒュージブルだの海竜だの、物騒に
なってきたがね
MsgEn:
Fishing is still going on slowly.
Fugeables and sea dragons are getting noisy.

MsgJp:
食う分の魚はまだ獲れるなぁ
生活には困っとらんよ
MsgEn:
I can still catch enough fish to eat.
I don't have to make a living.

MsgJp:
たまに大きな船が浜に流れ着く
あれは、帰ってこれなかった
神殿の船なのかね？
MsgEn:
Sometimes big boats wash up on the beach
That one didn't make it back
Is it a temple boat?

MsgJp: ん？　何だね
MsgEn: Hm? What's up?

MsgJp:
ローテスは漁村ですが
海にはヒュージブルがいるため
あまり住民は沖へでませんね
MsgEn:
Rotes is a fishing village, but
the residents don't go offshore much because of
the fusibles in the sea

MsgJp: 浅い所は大丈夫でありますが
MsgEn: Shallow areas are fine.

MsgJp:
このところのローテスの問題は
《ブリア宝奪団》という海賊なのです
MsgEn:
The problem with the Lotes these days is that
they are pirates called the "Breya Treasure
Robbers"!

MsgJp:
エリアマスターのオニールさんも
自分も、かなり困っているのです
MsgEn:
Both Area Master O'Neill and
myself are in a lot of trouble!

MsgJp:
一体連中はどこに潜んでいるのか――
いくつか怪しい場所候補はあるのですが
むむむ――
MsgEn:
Where the heck are they lurking--
I have a few potential suspicious places
mmmm--

MsgJp: ここの警備担当は自分であります！
MsgEn: I am in charge of security here!

MsgJp:
覚者殿は、村の問題解決担当で？
そりゃあ助かります！
MsgEn:
You're in charge of solving the village's
problems, aren't you?
That would be very helpful!

MsgJp:
一つ注意です
村から南に下った裏の浜辺、《青爪浜》
方面はできるだけ近づかないでください！
MsgEn:
A word of caution:
The southern beach, 《Blueclaw Beach》,
is best avoided entirely!

MsgJp: c
MsgEn:
The demons are dangerous there
and I'm not confident that I
would be able to help if something were to happen!

MsgJp:
とくに、そっちの方へ続く道には
《小鬼の野営地》があり、ホブゴブリンが
うろつくこともあり、危険であります
MsgEn:
There is a "Goblin Camp" on the road leading that
way.
Hobgoblins are known to wander there as well.
It is quite dangerous!

MsgJp: 浜遊びは村の近くでどうぞ！
MsgEn:
Please enjoy playing at the beach near the
village!

MsgJp: ようこそローテスへ！
MsgEn: Welcome to Rotes!

MsgJp: お客さん？　こんにちは
MsgEn: Hello and welcome.

MsgJp:
行ってみたい所がたくさんあるの
この部屋から出ることもできないのに――
MsgEn:
There are so many places I'd like to go,
but I can't even leave this room--

MsgJp:
私、歩けないの
だからずっとここにいるよ
MsgEn:
I can't walk,
so I stay here all the time.

MsgJp:
冒険の話を聞かせてほしいな
どんなことでもいいから
MsgEn:
Please, tell me stories of your adventures.
Any story at all!

MsgJp: 旅の同伴者をお求めですか？　覚者様
MsgEn:
Are you looking for a travel companion, Ser
Arisen?

MsgJp: 白竜様のご加護があらんことを
MsgEn:
May the blessings of The White Dragon
be with you, Arisen.

MsgJp: リムの輝きは常に貴方と共に
MsgEn: Even now, the Rift's glow shields you.

MsgJp:
メンバーの再編をお考えでしたら
なんなりと
MsgEn:
If you are thinking of reorganizing your 
party members, please do not hesitate 
to ask.

MsgJp:
ほほ！　どうです、ワシの演奏は！
神殿の詩人にも引けをとらんでしょう
MsgEn:
Ho ho!　What do you think of my performance?
I'm as good as the poets of the temple.

MsgJp:
ふんふ～ん～　青い海～　白い砂～
潮風薫る浜辺の夢～
MsgEn:
Mmmmm～ Blue sea～ White sand～
Sea breeze smells like a dream on the beach～

MsgJp:
ローテス！　ローテ～ス！
一度はおいでませ～～～
MsgEn: Rotes! Rotes～～～!

MsgJp:
はんは～ん～　るるる～
青い水辺に潜む罠～
赤いべとべと忍び寄る～～
MsgEn:
Hmmm～　Lululu～
A trap lurking at the blue water's edge～
Sticky red creeps up～

MsgJp:
気づけば足元ヒュージブル～～
油断大敵ヒュージブル～～～！
MsgEn:
Too late, brine at your feet ～～!
Carelessness kills,  the brine again～～～!

MsgJp: ほっほっほ！　くつろいで下され！
MsgEn: Hohoho! Please relax!

MsgJp:
あぁ、いらっしゃいませ
品物を出しますね
MsgEn:
Ah, welcome.
I'll bring out the goods.

MsgJp:
はぁ――
気疲れかしら
でも、わたしまで倒れるわけにはいかないし
MsgEn:
Haah... Must be exhaustion.
Still, I don't have the luxury of falling ill.

MsgJp:
この村では薬が不足しがちなんです
妙な流行り病のせいで――
旅の方へお分けする量はあるのですが
MsgEn:
There is a tendency of shortage of medicine
in this village due to a strange epidemic.
There is a sufficient amount to share with
travelers though.

MsgJp:
うちの旦那も倒れて
もう半月くらい経つのですが
いい薬があったら教えてもらえませんか？
MsgEn:
My husband collapsed two weeks
back and still...
Do you know any remedies that might help?

MsgJp: うぅ――？
MsgEn: Ugh--?

MsgJp: うぅ――、体が、痛い――
MsgEn: Ugh-- my body hurts--

MsgJp: あぁ、あ、頭が――
MsgEn: Ah, my head--

MsgJp: 寒いのか、暑いのか――
MsgEn: Is it cold or hot--

MsgJp:
ようこそ、テルへ
旅の準備はこちらで承ろう
何かご用かな？

宿泊だったら<VAL PRICE_INN>だよ
泊っていくかい？
MsgEn:
If you're staying overnight, it's <VAL PRICE_INN>.
Want to stay the night?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
《弱化の治療》なら
<VAL PRICE_WEAK>だよ、どうするね？
MsgEn:
If it's 《Treat Weakness》, it's <VAL PRICE_WEAK>.
What do you want to do?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
《弱化の治療》は必要ないようだ
それでも疲れているなら
うちで休憩していくといい
MsgEn:
It seems that 《Treatment for Weakness》 
is not necessary.
However, if you are still tired, it would be 
good to take a break at my place.

MsgJp:
覚者さん、神殿からあんたには便宜を図るよう
言われているよ
さ、好きな部屋を自由に使ってくれ
休んでいくか？
MsgEn:
Arisen, the Temple has told me to accommodate you.
Now, feel free to use any room you like.
Shall we take a break?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
ただでさえ近頃大変だというのに
西に墜ちてきたアレ――
まったく、不安でたまらんよ
MsgEn:
Even though it's been tough lately
that thing that crashed in the west--
I'm so anxious to see it, at all!

MsgJp:
覚者さん、良ければ力を貸して
もらえないか？実は、今ここテルでは
変な病が流行っていてな――
MsgEn:
Arisen, if you don't mind, can you help me?
Actually, there's a strange disease going 
around here in Tel right now--

MsgJp:
ついに倒れる者もでるようになったんだ
一応神殿にも連絡はしているんだが
MsgEn:
Folks are beginning to collapse now.
We did alert the temple, but...

MsgJp:
この辺りの情報なら
隣にいるアルフレドに聞いてみるといい
MsgEn:
You can ask Alfred next door
for more information on this area.

MsgJp:
日頃の厄介事は、あいつを介して
騎士団や覚者さんに取り次いでもらってる
まぁ、私から直接の時もあるにはあるが
MsgEn:
Most issues get channeled to the
Order and Arisen through him -
though occasional direct reports do 
happen.

MsgJp:
ウチは装具屋だよ
要るものがないか見ていってよ
MsgEn:
Hey, you here to shop?
See if there's anything you need.

MsgJp:
うちがなんとかやっていけてるのも
騎士さんや覚者さんのお陰だよ
MsgEn:
We're scraping by thanks to the Knights...
and the Arisen's deeds.

MsgJp: お客さん、何か欲しいのある？
MsgEn: Do you need anything, ser?

MsgJp: 必要なものがあれば、買ってって
MsgEn: If you need anything, feel free to buy it.

MsgJp: うん、何か用かな？
MsgEn: Hmm, what can I do for you?

MsgJp:
川を少し北にいったところの河原
《血すすぎ河原》っていうんだが
いつのころからかリザードマンが集まってきてなぁ
MsgEn:
A little north of the river, there's a riverbed
called the 《Blood Rinsing Riverbed》
Lizardmen have been gathering there for some 
time now.

MsgJp:
川を泳いでこっちへ来やしないかと
落ち着かんね
MsgEn:
I'm wondering if he's going to swim down
the river and come over here.
I'm getting restless.

MsgJp:
覚者さん、よければそこの黒ブドウ亭
にいるアルフレドに力を貸してやって
くれないか
MsgEn:
Arisen, if you don't mind, can you help
Alfred at the Black Grape Inn?

MsgJp: はぁ、疲れが溜まりやすくなったな
MsgEn: Ah, I've been getting tired easily.

MsgJp:
やや熱っぽいような気が
い、いやいや気のせいだな
MsgEn:
I feel somewhat feverish
No, no, no, it's just my imagination.

MsgJp:
西側の森に、巨大な何かが落ちてきたんだ
神殿から調査の人も来ていたよ
村の者は恐ろしくて誰も近寄らんね
MsgEn:
Something huge fell in the woods to the west.
Some people from the temple came to investigate.
No one in the village is afraid to go near it.

MsgJp: あぁ、どうかしたか？
MsgEn: Oh, is something wrong?

MsgJp:
ハイデルもそう住みよいとはいえないよ
神殿が近いと言っても――
MsgEn:
Hidell's hardly a paradise either, even
with the temple so close—

MsgJp:
特に、橋を渡ってしばらく進んだところに
野盗達が居付いてるだろう
《黒狼団》といったかな
MsgEn:
Cross the bridge and keep going,
you'll hit their damn hideout.
'Black Wolf whatever-they-call-it' gang.

MsgJp:
村の近くやローテスへ続く街道まで現れて
あのローグ達は本当に困るよ
MsgEn:
Now they're appearing near villages
and even the roads to Rotes!
Those rogues are becoming a real nuisance.

MsgJp:
例の病に効く薬はないのか
ペドロのような重症者がまた出たら――
MsgEn:
Is there any medicine for the disease?
If there is another serious case like Pedro's--

MsgJp:
悪い時期に来たね、冒険者さん
今年は良いワインができそうにないよ
MsgEn:
You've come at a bad time, adventurer.
I don't think we're going to make good
wine this year.

MsgJp:
空から降ってきた物体に病気に――
くそ！何かできる事はないのか
MsgEn:
That falling thing spread disease--
Dammit! Isn't there anything we can do?!

MsgJp: 何だい、あたしゃ忙しいんだ
MsgEn: What do you want? I'm busy.

MsgJp:
ブタの世話だって、タダじゃないんだ
餌代もかかるってのに
MsgEn:
Even taking care of pigs isn't free.
It costs a lot of money to feed them.

MsgJp:
暮らしは厳しくなる一方だよ
なのにこの頃は変な病気まで！
あぁ、いやだいやだ
MsgEn:
Survival grows harsher every day,
and now bizarre sicknesses too?
Damn it all!

MsgJp:
たまに、枯れ井戸から変な臭いがするんだよ
まったく嫌んなるよ
MsgEn:
Sometimes there's a funny smell
coming from the dry well.
It's utterly disgusting.

MsgJp:
どいつもこいつも！
しみったれた面しやがってよぉ！
MsgEn:
All of them!
They've got a sullen look on their faces!

MsgJp:
はぁ～、酒くらいしか楽しみがねぇのに
どうすりゃいいんだまったく！
MsgEn:
I've got nothing to look forward to but drinking.
What am I going to do now?

MsgJp: 酒のアテ、次はどうすっかなぁ
MsgEn: Now, what'll complement the next drink...?

MsgJp: ニキちゃん、もう一杯！
MsgEn: Nikki, one more glass!

MsgJp:
はぁーい、旅人さん
聞きたいこと？なんでも聞いて
MsgEn:
Hi, Traveler,
Questions you want to ask?
Ask me anything.

MsgJp:
最近できがイマイチだけど
テルはワインが有名よ
一杯どう？
MsgEn:
Business has been slow lately...
But Tel is famous for its wine!
Care for a cup?

MsgJp:
あんた、裏の廃教会は知ってるかい？
あそこさ、すんごい地下墓地と繋がってるって話よ
MsgEn:
You know that abandoned church out back?
They say it's connected to a huge catacombs.

MsgJp:
裏の枯れ井戸、たまにすごい臭うのよ
わたしさぁ、村の流行り病と関係
ある気がするんだよね、女の勘だけど
MsgEn:
That dried-up well out back...
reeks something fierce lately.
Call it woman's intuition, but
I swear it's tied to the village
plague.

MsgJp: 覚者だな？任務で来たのか
MsgEn:
Are you an Arisen? 
Did you come on a mission?

MsgJp:
村の東側、《鬼鳴き橋》のことは知ってるか？
あそこは忌々しい事に
今やゴブリン共の占領下だ
MsgEn:
Do you know about the Roaring Demon
Bridge, east of the village?
That place is occupied by goblins now,
to our dismay.

MsgJp:
騎士が変な飾りを撤去しても
覚者がゴブリンを退治しても
気が付いたらすぐまた元通りだよ
嫌になるよまったく
MsgEn:
Whether knights remove those odd 
decorations, or the Arisen slays the
goblins, everything just returns overnight.
Honestly, it's exasperating!

MsgJp:
占拠したくせに橋守だと！
図々しいにもほどがある、小鬼どもめ
MsgEn:
Occupying our bridge and playing guards?
The shamelessness of these wretches
knows no bounds!

MsgJp:
次から次へと、問題は山積みだ
どれか一つでもクエストボードの依頼を
受けて貰えれば助かるんだが
MsgEn:
There are so many problems, one after another.
If only someone could take one quest from the
quest board.
That would be a great help.

MsgJp:
テル村での任務か何かなら
組合宿に顔を出しておけよ
MsgEn:
If it's a mission or something at Tel Village,
make sure to visit the inn.

MsgJp:
今この村じゃ、妙な風邪が流行っててな
神殿に病を持ち込むなよ
MsgEn:
There's a strange cold going around
in this village right now.
Don't bring illness into the temple.

MsgJp:
オーク侵攻のおり、村の西に落ちてきた
アレ――
MsgEn:
During the orc invasion, it fell to the west of
the village
Ale--

MsgJp: あのでかい岩の塊は、結局何なんだろうな？
MsgEn: I wonder what that big hunk of rock is after all?

MsgJp: 旅の同伴者をお求めでしょうか、覚者殿
MsgEn:
Are you looking for a traveling companion, Master
Arisen?

MsgJp: 白竜様のご加護があらんことを
MsgEn:
May the blessings of The White Dragon
be with you, Arisen.

MsgJp: リムの輝きは常に貴方と共に
MsgEn: Even now, the Rift's glow shields you.

MsgJp:
メンバーの再編でしたら
私にお申し付けください
MsgEn:
For party member reassignments, 
I'd be honored to receive your orders.

MsgJp: この先に用か？
MsgEn: You want something down the road?

MsgJp:
この先へ行きたいのか？
――悪いが、それはできない
MsgEn:
You want to go beyond this?
I'm--I'm sorry, but I can't do that.

MsgJp:
この先《ダウ渓谷》は危険地域
通って良いのは、神殿本部の許可を得た者のみだ
MsgEn:
This is a dangerous area ahead,
only those who have obtained permission from the
temple headquarters are allowed to pass.

MsgJp:
よほどの任務か功績でなければ
ゲルト団長の許可は下りないだろうがな
MsgEn:
Unless it's a significant mission or
accomplishment,
you won't get permission from Captain Gerd.

MsgJp:
ああ、お前が許可を得たことは聞いている
先へいくといい
だが《ダウ渓谷》の魔物は手強い
十分用心するのだ
MsgEn:
I have heard that you have obtained permission to
proceed.
However, the enemies in Dowe Valley are tough.
Be sure to take enough precautions.

MsgJp:
現在この先、《ダウ渓谷》は危険地域に
指定されている
ジンゲンの住民には苦労をかけるがな――
MsgEn:
The "Dow Valley" is currently designated as a
danger zone
, which will cause hardship for the residents of
Gingen...

MsgJp:
だがオークと魔物の侵入をこれ以上
許すわけにはいかんのだ
MsgEn:
But we can't allow any more orcs and demons to
invade

MsgJp:
ここを通れるのは神殿本部の許可を
得た者のみだ
MsgEn:
Only those with permission from temple
headquarters
can pass through here.

MsgJp:
つまり、相応の任務か功績が必要だと
いうことだ
MsgEn:
Which means you need a commensurate mission or
accomplishment.

MsgJp:
グリッテン砦とこの関所が、オークどもから
ハイデルを守る要――
見張りとは言え責任重大だよ
MsgEn:
Fort Gritten and this gateway are the key to
protecting the
Hyder from the orcs--
It's a big responsibility, even for a watchman.

MsgJp: ああ、何だ？
MsgEn: What is it?

MsgJp:
この間の大水で橋が壊れしまってな
ミスリウ森林方面に用があるなら
今は別の道をいくしかないな
MsgEn:
The bridge was destroyed by the big water the
other day.
If you need to go to Mysree Forest
you'll have to go the other way for now.

MsgJp:
テル村のすぐ西にある《狩人の抜け穴》
という洞窟を通れば
《ポーン郷》や《リンウッド》へ行くことができるぞ
MsgEn:
You can reach Pawn Township and Lynwood through
a cave called "Hunter's Loophole"
located just west of Tell Village.

MsgJp:
どうにも、木の橋は大水に弱いなぁ
流されたら修理も一苦労だよ
MsgEn:
In any case, wooden bridges are vulnerable to
heavy water.
If they get washed away, they'll be a pain to
repair.

MsgJp:
ここはたまに森の魔物も出るんだ
お前も注意しろよ
MsgEn:
Sometimes forest demons come out here too.
You be careful too.

MsgJp:
石の橋ならちょっとやそっとじゃ
壊れないだろうになぁ
MsgEn:
A stone bridge wouldn't break
in a little bit.

MsgJp:
テル周辺の事で相談か？
用件を伺おう
MsgEn:
You want to talk to me about the Tel area?
Let's hear what you have to say.

MsgJp: テルの西に振ってきた炎に包まれた何か――
MsgEn:
Something engulfed in flames swung from the west
of Tel--

MsgJp:
黒い石の塊のようなものなのだが
不気味でしかたがない
その近くで異様な姿のゴブリンを
見たという者もいる――
MsgEn:
It's like a block of black stone, but
it's just creepy.
Some people have seen strange-looking goblins
near it-- some say they've seen them-- and
they're not sure what they're supposed to be.

MsgJp: 村に影響がなければいいのだが
MsgEn:
As long as it doesn't affect the village, it's
fine.

MsgJp:
わたしの役割はテルと白竜神殿との仲介だ
ハイデル平原で起こった問題について
聞きたければ、いつでも訪れてくれ
MsgEn:
My role is to mediate between Tel and 
the White Dragon Temple about the
problems that have occurred in the
Hidell Plains.
If you want to ask me about it, you can
visit me anytime.

MsgJp:
魔物の増加に資材の不足
そして何より村の病――
悩みの種はつきないものだ
MsgEn:
More demons, lack of materials
and above all, the village's illnesses,
are a constant source of worry.

MsgJp:
一つでも多くの問題解決に、協力頂けると助かる
貴君のことは頼りにさせてもらう
MsgEn:
I would appreciate your help in solving
as many problems as possible.
I will be relying on you.

MsgJp:
おお、よく来てくれた
ちょうど貴君に伝えたいことがあってな！
MsgEn:
Oh, thank you for coming.
I just had something I wanted to tell you!

MsgJp:
このハイデル平原に設置された
《辺境の礎》が全て解放されたのだ！
これでハイデルの隅々まで足を運びやすくなるだろう
MsgEn:
All of the
sub-crystals set up here in the Hidell Plains
have been released!
Now it will be easier to visit every corner of
Hidell!

MsgJp:
貴君も最近は覚者隊での地位を築き、
益々の活躍に忙しいと聞いている
効率の良い探索のためにも、ぜひ活用してくれ
MsgEn:
I hear that you have recently established your
position in the Arisen Corps and are busy
increasing your activities.
Please make use of it for efficient search!

MsgJp:
以前、テルの西に降ってきた黒い塊――
そう、《アーク》といったか
あの付近を新手の魔物が徘徊しはじめてな
MsgEn:
That black mass that fell to the west of Tel--
"Ark", was it?
There are new monsters roaming that area now.

MsgJp:
今のところ移動する気配は無いが
万が一、村に近寄ることがあれば
混乱は避けられないだろう

付近の魔物の動向は把握しておきたいのだ
もし調査を頼めるのなら、
あらためてわたしに話しかけてほしい
MsgEn:
I'd like to know what's going on with the
monsters in the area.
If you can help investigate,
please come speak with me again.

MsgJp:
貴君が以前調査してきてくれた《アーク》だが
裏側にもう一つ出入り口があったのを知っているか？
MsgEn:
That "Ark" that you investigated earlier--
Did you know there is another entrance at the
back?

MsgJp:
何かの罠である可能性を警戒して封鎖していたのだが
今の貴君であれば心配は無さそうだ
封鎖を解いておこう
MsgEn:
Be wary of the possibility that it may be a trap
and sealed it off.
But with your current status, there seems to be
no need to worry.
Let's remove the seal.

MsgJp:
興味があれば中を調べてみるのも良いかもしれぬ
ただ、中に魔物がいることは確実だろう
調査の際は十分に注意しておくことだ
MsgEn:
If you're interested, it may be good to
investigate inside.
However, it is certain that there are enemies
inside.
Be cautious during the investigation.

MsgJp:
――口うるさいと思わないでくれ
このテルの守り手を失いたくはないのだ
MsgEn:
Please don't think I'm being annoying.
I don't want to lose my Protector of Tel.

MsgJp:
ああ、よいところに来てくれた
実は貴君に相談したいことがあったのだ
MsgEn:
Ah, you've come at a good time.
I actually have something I want to discuss with
you.

MsgJp:
以前調査してきてもらった《アーク》の付近から
最近、虫や小動物の姿が消えているのだ
MsgEn:
From the vicinity of the 《Ark》 that you have
previously surveyed for me
, insects and small animals have been
disappearing lately.

MsgJp:
アークに変化が起こっているのかも知れん
そこで、貴君に内部を
調査してきてもらいたいのだが、頼めるだろうか
MsgEn:
There may be a change in the arc
so I need you to go inside
and check it out, can you do that for me?

MsgJp:
引き受けてくれるようであれば、
あらためてわたしに話しかけてくれ
わたしもアークの周囲を調べてわかったことがある
貴君に詳しく伝えよう
MsgEn:
If you are willing to accept,
please talk to me again
I've been looking around ARC and found out some
things
I'll tell you more about it.

MsgJp:
貴君の働きにはわたしも、テルの村人たちも
とても感謝しているのだ
MsgEn:
I and the villagers of Tell are very grateful to
you for your work

MsgJp:
今回、村人たちからの強い希望もあって
支援品としてさらに良いものを揃えることにした
MsgEn:
This time, due to strong requests from the
villagers,
we have decided to have an even better selection
of support items.

MsgJp:
貴君への恩に報いるには足りぬが、
村のみなからの気持ちとして受け取ってくれ
MsgEn:
It is not enough to repay your debt to me, but
please accept it as a gesture from all of us in
the
village.

MsgJp:
これからも、よろしく頼む
テルとハイデルの守り手であってくれ
MsgEn:
Please keep up the good work.
Be a defender of Tell and Hidell.

MsgJp:
貴君がレオの信頼を得ているならば、
あるいは好奇心に身を任せるならば――
MsgEn:
If you have Leo's trust,
or if you let your curiosity get the better of
you--

MsgJp:
それだけ多く、様々な地を
訪ねることになるだろう
そして、貴君の活躍を待つ者も多いだろう
MsgEn:
So many, many places
will be visited
and many will be waiting to see you in action!

MsgJp:
白竜が衰えたことで
レスタニアはこの300年、様々な異変や
魔物に襲われるようになった
むろん、抱える問題もそれぞれだ
MsgEn:
With the decline of the white dragon,
Lestania has been attacked by various mutations
and
demons for the past 300 years.
Of course, they have their own problems to deal
with.

MsgJp:
新しい土地へ行ったら
エリアマスターへの挨拶を忘れるな
クセの強い者もいるが、皆この役を誇りに思っている
MsgEn:
When you go to a new place
don't forget to say hello to the Area Master
Some are quirky, but all are proud of their roles!

MsgJp:
つまり、貴君の味方だ
我々を大いに活用しつつ各地の問題を解決してくれ
MsgEn:
So, you are on our side
Please make use of us greatly and solve the
problems in various places

MsgJp:
貴君にはすでに恩がある
そこでだ、ミスリウ方面――
ポーン郷やリンウッドの村へ向かう道を提供しよう
MsgEn:
You already have our gratitude
Therefore, to the direction of Mysree
I will provide a way to the villages of Pawn
Cathedral and Lynwood

MsgJp:
テルのすぐ西にある洞窟、《狩人の抜け穴》
を通れるようにしておく
村人にとっては危険だが、貴君なら通れるだろう
MsgEn:
To the west of Tel, there is a cave, the Hunters'
Secret Passage
Make sure you can pass through
It is dangerous for the villagers, but you should
be able to pass

MsgJp:
だが、中には野盗の類や危険な獣も多い
十分注意してくれ
MsgEn:
However, there are many bandits and dangerous
animals inside
Be wary

MsgJp:
《狩人の抜け穴》に出る魔物やアイテムの
情報は、《エリア情報》の《スポット情報》
で確認していくことを勧めよう
MsgEn:
It is recommended to check the information on the
monsters and items that appear in "Hunters' Secret
Passage" in the "Area Information" and "Spot
Information."

MsgJp:
色々手伝ってもらってすまないな
貴君への支援品を用意した
これからも手を貸してくれ
MsgEn:
Sorry for all the help you've been giving me
I've got a support package for you
Keep up the good work!

MsgJp:
ところで、白竜が衰えたことで
レスタニアはこの300年、様々な異変や
魔物に襲われるようになった
MsgEn:
By the way, with the decline of the white dragon,
Lestania has been attacked by various mutations
and
demons for the last 300 years!

MsgJp: ――それは、このハイデルも例外ではない
MsgEn: ――Hidell is no exception to that.

MsgJp:
すでに知っているかもしれないが
テルはここしばらく謎の疫病に
苦しめられている
MsgEn:
As you may already know
Tell has been suffering from a mysterious plague
for some time now

MsgJp:
疫病の原因調査は、これまでに多くの
覚者が挑んだが、未だ解決には遠い
MsgEn:
The investigation of the cause of the epidemic
has been challenged by many Arisen people, but it
is still far from being solved.

MsgJp:
今の貴君の手にはあまるだろうが
いずれ時が来れば詳しく話そう
MsgEn:
I know it's too much for you right now
but we'll talk more about it when the time comes.

MsgJp:
これからも、テルとハイデルを
よろしく頼む
MsgEn: Keep up the good work Tel and Hidell at

MsgJp:
――実はな、困ったことになったのだ
テルの東にある通称《鬼鳴き橋》に
厄介なゴブリンが戻ってきたようなのだ
MsgEn:
Well, you see, something troublesome has
happened. It seems that a troublesome goblin has
returned to the bridge commonly known as the
"Roaring Demon Bridge" to the east of Tel.

MsgJp:
ヤツは《橋守のビンシャ》と名乗り
東の橋を占拠し陣取っている小鬼どものリーダーだ
見かけたらそいつを退治してくれないだろうか
MsgEn:
He is the leader of the small demons
who call themselves the "Bridgekeeper Binshaw"
and have entrenched themselves
on the eastern bridge.
Could you get rid of them if you see them?

MsgJp:
ヤツは返り討ちにした騎士や覚者から
いくつも《グレードの高い装備》を奪っているらしい
MsgEn:
It seems that he has taken several
"high-grade equipment" from the knights and the
Arisen he has defeated.

MsgJp:
討伐できたなら、貴君がそれを
奪い返し手に入れることもできるだろう
頭のかたすみに留めておいてくれ
MsgEn:
If you can subdue him,
you will also be able to retrieve it.
Please keep that in mind.

MsgJp:
村を代表して礼を言う
貴君はテルにとって英雄だ
MsgEn:
I will express my gratitude on behalf of the
village.
You are a hero to Tel.

MsgJp:
これからもどうかよろしく頼む
わたしも貴君のために、できることを探してみよう
MsgEn:
I have an idea,
please continue to rely on me, I will try to find
what I can do for you

MsgJp: こちらから貴君に朗報だ！
MsgEn: Here's good news for you!

MsgJp:
大水で損壊していた
《南ハイデル大橋》がようやく復旧したのだ
リンウッドから木材が届いてな
MsgEn:
The South Hidell Bridge, which had been damaged
by the flood, was finally restored.
Lumber arrived from Lynwood.

MsgJp:
これで、例の抜け穴を通らずとも
テルからミスリウ森林方面に
行きやすくなったぞ
MsgEn:
Now it's easier to get to
from the
tell to the Mysree Forest without having to go
through the loophole in the example!

MsgJp:
おお、来てくれたか！
貴君に伝えねばならんことがあったのだ
――そう、例の《ハイデル地下霊廟　深部》
についてだ
MsgEn:
Oh, you've come!
I have something to tell you about
-- yes, about the "Hidell Underground Mausoleum
Deep"

MsgJp:
霊廟の地下二階より下は
先代のエリアマスターが
早期の段階で封鎖していたよ
MsgEn:
Below the second basement floor of the mausoleum
the previous area master
had it sealed off early on!

MsgJp:
あの《開かずの路》で発見した手帳に
そのくだりと、霊廟深部の封鎖を解除する
スペリングが書かれていた
MsgEn:
The notebook I found in that "open road"
had that crap and the
spelling to break the blockade deep in the
mausoleum.

MsgJp:
今なら、《ハイデル地下霊廟　深部》へ
入る事ができるだろう
MsgEn:
Now, you should be able to enter the "Hidell
Catacombs Depths"
.

MsgJp:
もし調査の続きを頼めるなら
あらためて、わたしに話しかけてくれ
MsgEn:
If you want to continue the investigation
please talk to me again.

MsgJp:
いつもすまないな
お陰で本当に助かっている
心ばかりだが、礼をさせてくれ
MsgEn:
I'm always sorry
You've been a real help
Let me thank you from the bottom of my heart.

MsgJp:
――そろそろ貴君にもあの件を伝えておこう
例のハイデル教会の司祭だった男
メンヴィルについてだ
MsgEn:
――I think it's about time I inform you about that
matter.
About Menvili, the man who was a priest at the
infamous Hidell Church.

MsgJp:
もう数十年前のことだが、司祭は
村人から邪教崇拝の疑いをかけられて
追われ、失踪した
MsgEn:
Decades ago, the priest was
suspected by the villagers of pagan worship,
chased and disappeared.

MsgJp:
司祭の家の地下室から、多数の死体と
怪しい祭壇が発見されたからだ
MsgEn:
Because a number of dead bodies and a
suspicious altar were found in the basement of a
priest's house.

MsgJp:
――貴君も心当たりがあるだろう？
前に貴君が魔物退治をしたあの廃屋――
あそここそ、司祭メンヴィルの住居なのだ
MsgEn:
Perhaps you have an idea as well?
That abandoned house where you exterminated the
monsters earlier--
That place is none other than the residence of
Priest Menvili.

MsgJp:
以来、地下室から続く祭壇への通路は
《開かずの路》と呼ばれ、封印すべき場所として
先代のエリアマスターから受け継いだ
MsgEn:
Since then, the passage to the altar that leads
from the basement is called
"The Open Road" and is a place that should be
sealed
inherited from the previous area master.

MsgJp:
わたしも中を調べるつもりだが
貴君も興味があれば行ってみてくれ
MsgEn:
I'm going to check inside too
if you're interested.

MsgJp:
司祭、霊廟、そしてこの《開かずの路》――
疫病と何か関係がある気がしてならない
MsgEn:
Priests, mausoleums, and this "open road" -
I can't help but think it has something to do
with the plague.

MsgJp:
貴君には手伝ってもらってばかりだな
良ければまた手を貸してくれ
MsgEn:
You've been helping me a lot.
I'd like to give you a hand again, if you don't
mind.

MsgJp:
貴君、《血すすぎ河原》のことは知っているか？
あの場所に、ひときわ体の大きなリザードマンが
棲みつくようになったのだ
MsgEn:
Have you ever heard of the "Blood Soak Riverbed"?
A very large lizardman
has come to inhabit that place!

MsgJp:
河原はテルとも近い
かの大トカゲが村人や家畜を襲う前に
退治してくれないだろうか
MsgEn:
The riverbank is also close to Tel
before that giant lizard attacks villagers and
livestock

MsgJp:
――貴君、そういえば例の《開かずの路》へは
行ってみたか？
MsgEn:
By the way, have you tried going to that 'Blocked
Passage' we mentioned before, Ser?

MsgJp:
村の枯れ井戸と繋がっていたとは――
あれが、枯れていなかったらと思うと
ぞっとする話だ
MsgEn:
I didn't realize it was connected to the
village's dry well--
I'd be horrified if it hadn't

MsgJp:
たまに何やら臭うのも
おそらくそのせいだったのだな――
MsgEn:
Sometimes it smells like something, too.
Perhaps that was the reason--

MsgJp:
わたしもあの場所を調べ、手掛かりらしき
先代の手帳を見つけたのだ
もう少し調べがついたら、貴君に伝えよう
MsgEn:
I also checked that place and found a clue
that looks like my predecessor's notebook
I'll pass it on to you when I've done some more
research.

MsgJp:
ああ、そう言えば！
渡したいものがあるのだ
MsgEn:
Oh, by the way!
I have something for you.

MsgJp:
貴君のためにこれを取っておいた
どうか、旅に役立ててくれ
MsgEn:
I have kept this for you,
please make use of it on your journey.

MsgJp:
貴君、ハイデルで最も危険な場所は
どこか知っているか？
MsgEn: Do you know the most dangerous place in Hidell?

MsgJp:
それは、東にある教会の地下墓地
《ハイデル地下霊廟》だ
MsgEn:
It is the underground cemetery
of the eastern church, "Hidell Catacombs."

MsgJp:
調査に向かった覚者もほとんど戻らず
さまよい出る亡者も増えたので、
ここしばらく封鎖していたんだが――
MsgEn:
Few of the Arisen who've gone to investigate
have returned and more of the departed have wandered off,
so we've been on lockdown for a while now.
And we're still here.

MsgJp:
貴君ならあの場所を調べることが
できるかもしれん
《ハイデル地下霊廟》を開放しよう
MsgEn:
You might be able to check out that place
and open up the "Hidell Underground Mausoleum!"

MsgJp:
どうするかは委ねるが
行くなら頼みたいことがある
その気があれば、あらためて話しかけてくれ
MsgEn:
I'll leave it to you to decide what to do,
but should you go, there's aught I'd like to ask of you.
Please speak with me again if so.

MsgJp:
おお、貴君か
良い物資が手に入ったのだ
これを持って行ってくれ
MsgEn:
Oh, it's you.
I've managed to get some good supplies.
Please take this with you.

MsgJp:
テルとハイデルのため力を尽くしてくれた
貴君に、わたしもできることを探してみたのだ
MsgEn:
I wanted to do something for you
in return for all you have done for Tel and
Hidell.

MsgJp:
現状手に入る最も良い支援品を
手配しておいた
貴君の恩に報いるには、とうてい足りていないがな
MsgEn:
I've arranged for the best support goods we can
currently get.
Though, I fear it is still far from enough to
repay your kindness.

MsgJp:
これからも、よろしく頼む
テルとハイデルの守り手であってくれ
MsgEn:
Please keep up the good work.
Be a defender of Tell and Hidell.

MsgJp:
よく来たな
今回の支援品だ、受け取ってくれ
MsgEn:
You've made it!
Here are the support goods. Please take them.

MsgJp:
貴君、ハイデルの街道に野盗が度々
出ることは知っているだろう？
MsgEn:
You know, my dear, that the streets of Hidell are
often
riddled with wild thieves, don't you?

MsgJp:
ヤツらの名は《黒狼団》
東のアジトに居を構える盗賊集団だ
MsgEn:
Their name is the Black Wolf Bandit Group
, a bandit group that has its hideout in the east.

MsgJp:
神殿から指名手配され姿を消していた
その首領ラダンが、どうやらアジトに
戻ってきたらしい
MsgEn:
The leader, Ladan, who was wanted by the Temple
and disappeared
, has apparently returned
to his hideout!

MsgJp:
連中は、高価なアクセサリーや宝飾品を
かなりの量奪っているという話だ
MsgEn:
It is said that they have stolen a considerable
amount of expensive accessories and jewelry
.

MsgJp:
今や覚者隊でも騎士団でもなく、貴君が頼りだ
ヤツらの動向に目を光らせておいてくれ
MsgEn:
Now it's not the Arisen Corps or the Knights,
it's you.
Keep an eye out for them.

MsgJp:
やあ、貴君は――
ガルドリンの騒動では世話になったな
MsgEn:
Hey, you--
took care of me during the Gardolyn debacle.

MsgJp:
ところで、あの一件の裏側を
貴君はどこまで知っていた？
MsgEn:
By the way, how much did you know about the other
side of that one
?

MsgJp:
病に倒れた母親をかかえ
苦労している若い娘がいて――
MsgEn:
There's a young girl struggling
with an ailing mother...

MsgJp:
その話を聞いたガルドリンが
魔物退治を巡る賭博を思いついたらしい
もちろん、彼女に金を渡すことが目的だ
MsgEn:
Galdrin heard about it and came up with the idea
of
gambling over demon slaying.
The goal, of course, is to get her the money.

MsgJp:
親子はキノザの温泉で湯治をすると
旅立っていった
もしガルドリンに会う機会があったら
わたしが感服していたと伝えてくれ
MsgEn:
The father and son took a hot spring bath in
Kinoza and left
If you ever get a chance to meet Galdrin,
tell him I was impressed.

MsgJp:
エリアマスターとはこれでなかなか
難儀な仕事でな――
MsgEn:
Being an Area Master is truly
no easy task, I tell you—

MsgJp:
しかし、覚者の援助をすることで
神殿、そして白竜に貢献していると思うと
大変に誇らしい
MsgEn:
However, I am very proud to think that I am
contributing to the Temple and the White 
Dragon by assisting the Arisen!

MsgJp: せいぜい、活用してやってくれ
MsgEn: Please make use of me as much as possible.

MsgJp:
貴君の活躍は
見事なものだったと聞いているぞ
MsgEn:
I hear that your performance was
brilliant.

MsgJp:
各地のエリアマスターも喜んでいることだろう
もちろん、わたしもだ
ごくろうだった
MsgEn:
Each Area Master in each area will be delighted,
and of course, so am I
Thank you for your hard work

MsgJp: 森の素材はいかが？
MsgEn: How about forest materials?

MsgJp:
いい素材が揃ってるわ
ここにはハーブもキノコも、獣たちも
たくさんいるからね
MsgEn:
We have good materials here
Herbs and mushrooms, as well as animals, are
abundant here

MsgJp:
うちではいい木材を扱ってるわよ
森がくれる一番の恵みね
MsgEn:
We deal with good lumber here
It's the greatest gift that the forest provides

MsgJp:
この村では、みんなが森の恵みを
大切にしてるのよ
MsgEn:
In this village, everyone cherishes the gift of
the forest

MsgJp:
らっしゃい！
気に入ったのがあったら
買ってってくれよな！
MsgEn:
Rasai!
If you like what you see, you can buy it at
, right?

MsgJp:
森は発見も多いが危険も多い
行くなら十分準備してけよな！
MsgEn:
There's a lot to discover in the forest, but
there's also a lot of danger.
If you're going, be well prepared!

MsgJp:
動物の牙や皮、肉に関しちゃ
リンウッドが一番さ！
ここの男は全員、狩りくらいはできるんだぜ
MsgEn:
When it comes to animal tusks, hides and meat
Lynwood is the best!
All the men here can at least hunt!

MsgJp:
こないだ、リザードマンに
ケツをかじられちまってよ！
いやぁまいったまいった
MsgEn:
The other day, I got my ass chewed out by a
Lizardman
!
Well, that's good, that's good, that's good.

MsgJp:
リンウッドによく来たな
用があれば言ってくれ
MsgEn:
Nice to see you in Lynwood.
Let me know if you need anything.

MsgJp:
おお、泊っていくか、だったら
<VAL PRICE_INN>だが、どうする？
MsgEn:
Oh, do you plan to stay? If you are going to
<VAL PRICE_INN>, what will you do?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
うむ、《弱化の治療》だな
だったら<VAL PRICE_WEAK>だが、どうする？
MsgEn:
Mm, "The Weakening Cure"
then <VAL PRICE_WEAK>,but what do you do?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
だが見た所、あんたは《弱化》ではないようだ
泊ってゆっくり休むといい
MsgEn:
But from the looks of it, you're not "weakened."
Stay the night and get some rest.

MsgJp:
おお、休んでいくか？
もちろんあんたからお代を取ったりはしないよ
村にとっての大事な問題解決役だからな
MsgEn:
Oh, you want to take a break?
Of course I won't take any money from you.
You're an important problem solver for the
village.

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
村の問題はパトリシアに任せている
良ければ彼女の力になってくれないか
MsgEn:
Patricia is in charge of the village's problems.
You can help her if you'd like.

MsgJp:
ミスリウ森林は歩いたか？
西にはポーン達の聖堂《ポーン郷》
それに多くの自然洞窟や、旧時代の遺跡もある
探索場所には事欠かないぞ
MsgEn:
Have you walked through the Mysree Forest?
To the west is the Cathedral of the Pawns, "Pawn
Township"
and there are many natural caves and ruins from
the olden times
There is no shortage of places to explore!

MsgJp:
ゆっくり滞在していってくれ、覚者よ
もし手すきなら、《クエストボード》にも
目を通して貰えるとありがたい
MsgEn:
Take your time and stay with us, my learned
friend.
If you are free, I would also appreciate it if
you could look over the "Quest Board" at

MsgJp:
リンウッドは木こりと狩人の村だ
森で採れる素材が必要なら
ミランダを当たるといい
MsgEn:
Lynwood is a village of lumberjacks and hunters.
If you need materials from the woods, hit
Miranda.

MsgJp:
ミスリウ森林の南にぽつんと一軒家が
あるんだがな、そこには女性魔術師が
暮らしてるんだ
MsgEn:
There is a house
south of Mysree forest where a female magician
lives.

MsgJp:
エメラダさんっていうんだが
もし魔術師として弟子入りを希望するなら
白鹿亭のパトリシアに認められなきゃいけないぞ
MsgEn:
Her name is Emelada.
If you want to be an apprentice sorceress,
you have to be approved by Patricia of the White
Deer Pavilion.

MsgJp:
彼女の紹介した覚者しか、エメラダさんから
魔術は習えないらしいから
MsgEn:
Because I heard that only the Arisen she
introduced me to can learn witchcraft from Ms.
Emerada.

MsgJp: 《燐光虫の洞窟》には行ったか？
MsgEn: Have you been to Glowworm Cave?

MsgJp:
危険なところなんだが、奥はまるで
星空に迷い込んだかのように美しいらしい
俺も見てみたいもんだなぁ
MsgEn:
It's a dangerous place, but I hear it's so
beautiful in the back it's like
you're lost in a starry sky
I wish I could see it too!

MsgJp: やぁ、何か聞きたいことでも？
MsgEn: Hello, is there something you want to ask?

MsgJp:
ミスリウの森には、悪さを働くエイプが
何匹かいるんだ
MsgEn:
There are a few bad ape's
in the Misliw forest.

MsgJp:
それぞれ、唸り猿、裂き猿、豚喰い猿
ってあだ名がついててね
まぁ家畜は攫うわ狩人は襲うわ
やりたいほうだいでね
MsgEn:
They were nicknamed roaring monkeys, ripping
monkeys, and pig-eating monkeys
, respectively.
Well, they kidnap livestock and attack hunters
as much as they want.

MsgJp:
やつらの縄張りは、廃屋が目印だ
臭ったり気味悪いところは注意した方がいい
MsgEn:
Their territory is marked by abandoned houses.
You should be careful where it smells or looks
creepy.

MsgJp:
オークだ戦争だって、悲観したって
どうにもできないしね
ま、なるようになるわよ！
MsgEn:
It's orcs, it's war, it's pessimism.
And there's nothing we can do about it.
Well, it's going to happen!

MsgJp:
難しい顔してるわね、考え事？
気にしない気にしない！
MsgEn:
You look so difficult. Are you thinking?
I don't mind, I don't mind!

MsgJp:
騎士様、覚者様！　頼りにしてるんだから
ほんとよ、ほんと！
MsgEn:
Dear knight, dear Arisen!　I'm counting on you.
Really, really!

MsgJp: あっはは！　こんにちは！
MsgEn: Ahaha! Good day!

MsgJp:
こないだ、でかい木を切り倒そうとしたら
突然そいつが動き始めてなぁ！
MsgEn:
The other day I was about to cut down a big tree
and all of a sudden it started moving!

MsgJp:
エントだよ、エント！
あれは腰を抜かしたよ
MsgEn:
It's an Ent, an Ent!
That scared the hell out of me

MsgJp:
前に、外の川で水浴びしてたんだ
そしたらいつの間にか周りはリザードマン
だらけでなぁ！　ホント肝を冷やしたよ
MsgEn:
I was outside taking a dip in the river
and before I knew it, there were Lizardmen
all around me!　It was really chilling!

MsgJp:
孫のエコールは働き者のいい子なんだが
外へ出たがっててなぁ
危険な目に合わんか心配だよ
MsgEn:
My grandson, Ecole, is a good, hard-working kid,
but
he wants to go outside.
I'm worried he's in danger.

MsgJp: おう、なんだい旅人さん
MsgEn: Hey, what's up, traveler?

MsgJp:
森の奥にはいつの時代のか分からん
古い遺跡があるんだよ
MsgEn:
In the depths of the forest, there is an ancient
ruins from some unknown
era

MsgJp:
《古の祭祀場》と呼ばれててなぁ
いったい何のための場所なんだろうなぁ
MsgEn:
It's called the "Ancient Ritual Site".
I wonder what on earth it's for?

MsgJp:
そういえば以前、祭祀場の方から
ものすごい地響きがしたことがあったな――
何が起こったかは知らんが
MsgEn:
You know, I once heard a
tremendous ground shaking from the ritual hall--
I don't know what happened.

MsgJp:
この見張り塔登ってみた？
景色が綺麗だよ！
MsgEn:
Have you tried climbing this watchtower?
The view is beautiful!

MsgJp:
そのうち、あちこち旅をしたいの
この村も好きだけど、他の土地を自分で見て
歩いてみたいんだ
MsgEn:
One of these days I'd like to travel around
I love this village, but I'd like to see the rest
of the land for myself
and walk around it.

MsgJp:
マハル達、かくれんぼが大好きでさ
わたしも遊ぶんだけど面白いよ！
森を知らないひとがやると迷っちゃうけどね
MsgEn:
Mahal and his friends love to play hide and seek.
I play too and it's fun!
If you don't know the forest, though, you'll get
lost.

MsgJp: こんにちはっ！
MsgEn: Hello!

MsgJp:
うん？　覚者か
任務で来たのか？
MsgEn:
Hm?　You're a Arisen or
on a mission?

MsgJp:
たまに森の獣や魔物が村のすぐ近くまで
来ることがある、十分気をつけろよ
MsgEn:
Sometimes forest beasts and demons come
very close to the village, be very careful!

MsgJp:
われわれ白衛騎士団は、各地の衛兵として
大陸全土を守っている
MsgEn:
We, the Knights of the White Guard, protect
the entire continent as the local guards.

MsgJp: ここはミスリウ森林の村、リンウッドだ
MsgEn: This is the village of Linwood in Mysree Forest.

MsgJp:
森には様々な魔物がいるが
中でも多いのは森小人――
フォレストゴブリン達だ
MsgEn:
There are many different kinds of demons in the
forest,
but the most common are the forest dwarves--
forest goblins.

MsgJp:
村の北東には、やつらの群れる
《森小人の集落》がある
できるだけ近づかんようにな
MsgEn:
To the northeast of the village, there is a
"forest dwarves' village" where they are huddled
Stay away from them as much as possible!

MsgJp:
ねぇねぇ、こないだぼく見たんだよ！
すっごい大きなエント！！
MsgEn:
Hey, hey, I saw something the other day!
A very big entry!

MsgJp:
見張り塔から眺めてたらほんとにいたんだ
でもそのあとどこかいっちゃって――
ホントだよ、ホントに見たんだって！
MsgEn:
I was looking at it from the watchtower and it
was really there.
But then it went away...
It's true, he really saw it!

MsgJp:
なぁ、村からずーっと離れた滝の近くに
古いお墓があるんだ
村のお墓でもないし、誰のお墓なんだろ
MsgEn:
Hey, there's an old grave near the waterfall
that's a long way from the village
It's not a village grave, and I wonder whose
grave it is.

MsgJp:
ねぇ、神殿から来たんでしょ！？
いいなー、ぼくも行ってみたいな！
MsgEn:
Hey, you came from the temple!
I wish I could go there!

MsgJp: えっ、なぁに？
MsgEn: What?

MsgJp:
わたしねー、大きくなったら
魔法使いになるの！
MsgEn:
I'm going to be a
wizard when I grow up!

MsgJp:
ねぇねぇ聞いて、前に森の家に住んでる
綺麗な女の人とお話したんだよ！
魔法使いなんだって！
MsgEn:
Hey hey listen, I talked to a beautiful
woman who lives in a house in the forest before!
She said she's a magician!

MsgJp: 今日はかくれんぼしないのかなー、マハル達
MsgEn:
Aren't we playing hide-and-seek today, Mahal and
the others?

MsgJp: こんにちは、旅人さん！
MsgEn: Hello, traveler!

MsgJp:
エコール姉ちゃんとよく森に行くんだ！
姉ちゃん、ウサギより足早いんだぜ！
MsgEn:
I often go to the woods with my sister Ekor!
My sister is faster than a rabbit!

MsgJp:
へっへー
前にこっそり《燐光虫の洞窟》まで
いったんだぜ！　怒られちゃったけどな
MsgEn:
Hehehe
I sneaked up to the Cave of the Phosphorescent
Worms
once before!　I was pissed, though.

MsgJp:
オレも早く一人前の狩人になるんだ
リンウッドの男だからな！
MsgEn:
I'll be a full-fledged hunter soon.
I'm a Lynwood man!

MsgJp: えっ、オレになんか用？
MsgEn: Huh, do you need something from me?

MsgJp: 白竜さまのご加護があらんことを
MsgEn: May the blessing of the White Dragon be upon you

MsgJp: リムの輝きは常に貴方と共に
MsgEn: Even now, the Rift's glow shields you.

MsgJp:
メンバーの再編をお考えでしたら
なんなりと
MsgEn:
If you are thinking of reorganizing your 
party members, please do not hesitate 
to ask.

MsgJp: 旅の同伴者をお求めですか？　覚者様
MsgEn:
Are you looking for a travel companion, Ser
Arisen?

MsgJp:
ミスリウ一帯の案件なら
私が預かっているわ
MsgEn:
If you're looking for a case in the Mysree area,
I can take care of it.

MsgJp:
リンウッドは深部の森やその周辺とも
昔から交流があるの
MsgEn:
Lynwood has a long history of contact
with the deep forest and its surroundings.

MsgJp:
ポーン郷のカミュ様やエメラダには
よくお世話になってるしね
MsgEn:
Camus and Emerada of the Pawn Cathedral
have taken good care of me.

MsgJp:
洞窟や奥地に行く時は気を付けてね
トロールやエントと出くわしたら大変よ
MsgEn:
Be careful when you travel to the caves and
backcountry.
If you run into a troll or an ent, there will be
trouble.

MsgJp:
森が危なくなって、木材の調達も
難しくなってきたわ
MsgEn:
The forests have become more dangerous,
and it's getting more difficult to gather wood.

MsgJp:
もう知ってるかもしれないけど
《辺境の礎》っていうのが各地に
設置されることになったでしょう
MsgEn:
You may already know that something called
Subcrystal is going to be installed in various
places

MsgJp:
今回、ミスリウの《辺境の礎》全てが
使えるようになったのよ
このことをぜひ貴方にも知らせておこうと思って！
MsgEn:
This time, all of Mysree's "Sub-Portcrystals"
are now available
I thought I'd let you know about this!

MsgJp:
森の中は入り組んでいるから
迷いやすかったり移動に時間がかかりがちだけど
これで少しは楽になると思うわ
MsgEn:
The woods are so convoluted that
it's easy to get lost or take a long time to get
around.
I think this will make things a little easier.

MsgJp:
ちょうどいいところに来てくれたわ！
貴方に相談したいことがあったの
MsgEn:
You've come just in time!
There's something I needed to speak with you
about.

MsgJp:
リンウッドからミスリウ森林深部に行く
一本道があるでしょう
その途中に、"子攫いのメリーティア"と呼ばれる
ナイトメアが巣食ってしまったの
MsgEn:
There's a single road that leads from Lynwood
to the depths of Mysree Grove.
A nightmare known as "Maritia the Kidnapper"
has taken up residence along that road.

MsgJp:
ナイトメアの中でも凶悪な個体で
生半可な腕では近付くことすらできないのよ
お願い、貴方に退治を頼めないかしら
MsgEn:
It's the most vicious of the nightmares and
with my lacking skill, I can't even get close to
it.
Please, can you help me get rid of it?

MsgJp:
退治してくれるなら出発前に
私に話しかけてちょうだい
くわしく説明するわ
MsgEn:
If you want to exterminate them, talk to me
before you leave
and I'll explain more.

MsgJp:
そうそう、貴方に伝えようと思っていたことがあるの
森の中にある遺跡《ミスリウ古墳墓》の封鎖を
解くことにしたのよ
MsgEn:
That's right, I've been meaning to tell you.
I've decided to unseal those ruins in the forest,
the "Mysree Mysree Barrow".

MsgJp:
以前から歴史研究のために解放を
望む声があったんだけど、万が一のことを考えると
封鎖しておかざるをえなかったのよね
MsgEn:
There have been continued calls
to release it for historical research,
but not knowing what could occur, we had to keep
it sealed off.

MsgJp:
けど、今は貴方という頼もしい覚者さんが
ミスリウに寄ってくれることだし
この機会にと思ってね！
MsgEn:
But now that a reliable Arisen such as yourself
will be stopping by Mysree,
I couldn't miss this opportunity!

MsgJp:
うーん、覚者さん――
ちょっと相談してもいいかしら
MsgEn:
Hmmm, Arisen--
Could I speak with you a moment?

MsgJp:
実は、この前封鎖を解いた
《ミスリウ古墳墓》についてなんだけど
さっそく問題が起こっちゃって――
MsgEn:
Actually, about the
Mysree Barrow that was unsealed recently,
a problem has occurred right away...

MsgJp:
あの古墳墓に入った歴史家が
魔物に襲われたらしいんだけど
どんな魔物なのかすらわからないの
MsgEn:
It seems that the historian who entered that
ancient burial mound was attacked by
enemies, but
we don't even know what kind of enemies they are

MsgJp:
このままじゃ謎を抱えたまま
あの古墳墓をもう一度
封鎖しないといけなくなるわ
MsgEn:
If we leave it like this,
we will have to seal that ancient burial mound
again
while still having this mystery

MsgJp:
貴方の力で何とかならないかしら
調査を頼めるようなら、くわしく
説明するから、もう一度私に声をかけてね
MsgEn:
I wonder if it's possible to solve this with your
power?
If I can ask you to investigate,
I will explain in detail, so please talk to me
again

MsgJp:
いつもリンウッドを助けてくれてありがとう
この森の住人を代表してお礼を言うわ！
MsgEn:
Thank you for always helping Lynwood.
I thank you on behalf of all the residents of
this forest!

MsgJp:
私も、もっと貴方の力になりたいんだけど
物資での支援くらいしかできないから――
MsgEn:
I'd like to help you more, too, but I can only
help you with supplies at

MsgJp:
せめてもの気持ちとして、もっといいものを
揃えられるように手配しておいたの
役立ててくれると嬉しいわ
MsgEn:
At the very least, I've arranged to have
something better
I hope it helps!

MsgJp:
リンウッドの皆がこうしてられるのも
貴方のお陰よね
MsgEn:
Thanks to you, everyone in Lynwood is able to do
this

MsgJp:
私にできることなんてたかが
知れてるだろうけど、何とか恩返しするわ！
だから、今後ともよろしくね
MsgEn:
I know there's not much I can do
but I'll try to repay you somehow!
So keep up the good work!

MsgJp:
貴方の活躍、噂になってるわよ！
はい、今回のお礼
ぜひまたお願いね！
MsgEn:
Your achievements are being talked about!
Yes, as thanks this time
Please let me rely on you again!

MsgJp:
村の仕事を手伝ってくれて、ありがとう
何かお礼しないとね
MsgEn:
Thank you for helping with the village's work,
I have to thank you for something

MsgJp:
来てくれてありがとう！
これ、リンウッドのみんなで少しずつ
出しあって買ったの
MsgEn:
Thanks for coming!
We all paid a little
for this one.

MsgJp: みんなからの、日ごろの感謝の印よ
MsgEn: It's a symbol of our daily gratitude to everyone

MsgJp:
ねぇ、これ、貴方に使ってもらおうと
思ってとっといたの
少しは何かの役に立つかしら
MsgEn:
Hey, I saved this for you to use
I hope it's of some use.

MsgJp:
こんにちは
私はエリアマスターのパトリシア
よろしくね
MsgEn:
Hello
I'm Patricia, an Area Master
Nice to meet you

MsgJp:
このミスリウ一帯は、木々が密生しているから
迷わないように注意してね
特に道から外れた時はカンに頼らず
かならず地図を確認するのよ
MsgEn:
This area of Mysree is densely wooded
so be careful not to get lost
especially if you are off the path, don't rely on
your instincts
always check the map!

MsgJp:
それと、すこしミスリウ森林の
現状について共有しておくわね
MsgEn:
Also, I'd like to share a bit about the current
status of
in the Mysree Forest.

MsgJp:
白竜様の力が衰えてから
森のいたるところで魔物や獣たちが
凶暴化してきているの
MsgEn:
Since the Lord White Dragon's power waned,
demons and beasts everywhere in the forest have
become more ferocious.

MsgJp:
今は、各所で起こった異変に
順番に対処するしかないという状況よ
特に、洞窟や水辺には注意して
MsgEn:
Right now, we're just dealing with the anomalies
that have occurred in various places
in turn.
Be especially careful in caves and near water!

MsgJp:
あと、あなたが信頼できる人だって
分かったら紹介したい人もいるんだけど――
それは、あなたの活躍を見てからに
させてもらうわ
MsgEn:
I also have some people I'd like to introduce you
to if I find out
that you're someone I can trust--
I'll let you do that
after I see how well you're doing.

MsgJp:
あ、そうだ
これ使って、大した物じゃないけど
MsgEn:
Oh, yeah.
Use this. It's not much, but...

MsgJp: 村の仕事を手伝ってくれて、ありがとう
MsgEn: Thank you for helping with the village's work.

MsgJp:
あなたのサポートができるよう
物資面で支援するわね
MsgEn:
I'll be happy to assist you with supplies at
so that we can support you.

MsgJp:
さっそくだけど、問題発生よ
リンウッドの北東にフォレストゴブリン達の
集落があるのは知ってる？
MsgEn:
Quickly, we have a problem.
Did you know there is a
settlement of forest goblins northeast of
Lynwood?

MsgJp:
その《森小人の集落》で、連中の首領を
見かけたって報告があったの
MsgEn:
I got a report that I saw the head of them
in that "forest dwarves' settlement".

MsgJp:
森小人の長、《緑鬼グリッガ》
前はもっと森の奥地にいたはずなのに
MsgEn:
Chief of the Forest Dwarfs, "Griga the Green
Demon"
He used to be in a more secluded part of the
forest.

MsgJp:
もし見かけたら、先手を打てないかしら
貴方にも気をつけておいてほしいの
MsgEn:
If I see you, I'll see if I can get a head start.
I want you to keep an eye out too.

MsgJp:
良い所に来たわね！
《西ミスリウ橋》の修繕がようやく終わったの
MsgEn:
You've come to the right place!
The repairs to the West Mysree Bridge are finally
finished.

MsgJp:
これも、あなたが村の問題解決を
手伝ってくれたお陰よ
ポーン郷との行き来が楽になるんじゃないかしら
MsgEn:
This is all thanks to you helping
solve the village's problems
I'm sure it will make it easier to get to and
from Pawn Cathedral.

MsgJp:
橋さえ通れれば、わざわざリム転移を
使うほどの距離でもなくなるからね
MsgEn:
If you can cross the bridge, you won't have to
use Rift Teleport for such short distance.

MsgJp:
貴方に言おうと思ってたことがあったの
村の北東、川沿いに《リンウッド地下水路》
っていう旧時代の水路があるのよ
MsgEn:
I was going to tell you about something
there is an old time waterway along the river
northeast of the village called the Lynwood
Underground Canal

MsgJp:
リザードマンが多くて危険だから、
入口を閉鎖してたんだけど、どういうわけか
行商人が入ってしまって――
MsgEn:
There are so many Lizardmen that it's dangerous,
we had to close the entrance, but somehow
the peddlers got in and--

MsgJp:
私が掛けていた鍵が、市販品だった
からかしら――
MsgEn:
I think it was from
where the lock I was hanging was a commercial
one--I don't know.

MsgJp:
救援要請があってすぐ水路に向かったん
だけど、もう姿が見えなくてね
もしかしたら近くに居るかもしれないから
少し気にしておいてほしいの
MsgEn:
I went to the canal as soon as I got the call for
help
but I can't see him anymore
so maybe he's around
I just want you to keep an eye out for him.

MsgJp: 結局彼ら、どうなったのかしら――
MsgEn: I wonder what happened to them in the end?

MsgJp:
貴方の活躍、噂になってるわよ！
これからもお願いね！
MsgEn:
Word is getting out about your success!
Keep up the good work!

MsgJp:
物資の支援くらいしか報いられないから
私の方でも別の品が手に入らないか
当たってみたの
少しでも助けになればいいんだけど
MsgEn:
I can only repay with support for supplies
When I'm not other stuff in my own way
I tried hitting it
If I can help even a little bit

MsgJp:
そうだわ！
ちょうど貴方に紹介したい人がいるのよ
MsgEn:
Yes!
I have someone I want to introduce to you

MsgJp:
その人の名はエメラダ
リンウッドの南、《森の一軒家》にいる女性よ
MsgEn:
Her name is Emerada.
She's a woman living in the south of Lynwood, 
in the "Lone House in the Forest."

MsgJp:
話は通しておくから、その気があれば
エメラダと会ってみて
彼女の家の場所が分からなければ
《スポット情報》で確認するといいわ
MsgEn:
I'll handle the details—
visit Emerada if you want.
Her home's location is listed
under Spot Info if needed.

MsgJp:
ちょっとまずい状況になったの
森に、腐肉が散乱する廃屋がいくつか
あるのは知ってるかしら
MsgEn:
I'm in a bit of a bad situation
I wonder if you know that there are some
abandoned houses in the forest
that are littered with carrion.

MsgJp:
あそこはそれぞれ、凶暴なエイプ達の縄張りに
なっててね――
だいぶ前に追い払ったのだけど
いつの間にか戻ってきたらしいのよ
MsgEn:
Each of those places has become the turf of the
vicious apes
--
we chased them away a long time ago, but
they've been back for some time now.

MsgJp:
猿達は、それぞれ
《唸り猿》《裂き猿》《豚喰い猿》って
呼ばれてるわ
MsgEn:
The monkeys are called
"snarling monkeys," "ripping monkeys," and
"pig-eating monkeys,"
respectively.

MsgJp:
森に３か所ある廃屋が彼らのねぐらだから
近くを通る時は注意して
村のみんなにも伝えなきゃ
MsgEn:
There are three abandoned houses in the forest
that serve as their nests, so be careful when
passing by
, and make sure to let everyone in the village
know

MsgJp:
――ちょっと聞いてくれる？
《ミスリウ鍾乳洞》っていう、この森で最も深く
危険な巨大洞窟があるんだけど
MsgEn:
--Can I have your attention, please?
There is a huge cave called "Mysree Limestone
Cave", the deepest and most dangerous cave in this
forest.

MsgJp:
少し前からその周辺で、恐ろしい獣の
唸り声や地響きがするようになってね
MsgEn:
Not long ago, I started hearing the
roar of a terrible beast in that neighborhood,
and the earth shaking.

MsgJp:
調査に行ってくれた騎士団が
まだ戻らないのよ――
MsgEn:
The Knights who went to investigate
still haven't come back--

MsgJp:
神殿にも救援要請を出しているんだけど
覚者隊はオークとの戦いでなかなか
手が回らないらしくて
MsgEn:
I've also sent a request for help to the Temple,
but
the Arisen Corps is having a hard time
fighting the orcs.

MsgJp:
そこで、相談なんだけど
貴方に確認を頼めないかしら
お願い――、力を貸してちょうだい
MsgEn:
So, I was wondering if I could ask you to check
please--help me out.

MsgJp:
リンウッドの皆がこうしていられるのも
貴方のお陰よね
MsgEn:
Everyone in Lynwood is alive and well because of
you

MsgJp:
私にできることなんてたかだか
知れてるだろうけど、何とか恩返しするわ
補給支援の仕入れ、張り込んだんだから！
MsgEn:
There's not much I can do
you know, but I'll return the favor somehow.
I've stocked up on supply support and staked it
out!

MsgJp:
今後ともよろしくね
ミスリウの勇者さん
MsgEn:
Keep up the good work.
Mysree's Braveheart

MsgJp: 貴方にお願いしたいことがあるの
MsgEn: I need you to do something for me.

MsgJp:
――《古の祭祀場》
あの遺跡に、森にいるのとは異なる
エントが出るようになったらしいの
MsgEn:
――《Ancient Ritual Ground》
It seems that Ents have started appearing in that
ancient ritual site, different from those in the
forest.

MsgJp:
――悪いことの前兆でなければ
いいんだけど
MsgEn: -- if it's not a sign of bad things, it's fine.

MsgJp:
少し気になることがあるの
あなたに詳しい調査を頼めないかしら
準備ができたら、もう一度声をかけてちょうだい
MsgEn:
I'm a little concerned about something
I wonder if I could ask you to do some further
research
When you're ready, give me a shout again.

MsgJp:
小さな村だが、旅の準備くらいは整えられる
必要なことがあれば言ってくれ
MsgEn:
It's a small village, but I can at least get you
ready for your trip.
Let me know if you need anything else.

MsgJp:
休んでいくか？
谷道は慣れないうちは堪えるだろう
MsgEn:
You want to take a break?
The valley road will take some getting used to.

MsgJp:
ここは他の村との行き来が厳しくてな
物資の補給も思うようにいっていない
MsgEn:
It's hard to get to and from the other villages
here
and supplies are not coming in as fast as we
would like.

MsgJp:
もし手伝ってもらえるなら、奥にいる
ヘイデンに話を聞いてみてくれ
MsgEn:
If you can help, talk to Hayden at
in the back.

MsgJp:
休憩なら
<VAL PRICE_INN>いただくが、どうする？
疲れは溜めないほうがいいぞ
MsgEn:
If you need a break, I'll take
<VAL PRICE_INN>, what do you say?
You better not be tired.

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
《弱化の治療》なら
<VAL PRICE_WEAK>いただこう、どうかね？
MsgEn:
I'll take <VAL PRICE_WEAK> for the "weakening
cure", how about that?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
うむ、《弱化の治療》は不要のようだな
必要になればまた言ってくれ
MsgEn:
Mm, looks like you don't need the "weakening cure"
Let me know if you need it again.

MsgJp: ジンゲンへようこそ、旅の方
MsgEn: Welcome to Zingen, traveler!

MsgJp:
ああ、休憩なら空いてるベッドを好きに使うといい
ここが何とかやれているのもお前さんの
おかげだからな、休むかね？
MsgEn:
Oh, and if you need a break, you can use any
available bed.
The only reason this place is still going strong
is because of you.
Want to take a break?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
ジンゲンへようこそ
――こんな状況になっても
ここを気にかけてくれるとは
MsgEn:
Welcome to Jingen
--I'm so glad you care about this place
even in this situation.

MsgJp:
ここは魔物も出るし、何より不便だ
どこか平穏に暮らせる場所に引っ越したい――
そう言い続けて、結局ジンゲンで人生を
終えることになるなんて
MsgEn:
This place has demons and is inconvenient above
all.
I want to move somewhere where I can live
peacefully...
I can't believe I kept saying that and ended up
ending my life
in Jingen.

MsgJp:
年寄りが騒いだところで
何も変わらんよ
どうなろうと、静かに待つしかない
MsgEn:
No matter how much the elderly complain,
nothing will change
Whatever happens, all we can do is wait quietly

MsgJp:
ここまで来て疲れたろう
せめて旅立ちの時間まで
ゆっくり休んでいくといい
MsgEn:
I'm sure you're tired after coming all this way
at least until it's time to leave
to get some rest.

MsgJp: 村から見えるドリード城、あなたは行った？
MsgEn:
Have you been to Dreed Castle visible from the
village?

MsgJp:
私のいい人もあそこに行ってるんだ
財宝を見つけるまで戻らないって息巻いてね――
MsgEn:
My good friend also went there
I won't go back until I find the treasure, they
said with determination—

MsgJp:
しっかりお金を貯めて、店と家を大きくするの！
うーん、でもここ、お客さん少ないのよね
MsgEn:
I will save money and expand the shop and house!
Hmm, but there aren't many customers here

MsgJp:
あーあ、あの人早く戻らないかしら
私が稼ぐから、財宝なんかいいのに
MsgEn:
Oh, I wonder if that person will come back soon
I earn money, so I don't care about treasure

MsgJp:
はぁい、いい取引をしましょう！
できればなるべくたくさんね
MsgEn:
Yes, let's make a good transaction!
As much as possible, please

MsgJp:
あの空を見た？
――もう時間がないみたい
取引できるかぎり、取引しましょう！
MsgEn:
Did you see that sky?
――Seems like there's no time left
Let's make transactions as much as possible!

MsgJp:
色んな夢があったの
お金を貯めて、この店を大きくして
その頃にはドリード城から
私のいい人も帰ってきて――
MsgEn:
I had all kinds of dreams
to save up money and make this place bigger
and by that time, my good man from Dorid Castle
came back and--

MsgJp:
ここまできたんだもの
最後まであの人を待ち続けるわ
MsgEn:
We've come this far.
I'll wait for that guy until the end.

MsgJp:
もしかしたら、お金を集めても
もう意味が無いかも知れないけど――
MsgEn:
Maybe raising money for
doesn't mean anything anymore--but--I'm not sure.

MsgJp:
あんたもモノ好きね
こんなとこ、何しに来たの
MsgEn:
You like things too.
What are you doing here?

MsgJp: ふー、だるいわね
MsgEn: Ugh, I'm bored.

MsgJp:
散策場所、多いでしょ、ここ
地下墓地とか遺跡とか
MsgEn:
There are a lot of places to explore, right here
, like catacombs and ruins.

MsgJp: あんた、全部行くの？
MsgEn: Are you going to go all of it?

MsgJp: うん、何？
MsgEn: Yeah, what?

MsgJp:
そういえばさ、怖い話があったっけ
村の北に《歌姫の崖座》っていう
場所があんの
MsgEn:
You know, there's a scary story
about a place north of the village called "The
Cliff Seat of the Diva"

MsgJp:
恐ろしげな女の声が響いた時
外に出てた村人――半分くらいが
「持って行かれた」んだってさ
MsgEn:
When the scary woman's voice sounded
the villagers who were outside--about half of
them--were
"taken away."

MsgJp: 相当前の話らしいけどさ
MsgEn: It seems to be a story from a while ago.

MsgJp:
いたたたた――！　こ、腰がっ！
くそ、キノザの湯にさえ行ければ――
MsgEn:
Ouch!　My back!
Damn, if only I could get to Kinoza's hot
spring...

MsgJp:
うーむ、どっかにいい薬はないものか
腰さえ治れば谷を降りるんだがなぁ――
MsgEn:
Hmmm, I wonder if there is a good medicine
somewhere
If only my back would heal, I'd be down the
valley--

MsgJp:
景色は良いんだが、いかんせん
ジンゲンは道が険しいだろう
どうにもそれがなぁ
MsgEn:
The scenery is nice, but I can't help but think
Jingen will be a steep road
I can't help but think that's it.

MsgJp: あぁ、いたた！　腰に響く
MsgEn: Ah, that hurts! It's throbbing in my back.

MsgJp:
いやぁ、なかなかうまくいかねぇぜ
目当ての品を探すにも、収穫ナシの日が
続くと酒がまずくならぁ
MsgEn:
Well, it's not going so well.
Even if you're looking for something you're
looking for, a day without a harvest
can make your drink go bad...

MsgJp:
ハーピーの野郎――いや、女ども！
頭の上をギャーギャー飛びまわって
うるさくてかなわねぇや
MsgEn:
Harpy's - no, women!
They're flying around on my head
making so much noise!

MsgJp:
登ってる時に限って襲って
きやがるしよぉ！
MsgEn:
They attack me only when I'm climbing
!

MsgJp:
たまーに渓谷で、でかい魔物を見かけるんだよな
さすがに避けて通るが、ぶっ倒したら
見返りもでかそうだよな
MsgEn:
Sometimes in the canyon, I see a big demon.
I avoid it, as I should, but if I knock it down,
the payback seems to be huge too.

MsgJp: とはいえ、命あっての物種っつーしな
MsgEn: However, life is what we make of it.

MsgJp: おう！　何か用か
MsgEn: Oh!　What do you want?

MsgJp:
《ドリード監視塔》は知ってっか？
何十年か前、白騎団の駐屯所だったらしいが
完全な廃墟だぜ
MsgEn:
Do you know about the Dreed Watchtower? It seems
like it used to be the barracks of the White
Knights several decades ago, but now it's just a
complete ruin.

MsgJp:
ま、それなりに使えるものは残ってそう
だけどな
あの野郎――いや、ギャーギャー喚く
鳥女どもが邪魔しやがるが！
MsgEn:
Well, it looks like there's still some usable
stuff left
but that bastard - no, the gawking
bird women are getting in the way!

MsgJp:
魔物の警戒は白騎団が常に行っている
覚者隊に応援を要請する必要はない
MsgEn:
