The White Knights are always on the lookout for
demons.
There is no need to request support from the
Arisen Corps.

MsgJp: 今の所はな
MsgEn: For now.

MsgJp:
北のバートランド平原は、オーク共の根城に近い
このダウ渓谷にも斥候が入り込むかもしれん
MsgEn:
The Bertrand Plains to the north are close to the
orcs' stronghold
Scouts may enter this dhow valley as well.

MsgJp: お前達も気をつけろ
MsgEn: You guys watch yourselves.

MsgJp:
ドリード城は、元は白騎団の本丸だったと聞く
白竜様がお元気で、レスタニアが今よりも
開かれていた時代のことだ
MsgEn:
I hear that Dorid Castle used to be the main
castle of the White Knights
when the White Dragon Lord was in good health and
Lestania was more
open than it is now.

MsgJp: 今や魔物の巣窟らしいがな
MsgEn: Now I hear it's a den of demons.

MsgJp: 特に問題はない
MsgEn: No particular problem.

MsgJp:
村近くの《白砂河原》には
サルファーリザードが多く棲みついている
お前が覚者なら、軽くまとめて退治しておいて
ほしいものだ
MsgEn:
The White Sand Riverbanks near the village is
home to many
Sulphur Lizards.
If you are an Arisen, I hope you can kill them
all in one piece.

MsgJp: 白竜様のご加護があらんことを
MsgEn:
May the blessings of The White Dragon
be with you, Arisen.

MsgJp: リムの輝きは常に貴方と共に
MsgEn: Even now, the Rift's glow shields you.

MsgJp:
メンバーの再編でしたら
私にお申し付けください
MsgEn:
For party member reassignments, 
I'd be honored to receive your orders.

MsgJp: 旅の同伴者をお求めでしょうか、覚者殿
MsgEn:
Are you looking for a traveling companion, Master
Arisen?

MsgJp:
この関所から北は《バートランド平原》だ
本関所はグリッテン砦の管理下にあるが
ダウのエリアマスター、ヘイデン殿が認めた者は
通してもよいと言われている
MsgEn:
North of this gateway is the Bertrand Plain.
This gateway is under the control of Fort
Gritten, but
Dow's Area Master, Lord Hayden, allows those who
have been approved
to pass.

MsgJp:
俺は鼻がいいほうでな
オークの臭いが強まればすぐ砦に連絡する
MsgEn:
I have a good nose.
If the smell of orcs intensifies, I'll call the
fort right away.

MsgJp:
俺は関所番であることに誇りを感じている
砦より薄くとも、ここは北の地に対する
守りの要なのだ
MsgEn:
I feel proud to be a barrier guard
even if thinner than a fortress, this is the
Portcrystal of
defense against the land of the north.

MsgJp: ああ、覚者隊の者か
MsgEn: Ah, the Arisen Corps.

MsgJp:
この関所の通行許可を得た隊士は
バートランド平原の任務も行うことに
なるだろう
MsgEn:
The troopers who are granted passage through this
barrier will also be
performing duties on the Bertrand Plain

MsgJp:
その際、《グリッテン砦》西側通路の
通行許可も同時に出されるのだ
覚えておくといい
MsgEn:
At that time, you will also be given permission
to pass through the west corridor of "Fort
Gritten"
at the same time.
Remember that

MsgJp:
ああ、覚者様！！
あなたのお力をお貸しいただきたい事が――！
MsgEn:
Oh, Arisen!
I have something I need your help with--!

MsgJp:
ジンゲンの上、崖を登ったダウで最も標高の
高い所に《歌姫の崖座》と呼ばれる場所が
あるのですが――
MsgEn:
Above Zingen, at the highest elevation
on the dhow up the cliffs, there is a place
called "The Cliff Seat of the Diva"

MsgJp:
例の魔鳥、《妖歌のローレライ》が
今度こそ本当に姿を現したのです！！
MsgEn:
The demon bird, "Lorelei the Spectator,"
has really shown itself this time!

MsgJp:
ジンゲンの民半数を攫い
相当数の覚者と騎士が命を落とし
ようやく撃退した、かの魔物が！
MsgEn:
Half of the people of Jingen were kidnapped,
a considerable number of Arisen and
knights lost their lives,
and the demon was finally repelled!

MsgJp:
覚者様にばかり頼ることはできませんが
もし可能であれば――どうか！
依頼を引き受けていただきたいのです
MsgEn:
I can't rely on the memorandum of understanding
all the time, but
if it is possible--please!
I would like you to accept my request.

MsgJp:
あなたさまがジンゲンに掛けて下さる
お心遣いの数々――
感謝してもしきれません
MsgEn:
I can't thank you enough for all the
kindnesses that you hang on Jingen--

MsgJp:
あなたこそまさに
白竜様が我々に遣わして下さった恵みです
MsgEn:
You are truly
the blessing that the White Dragon has sent to us!

MsgJp:
比べられるものではありませんが
我々にできる精一杯の礼を用意しました
ジンゲンの民は、あなたと共に
MsgEn:
It's nothing to compare.
We have prepared the best thank you we can.
The people of Jingen are with you.

MsgJp:
あなたさまが村に滞在されるようになって
民の表情も明るくなったかのようです
MsgEn:
Since you have been staying in our village
it seems as if the people's faces have brightened!

MsgJp:
どうか、これを――
そして今後もよろしくお願いいたします
MsgEn:
Please let this be--
and keep up the good work!

MsgJp:
村の依頼を引き受けて下さり
ありがとうございます
心ばかりですが、我々からの礼でございます
MsgEn:
Thank you
for accepting the Village's request
It's a small gesture of gratitude from us!

MsgJp:
いつも懇意にして下さるあなたさまに
何かできることはないかと思い
我々でこれを用意いたしました
MsgEn:
We thought it would be nice to do something for
you, our ever loyal friend
and we have prepared this for you.

MsgJp: いつでもあなたを歓迎いたします
MsgEn: We always welcome you.

MsgJp:
たびたびご足労をお掛けします
ねぎらいとなるか分かりませんが
これを用意いたしました
MsgEn:
Thank you for your frequent visits
I don't know if this is a compliment, but
I have prepared this for you.

MsgJp: どうかお受け取りください
MsgEn: Please accept it.

MsgJp:
谷道は厳しかったでしょう
つまらぬ物ですが、こちらは立ち寄って
いただいたお礼です
MsgEn:
Must have been tough on the valley roads.
Boring stuff, but here's a thank you for stopping
by and

MsgJp:
遠路はるばるようこそ
ダウ渓谷へはどのような？
MsgEn:
Welcome to the long way to
What is it like to visit the Dow Valley?

MsgJp:
美しい渓谷に針葉樹林
ドリード城の佇まい――
MsgEn:
Coniferous forests in a beautiful valley
The appearance of Dorid Castle--

MsgJp:
ダウ渓谷は美しい土地です
どうかジンゲンのため、あなたさまのお力を
お貸し下さい
MsgEn:
The Dow Valley is a beautiful place
Please help us help you
for the sake of Gingen!

MsgJp:
谷山の上には、チェスターという青年が
一人で暮らしています
MsgEn:
On top of the valley mountain, a young man named
Chester lives alone

MsgJp:
相当の変わり者ですが、軽業の技術で
右に出る者はいません
MsgEn:
Quite a strange one, but you'll find
no one more skilled in acrobatics!

MsgJp:
あなたが渓谷を愛する方であれば
あの者と気が合う事でしょう
MsgEn:
If you love canyons,
you two should get along well.

MsgJp:
滝の水音に薄い雲、豊かな緑
魔物の脅威さえなければ、ここは実に
穏やかな村なのですが
MsgEn:
The sound of waterfalls, sparse clouds, and lush
greenery.
Were it not for the threat of the monsters,
this would be a truly peaceful village.

MsgJp:
ようこそいらっしゃいました
お伝えすべきことがあるのです
MsgEn:
Welcome!
There is something I must tell you.

MsgJp:
このダウ渓谷に置かれた《辺境の礎》が
全てあなたさまのために解放されました
MsgEn:
The "Sub Portcrystals" placed in this Dowe Valley
have all been released for you!

MsgJp:
この辺りでのあなたさまの格別の働きを
神殿が評価しての配慮とのことです
MsgEn:
I'm told that this is a consideration in
recognition of your exceptional work in this area
by the Temple.

MsgJp:
どうぞ、これを機会に
この美しいダウ渓谷の自然を
すみずみまでご覧ください
MsgEn:
Please take this opportunity to visit
and
to see every detail of this beautiful Dow Valley
nature!

MsgJp:
ああ、覚者様！
どうかお力をお貸しください――
ジンゲンの村の危機なのです
MsgEn:
Oh, Ser Arisen!
Please help us--
It is a crisis in the village of Jingen!

MsgJp:
実は、少し前から外で遊んでいた子供が
行方不明になる事件が相次ぎました
MsgEn:
In fact, there has been a spate of missing
children
who have been playing outside for a little while
now!

MsgJp:
たまりかねた親たち、年かさの兄弟たち
さらには居合わせた旅の方までが
何人も連れ立って捜索へと旅立ったのですが
ついに一人も戻らず――
MsgEn:
Unable to bear it, the parents and older siblings
and even some travelers who were there
set off to search with a number of others, but
finally none of them returned...

MsgJp:
そして先日、カタコンベ近くで
何体もの石像が発見されました
生生しい、何かから逃げ惑うような姿勢のものが――
MsgEn:
Then, the other day, near Kataconve
Numerous stone statues were discovered
Lifelike figures, as if fleeing from something.

MsgJp:
あれは捜索に出た者たちが
石にされたものではないでしょうか――
この村に大きな脅威が迫っているのではと
気が気ではありません
MsgEn:
Could it be that those who went on the search
were turned into stone?
I can't help but feel that a great threat is
looming over this village
.

MsgJp:
覚者さま
あの辺りに危険な魔物が潜んでいないか
一度調査していただけないでしょうか
何卒ご一考のほどを――
MsgEn:
Dear Arisen,
Could you please investigate once to see if there
are any dangerous demons lurking in that area.
Please give it some thought--

MsgJp: 覚者様、実は――
MsgEn: Ser Arisen, actually--

MsgJp:
以前、ガーゴイルの群れを討伐してくださった
場所の近くに《見捨てられた井戸》が発見されました
MsgEn:
An "Abandoned Well" has been discovered near the
location where you previously took down a herd of
gargoyles!

MsgJp:
まるで中から逃げ出そうとしているような姿勢の
石像も一緒に見つかったのです
MsgEn:
They also found a
stone statue with it, in a posture as if it were
trying to escape from inside!

MsgJp:
もしかすると、あの辺りの石像はガーゴイルではなく
井戸の中にいる何か恐ろしい魔物から
逃げようとしていたのかも知れません
MsgEn:
Maybe the stone statues in that area were not
gargoyles
but were trying to escape
from some horrible demon in the well!

MsgJp:
この村の危機は
まだ去っていないのでは――
MsgEn:
The crisis in this village may not have
gone away yet--

MsgJp: 覚者様、度重なる依頼をお許しください――
MsgEn: Arisen, please forgive the repeated requests.

MsgJp:
実は、《見捨てられた井戸》に近づいた者が
井戸から人の声のような物音が

MsgEn:
As a matter of fact, someone who approached the
Abandoned Well
claimed to have heard what sounded like human
voices
coming from the well.

MsgJp:
もちろん魔物の声である可能性も大いにありますが
このままでは我々も諦めがつきません
どうか、井戸の奥を確かめてきては

MsgEn:
Of course, it could very well be the voice of a
demon.
We are not giving up at this point.
Please, go check the depths of the well.

MsgJp:
引き受けてくださるならば、

MsgEn:
If you accept, please contact us at
and we'll explain it to you in more detail.

MsgJp:
あなたこそまさに
白竜様が我々に遣わして下さった恵みです
MsgEn:
You are truly
the blessing that the White Dragon has sent to us!

MsgJp:
あなたさまからの数々お心遣いによって
この村は幾度となく救われております

MsgEn:
Your kindness has saved our village many times
and we can never thank you enough

MsgJp:
まだまだ至りませんが

ジンゲンの民は、これからもあなたさまと共に
MsgEn:
We're not quite there yet, but
will provide you with as many supplies as we can
gather at this time.
The people of Jingen will continue to be with you.

MsgEn: Have you already seen this area?

MsgJp:
ドリード城の城下として栄えたのは
はるか昔――
MsgEn:
It flourished as the seat of Dorid Castle
a long time ago--

MsgJp:
オークどもの台頭で今や住む者も

With the rise of the orcs, there are now very few
people who live in

MsgJp:
よって、このジンゲンとその周辺は

MsgEn:
Therefore, this Gingen and the surrounding area
is a district that should be
abandoned!

MsgJp:
しかしながら、突き放すような厳しさ――
そして険しさ故の美が入り混じる風景に心ひかれ
訪ね来る人々も少なくありません
MsgEn:
However, many people come to visit
because they are attracted by the landscape that
combines the harshness of the place -
- and the beauty of its ruggedness.

MsgJp:
そんな人々に便宜を提供することで
白竜様のお役に立とうと
我々はここに暮らし、精進しております
MsgEn:
We live here and devote ourselves
to helping the Lord White Dragon by
providing convenience to such people.

MsgJp:
わたくしはジンゲンの長――
ダウ渓谷のエリアマスター、ヘイデンと申します
どうぞお見知りおきを
MsgEn:
I am the head of Gingen--
I am Hayden, Area Master of the Dow Valley
Please get to know me.

MsgJp:
村の依頼を引き受けて下さり
ありがとうございます
MsgEn: Thank you for accepting the village's request.

MsgJp:
今後は、覚者様を物資面にて
支援させていただきます
MsgEn:
We will continue to support the Arisen with
supplies.

MsgJp:
――覚者様にお知らせすべき
ことがあるのです
MsgEn:
- There is something I should inform the esteemed
Arisen about.

MsgJp:
村から降りた川べり、《白砂河原》で
このところ、凶暴で大きなラージサルファーの
目撃が相次いでおりまして
MsgEn:
On the riverbank down from the village, the White
Sand River,
there have been a number of sightings of large,
ferocious large sulphurs
in recent days.

MsgJp:
《タイガーテール・サルファー》と呼び
警戒をしておりました
MsgEn: I was on guard against a "Sulfur Tiger-Tail".

MsgJp:
もし河原へ下りる時は、
十分注意なさることです
MsgEn:
If you go down to the riverbank,
be very careful!

MsgJp:
――地下墓地、《カタコンベ》
ドリード城近くにある地下墓地は旧時代
罪人を葬る場所であったと言われています
MsgEn:
It is said that the underground catacombs near
Dreed Castle were a burial place for sinners in
ancient times.

MsgJp:
白竜様のお力が弱まり
近年妙に瘴気が溜まりやすくなって

MsgEn:
The power of the White Dragon Master has weakened
and the strange miasma that has been accumulating
in recent years seems to have become--

MsgJp:
そこで、危険ではありますが
一度入り口を開放することにいたしました
MsgEn:
So we have decided to open the entrance once
although it is dangerous!

MsgJp:
もし、探索をされるのでしたらどうぞ
積極的に私から勧めはいたしませんが
MsgEn:
If you'd like to explore, please go to
I'm not going to actively encourage you to do so.

MsgJp:
ダウの西に、《ドリード監視塔》という
小塔があるのはご存知ですか
MsgEn:
Did you know that there is a
small tower west of Dow called the "Dorid
Watchtower"?

MsgJp:
一昔前までは、現役の騎士団詰め所でも
あった場所なのですが
今やスノーハーピーが縄張りとする危険地帯
MsgEn:
Not long ago, this was still
a functioning knights' garrison.
Now it's become dangerous
Snow Harpy territory."

MsgJp:
この調子で増えられれば
いずれジンゲンにも彼女らが飛来するのは
明白です
MsgEn:
With numbers growing like this,
they'll inevitably come
to Jingen - it's certain.

MsgJp:
どうか、群れの中核をなす
《スノーグーラー・ハーピー》を討伐して
くださいませんか
MsgEn:
Could you please eliminate
the 《Snow Glare Harpy》 that
forms the core of the flock?

MsgJp:
あなた様が村に滞在されるようになって
民の表情も明るくなった気がいたします
MsgEn:
Since you came to stay with us,
everyone in the village
seems much more cheerful.

MsgJp:
大した支援品ではありませんが
改善の努力をしますので
今後もよろしくお願いいたします
MsgEn:
It's not a great support item, but
we will try to improve it.
Thank you for your continued support!

MsgJp:
覚者様は、いまや相当にダウ渓谷を
よく知る方――
以前お話したとおり、ある人物を紹介
したいのです
MsgEn:
The Arisen now knows the Dowe Valley quite well--
As I told you before, I would like to introduce
someone to you.

その者の名はチェスター
神殿では伝えられていない職
《シーカー》の技術に長けた若者です

His name is Chester
a position not handed down in the Temple
a young man skilled in the art of the Seeker.

ダガ―を駆使する素早い身ごなしと
ロープを用いた跳躍術
MsgEn:
Quick gestures using daggers and
leaping techniques with ropes

その特性から、暗殺者や盗賊といった
ならず者が好む技術ではありますが
あなたであれば善く使うことができるはず
MsgEn:
Because of its characteristics, it is a technique
favored by
ruffians such as assassins and thieves, but
you can use it for good!

MsgJp:
《シーカー》としてさらに腕を磨かれる時が来れば
《渓谷の一軒家》に居る青年、チェスターを
お訪ねください
きっと彼が力となってくれるでしょう
MsgEn:
When the time comes for you to further hone your
skills as a Seeker, please visit Chester, the
young man in the "House in the Valley".
I'm sure he will be able to help you.

MsgJp:
覚者様についてはすでに話を通しておきました
住居の場所については、《スポット情報》で
確認されるとよいでしょう
MsgEn:
I've already talked to you about the Arisen.
You may want to check 《Spot Information》
for the location of the Arisen's residence.

MsgJp:
そろそろ切り出そうと思っていたことが
ありまして――
MsgEn: There's something I've been meaning to bring up--

MsgJp:
あなたは相当の実力をお持ちです
それは、このダウを守るためではなく
より多くの人々のため活かされるべき――
MsgEn:
You have considerable skills.
They should be put to use not only to protect
Dowe,
but for the good of as many as possible.

MsgJp:
グリッテン砦の北、オークが占領する
バートランドの調査にこそ、覚者様の力が
必要であると思うようになったのです
MsgEn:
I have come to believe that it is precisely to
investigate the orc-occupied
Betland, north of Fort Gritten, that we need the
help of the Arisen!

もちろん、これは私の手前勝手

オーク侵入の危険と引き換えですが
MsgEn:
Of course, this is my own selfish
I spoke to Nommel at the customs house and told
him to open a
path to Bertrand
in exchange for the risk of an orc invasion.

MsgJp:
《バートランド東関所》、そして
《グリッテン砦の西側通路》どちらからでも
バートランドへ行く事ができるでしょう
MsgEn:
From either the "Betland East Gate" or "The West
Passage of Fort Gritten",
you can get to Betland from either of them.

先に行かれるかどうかは、お任せします
どうぞよき判断を
MsgEn:
I'll leave it up to you to decide if you want to
go ahead.
Please make a good decision.

MsgJp:
――恐れ入りますが覚者様
あなたにぜひお願いしたいことがあるのです
MsgEn:
――I'm sorry, Ser Arisen, there's something I
would like to ask of you.

MsgJp:
渓谷にある大きな自然洞
《風鳴り洞窟》のことはご存知でしょうか？
MsgEn:
Have you heard about the large natural cave in
the canyon
《Wind Sounding Cave》?

MsgJp:
あそこはかつて、ある恐ろしい魔物の

MsgEn:
There, it was once the
lair of a terrifying
monster, in which many of Jingen's people fell
victim to.

撃退され姿を消していたのですが

MsgEn:
It was repulsed and disappeared, but
there are reports that the monster may have
returned
and if true, that would be a big deal!

MsgJp:
申し訳ありませんが覚者様
その真偽を確かめてはいただけないでしょうか
正式に依頼いたしますので――
MsgEn:
I apologize, Arisen
would you be able to confirm its authenticity?
We will make a formal request for it ――

MsgJp:
あなたさまがジンゲンに掛けて下さる
お心遣いの数々――
感謝してもしきれません
MsgEn:
I can't thank you enough for all the
kindnesses that you hang on Jingen--

MsgJp:
あなたこそまさに
白竜様が我々に遣わして下さった恵みです
MsgEn:
You are truly
the blessing that the White Dragon has sent to us!

MsgJp:
比べられるものではありませんが
我々にできる精一杯の礼を用意しました
ジンゲンの民は、これからもあなたと共に
MsgEn:
Although it cannot be compared
We have prepared our utmost gratitude that we can
offer
The people of Jingen will continue to stand with
you.

MsgJp:
おお、覚者様
《滅びの渦》の調査にいらしたのですか？
MsgEn:
Oh, Arisen-sama
, Did you come to investigate the 'Vortex of
Destruction'?

MsgJp:
数少ないジンゲンの民ですが
意外にも、あの空を恐れて
逃げだすものはおりませんでした
MsgEn:
Even though there are only a few Seekers left in
Jingen
, surprisingly, none of them were afraid of the
sky and fled

MsgJp:
元より、このジンゲンを離れられぬ
愛着のある者が残っていたのでしょう

From the beginning, it seems that there were some
who couldn't leave Jingen due to their attachment

諦めた方が良いのやもしれません

お救いくださるのではと
思わずにいられないのです
MsgEn:
It may be better to give up
but again I can't help but think that you
can save us

MsgJp: あなたさまこそ、竜が遣わされた恵み
MsgEn: You are the blessing sent by the dragon

MsgJp:
どのような結果になろうとも
あなたを信じるという選択を
後悔はいたしません
MsgEn:
Whatever the outcome,
I will not regret
my choice to believe in you!

MsgJp:
ボルドで採れたいい品が揃ってるよ
見てっておくれよ！
安くしとくからさ！
MsgEn:
We've got some good stuff from the Volden
Take a look!
I'll give you a discount!

ねぇねぇ、知ってるかい？
キノザ鉱泉には泉質が違う３つの温泉があるんだよ

MsgEn:
Hey, hey, did you know?
Kinoza Kosen has three hot springs with different
qualities.
Go ahead and take a bath, your skin will be
smooth and smooth!

《ボルド大坑道》ってのが、山の中腹にあるのさ

MsgEn:
There's a place called the Volden Large Tunnels,

It was closed down because giants were appearing,
but there are still many people who go there to
mine ores.

MsgJp:
いらっしゃい！
ボルドの名産品だよ！
MsgEn:
Welcome!
It's a Volden specialty!

MsgJp:
良い武器には良い鉱石が要る
当たり前のことだがな！
MsgEn:
Good weapons need good ore.
It's obvious!

MsgJp: 材料への妥協は出来への妥協だ
MsgEn:
Compromising on ingredients means compromising on
the outcome.

MsgJp:
お前が一流の戦士を目指すなら
武器も一流を目指せ
MsgEn:
If you aim to be a top-notch warrior,
aim for top-notch weapons.

MsgJp:
だが、肝心なのは身分相応ってやつだ
それを忘れるなよ
MsgEn:
But what's important is to know your place.
Don't forget that.

MsgJp:
命を賭けて武器を打ち、命を賭けた勇士が
それを振るう
MsgEn:
Putting your life at stake to wield your weapon,
you, the brave warrior.

MsgJp: ――フフ、これ以上のやり甲斐があろうか！
MsgEn:
Hahaha, can there be anything more worthwhile
than this!

MsgJp:
ああ、鍛冶の依頼か？
話を聞こう
MsgEn:
Oh, you're asking for a blacksmith?
Let's talk about it.

MsgJp:
覚者さん、キノザは白竜神殿ほどじゃ
ないにしろ賑やかだろ？
MsgEn:
Arisen, Kinoza is not as busy as the White Dragon
Temple, but it's still busy, right?

MsgJp:
そういうとこにゃ、商売のチャンスも
多いってことさ
MsgEn:
There are a lot of business opportunities
in that kind of place.

MsgJp:
鉱山へ行くにも森方面へ行くにも
なんせ道具は多い方がいい！
MsgEn:
Whether you are going to the mine or to the forest
the more tools you have, the better!

MsgJp:
切らしてるなら補充していきな
じゃんじゃん買ってってくれ
MsgEn:
If you're out, go to
and buy a bunch of stuff.

MsgJp:
大浴場のロイは、たまーに奇妙な品を

一体ありゃ、どっから手に入れてるんだろなぁ
MsgEn:
Roy from the big bathhouse sometimes gets some
strange
items

<VAL PRICE_INN>よ

温泉浸かってゆっくりしてさ

山掘りも冒険者も、うちは大歓迎よ！
MsgEn:
Soak in the hot springs, relax,
have a drink and have a good rest!
Mountain diggers and adventurers are welcome at
our place!

MsgJp:
自慢の料理も食べていってね！
キノザは料理にも温泉を使ってるんだから

MsgEn:
Please try their signature dishes too!
Kinoza uses hot springs in their cooking as well.
You need to get plenty of energy!

MsgJp:
大坑道へ行くなら十分気をつけてよ
鉱石目当ての人がよく行くって言っても
全員無事だったわけじゃないからね
MsgEn:
If you're going to the big tunnels, be very

<VAL PRICE_WEAK>よ

Ah, "Treat Weakness"? In that case, the price is

MsgEn: No

MsgEn:
Hmmm, but you're not "weakened"
I think you're just too tired.

MsgJp:
はーい、キノザ組合宿へようこそ！
ゆっくりしていってね
MsgEn:
Yes, welcome to the Kinoza Association Inn!
Please make yourself at home.

MsgJp:
あら、休んでく？　じゃあゆっくりしてってよ
宿代はタダよ、あなただけ特別なんだから！
その代わり冒険話を聞かせてね
MsgEn:
Oh, you want to take a break?　Then take your time.
The accommodation is free, you're the only one
who's special!
Tell us about your adventures in return!

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
この辺りって、毒沼やら油田やらいろいろあるでしょ
入っちゃって相当大変な目に合う人も多いのよ
MsgEn:
There are all kinds of poisonous swamps and oil
fields around here.
Many people get into a lot of trouble if they get
in.

MsgJp:
応急処置ができるよう
しっかりと準備してったほうがいいわよ
MsgEn:
You'd better make sure you're prepared for first
aid at

気を付けてても
魔物にぶっとばされて毒まみれ――

MsgEn:
Even if you're careful,
you can still get hit by demons and covered in
poison--

MsgJp:
いやぁ～～！！
それにしても大活躍ですなぁ！
MsgEn:
Oh no!
That's still a great success!

MsgJp:
覚者様様、お陰様でキノザも
穴ぐらの面々も大助かりですよ！
MsgEn:
Thanks to you, Arisen, Kinoza and the hole in the
ground have been a great help to us!

MsgJp:
お礼はしっかりさせてもらいますんで
今後ともよしなに！
MsgEn:
I will give you a proper
thanks, so please continue to be kind!

MsgJp:
私はロイ

I am Roy

and the
Borudo area master

Thank you very much for your continued favor to
the Arisen
!

MsgJp:
キノザに立ち寄った際は、

MsgEn:
When you stop by Kinoza,
please take the time to relax and rest your wings
in the hot springs and
please be the one to solve the problem!

MsgEn:
This area used to be a major mining region, but

白竜様がお元気な時分は、それはもう

MsgEn:
When the Lord White Dragon was in good health,

キノザの活気は巡り巡って必ずや

MsgEn:
Anyway, the vibrancy of Kinoza, the leading
recreational area of Restania
, will surely be a great help to
the White Dragon and the Temple
!

MsgJp:
レオ統率やイリスさん、ヴァネッサさんにも

MsgEn:
Please send my best wishes to Leo leadership,

But still, every time I go to
, you deal with this and that!

お手数お掛けしてる分、それなりに
応えなきゃあ、風呂番がすたるってもんです
MsgEn:
If we don't
respond in a reasonable manner to the trouble
you're taking, we'll all be disappointed.

MsgJp:
いやぁ、何かと手伝ってもらってすみませんね！
助かりますよ
MsgEn:
Well, I'm sorry for all the help you've been
giving me!
I appreciate it.

MsgJp:
支援品の方、融通させてもらいますんで
今後ともよしなに
MsgEn:
I'll be happy to provide you with any support
items you need.
I look forward to working with you in the future.

MsgJp:
いやぁ、何かと手伝ってもらってすみませんね！
助かりますよ
MsgEn:
Well, I'm sorry for all the help you've been
giving me!
I appreciate it.

MsgJp: やぁ、どうもどうも覚者さん！
MsgEn:
Hey there, good to see you,
Arisen!

MsgJp:
覚者さんが力を貸してくださったお陰ですかね
どうも鉱泉の資源が豊かになってきた
気がしますな！
MsgEn:
Thanks to the help of the Arisen, I feel that the
resources of the mineral springs are getting
richer.

MsgJp:
よければ羽休めも兼ねて、温泉で
ゆっくりしていってくださいよ
MsgEn:
If you'd like, you can also take a break from
your wings and relax at the hot springs

MsgJp:
そうそう！
こいつを持って行ってくださいよ！
覚者さんのため、特別に用意したんですから
MsgEn:
Oh yeah!
Take this guy with you, please!
I prepared it especially for you, Arisen!

MsgJp: どうです、結構な品でしょう？
MsgEn: What do you think?

MsgJp:
そうだ覚者さん
あなたにお話があるんですよ
MsgEn:
Yes, Arisen
I need to talk to you.

MsgJp:
ホボリック洞穴からダウ渓谷へ
つづく谷道のところに、《南壁のひび》って
洞窟があるのはご存知で？
MsgEn:
Hobolik Cave to Dow Valley
Did you know that there is a cave called "Cracks
in the South Face"
at the end of the valley road?

MsgJp:
そこは、中で鉱員が行方不明になるって
ことが続いて閉鎖された洞窟なんですが
私は良い鉱脈が伸びてるんじゃないかと
踏んでましてね――
MsgEn:
It's a cave that was closed after a series of
miners went missing in it.
I thought there might be a good vein of ore
growing there.

MsgJp:
何やら、洞窟内に光るものがあるとか
ないとかで――
MsgEn:
Something about shiny things in the cave or
not--

MsgJp:
どうです？
あなたなら行けるんじゃないですかね
探検にいっちゃみませんか
内緒で封鎖は解いておきますんで
MsgEn:
What do you think?
Maybe you can go
and explore
I'll break the blockade in secret.

MsgJp:
お待ちしておりましたよ！
ささ、これをどうぞ！
日頃の礼です、道中お役に立ててくださいよ
MsgEn:
We've been waiting for you!
Here, take this!
Thank you for all you've done for us. Please help
us along the way.

MsgJp: 覚者さん、いいニュースがあるんですよ！
MsgEn: Arisen, I have some good news!

MsgJp:
ダウ渓谷とボルド鉱山地区を繋ぐ谷道――
《南壁谷》を塞いでた土砂が、ようやく撤去できた
そうでして！
MsgEn:
The valley road connecting the Dow Valley and the
Boldo mining district--
The earth and sand that had been blocking the
"South Wall Valley" has finally been removed
And so it was!

MsgJp:
まぁ、《採掘師の隠れ道》を使えば通れはしますが
鉱員でもなければ
あんな危ない道は使いたくありませんからな
MsgEn:
Well, you can get through if you use the "miner's
hidden path"
but unless you're a miner
you don't want to use that dangerous path.

MsgJp:
ともあれ、これでダウ渓谷方面、ジンゲン村との
行き来ができるようになりますな
MsgEn:
Anyway, we now have access to Dowe Valley
and to the village of Jingen.

MsgJp:
それにしても、毎度毎度
あれこれ対処頂いて！
MsgEn:
But still, every time I go to
, you deal with this and that!

MsgJp:
お手数お掛けしてる分、それなりに
応えなきゃあ風呂番がすたるってもんです！
MsgEn:
If we don't
respond in a reasonable manner to the trouble
you're taking, we'll be stuck with the bathtub!

MsgJp:
またまた融通させてもらいますんで
今後ともよしなに
MsgEn:
I'll be happy to accommodate you again.
I look forward to working with you in the future.

MsgJp:
よろしければこれをどうぞ
今日は来場者に粗品をお渡ししてるんです
MsgEn:
If you'd like, here it is:
We're giving away some roughage to visitors today.

MsgJp:
今日は覚者さんに、またまた折り入って
相談があるんですよ――
MsgEn:
Today I have another folded
consultation with a memorandum of understanding--.

MsgJp:
実はね、白騎団のかたがたに
討伐要請を出していた厄介なオーガ
《坑道荒らし》ってのがいるんですが――
MsgEn:
As a matter of fact, there is a nasty ogre
that the White Knights have been asked to take down
, the Tunnel Troll...

MsgJp:
どうも騎士さん達の手には負えないようで
むしろ、騎士さん側の被害が増えてるって
状況なんですよ
MsgEn:
Apparently, the knights are out of control
and the damage to the knight's side is increasing

MsgJp:
キノザの西、ボルド小坑道近くの
《山腹の野戦場》で、件のオーガを
やっつけちゃくれませんかね
MsgEn:
Can you please kill the ogre
at the
"hillside field" near the Boldo small tunnels,
west of Kinoza?

MsgJp:
しかし、オーガも前はもっと山間に
いたってのに、どうしてふもとの方へばかり
降りて来るんでしょう――迷惑な話ですよ
MsgEn:
But why do they keep coming down to the foothills
when the ogre used to be more mountainous
- it's annoying!

MsgJp:
おお、今日は大きなお知らせが
ありますよ！
MsgEn: Oh, we have a big announcement today:

MsgJp:
このボルド鉱山一の大坑道、
《ボルド大坑道》の出入り口を塞いでいた
ガレキが撤去できたんです！
MsgEn:
We were able to remove the debris
that was blocking the entrance and exit of the
Boldo Tunnel,
the largest tunnel in the Boldo Mine!

MsgJp:
これでまた、採掘に再開発も
捗るってもんです！
MsgEn:
This will also allow for redevelopment
progress in mining!

MsgJp:
――とはいえ、元は巨人が現れた
衝撃であちこち崩落したって話です
サイクロプスやなんかが棲みついてる
可能性も――
MsgEn:
――However, it's said that originally there were
Giants who appeared and caused various collapses.
There is also a possibility that a Cyclops or
something similar is inhabiting there.

MsgJp:
そこで覚者さん、ボルドのために一肌
脱いで頂けませんかね
巨人がいないか、一通り奥まで様子を
見て来てもらいたいんですよ
MsgEn:
So, Arisen, could you please take off some skin
for Volden
and go to the back to see if there are any Titans
there.

MsgJp:
引き受けてくださるなら
あらためて私にお声掛けを！
MsgEn:
If you would like to take it on, please contact
me at
again!

MsgJp:
いやぁ～～！！
それにしても大活躍ですなぁ！
MsgEn:
Oh no!
That's still a great success!

MsgJp:
覚者さまさま、お陰様でキノザも
穴ぐらの面々も大助かりですよ！
MsgEn:
Thanks to you, Arisen, Kinoza and the
hole-in-the-wall guys have been a big help!

MsgJp:
お礼はしっかりさせてもらいますんで
今後ともよしなに！
MsgEn:
I will give you a proper
thanks, so please continue to be kind!

MsgJp:
ああ覚者さん、覚者さん！
またちょっとした問題がありましてね
MsgEn:
Oh, Arisen, Arisen!
We're having a little problem again.

MsgJp:
ムジナ団――だったかな？
ボルド鉱山のふもとに、盗賊たちが
住処にしてる坑道があるんですよ
MsgEn:
The Mujina group - I think it was?
There's a tunnel at the foot of the Boldo Mine
where the bandits
make their home.

MsgJp: その名もずばり、《盗賊の隠れ家》！
MsgEn: The name of the house is "Thieves' Hideout"!

MsgJp:
前に騎士さんが連中を追いたてた後に
表に出られないよう入り口を塞いで
鍵を預けてくれたんですけどね、
どうもそれが壊されたようで――
MsgEn:
After the knight chased them off before,
he blocked the entrance to prevent them from
getting out
and left me a key,
but apparently it was broken...

MsgJp:
我がもの顔で暴れてる奴らの隠れ家に
乗り込んで、一つ懲らしめてやってくださいよ
MsgEn:
Please go to
to the hideouts of those who are raging against
themselves and punish them one by one!

MsgJp:
ヤツら、金目の装身具をずいぶん
略奪してるみたいで、鉱泉の客足にも
響くってもんです
MsgEn:
They seem to be looting a lot of gold-grained
trinkets
, which will affect the number of visitors to the
mineral springs

MsgJp:
うーむ困ったことになったんですよ
覚者さん！
MsgEn: Ummm, I'm in trouble, Arisen!

MsgJp:
ボルド鉱山の頂きに、祠があるのはご存知で？
その祠――《山頂の小堂》付近が
グリフィンの巣になってましてね
MsgEn:
Did you know that there is a shrine at the top of
the Boldt Mine?
That shrine - near the small hall at the top of
the mountain
is a Griffin's nest.

MsgJp:
グリフィンがしばしばそこで羽休めをしてたん
ですが、特に厄介なグリフィンが
舞い戻ってきたんですよ！
MsgEn:
Griffins often rested their wings there
, but one particularly nasty griffin came back
!

MsgJp:
覚者さん、どうかそのグリフィンを
追い払っちゃくれませんかね？
また、詳しくは追って説明しますんで
MsgEn:
Arisen, can you please get rid of that griffin?
I'll explain the details later.

MsgJp:
当鉱泉はお客様の需要にあわせ
３つの浴場を用意してますよ
MsgEn:
We have three bathhouses at
to meet your needs!

MsgJp:
どうぞ、ごゆるりと
それぞれのお湯を楽しんでください！
入場キーは受付けのルーシーが販売しております
MsgEn:
Please relax and
enjoy each hot tub!
Admission keys are available for sale by Lucy at
the reception!

MsgJp:
私は一応この地域の顔役もやってましてね
組合宿のリビアンともども、自治と仕事の斡旋も
引き受けてるってわけです
MsgEn:
I'm also the face of the community
and the union inn, Livian, and I also take care
of the local government and job placement

MsgJp:
キノザとボルド鉱山のため、良かったら
一肌脱いで頂けませんかね、風呂だけに！
MsgEn:
For the sake of Kinoza and Volden Mine, if you
would like to
please give us a skinful, just for the bath!

MsgJp:
実は、ちょっと私は人外方面の方とも
付き合いがありましてね
MsgEn:
Actually, I have a bit of a relationship with
the non-human side of things, too.

MsgJp:
覚者さんだったら、ご存知じゃありませんか？
穴ぐらに住んでる連中と会ったら
よろしくお伝えください
MsgEn:
If you are an Arisen person, wouldn't you know?
If you see any of the guys living in the cave,
please send them my regards at

MsgJp:
おお、いらっしゃい！
キノザとボルドに関して
私に何かご用で？
MsgEn:
Oh, welcome!
Regarding Kinoza and Volden:
What can I do for you?

MsgJp:
おお、覚者さんにお伝えしたいことがあるんですよ！
《辺境の礎》ってやつがこのボルドでも
使えるようになりましてね
MsgEn:
Oh, I have something to tell you, Arisen!
Subcrystals are now available at here in Volden!

MsgJp:
何でも、行きづらかったところに
一瞬で到着する便利な代物だとか
MsgEn:
I hear it's a convenient way to get to places
you've been trying to get to
in an instant.

MsgJp:
キノザの管理者としては、ボルドにいらっしゃるなら
ぜひともこのキノザに寄って一風呂浴びていって
ほしいところですが――
MsgEn:
As the manager of Kinoza, if you're in Volden,
I'd love for you to stop by Kinoza and take a
bath.

MsgJp:
ま、任務の途中や帰りにも、疲れを癒すために
ぜひお湯に浸かっていってくださいよ！
いつでもお待ちしてますんで！
MsgEn:
Well, please visit
to soak in the hot water to relieve your fatigue
on your way to or from your mission!
We're always waiting for you!

MsgJp:
おお、覚者さんじゃないですか！
ちょうどよかった
一つ相談に乗っちゃくれませんか
MsgEn:
Oh, you are an Arisen, aren't you?
I was just in time.
Can you help me with one thing?

MsgJp:
いや、《ボルド大坑道》についてなんですけどね
せっかく再開発も軌道に乗り始めたところだってのに
最近妙な噂が立っちまって鉱員が集まらないんですよ
MsgEn:
No, I'm talking about the Boldt Tunnel.
The redevelopment is just getting back on track.
Lately there have been strange rumors and it's
hard to get miners.

MsgJp:
なんでも、骸骨騎士が坑内を歩いてる――とか
光るドクロがこっちを見てた――とか
気味が悪いでしょう
MsgEn:
Anything, a skeletal knight walking down the mine
shaft-- or
a glowing skull looking at me-- or
It must be creepy!

MsgJp:
多分何かの魔物がうろついてるんだと思うんですがね
覚者さん、そいつを退治してきてくれませんか
MsgEn:
I think there's probably some kind of demon
hanging around.
Arisen, can you go kill that guy?

MsgJp:
詳しくは追って説明しますんで
一度考えてみてください
このボルドの未来のためと思って、頼みます！
MsgEn:
I'll follow up with more details.
Please think about it once
I'm asking you to do this for the future of this
Volden!

MsgJp:
ところで覚者さん、《ボルド大坑道》の中にある
《灼熱の封鎖道》なんですが
ご興味があったりはしませんかね？
MsgEn:
By the way, Arisen, I was wondering if you might
be interested in
"Burning Blockade" in the "Great Volden Tunnel"?

MsgJp:
いえ、というのもですね！
ああいうところには良質な鉱脈が
埋まっていることが多いんですよ
MsgEn:
No, I mean, you know!
There are often good veins of ore
buried in places like that!

MsgJp:
特に私が目を付けているのは
この辺りだけで、それもごく少量しか採れない
貴重なボルディックダイヤってやつでしてね
MsgEn:
I'm particularly interested in
which is only found around here, and only in very
small quantities.
It's called a precious bordic diamond.

MsgJp: ――あるんじゃないか、と――！
MsgEn: ――Maybe, or maybe not――!

MsgJp:
あそこは地下のマグマの活性度によって
坑内の気温がやたら上がってしまうってことで
封鎖してたんですが
今なら何とか入れる状態なんですよ
MsgEn:
The mine was closed
because the activity of the magma underground
causes
the temperature in the mine to rise dramatically,
but
it is now in a state where we can manage to get
in.

MsgJp:
今回もこっそり封鎖を解いておきますんで
よかったら、一度中を調査してみてください！
絶対何かあると思うんですよね、あそこは――
MsgEn:
I'll be sneaking off the blockade again this time.
If you'd like, you can investigate inside once
more!
I'm sure there's something in there that--

MsgJp:
おや、ちょうどいいところに！
覚者さんにご相談したいことが
あったんですよ！
MsgEn:
Oh, just in time!
There was something I wanted to discuss with the
Arisen
!

MsgJp:
実は私も《灼熱の封鎖道》に入ってみたんですがね
ボルディックダイヤどころか
ジオゴーレムを見つけてしまいまして！
MsgEn:
I actually went into the "Burning Blockade"
and found not only a bordic diamond, but
a geo-golem!

MsgJp:
いやぁ、やっぱり封鎖されて長いと
ああいうのが棲みついてしまうんですねぇ
MsgEn:
Well, after all, if it's been blockaded for a
long time,
that kind of thing will inhabit it.

MsgJp:
なんとか討伐をお願いできないでしょうか？
詳しくはまた追ってご説明しますので！
MsgEn:
Can you please manage to take them down?
I will explain the details as soon as possible!

MsgJp:
いやぁ～～！！
覚者さんのご活躍には
我々ただもう舌を巻くばかり！
MsgEn:
Oh no!
We at
just can't get enough of your work!

MsgJp:
このキノザ鉱泉の管理者として、
そしてボルドのエリアマスターとして
ここはお礼を奮発しないとですな！
MsgEn:
As the manager of Kinoza Mineral Springs,
and as an Area Master of Voldic,
we need to spare no expense to show our gratitude
here!

MsgJp:
良いものを取り揃えておきますんで
今後とも、どうぞよしなに！
MsgEn:
We will prepare good things for you
so please continue to favor us in the future!

MsgJp:
いやぁ、温泉は最高だよ！
まさに命の湯、生き返るね！
MsgEn:
Oh, hot springs are the best!
It's truly the water of life, it revitalizes you!

MsgJp:
キノザに来たら、一回はほら
行きたいだろ！？　《豊穣の泉》！！
しかしアレだよ、料金がなぁ
MsgEn:
When you come to Kinoza, you know you want to go
to
at least once! You want to go to the Fountain of
Abundance at least once when you come to Kinoza!
But that's the thing, the price.

MsgJp:
ふー、湯の後は酒場で一杯！
お陰でここを離れられないよ
MsgEn:
Whew, after the hot water, I had a drink at the
bar!
Thanks to you, I'll never leave this place!

MsgJp: やあ、何かな？
MsgEn: Hello, do you need something?

MsgJp:
覚者がわざわざボルド地方まで任務か
まぁ、大かた温泉目当てだろう？
MsgEn:
So, the Arisen went all the way to the Volden
region on a mission.
Well, they went for the hot springs, didn't they?

MsgJp:
キノザは鉱石と武具の町でもある
白竜神殿や、我ら白騎団
それに覚者にとっても重要な拠点だ
MsgEn:
Kinoza is not only a town of minerals and
armaments, but also serves as a significant base
for the White Dragon Temple, our White Knights,
and is of importance to the Arisen ones as well.

MsgJp:
だからその、なんだ
お前ら覚者が見張りになってもいいと
思うんだがな
MsgEn:
So, you know, what the hell.
I'm sure you Arisen folks could be on the
lookout for

MsgJp:
ハインツ副団長にあったらよろしく伝えてくれ
あと、そろそろ配置変えはどうか、とな
MsgEn:
Please give my regards to Vice Commander Heinz
and also, how about changing the formation soon?

MsgJp: うん？　覚者か
MsgEn: Hmm? An Arisen?

MsgJp: ほら、向こうの山頂に祠が見えるでしょ？
MsgEn:
Look, can you see the shrine at the summit over
there?

MsgJp:
あの《山頂の小堂》は
以前は白竜様と、故人への祈りの場として
大事にされる場所だったそうです
MsgEn:
That "small hall at the top of the mountain"
used to be a place of prayer for the White Dragon
and the deceased

MsgJp:
今はちょくちょく魔物が出る上
でっかい鷲がすぐ傍に巣を作ったとかで
寄りつく人が居なくなったとか
MsgEn:
Nowadays, there are always demons and
a big eagle has built a nest right next to it, so
there's no one left to hang around.

MsgJp: どこも大変ですよねえ
MsgEn: Everywhere is tough, isn't it?

MsgJp:
キノザは人も多いし品も豊富です
商売するにはいい土地なんですが
商売仇が多いのが玉に傷ですねえ
MsgEn:
Kinoza has a lot of people and a lot of goods.
It's a good place to do business.
It's just that there are a lot of business people.

MsgJp:
あたしにとっては、準備と勉強の場って
とこでしょうか
MsgEn: For me, the place to prepare and study is at

MsgJp:
あたしゃ、近々素材を扱う行商を
始めようと思ってるんですよ
MsgEn:
I'm thinking of starting a materials peddling
business
in the near future!

MsgJp:
近くに素材を取りにいくにも
なかなかどうして魔物が厄介なんですよ
MsgEn:
It's not easy to gather materials nearby
because of those troublesome monsters.

MsgJp: いい坑道はあちこちにあるんですけどねえ
MsgEn: There are good mines everywhere, but...

MsgJp:
どうも覚者さん
あたしにご用で？
MsgEn:
Hi, Arisen.
You wanted to see me?

MsgJp:
ふー、遠出したいけど勇気がでなくて――
強い護衛を雇うしかないかなぁ
MsgEn:
Whew, I want to go away, but I'm not brave
enough--
I guess I'll just have to hire a strong escort.

MsgJp:
ゴツゴツした岩みたいな鬼やらトカゲやら
外にはうようよ居るっていうじゃないか
あわわわ
MsgEn:
There are rough-looking demons or lizards or
something like that,
and they say that there are a lot of them outside.
Ahh...

MsgJp:
よ、よしリンウッドまで行くぞ！
そ、そのうちに――
MsgEn:
Alright, let's go to Lynwood!
And, eventually--

MsgJp: や、やぁ、何か用？
MsgEn: Um, um, do you need something?

MsgJp:
そ、そういえばさ
キノザからちょっと山の麓へ下りて
北に行ったところに《ボルド小坑道》って
場所があるのは知ってるかい？
MsgEn:
Oh, by the way,
did you know that there is a place called "Volden
Narrow Tunnels"
north of Kinoza, a little down the foot of the
mountain?

MsgJp:
そこはかなり前から怖いオーガがうろつく
ようになったんたけど、派遣された騎士団が
かなりやられちゃったらしいんだ！
MsgEn:
There has been a scary ogre roaming
around there for quite a while now, but the
knights who were sent there
got hit pretty hard, I heard!

MsgJp:
戦いの跡がまだ残ってて、《山腹の野戦場》
なんて呼ばれているよ
ううう、おそろしい――！
MsgEn:
There are still battle scars and it's called
《Fieldsides of the Mountainside》
Ugh, horrifying--!

MsgJp:
ふう、貴重な宝石の原石を探しに
ここへ来たのだけれど、魔物が邪魔で
なかなか思うように探せないわ
MsgEn:
I came here
to look for precious gemstones, but the demons
are in the way
and I can't find them as easily as I'd like.

MsgJp:
ねぇあなた、《ボルド大坑道》へは行った？
閉鎖されてから、中はどうなっているのかしら
MsgEn:
Hey, have you been to the Volden Tunnel?
I wonder what's going on in there since it was
closed.

MsgJp:
巨人出現って、サイクロプスかコロッサス
でも出たのかしら
MsgEn:
Giants appeared, were there also Cyclops or
Colossus
?

MsgJp:
魔物の中には、宝石を身体に生やした
ステキな生き物もいるそうなの
MsgEn:
It seems that among the enemies there are also
creatures with gems growing on their bodies like

MsgJp:
まるで宝石そのもの、みたいな魔物も
いるらしいわ
MsgEn:
They say there are monsters that look just like
real gems.

MsgJp: なんとか生け捕りにできないかしら
MsgEn: I wonder if they can be captured alive somehow

MsgJp: その様子、あなたも探索者かしら？
MsgEn: Are you also an adventurer exploring this place?

MsgJp:
ここは《癒しの泉》です
ゆっくり旅のお疲れを癒してくださいね
MsgEn:
This is the "Spring of Healing"
Please relax and heal your fatigue from your
journey

MsgJp:
浴場では、ミックスハーブの蒸気も
炊いているんですよ
MsgEn:
In the bath, we are also steaming
mixed herbs

MsgJp: ごゆっくり
MsgEn: Enjoy your stay

MsgJp: 《癒しの泉》のお湯はいかがですか？
MsgEn:
How about the hot spring water at the "Spring of
Healing"?

MsgJp:
ふー、いいお湯！
のぼせないようにしないとねぇ
MsgEn:
Whew, nice hot water!
I'll have to try not to get bloated!

MsgJp:
あんた、異国の覚者なんだろ！？
あのタラスクの討伐してきてくれないかい？
MsgEn:
Are you an Arisen from a foreign land?!
Would you be willing to vanquish the Tarasque for
us?

MsgJp:
引き受けてくれるなら
タラスクの居場所を知ってる子に話を通すから
あたしに話しかけておくれ
MsgEn:
If you're willing to take on the task, I'll have
a conversation with the child who knows the
whereabouts of the Tarasque.
Please speak to me.

MsgJp:
ああ、よく来たね！
あんたがタラスクを退治してくれたおかげで
地鳴りも聞こえなくなったよ！
MsgEn:
Ah, you've come! Thanks to you for defeating the
Tarasque, we can no longer hear the rumbling of
the land!

MsgJp:
最近色んなことが起こるから
うちの戦士たちも疲れててさ――
あんたに助けてもらえて、本当に感謝してるよ
MsgEn:
Lately, so many things have been happening, and
my soldiers are tired... I really appreciate your
help.

MsgJp:
武勇の恩には報いるのが
このダナのならわしだよ！
支援品を格上げしておいたから
またいつでもダナに顔見せにきとくれ！
MsgEn:
It is our custom to repay the debt of bravery.
I have upgraded the support goods for you.
So please feel free to come and show your face in
Dana anytime!

MsgJp:
また困ったことが起きたよ――
こんなに問題が起きるなんて
一体フィンダムはどうしちまったのかね
MsgEn:
Another problem has occurred -
I never thought so many issues would arise.
What on earth happened to Phindym?

MsgJp:
実は、また地鳴りがするようになったんだ
あんたにタラスクを退治してもらったはずなのに
おかしいだろ？
MsgEn:
Actually, the ground is shaking again.
We asked you to defeat the Tarasque, didn't we?
Something's not right.

MsgJp:
あの地鳴り――タラスクのものじゃなかったのかねぇ
もうあたしらには見当もつかないよ
MsgEn:
That shaking ground... it wasn't caused by the
Tarasque, was it?
We have no idea anymore.

MsgJp:
――このファーラナ平原のはずれ
《<SPOT 904>》に、異文化を持った村があるんだ
そこの住人なら何かを知っているかも――
MsgEn:
At the outskirts of the Farana Plain, there's a
village known as <SPOT 904>, inhabited by people
of a different culture.
Those villagers might know something...

MsgJp:
でも、あそこの住人、どうもダナの人間が
嫌いみたいで交流が難しいんだよねぇ――
MsgEn:
But it seems like the people living there really
don't like the residents of Dana, so it's
difficult to interact with them.

MsgJp:
ねぇ、もしよかったらあんたが探りを
入れてきてくれないかい？
通りかかったらでいいからさ
MsgEn:
Hey, if you don't mind, could you do some probing
for me?
If you happen to pass by, that would be great.

MsgJp:
ああ――そういえば、あんた
《マヌンの集落》に顔出してくれたんだろ？
MsgEn:
Ah, by the way, didn't you show up in Manun
Village?

MsgJp:
あそこの長老のエナン――とか
いう人から手紙が届いたんだ
MsgEn:
I received a letter from the elder of that place,
Enan.

MsgJp:
なんでも
「信頼に値する相手だと証明してくれ」
「そのために《<SPOT 901>》
　の魔物を倒してくれ」ってことらしいよ
MsgEn:
It seems they want you to 'prove yourself as a
trustworthy ally.'
You can do that by 'defeating the monsters in
<SPOT 901>,' according to the villagers.

MsgJp:
要するに、武勇を見せろってことさ――
マヌンの住人たちって、もしかしたら
あたしらと似た文化を持ってるのかもね
MsgEn:
In short, they're telling us to show our bravery,
you know? The residents of Manun might actually
have a similar culture to ours.

MsgJp:
まぁ、とにかくそういうことなんだ
彼らに"信頼に値する相手"だって証明するため
魔物退治に行ってくれる気になったら
また声かけておくれよ
MsgEn:
Well, anyway, that's how it is.
In order to prove that we are "trustworthy
allies" to them, if you ever feel like going on a
monster extermination, please let us know again.

MsgJp:
そうそう、あんたが
《マヌンの集落》のエナン爺さんに
聞いてきてくれた《知恵の小塔》なんだけどさ
MsgEn:
Oh, that's right. You brought me info about the
Small Tower of Wisdom that you asked Enan from
Manun Village about, didn't you?

MsgJp:
なんでも、あそこに収められた昔の本に
今度こそ手がかりがあるかもっていうから
封鎖を解くことにしたんだ
MsgEn:
Because there might be a clue in the old books
stored there, we decided to lift the blockade this
time.

MsgJp:
今、手の空いてる子たちに
本を漁らせてるところさ
MsgEn:
Now, I'm letting the children who have free hands
search for books.

MsgJp:
古臭い本以外にも色々ありそうだから
あんたも入りたかったら入っていいよ
何か見つけたら、好きに持って帰りな
MsgEn:
Besides old-fashioned books, there seem to be
various other things here.
If you want to join, you're welcome to.
If you find something you like, feel free to take
it home.

MsgJp:
まぁ、わかってるとは思うけど
本の持ち出しは禁止させてもらうけどね
MsgEn:
Well, I think you understand, but I have to
prohibit taking books out.

MsgJp:
ああ！
何だってあんたはいつも
村が危ないって時に来てくれるんだろうね？
MsgEn:
Ah!
Why is it that you always come when the village
is in danger, I wonder?

MsgJp:
実は今、大変なのさ
タラスクみたいな巨大な動くものを
見たって報告があってね――
MsgEn:
Actually, right now things are tough.
There have been reports of a gigantic moving
creature, like a Tarasque.

MsgJp:
最悪、すぐにでも村ごと別の場所へ
移動しなけりゃ踏み潰されちまうかもしれない
そうなったら、あんたにも
手を貸してもらうかも――
MsgEn:
At worst, we may need to move the entire village
to a different location immediately, or else we
might be crushed.
If that happens, I may ask for your help as
well...

MsgJp:
とにかく今は情報を集めることで
手一杯なんだ
何か用があるなら、改めて話しかけてもらえるかい
MsgEn:
Right now, I'm really busy gathering information.
If you have something to discuss, could you
please talk to me again later?

MsgJp:
あんたのお陰で地鳴りも止んで
平和な生活が戻ってきたよ
ずいぶん世話になったね！
MsgEn:
Thanks to you, even the earthquakes have stopped,
and peace has returned to our lives.
We are truly grateful for all your help!

MsgJp:
まだまだ侵食魔はウロウロしちゃいるけど
ダナは戦士の村だ
そこら辺にいる侵食魔くらい、痛くもかゆくもないさ
MsgEn:
The corrupting monsters are still lurking around,
but Dana is a warrior's village.
The infected around here are nothing to be
worried about.

MsgJp:
侵食と地鳴り――
二つの厄介ごとを抱えてたこの村に
手を貸してくれてありがとう
MsgEn:
Corruption and Earthquakes -
Thank you for lending a hand to this village
burdened with two troubles.

MsgJp:
これほど力を貸してもらったんだ
エリアマスターとして
それからダナの族長ピサルの女房として
あんたには十分なお礼をしなきゃならない
MsgEn:
I've received so much help.
As an Area Master, and also as the wife of
Pisarr, the chief of Dana, I must express my
gratitude to you properly.

MsgJp:
とりあえず、あんたへの支給品に
より一層良いものを揃えるってことは
決まってるんだけど――
MsgEn:
For now, it has been decided to gather even
better supplies for you, but...

MsgJp:
それ以外に、どんなお礼をしようか
迷ってるところなんだよ
何せ、この恩を返せるようなお礼なんて
中々思い浮かばないもんだからさ！
MsgEn:
Apart from that, I'm at a loss as to what kind of
gratitude I should express.
After all, it's not easy to come up with a way to
repay this favor!

MsgJp:
まぁ、これからもダナには寄るんだろ？
勇敢な戦士として、いつでも迎えるからさ
お礼についても追々考えていくことにしようか――
MsgEn:
Well, I guess I'll continue relying on Dana from
now on, right?
As a brave soldier, I'll always be there to
welcome you.
Let's think about the expression of gratitude
little by little as well.

MsgJp:
あんた、覚者ってなら竜のために戦うんだろ？
エモノは一体何なんだい？
大剣？　それとも弓？
MsgEn:
Hey, if you're an Arisen, then you fight for the
dragons, right?
So what exactly are those?
Are they like greatswords or bows?

MsgJp:
もしもあんたがそこそこ槍を使えるようなら――
いつか、精霊槍の達人に紹介してやってもいいよ
レスタニアには精霊槍を扱う戦士は
いなさそうだからね
MsgEn:
If you're reasonably skilled with a spear, then
someday I could introduce you to a master of the
Spirit Lance.
There don't seem to be any soldiers in Lestania
who handle Spirit Lances, you see.

MsgJp:
戦士に休息の場を提供するのがわしの仕事だ
宿の手配から弱化回復まで、何でも言ってくれ
MsgEn:
It is my job to provide a place of rest for
warriors.
From arranging accommodations to weakening
recovery, tell me anything you need.

MsgJp:
勇猛な戦士にも休息は必要だ
必要な時に必要なだけ休まねばならん
MsgEn:
Even a brave warrior needs rest.
You must rest as much as necessary, when
necessary.

MsgJp:
寝床を使うなら<VAL PRICE_INN>貰うことになるが
いいか？
MsgEn:
If you use the bed, you will have to pay <VAL PRICE_INN>
 gold, but are you okay with that?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: OK

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: Cancel

MsgJp:
見ての通り、今は空いている
よし、好きな寝床を使うといい！
MsgEn:
As you can see, it is currently vacant.
Alright, you should use whichever sleeping spot
you like!

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: OK

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: Cancel

MsgJp:
戦って、一時の休息を楽しむ――
そしてまた戦いに出る！
どうだ、これこそ戦士として理想の生活だろう
MsgEn:
Fight, and enjoy a momentary rest--
And then, go forth to battle again!
How is it? This is surely the ideal life as a
Soldier, isn't it?

MsgJp:
《弱化の治療》なら
<VAL PRICE_WEAK>必要だが――
MsgEn:
If it's "Treat Weakness", it's <VAL PRICE_WEAK>.
What do you want to do?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: OK

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: Cancel

MsgJp:
ハッハッハ！
弱化にはなっていないようだ
弱気にはなっているようだがな
MsgEn:
Hahaha!
You don't seem to have weakened.
You seem to have become more timid, though.

MsgJp:
わしも今は引退してのんびりしているが
鍛練は怠っていないぞ
MsgEn:
I am also currently retired and enjoying a
leisurely life, but I have not neglected my
training.

MsgJp:
――まずは身の証を立ててから
来るべきじゃないのか？
MsgEn:
First, shouldn't we establish our credibility
before we come?

MsgJp:
身の証を立てる前に
休息を取りたいというなら
そりゃ、かまわんが――
MsgEn:
Before proving your innocence, if you wish to
take some rest,
Well then, it's fine...

MsgJp:
ハーイ、色々揃えてるわよ
どうぞ見て行ってね
MsgEn:
Yes, I have various things.
Please feel free to take a look!

MsgJp:
ピサルとラザネイル、素敵でしょ？
ああいう夫婦が理想なのよね
MsgEn:
Pisarr and Razanailt, aren't they wonderful?
That's the ideal kind of couple.

MsgJp:
たくさん覚者がいたら
一人一人が受けられる竜力が少なくならない？
何人もの覚者より、強い覚者が一人いた方が
安心できると思うんだけど
MsgEn:
If there were many Arisen, wouldn't the Dragon
Force that each one can receive be diminished?
I think it would be more reassuring to have one
strong Arisen than a number of Arisen.

MsgJp: あれ？　何も買っていかないの？
MsgEn: Huh? You're not buying anything?

MsgJp:
あ――もしかして、騒ぎになってた
異国の覚者さん？
MsgEn:
Oh, are you the Arisen from the foreign land that
caused all the commotion?

MsgJp:
――まずは身の証を立ててから
買い物しに来てくれるとうれしいわ
ちょっと信用できないもの
MsgEn:
--First, I would be happy if you could prove your
identity before shopping. I can't trust you that
easily.

MsgJp:
や、やぁ――
クレストのことかな？
MsgEn: Ah, um... Is it about Crests?

MsgJp:
クレストっていうのは、装備に付けられる
特殊な力の結晶らしいよ
僕は管理を任されてるだけなんだけど――
MsgEn:
Crests are apparently crystals that can be
attached to equipment, possessing special powers.
I'm just in charge of managing them...

MsgJp:
僕は子供の頃から線が細くて
戦いでも狩りでも中々手柄を上げられなくて――
MsgEn:
Since I was a child, I have always been frail,
unable to achieve any remarkable feats in battles
or hunts...

MsgJp:
なんて、よそから来た人には
この気持ち、わからないよな
MsgEn:
Oh, someone who comes from elsewhere would never
understand this feeling.

MsgJp:
戦いよりもこういうことの方が向いてるだろうって
ピサルからこの仕事を任されたんだ
自分でもそう思うよ
MsgEn:
I was entrusted with this job by Pisarr, who
believed that I was more suited for something like
this than for battle.
I think so too.

MsgJp:
――だけど、イーヴィの好みは
"誰よりも強い男"なんだよなぁ
MsgEn:
But Evey's preference is for a 'man stronger than
anyone else,' you know.

MsgJp:
あの――
身の証を立ててから来てもらえないかな
こういうのって信用が大事だからさ
MsgEn:
You know, it would be great if you could come
after proving yourself.
Because trust is important in situations like
this.

MsgJp:
戦いに行くの？
パーティの編成なら私がお手伝いするわ！
MsgEn:
Are you going to the battle?
If you need help with party formation, I can
assist you!

MsgJp:
力強く、信頼できる仲間と集まることで
一人ひとりの戦士の働きもよくなるはずよ！
MsgEn:
By gathering together strong and reliable
comrades, the efforts of each individual soldier
should also improve!

MsgJp:
ポーンを呼ぶこともできるけど――
どうする？
MsgEn:
You can also call for Pawns.
What will you do?

MsgJp:
変わった衣装――
それがあなたたちの力を引き出す衣なのね
ううん、見慣れないだけで――素敵よ
MsgEn:
Unusual costumes...
Those clothes bring out your power, don't they?
No, it's just because they're unfamiliar...
They're wonderful.

MsgJp:
あっ――
えっと、異国の方――
身の証を立ててもいない怪しい人と喋ってたら
族長に怒られちゃうから――
MsgEn:
Ah—
Um, traveler from a foreign land—
Talking to a suspicious person like me, who
hasn't even proven their identity might anger the
clan chief—

MsgJp: ――何だ
MsgEn: ...What is it?

MsgJp:
この村を纏めているのは
壮健で誇り高き族長、ピサルだ
MsgEn:
The one who leads this village is the robust and
proud chieftain, Pisarr.

MsgJp: 異国の覚者、か――
MsgEn: The Arisen from a foreign land, eh――

MsgJp:
ほう、なるほど
中々鋭い目をしている
MsgEn: Oh, I see. You have quite sharp eyes.

MsgJp: まずは身の証を立てるんだな
MsgEn: First, prove yourself.

MsgJp: おっ、何か用かよ？
MsgEn: Oh, do you need something?

MsgJp:
武器の手入れはいつでも万全だ！
早いとこ戦いに出て手柄を立てたいぜ
MsgEn:
I always ensure that my weapons are in perfect
condition!
I can't wait to go into battle and earn some
credit!

MsgJp:
俺だってダナの戦士
狩りでもいい働きをしているはずだ！
MsgEn:
I, too, am a soldier of Dana.
I should be able to contribute to the hunt!

MsgJp:
族長が狩りに行く時にでも
同行させてもらえりゃ早いんだけどな――
中々アピールするタイミングが――
MsgEn:
If I could just accompany the chief when they go
hunting, we could expedite things, you know――
It's just difficult to find the right timing to
make my appeal――

MsgJp:
盾も剣も、毎日点検しては磨いてるんだぜ
もちろん鍛錬も欠かさねぇ！
MsgEn:
I inspect and polish my shield and sword every
day, and of course, I never neglect my training!

MsgJp:
てめぇ、まずは身の証を立ててからにしろよな
この村で怪しげなことしたら承知しねぇぞ
MsgEn:
First, prove yourself before you speak.
I won't tolerate any suspicious activities in
this village.

MsgJp: 私に用か？
MsgEn: You wanted to see me?

MsgJp:
村に外敵が侵入しないように
ここで見張っているのだ
MsgEn:
I'm here to watch over this place and to ensure
no enemies invade the village.

MsgJp:
ダナはフィンダムでも知られた勇猛な部族の村だが
子供や年寄り、戦いの苦手な者もいる
彼らを守ってこその部族だ
MsgEn:
Dana is a village known all over Phindym for its
brave and fierce tribe, but it also has children,
elders, and those who are not skilled in combat.
Protecting them is what makes our tribe strong.

MsgJp:
ずっと見張りをしていて疲れないのか、だと？
この程度どうということはない
MsgEn:
Do you mean that you never get tired from keeping
watch? It's nothing to be concerned about.

MsgJp:
私に構ってないで村に入ったらどうだ
大方、ピサルかラザネイルに会いに来たのだろう？
MsgEn:
Why don't you enter the village instead of
ignoring me?
Most likely, you've come to meet Pisarr or
Razanailt, haven't you?

MsgJp: すまないが、まずは身の証を立てるのが先だろう
MsgEn:
I'm sorry, but first you should prove your
identity.

MsgJp: はいはい、何の御用？
MsgEn: Yes, yes. What can I help you with?

MsgJp:
うちも育ち盛りの子が多いからね
山のように用意した食事が
あっという間に無くなるのは見てて気分いいもんさ
MsgEn:
We also have many children who are in their
growing years, you know.
It's satisfying to see the meals we prepared like
a mountain disappear in no time.

MsgJp:
アンタも覚者だったら戦いに出ること、あるんだろ？
この村でしっかり食べて、体を休めて
次の旅立ちに備えるんだよ
MsgEn:
If you are also an Arisen, there must be
something you fight for, right?
Eat well and rest your body in this village, and
prepare yourself for the next journey.

MsgJp:
ふぅ、洗濯物は済んだし
次は家畜の世話でもしに行こうかな
MsgEn:
Phew, the laundry is done.
Now, should I go take care of the livestock?

MsgJp:
あっ――
あんた、さっき表で騒いでた奴らの仲間だね？
MsgEn:
Ah... Are you one of the people who were causing
a ruckus outside earlier?

MsgJp:
本当に覚者だっていうんなら
さっさと身の証を立ててきちまいなよ
そしたらややこしいことも無くなるんだからさ
MsgEn:
If you really claim to be an Arisen, then quickly
prove yourself and settle it.
That way, there won't be any more complications.

MsgJp:
《武霊の庵》のそばにある物見台はサイコーなんだ！
フィンダム全体が見渡せるし
"芯なる樹"がすっごくキレイに見えるよ
MsgEn:
The observation deck next to the Spirit Arts Hut
is awesome!
You can oversee the entire Phindym, and the Core
Tree looks incredibly beautiful.

MsgJp: 何だよ？　ここはオレの場所だかんな！
MsgEn: What's going on? This is my spot, you know!

MsgJp:
ここからは村の中くらいなら見渡せるよ
でも、やっぱり村の外を眺めたいなぁ――
MsgEn:
From here, you can see around the middle of the
village.
But, I still want to gaze at the outside of the
village...

MsgJp:
村の入り口はワイニが守ってる
万が一魔物が村に入ってきたって
ダナは戦士の村だからへっちゃらだ！
MsgEn:
The village entrance is guarded by Wine.
Even if monsters somehow get into the village,
it's no big deal because Dana is a warrior's
village!

MsgJp:
一人前の戦士になったら
ワイニみたいに武器を持って村を守りたいんだ
MsgEn:
Once I become a skilled warrior, I want to
protect the village like Wine does, wielding a
weapon.

MsgJp: ――怪しい人とはあんまり喋っちゃダメなんだ
MsgEn:
- You shouldn't talk too much with suspicious
people.

MsgJp: なによ
MsgEn: What is it?

MsgJp:
これからは腕力だけじゃやってけないわ
知識よ、あらゆる状況に対応できる知識が必要なの！
みんなわかってないの！
MsgEn:
From now on, it won't be enough to rely on arm
strength alone.
Knowledge, I need knowledge that can adapt to any
situation!
Everyone just doesn't understand!

MsgJp:
属性がどうとか弱点がなんだとか
そういう知識だけじゃなくて！
もっと幅広い知識を身に付けたいの――
戦いの役に立つはずよ
MsgEn:
It's not just about knowing attributes and
weaknesses.
I want to acquire a broader range of knowledge.
It should be useful in battle.

MsgJp:
暇なの？
ボーッとしてないで、知識を蓄えるなり
身体を鍛えるなりした方がいいんじゃない？
MsgEn:
Are you free?
Instead of spacing out, it would be better to
accumulate knowledge or train your body, wouldn't
it?

MsgJp:
なんなの、怪しい人ね！
信用してほしいんなら、さっさと身の証を
立ててこればいいじゃない！
MsgEn:
What's the matter? You're such a suspicious
person!
If you want me to trust you, then quickly provide
some proof and establish it!

MsgJp: どうした？
MsgEn: Hm, what is it?

MsgJp:
何か面白い話は無いか、だと？
昔話でもすると思ったか
ヌムム――年寄り扱いしおって
MsgEn:
Do you want to hear an interesting story or
something?
Did you think I was going to tell you an old
tale?
Gah, treating me like an old man.

MsgJp:
昔話を聞いて喜ぶ暇があれば
将来のために何ができるかを考えるんだな
MsgEn:
If you have time to rejoice in listening to old
tales, then ponder what you can do for the future.

MsgJp:
ダナの村は戦士の村だ
強くあるからこそ、護るべきものを
支えることができるのだ
MsgEn:
Dana's village is a village of Soldiers.
It is because they are strong that they can
protect what needs to be protected and support it.

MsgJp:
確かに――
俺も、そこのオドランも
すでに戦士としての役からは降りておる――
MsgEn:
Indeed, I and Odran over there have already
retired from our roles as soldiers.

MsgJp:
だが！
だからといって日々の研鑽を怠ることはない
若者に道を譲っただけのこと
MsgEn:
However! I will never neglect my daily training
and pursuit of knowledge.
It's just a matter of giving way to the younger
generation.

MsgJp:
お前は今、別のミッションを進行している
ようだな――
MsgEn:
It seems that you are currently engaged in
another Mission, Ser.

MsgJp:
そのミッションの参加を取りやめてから
あらためてここに来るんだな
MsgEn:
After canceling your participation in that
mission, you have come here again.

MsgJp:
自分の今の状況を把握することは
戦う者にとって常に重要なことだ
MsgEn:
Understanding one's current situation is always
important for a warrior.

MsgJp:
覚者だと言う割に
身の証も立てられんのか？
そんなことでは信用できんな
MsgEn:
Even though you claim to be an Arisen, can you
not provide any proof of your abilities?
I can't trust someone who can't even do that.

MsgJp:
アンタ――他のミッションを
受けている最中じゃないか
MsgEn:
Are you――in the middle of receiving another
mission?

MsgJp:
そちらを先に片づけるか、エントリーを
中止してからまた来るんだね
MsgEn:
Shall we tidy up that area first, or should we
cancel the entry and come back later?

MsgJp: さ、用件は何？
MsgEn: So, what's the subject?

MsgJp:
――ふぅん
なかなか鍛えてるね
MsgEn: Oh, I see. You're quite well trained.

MsgJp:
大物を狩りに行くなら
レウェラに声をかけて
仲間を集めた方がいいよ
MsgEn:
If you're going to hunt a big game, it's better
to ask Revela for help and gather your comrades.

MsgJp:
覚者が何人も居るってことは
ポーンもいっぱいいるんだろうね
アンタのところの大陸には
MsgEn:
There must be many Arisen, which means there are
probably plenty of Pawns too in your continent.

MsgJp:
いざという時の戦力に
余裕がありそうで羨ましいよ
MsgEn:
It's enviable to have such a surplus of strength
when the time comes.

MsgJp: 身の証を立ててから出直してくるんだね
MsgEn: Come back after proving your worth.

MsgJp:
旅人がこの村を訪れた時は
親身にもてなそうというのが
族長と族長補佐の方針なんです
MsgEn:
When a traveler visits this village, it is the
policy of the Chief and the Chief's assistant to
warmly welcome them.

MsgJp:
この村の族長はガラダ
族長補佐がモードレッドです
もし責任者と話したい、ということでしたら
彼らのところへどうぞ
MsgEn:
The chief of this village is Gearóid.
The chief assistant is Mordred.
If you wish to speak with the leaders, please go
to their place.

MsgJp:
あ、でもエリアマスターの役目は
アルトフェイルが任されているんです！
エリアの情報なら彼に聞いてみてくださいね
MsgEn:
Ah, but the role of the Area Master is entrusted
to Arthfael!
If you're looking for information about the area,
please ask him.

MsgJp: おや、何か？
MsgEn: Oh, something wrong?

MsgJp:
わたしのことか？
――今は族長補佐をしているが
何事も無ければ、精霊竜の守番長を
務める予定だったのだ
MsgEn:
Is it about me?
- Currently, I am serving as the assistant to the
clan chief.
If nothing goes wrong, I was supposed to be the
head guardian of the Spirit Dragon.

MsgJp:
守番長として務め始めれば
しばらく村には帰って来られない
村にいる間は精一杯族長補佐として働くつもりだ
MsgEn:
If I am to serve as the Chief Guardian, I won't
be able to return to the village for a while.
While I'm here in the village, I intend to work
my hardest as the Deputy Chief.

MsgJp:
これでなかなか忙しいもので
家でゆっくり休む間も無い――
とはいえ、うちの息子が
しっかりした子で助かっている
MsgEn:
With all this, it's quite busy indeed. I have no
time to rest at home.
However, I'm grateful that my son is a reliable
child.

MsgJp:
《芯なる樹》はフィンダムに
暮らす者にとって崇敬の対象であり
同時に、心の拠り所となる景色の一部ともいえる
MsgEn:
The Core Tree is not only revered by those who
live in Phindym, but also considered a part of the
scenic landscape that serves as a sanctuary for
the heart.

MsgJp:
雄大な《芯なる樹》を眺められる場所は
フィンダムのあちこちにある
自分の気に入る場所を探してみるのも
悪くないだろう
MsgEn:
There are various places in Phindym where you can
admire the majestic Core Tree.
It wouldn't hurt to try and find a place that you
like.

MsgJp:
わたしはモルフォール村のモードレッド
ガラダの留守を預かっている
MsgEn:
I am Mordred, from the village of Morfaul,
currently looking after Gearóid's place while he's
away.

MsgJp:
セシリーの恩人はガラダの恩人
そしてわたしの恩人でもある
何もないところだが、くつろいでくれ
MsgEn:
Cecily's benefactor is Gearóid's benefactor, and
also my benefactor.
There isn't much here, but please make yourself
comfortable.

MsgJp:
ガラダが一刻も早く回復するように
客人たちも祈ってくれ
MsgEn:
Please pray for Gearóid's swift recovery, so that
he may heal as soon as possible.

MsgJp:
祈りなど我々の習慣にはなかったが
やってみると、心に刺さったトゲが
抜けていくのがわかるのだ
MsgEn:
Praying was not part of our customs, but when we
tried it, we could feel the thorns being pulled
out of our hearts.

MsgJp:
フィンダムの大地を汚してしまったこと――
おまえたちと出会えたこと――
どちらもわたしは等しく受け入れいている
MsgEn:
I have tarnished the land of Phindym, and yet, I
accept both that and the fact that I have
encountered all of you.

MsgJp:
それがいかんのだろうなあ
善し悪しを区別し、悪しきは排除しなくては
世はいつまでたっても変わらない
MsgEn:
That's the way it goes, isn't it? Distinguishing
between right and wrong, and eliminating the
wicked is necessary. The world won't change unless
we do.

MsgJp:
フィンダムの危機におまえたちの世界と
交流を持てたことを幸運と呼ばずして
なんと呼べばいいのか――
MsgEn:
To have been able to establish a connection with
your world during the crisis in Phindym, what
should I call it if not lucky?

MsgJp: 邪悪な世界と繋がる可能性もあったのだからな
MsgEn:
There was even a possibility of being connected
to an evil world.

MsgJp:
フィンダムはもう大丈夫だ
これからは客人として
この美しい世界を楽しんでくれ
MsgEn:
Phindym is already fine.
From now on, as our esteemed guest, please enjoy
this beautiful world.

MsgJp:
我らの竜の目覚めはまだ先のようだが
大地や空気は徐々に清められている
MsgEn:
It seems that the awakening of our dragon is
still ahead, but the land and the air are
gradually being purified.

MsgJp: セシリーの息吹を感じるよ
MsgEn: I can feel Cecily's breath.

MsgJp: ふむ、何か必要なものでも？
MsgEn: Hmm, do you need something?

MsgJp:
フィンダムにあるものは
全て精霊竜様の恵みの賜物だ
何一つとて無駄にしてよいものは無いと心得よ
MsgEn:
Everything in Phindym is a gift from the Spirit
Dragon's blessing.
Remember that nothing is to be wasted, for
everything serves a purpose.

MsgJp: 何だ、用も無いのに話しかけたのか？
MsgEn: Why did you talk to me when you have no business?

MsgJp: ここに保管してある資材を数え直さねば――
MsgEn: I have to count the materials stored here again...

MsgJp:
必要なものがあるなら、遠慮せず言ってくれ
今この大陸に覚者はいない
我々にとっても、君だけが希望だ
MsgEn:
If you need anything, don't hesitate to tell me.
There are no Arisen on this continent right now.
You are our only hope.

MsgJp:
一つ聞きたい
――モルフォールはどんな様子だ？
MsgEn:
I have one question.
What is Morfaul like?

MsgJp:
何が起こるかはわからない
だが、何が起こってもいいように
資材の管理は万全にしておかねば
MsgEn:
We never know what will happen, but in order to
be prepared for anything, we must manage our
resources with utmost care.

MsgJp:
覚悟はしている
――家族への手紙も書いた
あの渦にすべてが飲み込まれようと
精霊竜様のお傍にいるつもりだ
MsgEn:
I am prepared
―― I have also written a letter to my family
Even if everything is swallowed by that vortex I
intend to stay by the side of the Spirit Dragon.

MsgJp:
異なる大陸からの客人よ
私でお力になれることでしょうか？
MsgEn:
Guest from a different continent,
how may I be of assistance to you?

MsgJp:
癒しを、救いを求めることは
決して悪いことではないはずです
MsgEn:
Seeking healing, seeking salvation, should never
be a bad thing.

MsgJp:
病にかかるは宿命です
しかし、病んだ"芯なる樹"は助けを求めている――
この現状に、我々はどう対処すればいいのでしょう
MsgEn:
It is fate to fall ill.
However, the ailing "Core Tree" is seeking help.
How should we deal with this situation?

MsgJp:
精霊竜の守番として
我々は全力を尽くす所存です――
MsgEn:
As guardians of the Spirit Dragon
We are determined to do our best —

MsgJp:
旅の方にはこの寝床を
<VAL PRICE_INN>にて貸し出しています
簡素な宿ですが――
休んでいかれますか？
MsgEn:
For travelers, we lend out this sleeping space at
<VAL PRICE_INN>.
It is a modest inn, but...
Would you like to rest here?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: OK

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: Cancel

MsgJp:
本日は旅の方のため、宿を解放しております
どうぞ疲れを癒していってください
MsgEn:
Today, we have opened the inn for travelers.
Please rest and heal your fatigue.

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: OK

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: Cancel

MsgJp:
《弱化の治療》には<VAL PRICE_WEAK>いただいています
時が経てば自然と治るものですが――
今すぐの回復をご希望でしょうか？
MsgEn:
I am receiving <VAL PRICE_WEAK> for "Treat
Weakness", yes?
While it usually heals naturally over time, would
you like immediate recovery?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: OK

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: Cancel

MsgJp:
おや、困りました――
弱化していないようですよ
気持ちがお疲れなのかもしれません
少しここでゆっくりしていかれては？
MsgEn:
Oh, dear, this is troublesome――
It seems that you are not weakened.
Perhaps you are feeling tired?
Why don't you take a rest here for a while?

MsgJp:
異なる大陸からの客人よ
――空の異変の件で
来てくださったのですか？
MsgEn:
Greetings, visitor from a different continent.
――Did you come here regarding the abnormality in
the sky?

MsgJp:
フィンダムの空に
あのような禍禍しいものが――
MsgEn:
In the sky of Phindym, such a calamitous presence
looms――

MsgJp:
何が起ころうと
我々は精霊竜の守番
ここを離れるわけにはまいりません
MsgEn:
No matter what may happen, We are the guardians
of the Spirit Dragon.
We cannot leave this place

MsgJp:
精霊竜セシリーの心も
常にあなたとともにあることでしょう
MsgEn:
Surely, the heart of the Spirit Dragon Cecily is
always with you.

MsgJp: はい――
MsgEn: Yes...

MsgJp:
この周辺の見張りには自分が出ています
他の２人よりも体力がありますから
MsgEn:
I am on watch duty in this area.
Because I have more stamina than the other two.

MsgJp:
"芯なる樹"から伸びる
各聖域の見回りも自分の仕事です
MsgEn:
It is also my job to patrol each sacred ground
that extends from the "Core Tree".

MsgJp:
――何かあれば一早く気付くことが
できる立場でしょう
MsgEn:
In a position where you can notice anything early
on, if something were to happen.

MsgJp:
精霊竜様のご様子を常に傍で見守る役割
それが"精霊竜の守番"です
誇りに思う者も多いのですよ
MsgEn:
The role of constantly watching over the Spirit
Dragon's condition, that's what it means to be a
"Spirit Dragon Guardian."
Many take pride in this role.

MsgJp:
険しい顔をされていますね
――この状況です、無理もありませんが
MsgEn:
You have a stern expression
――Given the situation, it's understandable

MsgJp:
お一人では危険です
共に進む仲間が必要であれば
自分が手配いたしましょう
MsgEn:
It is dangerous to go alone.
If you need companions to journey together, I
will make arrangements for you.

MsgJp:
マイアとドハティも
落ち着こうと努めているようです
彼らはまだ若い――
それぞれに葛藤があることでしょう
MsgEn:
Maia and Doherty also seem to be trying to calm
down.
They are still young - each surely has their own
struggles.

MsgJp:
あの禍禍しい渦については
あまり話したくありませんね
よく、わからないものですから
MsgEn:
Regarding that ominous whirlpool...
I don't really want to talk about it, because
it's something I don't understand well.

MsgJp:
キンガル峡谷を訪れし異国の覚者よ
このキアランが用件を聞こう
MsgEn:
Oh Arisen from a distant land who has visited the
Kingal Canyon.
Let Ciarán hear your purpose.

MsgJp:
神殿や遺跡に対し、畏怖の念を持つことは大切だ
そうやって伝統が守られ
また、伝統によって我らが守られてきたのだ
MsgEn:
It is important to have a sense of awe towards
temples and ruins. It is through this respect that
traditions are preserved, and it is through these
traditions that we have been protected.

MsgJp:
我らが変化を拒もうと
我らを取り巻く環境は常に変わってゆくのでは――
"侵食"という災厄に触れ
一層そう思うことが多くなった
MsgEn:
As we try to resist change the environment
surrounding us is constantly shifting.
I have come to think this even more after
experiencing the calamity known as "Corruption."

MsgJp:
若者の柔らかい感性が、環境の変化を
敏感に感じ取っているというのであれば
遅かれ早かれ、我らも
意識を改めねばならないのかもしれないと――
MsgEn:
If the sensitive sensibilities of the younger
generation can keenly perceive environmental
changes, then sooner or later, we may need to
reconsider our own awareness as well.

MsgJp:
むむ、話が長くなってしまった
これだからいつもメーヴに呆れられる
すまない
MsgEn:
Hmm, the conversation has become rather lengthy.
This is why Maeve always finds me exasperating.
I apologize.

MsgJp:
村の若者には
伝統を重んじるこの村の空気を
嫌う者もいるようだ
MsgEn:
It seems that some of the village's young people
dislike the atmosphere of this village, which
values tradition.

MsgJp:
族長として頭の痛い問題だ
彼らも成長すればきっと
わかってくれると信じたいが――
MsgEn:
As the clan chief, it's a headache-inducing
problem.
I want to believe that they will understand, once
they grow up.

MsgJp:
キンガルに来るのは初めてだったな
少しこの地について話しておこう
俺はエリアマスターのキアランという
MsgEn:
This was my first time coming to Kingal.
Let me tell you a little bit about this place.
I am Ciarán, one of the Area Masters.

MsgJp:
キンガル峡谷は多くの遺跡や神殿を残す
フィンダム文化の要所的地帯だ
MsgEn:
Kingal Canyon is a crucial region of the Phindym
culture, with many ruins and temples remaining.

MsgJp:
そのような地に住まう者として
我々グリンデュアの民は古来よりの伝承や
伝統の守り手としての側面を持っている
MsgEn:
As inhabitants of such a land, the people of
Glyndwr have long been keepers of ancient
traditions and guardians of our heritage.

MsgJp:
貴君もこの地に留まるのであれば――
キンガルの伝統に敬意を払うべきだ
そうすれば村人との衝突も無いだろう
MsgEn:
If you are going to stay in this land—
You should respect Kingal's traditions.
That way, there will be no conflict with the
villagers.

MsgJp:
他の村は侵食魔との戦いに
やっきになっているようだが
グリンデュアは――また別の問題に直面している
MsgEn:
While other villages are becoming obsessed with
the battle against the Corruption, Glyndwr is
facing another problem.

MsgJp:
遺跡を守ってきたグリンデュアならではの
問題というものがあるのだ――
MsgEn:
Glyndwr, who has protected the ruins, has its own
unique issues to deal with.

MsgJp:
――いや、異国から旅をしてきた者に
このようなこと話すべきではなかったかもしれん
忘れてくれ
MsgEn:
No, perhaps I should not have spoken of such
things to one who has traveled from a distant
land.
Please, forget about it.

MsgJp:
大方、このグリンデュアには少しの間
留まるだけのつもりなのだろう
――この辺りは質の良い鉱石が採れる
それらを拾って帰ることだ
MsgEn:
Most likely, I intend to stay in Glyndwr for a
little while.
This area has some high-quality ore to be mined,
so I plan to gather them and take them back.

MsgJp:
キンガル峡谷は地形の複雑さもあって
なかなか冒険がしづらいのではないか？
少しだが、これを足しにするといい
MsgEn:
Kingal Canyon's complex terrain can make it
challenging for adventurers, don't you think?
Adding a little something to it could be
beneficial.

MsgJp:
グリンデュアの大地――
いや、我々のために尽力してくれて感謝している
これは日々の礼のつもりだ
MsgEn:
The land of Glyndwr, or rather, I'm grateful for
your efforts on our behalf.
This is meant to be a daily expression of
gratitude.

MsgJp:
これを受け取ってくれ
お前のためにと、村の者たちから
自然と集まったものだ
旅に役立ててもらえれば我々も本望だ
MsgEn:
Please accept this.
It is gathered naturally from the villagers, for
your sake.
We would be grateful if you could make use of it
on your journey.

MsgJp:
異国の覚者か――
エリアマスターとして忠告しておこう
MsgEn:
A Foreign Arisen, huh? As an Area Master, let me
give you some advice.

MsgJp:
《<SPOT 945>》に新手の魔物が
出現したらしい
近くを通る時は警戒を怠らぬよう
気を引き締めることだ
MsgEn:
It seems that a new type of enemy has appeared
in《<SPOT 945>》.
When passing by nearby, be sure not to neglect
your vigilance and remain on high alert.

MsgJp:
《<SPOT 945>》についてはもちろん問題だが
最近はこのキンガル全域で
魔族が活性化してきている節もある――
MsgEn:
Regarding 《<SPOT 945>》, of course, there are
issues.
However, recently, there seems to be an
invigoration of Fiends throughout the entire
region of Kingal.

MsgJp:
あんたも命が惜しけりゃ慎重にいくことだ
俺からはそれくらいしか言うことは無いな
MsgEn:
If you value your life, you should proceed with
caution.
That's all I have to say.

MsgJp:
俺なんか、もう命くらいしか
無くして惜しいものも無いからよ
――こればっかりはな
MsgEn:
As for me, I don't really have anything left to
lose except my life – it's all I've got left.

MsgJp:
俺に何度も話しかけてどうするつもりだ？
懐に入り込んで、なけなしの金でも
毟り取るつもりか？
MsgEn:
What's the point of talking to me repeatedly?
Do you plan to get into my pocket and take even
the last bit of money I have?

MsgJp:
ふん、まぁ――
ここなら――
MsgEn:
Hmph, well...
If it's here...

MsgJp:
――もう、いつこの人生が終わるかって
これ以上何にも奪われたくないって
そんなことしか考えてなかったんだが
MsgEn:
I've been thinking only about when this life will
end, and how I don't want anything else to be
taken away from me.

MsgJp:
こうして取り戻せたものもあるし
もう少し、生きる努力をしてみても
いいのかもな
MsgEn:
There are things that can be regained like this,
so it might be worth trying a little harder to
live.
Yes.

MsgJp:
いや、でも俺は信じねえぞ
期待すると後が辛い
何が起こっても
「覚悟はできてた」って思いてぇんだ
MsgEn:
No, but I don't believe in it.
Expectations only lead to bitterness in the end.
No matter what happens, I want to think, "I was
prepared for this."

MsgJp:
昔のこと思い出しても
良いことねぇな
MsgEn:
Even when I remember the things from the past,
there's nothing good about it.

MsgJp:
――あ、はい
何でしょう
MsgEn:
- Ah, yes.
What is it?

MsgJp: 少し、疲れて――
MsgEn: A little tired...

MsgJp: 家族のことを想うと――
MsgEn: When I think about my family...

MsgJp: どうしようも、なかったんです――
MsgEn: There was nothing I could do...

MsgJp:
――ぐすっ
ああ、すみません
MsgEn:
- Sniff
Oh, I'm sorry.

MsgJp: 家族のことが頭をよぎって――
MsgEn: Thoughts of my family crossed my mind...

MsgJp:
――私も解放軍の一員なのですから
皆さんのために、何かするべきでしょうね
MsgEn:
――Since I'm also a member of the Liberation Army,
I should do something for everyone's sake.

MsgJp:
はぁ――
もう少しだけ、一人でいても良いでしょうか
MsgEn:
Sigh――
Is it alright if I stay alone for a little longer?

MsgJp:
ごめんなさい
話をするのが億劫で――
MsgEn:
I'm sorry.
It's too much of a hassle to talk...

MsgJp:
あ――
な、なんでしょう――
MsgEn:
Ah...
W-what is it...

MsgJp:
ここに匿ってもらえて、心底感謝しとります
もう、帰る家も無くなったものですから――
MsgEn:
I am deeply grateful for being able to hide here.
I no longer have a home to return to...

MsgJp:
家も、家畜も、今頃全部灰になっているでしょう
――大変な思いをして手に入れてきた財産でした
MsgEn:
The house, the livestock, they must all be turned
to ashes by now.
It was a fortune that we obtained after going
through great hardships.

MsgJp:
何よりも気がかりなのは
離ればなれになった妻のことでして――
ここに一緒にいられたら、それだけで
どんなに気が楽だったか
MsgEn:
The most worrisome thing is the separation from
my wife – it would have been so much more
reassuring if we could have been together here.

MsgJp: ――何か？
MsgEn: —What is it?

MsgJp:
ここにもきっとすぐにオークたちが来る――
こんな貧弱な拠点、一たまりも無いわ
MsgEn:
The orcs will surely come here soon... This weak
base is worth nothing.

MsgJp:
オークが攻めてきたら
こんなテントで寝起きしてる私たちなんて
真っ先に殺されるでしょうね
せめて小屋に入れてもらえないかしら――
MsgEn:
If the Orcs were to attack, we, who are sleeping
in such a tent, would surely be killed first,
wouldn't we?
I wonder if they could at least let us into a
cabin...

MsgJp:
もっとしっかりした拠点、どこかに無いかしら
良いところがあれば、そっちに移りたい――
MsgEn:
I wonder if there's a more solid base somewhere.
If there's a good place, I'd like to move there...

MsgJp: よう、元気してる？
MsgEn: Hey, are you doing well?

MsgJp:
休んでいくなら<VAL PRICE_INN>だ
見ての通り、ここって色んな店があるから
ちょっと騒がしいけど――耳栓も貸し出すからさ
それでもいいかい？
MsgEn:
If you want to rest, it's <VAL PRICE_INN>.
As you can see, there are various shops here, so
it might get noisy, but we can provide earplugs if
you'd like.

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: OK

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: Cancel

MsgJp:
ああ、休みたいのか
えーっと、ベッドは空いてるな――
サービスしとくぜ、好きに使ってってくれ
MsgEn:
Ah, do you want to take a break?
Um, the bed is available...
I'll provide the service, so use it however you
like.

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: OK

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: Cancel

MsgJp:
《弱化の治療》かい？
よしきた、気合入れて治療するよ
<VAL PRICE_WEAK>だけど、いいかな
MsgEn:
"Treat Weakness," huh?
Alright, I'll put my fighting spirit into the
treatment.
It's <VAL PRICE_WEAK>, but is that okay?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: OK

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: Cancel

MsgJp:
んー、弱化してないけどな
ほら、気持ちの問題じゃないか？
ちょっとそこら辺で好みの子に
声かけてこれば気も晴れるよ、きっと
MsgEn:
Well, you haven't weakened, you know. It's all
about the state of mind, isn't it?
Just try talking to someone you like around here,
and your spirits will lift for sure.

MsgJp:
どっかに可愛い子いたら教えてくれよ
こんな時だからこそ、楽しみが必要さ！
MsgEn:
If you find a cute girl somewhere, let me know.
Especially at times like this, we need something
to look forward to!

MsgJp:
ちょっと微笑んでくれる可愛い子が
いるってだけで毎日頑張れるってもんだろ？　
ホント、それだけでいいんだよな～
MsgEn:
Just having a cute girl who smiles at me makes me
able to do my best every day.
Really, that's all I need～

MsgJp:
まぁ、どんなに可愛い子がいても
俺のフィアンセには適わないだろうけど――
MsgEn:
Well, no matter how cute of a girl, she wouldn't
be suitable as my fiancee--

MsgJp:
嫌がってたけど、村に残してきたんだよな
だって、こんなとこに連れてくるのも危ないだろ
あいつからは少しの危険だって
遠ざけておきたかったんだ
MsgEn:
I know they didn't want to, but they left me
behind in the village.
Because it's dangerous to bring me to a place
like this, right?
I just wanted to keep a little distance from
them, even if it meant a small danger.

MsgJp:
いらっしゃいませ
幅広く取り揃えてますよ
MsgEn:
Welcome.
We have a wide variety of items.

MsgJp:
いや、恐ろしいことになりましたね――
ティネス砦を奪還できたのは嬉しいことですが
ここもまたいつ魔軍に攻め込まれるか
MsgEn:
No, it's become quite terrifying――
While it's good that we were able to retake Fort
Thines,
we never know when the Demon Army will attack
here again.

MsgJp:
まぁ、私には昔からやってる
商売くらいしかできませんから
やれることをやるだけです
MsgEn:
Well, since I've been doing business for as long
as I can remember, I can't do anything else but
that.
I'll just do what I can.

MsgJp:
先祖代々、商いをやってきとります
こうしてやれることをやることが
今私らに一番大切なことじゃないですかね
MsgEn:
Throughout generations, we have been engaged in
business.
Isn't it the most important thing for us now to
do what we can do?

MsgJp:
あら、覚者様
新しい武具がご入用でしょうか
MsgEn:
Oh, Ser Arisen.
Do you need new equipment?

MsgJp:
ティネス砦を取り戻せたのも
覚者様のお力あってのことと聞いております
ありがとうございます
MsgEn:
We've heard that Fort Thines was retaken, thanks
to the power of the Arisen. Thank you.

MsgJp:
今まで良いニュースなんて一つもありませんでした
覚者様が来てくださってから、何だか
希望が見えてきたような気がします
MsgEn:
Until now, there hasn't been a single piece of
good news.
But ever since the Arisen arrived, it feels like
we've glimpsed some hope.

MsgJp:
色々取り揃えております
どうぞ見ていってくださいね
MsgEn:
We have a variety of items available. Please take
a look.

MsgJp:
あっ、ハイ！
同行者をお探しでしょうか、覚者様
MsgEn:
Ah, yes! Are you looking for a companion, Ser
Arisen?

MsgJp: 同行者をお探しでしたら、僕がお役に立てますよ！
MsgEn:
If you're looking for a companion, I can be of
help!

MsgJp:
足の速さにはちょっと自信があるんです
人探しなんかも得意なんですよ
MsgEn:
I have a little confidence in my speed, you know.
I'm also good at searching for people.

MsgJp:
覚者様に話しかけていただけるなんて
この任務について良かったです！
MsgEn:
Arisen, please talk to me about the matter of
"Blood Orbs" whenever you need to exchange them.

MsgJp:
あ、覚者様じゃないですか
何のご用でしょうか
MsgEn:
Oh, it's the Arisen, isn't it? How may I assist
you?

MsgJp:
――ハァ
い、いえ、何でもありません！
申し訳ございません
MsgEn:
- *Sigh*
N-No, it's nothing! I apologize.

MsgJp:
ちょっと――最近眠れなくて
ハッ、も、申し訳ございません
覚者様にお話するようなことではありませんでした
MsgEn:
Just a moment... I've been having trouble
sleeping lately.
Uh, I'm sorry, that's not something to discuss
with someone like you, Arisen.

MsgJp:
い、今までずっと先輩と一緒だったんですが
任地が分かれてしまいまして――
オレ一人では、何とも――
MsgEn:
Well, I've always been with my senior until now,
but our assignments were separated.
I'm not sure if I can manage by myself.

MsgJp: ああ、覚者さまじゃないか！
MsgEn: Oh, it's the Arisen!

MsgJp:
ティネス砦は覚者さまのお陰で
奪還できたようなところだからね！
また奪われないように、こうして見張ってるよ
MsgEn:
Fort Thines was retaken thanks to your help,
Arisen! We're here to prevent it from being taken
again.

MsgJp:
リキャルドのヤツ、顔真っ青だろ
まぁ仕方ないよねぇ
戦に向いてないんだろうね、可哀想なもんだよ
MsgEn:
Ricardo looks pale, doesn't he? Well, it can't be
helped.
He's not cut out for battle, poor guy.

MsgJp:
もし敵が攻めてきたらさ、アタシがまず
ここで少しでも時間を稼いで――
その間にリキャルドに門を閉めるように
言ってあるんだ
MsgEn:
If the enemy attacks, I'll try to buy some time
here, and during that time, I've told Ricardo to
close the gate.

MsgJp:
ああ、覚者さん
どうかしたか？
MsgEn: Ah, Arisen, is there something you need?

MsgJp:
俺の調子？
まぁまぁだな
絶好調でも、特に悪いわけでもない
見たところ覚者さんもそうだろ
MsgEn:
How am I doing?
I'm doing okay.
I'm not in perfect condition, but I'm not
particularly bad either.
It seems like you're the same, Arisen.

MsgJp:
色々あったし、これからもあるだろうけど
悩んだところで仕方ないからな――
MsgEn:
There have been various things, and there will be
more in the future, but there's no use in worrying
about it ――

MsgJp:
覚者さんも色々あると思うけど
あんまり思い悩むより
割り切っていった方がいいぜ
MsgEn:
Arisen, I think there are various things that
even those who have awakened go through.
Instead of worrying too much, it's better to
accept and move on.

MsgJp:
ああ、覚者さまですか
いえ、避難してきた人たちが可哀想でね――
私に何かできれば良いのですが
MsgEn:
Ah, are you an Arisen, Ser?
No, it's just that the people who have taken
refuge here are so pitiful...
If there's anything I can do to help, please let
me know.

MsgJp:
家を焼け出され、財産を全て失い
家族すら亡くしてここに駆け込んでくる人が
いるんですよ――気の毒としか言いようがない
MsgEn:
They have lost their homes, all their
possessions, and even their families, and yet they
come running here... There's no other way to
describe it but unfortunate.

MsgJp:
どうにか避難してきた人たちの力に
なりたいんですが、この砦はまだまだ物資も
人手も不足していますからな
ままならないものです
MsgEn:
I want to be of help to the people who managed to
take shelter here, but this fort is still lacking
in supplies and manpower.
It's not in a good state.

MsgJp:
広場にいるミカエラなど
あの幼さで親も兄弟も亡くしているのですよ
家族の話をすると、目に涙をいっぱい溜めて――
MsgEn:
People like Michaela in the plaza, she lost her
parents and siblings at such a young age.
When she talks about her family, tears fill her
eyes...

MsgJp:
どうかなさいましたか、覚者様
こちらは特に問題ありませんが――
MsgEn:
What's wrong, Lord? We don't have any particular
problems here...

MsgJp:
魔軍に占領されていた間に
この砦もかなり傷んでしまいました
まだ完全に復旧していないところも
あるようですね
MsgEn:
While occupied by the Demon Army, this fortress
has also sustained considerable damage.
There are still parts that have not been
completely restored it seems.

MsgJp:
私も工事を手伝っていますが
この砦が完全にかつての姿に戻るまでは
時間がかかるでしょう――
MsgEn:
I'm also assisting with the construction, but it
will take time for this fortress to fully return
to its former glory.

MsgJp:
仮組の足場には手すりがありません
足を滑らせないよう気を付けてくださいね
いくら覚者様でも、この高さですから
MsgEn:
Be careful as there are no handrails on the
temporary scaffolding.
It's a long way down, even for the Arisen.

MsgJp:
はいはい、何でしょうか
自分でお役に立てることならお手伝いします
MsgEn:
Alright, alright, what can I help you with? If
there's anything I can assist with, I'll be happy
to.

MsgJp:
自分は家も家具も、丸ごと
全部焼かれちまいましたから
また一つ一つ揃えるところからですよ
MsgEn:
I lost everything in the fire – my house,
furniture, everything. I'll have to start
gathering things one by one.

MsgJp:
何の取り柄もないんでね、こうやって
兵士の皆さんの雑用でもやって
ちょっとずつ生きてく道を探っとかないとね
MsgEn:
I don't have any particular talents, so I'm
helping out with various odd jobs for the
soldiers, slowly finding a way to live.

MsgJp:
まだまだ故郷に帰れる状況じゃありませんけど
いつかまた、生まれ育った村に家を建てたいんです
それだけが自分の夢ですよ、ははは
MsgEn:
It's still not a situation where I can return to
my hometown.
But someday, I want to build a house in the
village where I was born and raised.
That's the only dream I have, hahaha.

MsgJp:
こんにちは、覚者さま
えっと、ミカエラです
MsgEn:
Hello, Ser Arisen.
Um, I'm Michaela.

MsgJp:
あのお歌を教えてくれたのが
王子さまだったなんて、知らなかったの
MsgEn:
I didn't know that the prince was the one who
taught me that song.

MsgJp:
王子さまはとっても優しかったよ
わたしが泣いてたから
ずっとそばにいてくれた
MsgEn:
The prince was very kind.
He stayed by my side the whole time I was crying.

MsgJp:
ほんとはね、今も、ひとりでさみしい――
でも、助けてもらったんだから
わたしも頑張ります
MsgEn:
Honestly, I still feel lonely now – but since
you've helped me, I'll do my best.

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
そんな体でここまで来られたなんて
それだけで上等ってものですよ
さぁ、《弱化の治療》は<VAL PRICE_WEAK>です
治療しますよね？
MsgEn:
Just the fact that you made it here in such a
state is impressive in itself.
Now, the cost for "Treat Weakness" is <VAL PRICE_WEAK>
.
Shall we proceed with the treatment?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
あらら、覚者様はきっと心が疲れてるんですよ
じゃなければ、《弱化》もしてないのに
治療してほしがるわけないもの
ちょっと眠っていかれたら？
MsgEn:
Oh my, I'm sure the Arisen must be weary.
Otherwise, you wouldn't be seeking treatment
without even being weakened.
Why not rest awhile?

MsgJp:
激戦の野営地でもありませんからね
この城内での体調不良は、大体眠れば
よくなるんです
MsgEn:
This is not a battlefield camp, so you don't have
to worry.
Most of the time, if you rest, your condition
will improve.

MsgJp:
私が一番気を付けたいのは、心の健康――
勝利の喜びで疲れや病気に
気付かなくなっちゃう人が時々いるのよねぇ
MsgEn:
What I'm most concerned about is mental
health—sometimes people get so caught up in the
joy of victory that they don't notice fatigue or
illness.

MsgJp:
今、一番気を付けたいのは、心の健康――
勝利の喜びで疲れや病気に
気付かなくなっちゃう人が時々いるのよねぇ
MsgEn:
The most important thing is mental health—
sometimes people get so caught up in the joy of
victory that they don't notice fatigue or illness.

MsgJp:
メルテムは放っておくと
すぐ傷だらけになるから困ってるんです
覚者様も、あまり無理はなさらないでくださいね
MsgEn:
I'm worried about Meltem because they tend to get
hurt easily if left alone.
Arisen, please try to avoid overexerting yourself
as well.

MsgJp:
おお、覚者さんじゃないか
それで、今日はどの武器が見たいんだ？
MsgEn:
Oh, it's the Arisen! So, which weapon would you
like to see today?

MsgJp:
ああ、ナヤジークさん綺麗だよな
いつかこの状況が落ち着いたら
また歌ってくれないかなぁ
MsgEn:
Ah, Nazik, she's so beautiful, isn't she? I
hope when things settle down, she'll sing for us
again.

MsgJp:
俺、昔っから歌姫ナヤジークの
大ファンだったんだよ
芝居も上手くってさぁ――
同じところに居られるのが信じられねぇ
MsgEn:
I've been a big fan of the songstress Nazik
since long ago. Her acting skills are also
amazing.
It's unbelievable that we can be in the same
place.

MsgJp:
国ん中はしっちゃかめっちゃかだけど
ツテの類はまだ、意外なことに生きてるんだよ
お陰でちょっと良い武器を仕入れられてるぜ
MsgEn:
Things are chaotic all over the country, but
surprisingly, my connections are still alive.
Thanks to that, I managed to get some pretty good
weapons.

MsgJp:
覚者様、こんにちは
何をいくつご用意しましょう？
MsgEn:
Greetings, Master Arisen. How many of each would
you like me to prepare?

MsgJp:
戦いに出ない人たちの取りまとめも
俺がやってるんですけど
なかなか言うことを聞いてくれなくて――
MsgEn:
I'm the one handling the organization of those
who don't participate in battles, but they're
quite stubborn and don't listen to me.

MsgJp:
武具屋のマルクスさんって
話しかけてもナヤジークさんのことしか
言わないんですよね――正に夢中ってやつです
MsgEn:
Mr. Marcus, the owner of the equipment shop, only
talks about Lady Nazik when you speak to him.
He's completely obsessed, isn't he?

MsgJp:
俺ももうちょっと上手くやれるようになると
いいんですけど、物資を管理するだけでも
精一杯ですよ
MsgEn:
I hope I can get better at this soon, but just
managing the supplies is already a handful for me.

MsgJp: はーい、何にする？
MsgEn: Alright, what do you need?

MsgJp:
これからまた戦いに出るのかい？
せっかくだから、その前に何か食べておいきよ！
MsgEn:
Are you going into battle again?
You might as well eat something before you go!

MsgJp:
お酒も肉もあるからさ
今日はパーッと食べていくのも
いいんじゃない？
MsgEn:
We have both alcohol and meat.
Wouldn't it be nice to have a hearty meal today?

MsgJp:
