Lord Gerhard.
Well, since you're not from this country, I'll
overlook a little rudeness.

MsgJp:
イェルハルド様はお忙しい
伝言なら俺がことづかろう
MsgEn:
Lord Gerhard is quite busy. If it's a message, I
can take care of it.

MsgJp:
怪しげであっても客人だ
イェルハルド様のためにも
貴方をもてなすよう皆に言っておいた
MsgEn:
Even if it's suspicious, you're a guest.
I've told everyone to treat you well for Lord
Gerhard's sake.

MsgJp:
や、調子どうだい？
戦技のことなら相談に乗るよ
MsgEn:
Hey, how are you doing? If you have any questions
about battle techniques, I'm here to help.

MsgJp:
いやー、いいねぇ
自分の望んだように戦えるっての
羨ましいよ
MsgEn:
Oh, I see. That's nice.
Being able to fight the way you want, I'm envious.

MsgJp:
アタシ？
アタシは今、療養中ってやつさ
体が良くなれば、また村の外に行くつもりだよ
MsgEn:
Me? I'm currently in recovery. Once my body gets
better, I plan to go outside the village again.

MsgJp:
覚者ってのは色んな技を覚えてるもんだね
戦技補佐のしがいがあるよ
MsgEn:
Arisen are skilled in various techniques, huh?
There's satisfaction in supporting their martial
arts.

MsgJp:
ようこそおいでくださいました
さぁ、ゆっくり休んでいってくださいね
MsgEn:
Welcome, please come in and rest. Take your time
to relax.

MsgJp:
ご宿泊は<VAL PRICE_INN>です
ロスギル名物、翡翠湖で採れた魚を使った
お粥もサービスしますよ！
きっと身も心も癒されるはずです
MsgEn:
Your accommodation is <VAL PRICE_INN>.
We'll also serve you some rice porridge made with
fish from the famous Emerald Lake in Rothgill.
It should surely heal your body and soul.

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: OK

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: Cancel

MsgJp:
ええ、どうぞこのロスギルで
長旅の疲れを癒してください
干し魚を使ったお粥、この辺りの名物なんです
こちらも、よかったら食べていってくださいね！
MsgEn:
Well, feel free to rest in Rothgill.
We have a local specialty, fish porridge made
from dried fish.
It's a famous dish around here. You're welcome to
try it if you'd like!

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: OK

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: Cancel

MsgJp:
《弱化の治療》ですね！
はい、もちろん承っていますとも
<VAL PRICE_WEAK>ですが、よろしいですか？
MsgEn:
It's "Treat Weakness", right?
Yes, of course, I can do that.
<VAL PRICE_WEAK>, is that okay?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: OK

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: Cancel

MsgJp:
あら、弱化していらっしゃいませんよ？
弱化していないものを治療しろとは――
謎かけみたいですね、フフフ
MsgEn:
Oh, you're not weakened, are you?
To treat something that isn't weakened...
It's like a riddle, isn't it? Hehehe.

MsgJp:
ロスギルの見どころ、ですか？
それはもちろん、翡翠湖です！
美しい滝もご覧いただけますよ
MsgEn:
What are the highlights of Rothgill? Of course,
it's Emerald Lake! You can also see beautiful
waterfalls.

MsgJp:
翡翠湖で採れる魚は
ロスギルの食生活を支えてくれています
煮てよし、焼いてよし、干してよし、なんです
MsgEn:
The fish caught in Emerald Lake supports
Rothgill's diet.
It can be boiled, grilled, or dried, offering
various culinary options.

MsgJp:
こうしてお仕事をし始めたのも
最近のことなんです
今はどこも大変ですからね
MsgEn:
I only began working like this recently. Things
are tough everywhere right now.

MsgJp:
いらっしゃいませ、覚者様
今日は何をお探しで？
MsgEn:
Welcome, Ser Arisen.
What are you looking for today?

MsgJp:
いや、戦のせいで縮小してしまいましたが
元はもっと大きな店を出してたんですよ
村の外に何店舗も店がありましてね
MsgEn:
No, it's because of the war that it has shrunk,
but we used to have a much bigger shop, you know.
Outside the village, there were several other
stores.

MsgJp:
イェルハルド様はご立派な方ですよ
あの方がいらっしゃらなかったら
この村も今頃オークの拠点になってるところです
MsgEn:
Lord Gerhard is a noble person.
If he wasn't here, this village would have become
an Orc stronghold by now.

MsgJp:
もしこのロスギルが危ない状態になっても――
私はここを離れないって決めてるんです
代々ここで商売してますんで
MsgEn:
Even if Rothgill were in a dangerous state, I
have made the decision not to leave this place. My
family has been running a business here for
generations.

MsgJp: 覚者様、旅の同行者をお探しでしょうか？
MsgEn: Arisen, are you looking for a travel companion?

MsgJp:
お知り合いへのご連絡、それから
ポーンの呼び出しなんかも
お手伝いいたしますよ
MsgEn:
I can help you with contacting acquaintances and
even calling your Pawn.

MsgJp:
こうしていられるのも、イェルハルド様が
しっかりロスギルを治めてくださるお陰ですな
MsgEn:
It is thanks to Lord Gerhard's firm rule over
Rothgill that we are able to stay like this.

MsgJp:
火にあたりながら
細々したものを作るのが好きでして――
何、つまらないものばかりなんですがね
MsgEn:
I enjoy making small things by the fire – nothing
special, though.

MsgJp:
覚者さま、《ブラッドオーブ》の交換であれば
わたしがご相談にのりましょう
MsgEn:
Arisen, if it's for exchanging "Blood Orbs," I'll
be the one to help you.

MsgJp:
こうしてお仕事をしていれば
少しは気もまぎれるというものです
MsgEn:
In this central area of the swamp, there are
harmful monsters gathering.

MsgJp:
エルセンさんは戦が始まる前から、この辺りで
手広く商いをしてらした方なんですよ
こうしてわたしにも、場所を貸してくださっています
MsgEn:
Elsen here has been involved in various
businesses around here even before the war
started.
And they've also lent me this place.

MsgJp:
覚者であれば、きっと色々と
達観していらっしゃるのでしょうね
わたしなどはあれこれ悩みが多くて――
MsgEn:
If you are an Arisen, you must surely have a more
enlightened perspective on things.
I, on the other hand, have many worries...

MsgJp:
おっ、覚者さんじゃないですか
何かご用で？
MsgEn:
Oh, it's the Arisen, isn't it? Do you have some
business with me?

MsgJp:
ロスギルはいいですね
この戦乱の最中にあって
食べる物にも住む場所にも困っていない
イェルハルド殿の見事な手腕によるものでしょう
MsgEn:
Rothgill is nice.
Even in the midst of this chaos, they have no
problems with food and shelter.
Thanks to Lord Gerhard's excellent management.

MsgJp:
そういえば、ロスギル名物の
魚と貝の粥はもう召し上がりましたか？
宿屋で出されるアレです
MsgEn:
By the way, have you tried Rothgill's famous fish
and shellfish porridge?
It's served at the inn.

MsgJp:
他でも食べられますが
やはりロスギルの魚を使っているだけあって
一味違いますよ！
MsgEn:
You can eat this elsewhere, but using Rothgill's
fish does make a difference!

MsgJp:
村から村へ手紙を届ける仕事をしてたんです
こんな状況ですから、みな遠くに住む親せきや
友人を心配して手紙を書くんです
MsgEn:
I used to work delivering letters from village to
village.
With this situation, everyone worries about their
relatives and friends who live far away and writes
letters to them.

MsgJp:
最近は――宛先として書かれている村が
無くなってることも多くなって――
少し疲れましてね
MsgEn:
Recently, many of the villages listed as
destinations are disappearing – it's tiring.

MsgJp:
私に何か用があるなんて
珍しいね？
MsgEn: Do you have business with me? That's unusual.

MsgJp:
ロスギルの人たちは外の状況を
分かっているのかしら？
あまりにものんびりしすぎてない？
MsgEn:
Do the people in Rothgill really understand the
conditions outside? Aren't they too relaxed?

MsgJp:
今はまだ修行中の身だけど
近いうちに、必ず戦士として身を立ててみせるわ
MsgEn:
Right now, I'm still in the midst of training,
but soon I will definitely prove myself as a
Soldier.

MsgJp:
いてもたってもいられないって
こういう気持ちのことを言うのね――
MsgEn:
I just couldn't sit around and do nothing. This
is what I mean by these feelings.

MsgJp:
あれ？　この村の人じゃない人だ
こんにちは
MsgEn: Huh? You're not from this village. Hello.

MsgJp:
うんうん、知ってるよ
戦争が始まったから、村の外に
出ちゃいけないんだよね
MsgEn:
Yeah, I know. We can't leave the village because
of the war.

MsgJp:
外は怖いことがいっぱいあるけど
ロスギルは大丈夫なんでしょ？
MsgEn:
There are many scary things outside, but is
Rothgill safe?

MsgJp:
あなたも外が怖いなら
ずっとロスギルにいてもいいよ！
MsgEn:
If you're also afraid of the outside, you're
welcome to stay in Rothgill!

MsgJp: ――なんだね
MsgEn: --What is it?

MsgJp:
――腹でも減ったのか？
そこにある魚をつまんでいってもいいぞ
焼いただけだが、味は保障する
MsgEn:
Are you hungry? You can have some of the fish
over there. They're just roasted, but the taste is
guaranteed.

MsgJp:
戦が始まる前からこうして釣りをしている
うちの親父も、そのまた親父も釣りをして
暮らしてたんだ
MsgEn:
I've been fishing like this even before the war
began. My father and his father also lived by
fishing.

MsgJp:
ロスギルの村人がまだ安定しているのは
魚が獲れさえすれば、少なくとも
食べ物には困らないからだ
――だからこうして釣りをしている
MsgEn:
The villagers in Rothgill are still stable
because as long as they can catch fish, they won't
have any shortage of food.
That's why they are fishing like this.

MsgJp:
あっ、はい
作業をしながらですみません――
MsgEn: Ah, yes. I apologize for working while speaking.

MsgJp:
こうやって魚を干すと
保存がきいて持ち運びも楽だし
旨みが増すんです
MsgEn:
Drying fish like this preserves them and makes
them easy to carry, and also enhances their
flavor.

MsgJp: はぁ、ぼくもずっと釣りをしてたいな――
MsgEn: Sigh, I wish I could fish all day...

MsgJp:
両親はぼくに
立派な騎士になってほしいそうなんです
――でも、ぼくは魚釣りが好きだな
MsgEn:
My parents want me to become a splendid knight,
but I really love fishing.

MsgJp: ん？　どうかした？
MsgEn: Hmmm, what's wrong?

MsgJp:
ベルタママがいない間
一応ココはあたしがまとめてるからさ
何かあったら聞きにきな
MsgEn:
While Lady Bertha is away, I'll be in charge here
for now. If you have any problems, feel free to
come and ask.

MsgJp:
あたしらなんかは
ママから生まれたわけじゃないけどさ
そういうことじゃないだろ、家族の絆って
MsgEn:
We may not have been born from the same mother,
but that's not what matters when it comes to
family bonds.

MsgJp:
ちょっと荒っぽいヤツもいるかもしれないけど
皆気はいいヤツらだよ
他の拠点とそう変わらないって！
MsgEn:
There might be a few rough ones here, but they're
all good people. Not that different from other
bases!

MsgJp:
俺たちとあんたらに未来があるなら
仲良く過ごすか敵対しあうか――
MsgEn:
If there's a future for us and you, will we spend
it getting along or fighting each other?

MsgJp: お頭次第だろうね
MsgEn: It depends on the leader.

MsgJp:
そっちには王子、こっちにはお頭が戻って
絶望的な雰囲気が少し変わった気がするよ
MsgEn:
On one side, we have the prince, and on the other
side, the leader has returned.
The despairing atmosphere feels like it has
changed a little.

MsgJp:
お頭はすっかり王子の取り巻きだ
盗賊稼業はどうなるのかね
MsgEn:
The chief's already surrounded by Prince Nedo's
entourage. What's going to happen to our thieving
business?

MsgJp:
何だ、じっと見て
用でもあんのか？
MsgEn:
What, are you just staring at me?
Do you need something?

MsgJp:
盗賊っていっても
俺らは殺して奪うようなことはしてねぇよ
子供をさらったりもしてねぇ
MsgEn:
We may be thieves, but we don't kill or rob
people. We don't kidnap children either.

MsgJp:
覚者ってのは正義の味方か？
だったら、俺とは気は合わないかもな
MsgEn:
Are Arisen always champions of justice? If that's
the case, we might not get along.

MsgJp:
竜のことはよく知らねぇんだ
王家の人間とその取り巻きが
なんかそれっぽくやってんだろ？
MsgEn:
I don't know much about dragons. It seems like
people from the royal family and their entourage
are doing something related to them, though.

MsgJp:
この騒動はいい気晴らしになる
思う存分暴れてやるよ
MsgEn:
This commotion will be a good diversion. Let's go
wild to our heart's content.

MsgJp:
これからどうなるのかね
先のことが少し気になってきたな
MsgEn:
I wonder what will happen from now on. I'm
starting to get a little worried about the future.

MsgJp:
盗賊の頭脳ってのはキリッと冷めてるものさ
でも、熱く燃えるのも悪くはなかった
MsgEn:
The intellect of a bandit is sharp and cold.
But it wasn't bad to see it burn passionately too.

MsgJp: ああ、どうした
MsgEn: Ah, what's wrong?

MsgJp:
あんた、自分が覚者だってことに
誇りを持ってんだろ？
俺ら盗賊だって同じだ
MsgEn:
You, do you take pride in being an Arisen? We
bandits are the same.

MsgJp:
覚者ってのは思ってたより馴れ馴れしいもんだな
――いや、悪い意味じゃないんだ
MsgEn:
The Arisen are more familiar than I had imagined.
Well, I don't mean it in a bad way.

MsgJp:
そう話しかけられても
あんたのタメになるような話はできないぜ
MsgEn:
Even if you talk to me, I can't tell you anything
that would be of any benefit.

MsgJp:
疲れてるなら一眠りしていくか？
ここは静かだし、見た目よりは
寝心地も悪くないぜ
MsgEn:
If you're tired, would you like to take a nap?
It's quiet here, and the sleeping conditions
aren't as bad as they may look.

MsgJp:
よし、一休みするなら<VAL PRICE_INN>だ
――これで金儲けしようってんじゃない
寝床を整える手間賃みたいなもんだよ
で、休んでいくのか？
MsgEn:
Alright, if you're going to take a break, it's
<VAL PRICE_INN>.
This is not about making money.
It's more like a fee for preparing a comfortable
place to sleep. So, are you going to rest?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: OK

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: Cancel

MsgJp:
ああ、今なら好きに休んでいっていいぜ
あんたも覚者とはいえ、疲れ溜まってんだろ？
MsgEn:
Ah, if you feel like it, you can take a break
however you want, you know?
Even though you're an Arisen, you must be tired,
right?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: OK

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: Cancel

MsgJp:
《弱化の治療》か
いや、できるんだが俺たちのルールで
<VAL PRICE_WEAK>もらうことにしてるんだ
手持ちはあるのか？
MsgEn:
"Weakening Treatment," you say?
Well, I can do it, but we've decided to charge
<VAL PRICE_WEAK> for it according to our rules.
Do you have enough on hand?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: OK

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: Cancel

MsgJp:
ん？　弱化してるヤツってのは
もっと弱弱しい感じになるんだぜ
あんた、強いみたいだが演技はまだまだだな
MsgEn:
Huh? Weakened people tend to look weaker, you
know?
You seem strong, but your acting still needs work.

MsgJp:
寝床がもっとたくさんあれば
保護してる人たちもゆっくり休ませてやれるんだが
MsgEn:
If we had more beds, we could let the people
we're protecting rest more comfortably.

MsgJp:
まぁ、どう言いつくろっても盗賊だから
外でさ迷ってる人に声をかけても
逃げられることの方が多くて――
MsgEn:
Well, even though I may act as a bandit, I've
often talked to people wandering outside.
Most times, they just run away.

MsgJp:
俺たち盗賊団ほど自由な集まりは無いと思うぜ
色んなところへフラフラ行っちまうヤツが
結構多いから、外でも見かけるかもな
MsgEn:
I don't think there's a gathering as free as our
thief gang.
There are quite a few people who wander around in
various places, so you might see them outside too.

MsgJp:
覚者さんか、いらっしゃい
さてと――ご用は何かな？
MsgEn: Welcome, Arisen. Now then, what can I do for you?

MsgJp:
おたく、今日もイカしてるぜ
数々の戦場を乗り越えてきた戦士の目をしてるよ
MsgEn:
You, you're still rocking it today. You have the
eyes of a warrior who's overcome many
battlefields.

MsgJp:
ここにあるものは盗品じゃないから
安心して買い物してってくれ
――俺らはこういう日用品みたいな小物は
狙わない主義でね
MsgEn:
Don't worry; the items here are not stolen. Feel
free to shop with confidence. We have a policy not
to target everyday items like this.

MsgJp:
並べてる商品は大体外の商人から
仕入れてきたもんだ
――ああ、後ろの酒瓶は俺のだけど
MsgEn:
I've mostly purchased the products from outside
merchants – oh, the bottles of alcohol in the back
are mine, though.

MsgJp:
ああ、覚者さま
私に何かご用でも？
MsgEn:
Ah, Lord
Arisen, do you need something from me?

MsgJp:
何か盗賊の方たちのお手伝いをと思って――
散らばっていた道具なんかを片付けてみたんです
少しはきれいになったかと
MsgEn:
I thought I'd help out with something for the
bandits.
I tried to clean up some of the scattered tools.
I wonder if it's a bit neater now.

MsgJp:
私にできることは無いかと聞いてみても
特に何も無いそうなんです
ただ休んでいるのも申し訳ないし
どうしましょうね――
MsgEn:
When I asked if there was anything I could do to
help, they said there wasn't anything specific.
I feel bad just resting, but what can we do?

MsgJp:
せっかく置いてもらっているのですから
盗賊の方たちのお役に立ちたいのですが――
MsgEn:
We're here because you've left us this chance,
and we'd like to be of service to the bandits.

MsgJp:
ごほっごほっ
ああ、すみません――
MsgEn:
Cough cough
Ah, I'm sorry--

MsgJp:
げほっごほっ
いや、ちょっとむせただけです
何でもないんですよ
MsgEn:
Cough cough
No, I just choked a bit.
It's nothing.

MsgJp:
はは、こうして人間らしく寝られるようになって
身も心も本当に助かりましたよ
木の根っこで丸まって休む日が続きましてね
限界だったんです
MsgEn:
Haha, being able to sleep like a human has really
been a lifesaver.
I've spent days curled up under tree roots to
rest.
I was at my limit.

MsgJp:
ごほん、げほっ
ちょ、ちょっと調子が悪いかなぁ
なんて、ハハハ――
MsgEn:
Ahem, cough
Um, umm, I'm feeling a bit off today
Uh, hahaha...

MsgJp:
あっ、覚者さんでしたか
ちょっとここのところ目がかすみまして
よくお顔が見えませんでした
MsgEn:
Ah, so you're an Arisen, aren't you? I apologize,
my vision has been a bit blurry lately, so I
couldn't see your face clearly.

MsgJp:
いやぁ、盗賊の皆さんには
お世話になりました――
げほっ、ごほん
MsgEn:
Well, I must say, I am grateful to all you
bandits for your assistance-- *cough* *cough*

MsgJp:
こ、この通り――
ちょっと体調が悪そうに見えるらしくて――
「展望城に行けば医者がいるかもしれん」と
ここまで送っていただきまして、ハハハ――
MsgEn:
Ju-just as you can see... I seemed to look a bit
unwell, and they, um, thought I should head to
Prospect Castle. They said there might be a doctor
there, so they brought me this far, hehe...

MsgJp:
展望城を取り戻せて、本当によかった――
やっと希望が見えてきました
ええ、やっと――
MsgEn:
I'm really glad that we were able to retake
Lookout Castle――
Finally, I see a glimmer of hope
Yes, finally――

MsgJp:
お、お気遣いなく――
ええ、大丈夫ですから――
MsgEn: Don't worry about it. Yes, I'm fine.

MsgJp: ええ、アデムはうちの子ですけど――
MsgEn: Yes, Adem is our child.

MsgJp:
はぁ――何です？
うちの子へのご用でも、私がお聞きしますから
MsgEn:
Hah... What is it? If you have any business with
my child, I'm the one to talk to.

MsgJp:
――ああ、あなた
何かご用でも？
MsgEn: - Ah, do you have some business with me?

MsgJp:
少しそっとしておいてほしいんですよ
うちの子が傷付いてるの
見てわからないんですか？
MsgEn:
I'd appreciate it if you left us alone for a bit.
My child is hurt. Can't you see that?

MsgJp:
私たち、目の前で家を潰されたんです
この子も、それがショックで――
MsgEn:
They destroyed our homes right before our eyes,
and my child was traumatized...

MsgJp:
さっきからじろじろ見て
一体何なんです？
わたしもアデムも何も持ってませんからね！
MsgEn:
You've been staring at us for a while now. What
is it?
Neither I nor Adem has anything on us!

MsgJp:
ベルタ盗賊団のアジトでお会いしましたね
ほら、《湖畔の洞窟》にある――
MsgEn:
We met at the Bertha's Bandit Group Hideout,
right? It's in the "Lakeside Grotto."

MsgJp:
アデムも少しずつ落ち着いてきています
盗賊の人たちも気にかけてくださって――
あの人たちって、悪人のくせに
子供には優しいんですね
MsgEn:
Adem is slowly settling down too.
The thieves are taking care of us – it's strange
that they're kind to children, despite being bad
people.

MsgJp:
家は潰されましたけど、きっとまた
私がお金を貯めて建て直してみせます
あの子を育てていかなくちゃ
MsgEn:
Our house was destroyed, but I'll surely save up
and rebuild it.
I have to raise my child.

MsgJp:
わたしの息子――
絶対に守り抜いてみせるわ
MsgEn: I will definitely protect my son -

MsgJp: ママ――？
MsgEn: Mom...?

MsgJp: ――なんなの――
MsgEn: What is it...?

MsgJp: ――こんにちは
MsgEn: Hello

MsgJp: うう――
MsgEn: Ugh...

MsgJp: あ、あっちにいって
MsgEn: Oh, go over there.

MsgJp: ママ、ぼくこわいよ
MsgEn: Mom, I'm scared.

MsgJp: ここにいれば、もうこわくないんでしょ？
MsgEn: If you're here, you're not afraid anymore, right?

MsgJp:
デニスおにいちゃん！
はやくボール投げて！
MsgEn: Brother Dennis! Please throw the ball quickly -

MsgJp:
ここに来てから
ママがやさしくなって――よかった
MsgEn:
Ever since coming here, Mom has become kinder -
I'm glad

MsgJp: ママ、ぼくのことみてる？
MsgEn: Mama, are you watching me?

MsgJp: やあ・仮
MsgEn: Hello, temporary

MsgJp: 雑談１・仮
MsgEn: Small talk 1, temporary

MsgJp: 雑談２・仮
MsgEn: Small talk 2, temporary

MsgEn: Hello, temporary

MsgEn: Small talk 1, temporary

MsgJp: 雑談２・仮

MsgEn: Yes, temporary

MsgEn: Small talk 1, temporary

MsgJp: へへへ・仮

MsgEn: Small talk 1, temporary

MsgJp: 雑談２・仮

MsgJp: 雑談３・仮
MsgEn: Small talk 3, temporary

MsgJp:
まぁ、覚者様
フェルヤナ一帯についてのお話でしょうか？
MsgEn:
Well, Ser Arisen, is this about the Feryana
region?

MsgJp:
あら、どなたでしょうか？
拠点の礎であれば
この隠れ家の外にございます
MsgEn:
Oh, who might you be?
If you're looking for the Portcrystal, it's
outside.

MsgJp:
かりそめのエリアマスターではありますが
この辺りのお話でしたら
わたしがお受けいたしましょう
MsgEn:
While I may be just a temporary Area Master, if
it's about this area I will gladly take on the
task.

MsgJp:
ふふ、おいででしたのね
展望城、ひいてはフェルヤナ一帯について
何か必要な情報が――？
MsgEn:
Ah, you came.
Do you need any information about Lookout Castle
or the surrounding area of Feryana?

MsgJp:
幸い、ここは規模こそ小さくとも全員が食べ、
眠る場所を維持するだけの力はあります
それぞれが力を尽くしてくれた結果です
MsgEn:
Fortunately, even though the scale is small,
everyone has the power to maintain a place to eat
and sleep.
It's the result of everyone's hard work.

MsgJp:
この辺りのエリアマスターは
他にいたはずですが――
この混乱の中、行方が知れません
MsgEn:
There should have been other Area Masters around
here, but in this chaos, their whereabouts are
unknown.

MsgJp:
しかし――誰かがエリアの情報を
取りまとめねばなりません
そこで、わたしがかりそめのエリアマスターを
名乗らせていただいております
MsgEn:
However, someone has to gather information about
the area.
So I'm temporarily calling myself the Area Master.

MsgJp:
戦乱の中、たくさんのものが破壊されました
それは家屋であり、人々の心であり――
そしてアッカーシェランという国が築いてきた
文化すらも犠牲になりつつあります
MsgEn:
In the midst of war, many things were destroyed.
Homes, people's hearts, and even the culture
built by the country of Acre Selund are becoming
sacrifices.

MsgJp:
そう、例えば《展望城》――
あれは文化的にも防衛的にも重要な城
魔軍の手に落ちてしまったのは
大変つらいことです
MsgEn:
Yes, for example, the "Lookout Castle."
It's an important castle both culturally and
defensively.
It's been a great hardship for it to fall into
the hands of the Demon Army.

MsgJp:
せっかくですから、覚者様も
少し休んでいかれてはいかがです？
ぐっすりと眠らないといざという時
疲れに足を取られるといいますもの
MsgEn:
Since you're here, how about taking a little
rest, Arisen?
They say that you'll need a good night's sleep
for times of need.

MsgJp:
《展望城》――アッカーシェランの国民としても
わたし個人としても、大変思い入れの深い場所です
MsgEn:
"Lookout Castle" – it's a place I hold dear as a
citizen of Acre Selund and as an individual.

MsgJp:
魔軍の手に落ちたと知った時は
心の一部まで失ったような思いを
したものですが――
MsgEn:
When I learned that it had fallen into the hands
of the Demon Army, I felt as though I had lost a
part of my heart.

MsgJp:
ふふ、今は――
ええ、素直に嬉しいものです！
MsgEn:
Hehe, now--
Yes, it's something to be honestly happy about!

MsgJp:
まさか、わたしがこの辺りの
エリアマスターとして正式に認められることに
なるなんて――
MsgEn:
I never thought I would officially be recognized
as an Area Master around here.

MsgJp:
実は、昔この展望城へも
歌を披露しに来たことがあるのですよ
今度は違う立場で招かれるなんて
人生何が起こるかわからないものです
MsgEn:
Actually, I came to perform here at Lookout
Castle in the past.
It's funny how life can invite you in different
ways this time.

MsgJp:
活動拠点が広くなった分
たくさんの避難者たちを受け入れることが
できるようになりました
MsgEn:
With the expanded operating base, we can now
accommodate many refugees.

MsgJp:
人が多くなると揉め事や悩み事も
増えるようですが――
これも命あってこそのものですものね
MsgEn:
With more people around, disputes and worries
seem to increase.
But that's just part of life.

MsgJp:
覚者様、もしよろしければ
問題を抱える人たちにお力をお貸しください
みな、喜ぶことでしょう
MsgEn:
Arisen, if you're willing, please lend your
strength to those in need.
Everyone would surely appreciate it.

MsgJp:
覚者様、あらためまして
わたしを含め、この村に居るものは皆
戦火を逃れて流れ着いた者ばかり
MsgEn:
Arisen, once again, I must emphasize that
everyone in this village, including myself, are
all refugees who have fled from the ravages of
war.

MsgJp:
あなたは解放軍と共に、このアッカーの地に
希望をもたらす方だと聞いています
MsgEn:
I have heard that you are the one who brings hope
to this land of Acre, alongside the Liberation
Army.

MsgJp:
わたしたちにできる協力は全ていたしましょう
まずはここより近い、安全な場所を
紹介いたします
MsgEn:
Let us cooperate and do everything we can.
First, I will introduce a nearby and safe location
for you.

MsgJp:
どうぞ、こちらを――
支援といっても、この程度しか用意できませんが
何かのお役に立つかもしれません
MsgEn:
Please, take this...
Although it's just a small token of support, it
may be of some use to you.

MsgJp:
覚者様のお力添えもあり
少しは旅の支えとなりそうなものを
手配できるようになってきました
遠慮なさらず、お持ちになってください
MsgEn:
With the assistance of the esteemed Arisen, we
are now able to arrange things that may serve as a
support on your journey.
Please do not hesitate to take them with you.

MsgJp:
覚者様、何もおっしゃらないで――
ただ、これをお持ちください
わたしたちが取り戻した希望、あなた様に
物資として託させてください
MsgEn:
Ser Arisen, please don't say anything...
Just please accept this.
Allow us to entrust you with the hope we have
regained as provisions.

MsgJp:
覚者様
この地にて新たな素材が
取れる場所をお教えします
あなたを守る武具に加工できるかもしれません
MsgEn:
Arisen, I shall reveal a new location in this
area where you can gather materials.
They might be suitable for crafting protective
armor for you.

MsgJp:
それと、もしよろしければ――
僅かな希望を胸に戦う兵たちをお救い下さい
どうか、よろしくお願いいたします――
MsgEn:
Also, if you would, please help the soldiers who
fight with a glimmer of hope in their hearts.
Please, we're counting on you.

MsgJp:
この村からほど近い北の地に
悪しき魔物たちが
集まろうとしているようです――
MsgEn:
It seems that wicked creatures are gathering in
the northern lands near this village.

MsgJp:
ここは、わたしたちに唯一のこされた憩いの村
どうかそのお力をお借りできないでしょうか――
MsgEn:
This is the only remaining peaceful village for
us.
Could we please borrow your power here?

MsgJp:
覚者様、僅かではありますが
支援品を増やすことができるようになりました
力無きわたしたちも、少しでもお役に立てればと
MsgEn:
Arisen, we've managed to increase our supply of
aid items.
Even those of us with little strength want to be
of assistance to you.

MsgJp:
この大陸の南方を統べる展望城――
王家ゆかりのこの城は、軍事だけでなく
貿易、文化面においても重要な城でした
MsgEn:
Lookout Castle, which governs the southern part
of this continent--
This castle, with its royal lineage, was not only
important in terms of military affairs, but also
in trade and culture.

MsgJp:
その城下には、貴重な素材が
手に入る地下遺跡が残っているのです
危険な場所ですが、あなたのお力と
なるかも知れません
MsgEn:
Beneath that castle town, there's an underground
ruin that contains valuable materials.
It's a dangerous place, but with your abilities,
it might be possible to obtain them.

MsgJp:
このエリア中心部の湿原に悪しき魔物たちが
集まっているようです
覚者様、力を貸していただけないでしょうか？
MsgEn:
It seems that wicked creatures have gathered in
the central marsh of this area.
Arisen, could you lend your strength?

MsgJp:
展望城の奪還――この報せは
アッカーシェランで生きる者にとって
大きな希望となります
MsgEn:
The recapture of Lookout Castle – this news is a
great hope for those living in Acre Selund.

MsgJp:
長くこの国と共にあった歴史ある城ですから
城自体も、また王家の手に戻ったことを
喜んでいることでしょう！
MsgEn:
Since the castle has a long history with this
nation, it will surely rejoice to be back in the
hands of the royal family!

MsgJp: しかし覚者様、少し急ぐべきかも知れません
MsgEn: However, Arisen, we may need to hurry a little.

MsgJp:
実は――このエリアの脅威は
ジフール砦の骸の将だけではないのです
MsgEn:
In fact, the threat in this area is not just the
Necro Master of Jifule Fortress.

MsgJp:
近頃、民の間で恐ろしき噂が
囁かれています
――いえ、今は奪還の喜びを享受する時でしょうか
このお話はまたの機会にいたしましょう
MsgEn:
Lately, there have been terrifying rumors
circulating among the people...
No, now is the time to savor the joy of
recapture.
Let us save this story for another occasion.

MsgJp:
覚者様だからこそお伝えできることなのですが――
ジフール砦の南方、ぬかるみの大地の先に
深い闇に包まれた地下水路があります
MsgEn:
It's because you're the Arisen that I can share
this information.
To the south of Jifule Fortress, beyond the muddy
expanse, there is a subterranean waterway shrouded
in deep darkness.

MsgJp:
すでに命無き魔物たちの巣窟となり果てた
恐ろしい場所ではありますが、そこには
特別な価値を持つモノが眠っているそうです
MsgEn:
Although it has already become a lair for
lifeless creatures, it's a dreadful place.
However, there are items with special value
sleeping there.

MsgJp:
覚者様――
折り入ってお願いがございます
王家の歴史にまつわるとても古い話――
MsgEn:
Esteemed Arisen,
I humbly ask for a favor.
A very ancient tale concerning the history of the
royal family...

MsgJp:
このエリアを蝕む、魔軍とは異なる
脅威についてお話しさせてください
MsgEn:
Please allow me to talk about the threat that is
different from the Demon Army that corrupts this
area.

MsgJp:
国の言い伝えとなっていた古き魔物が
再び活動を始めていたなんて――
MsgEn:
The ancient creatures that were supposed to be
legends in the country have started to become
active again.

MsgJp:
そしてその邪悪な魔物を
討ち果たして頂けただなんて！
この国はまたひとつ救われました――
感謝いたします
MsgEn:
To think you would be able to defeat those evil
creatures!
Once again, our country has been saved. Thank you.

MsgJp:
あら――
既に別のミッションを受注されているみたいですね
MsgEn: Oh, you already have another mission? It seems so.

MsgJp:
受注されているミッションを取り消して頂き
再度お尋ねください
MsgEn: Please cancel the accepted missions and ask again.

MsgJp:
黒い鎧の騎士のことでお話しできるのは
その容姿と強さだけです
何しろ混乱していたので――
MsgEn:
I can only speak about the Black-armored Knight
in terms of their appearance and strength. After
all, I was quite confused at the time.

MsgJp:
黒い騎士を見かけたら
すぐにお知らせしますからね
MsgEn:
If you happen to see the Black Knight, please
inform me immediately.

MsgJp:
アッカーシェランがこれからどうなるにせよ
前より悪くなることはないでしょう
MsgEn:
Whatever happens to Acre Selund from now on, at
least it won't get worse than before.

MsgJp:
何しろ我々は今や希望を忘れては
いけないことを知っていますからね
MsgEn:
We mustn't forget that we know how important it
is not to forget hope now.

MsgJp:
わたしが伝えたことで
ジリアンが父上のことを
見直してくれると良いのだがな
MsgEn:
I hope that what I've conveyed will make Gillian
reconsider her feelings toward her father.

MsgJp:
レスタニアの覚者たちよ
我が戦友の娘ジリアンを頼むぞ
MsgEn:
Arisen of Lestania, I entrust you with Gillian,
the daughter of my comrade in battle.

MsgJp:
生きて戦いを終えられることが
これほど嬉しいとはね
MsgEn:
To be able to end the battle and live on, I am so
happy.

MsgJp: 絶望のぬかるみで転ばなくて良かったよ
MsgEn: I'm glad I didn't slip in the quagmire of despair.

MsgJp:
あら、こんにちは！
休んでいかれますか？
それとも、《弱化の回復》？
MsgEn:
Oh, hello!
Are you taking a break?
Or are you hoping to recover from weakness?

MsgJp:
細々とやっているところですので――
休憩されるなら<VAL PRICE_INN>いただいても
よろしいでしょうか？
MsgEn:
Since we are doing things in a small scale――
If you would like to take a break, would it be
acceptable to charge you <VAL PRICE_INN>?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: OK

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: Cancel

MsgJp:
辛い時はお互い様、ですもんね
どうぞ、奥にベッドがありますから
疲れがとれるまで休んでいってくださいね！
MsgEn:
When times are tough, it's only fair to help each
other, right?
Please, there's a bed over there. Take a rest
until you're refreshed, okay!

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: OK

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: Cancel

MsgJp:
《弱化の治療》ですね
<VAL PRICE_WEAK>です
しっかり治療しますから、安心してください！
MsgEn:
"Treat Weakness," is it?
It's <VAL PRICE_WEAK>.
Rest assured, I will provide thorough treatment!

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: OK

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: Cancel

MsgJp:
うーん、わたしが見たところ
《弱化》はしてないみたいです
ここに来るまでに治ったのかしら――
MsgEn:
Hmm, from what I've seen, it doesn't seem like
you've been weakened.
I wonder if you healed before coming here...

MsgJp:
あ、わたしばっかり座りながらでごめんなさい
ここに来るまでに足を痛めてしまって
立っていられないんです
MsgEn:
Ah, I'm sorry for sitting here by myself. I
injured my leg before coming here, so I can't
stand.

MsgJp:
村が――鎧を付けた大きな魔物に
襲われたんです
気付いたら家族ともはぐれて――
MsgEn:
The village was attacked by a large monster
wearing armor.
Before I knew it, I got separated from my family.

MsgJp:
でも、逃げてくる途中で
ナヤジークさんに会えたんです
足を痛めたわたしに肩を貸してくださって
それで今、ここにいられています
MsgEn:
However, on the way while I was fleeing, I
encountered Lord Nazik.
He kindly lent me his shoulder as I had injured
my leg.
Thanks to that, I am able to be here now.

MsgJp:
父の真似事から始めたんですけど
医療の勉強をしていてよかったです
こうして皆さんのお役に立てますから
MsgEn:
I started by imitating my father, but I'm glad I
studied medicine.
Because I can help all of you this way.

MsgJp:
よう
要る物があるなら見ていけよ
MsgEn:
If you have something you need, go ahead and take
a look.

MsgJp:
俺もだけど、商人ってのは強いぜ
こんな状況になっても、まだ生きてるコネがある
そこから物やら情報を仕入れられるんだからな
MsgEn:
Not just me, but merchants are strong too.
Even in a situation like this, they still have
connections to keep them alive.
They can gather goods and information from there.

MsgJp:
ちっと展望城に用があってな
今はまだ様子見だが――
MsgEn:
I have something to do at Lookout Castle.
Right now, I'm just observing the situation
though...

MsgJp:
この一軒家が拠点として機能してるのは
ナヤジークのお陰だな
裏手では野菜まで作ってるんだぜ
MsgEn:
This single house is functioning as a base,
thanks to Nazik.
They even grow vegetables in the backyard.

MsgJp:
ああ、どうも
旅の仲間をお探しでしょうか？
MsgEn:
Ah, I see.
Are you looking for travel companions?

MsgJp:
仲間といえば――
私は牛をたくさん飼ってましてね
仲間みたいなもんでしたよ、ええ
MsgEn:
Speaking of companions...
I used to have a lot of oxen, you know.
They were like my companions, yes.

MsgJp:
ここでの生活に不満はありませんが
村に残してきた牛たちが気がかりです
連れて逃げられたら良かったのですが
MsgEn:
I have no complaints about life here, but I am
worried about the cows I left behind in the
village.
It would have been good if I could have brought
them with me.

MsgJp:
ナヤジークさんの案で
近くの高台の上に畑を作ってるんです
あんな風に、家畜小屋も作れたらなぁ――
MsgEn:
With Nazik's suggestion, we are creating a
field on a nearby high hill.
It would be nice if we could also build livestock
sheds like that...

MsgJp: えっと、何か？
MsgEn: Um, is there something you need?

MsgJp: ――はい
MsgEn: Yes, what is it?

MsgJp:
あっ、覚者さん
どうしたの？
MsgEn: Oh, Arisen, what's wrong?

MsgJp:
早くお父さんとお母さんが
迎えに来てくれないかなって――
妹にも会いたい――怖いよ――
MsgEn:
I wish my father and mother would come pick me up
quickly...
I want to see my sister too... I'm scared...

MsgJp:
ぼくがここにいるって、どうしたら
家族に伝わるんだろう？
ぼくも、家族がどこにいるかわからないのに――
MsgEn:
How can I make my presence known to my family?
Even though I don't know where my family is...

MsgJp:
どこに行ったらいいのか
何にもわからなくて――
どうしよう――
MsgEn:
Where should I go?
I don't know anything...
What should I do...

MsgJp:
ナヤジークさんがね
人が多いところに来た方が、お父さんや
お母さんが見つかりやすいかもって
ここに連れてきてくれたんだ
MsgEn:
Nazik told me that if we come to a place with
many people, it might be easier to find my father
or mother.
That's why they brought me here.

MsgJp:
ここにいれば、きっといつか
お父さんたちのことを知ってる人に会えるよね！
だって、これだけたくさんの人がいるんだもん
MsgEn:
If I stay here, I'm sure I'll eventually meet
someone who knows about Dad.
After all, there are so many people here.

MsgJp:
ここに来てから、ちょっと気分が良いよ
アデムと遊ぶのも楽しいしね！
MsgEn:
Since coming here, I've been feeling a little
better.
It's fun playing with Adem, too!

MsgJp:
迷子になった時は変に動くよりも
迎えを待ちなさいって、お父さんが言ってたんだ
MsgEn:
When you get lost, instead of wandering
aimlessly, my father used to say, "Wait for
someone to come and find you."

MsgJp:
俺は村の警備があって
ここを離れられないが――話だけなら
MsgEn:
I am responsible for guarding the village, so I
cannot leave here... but if it's just talking,
then I can.

MsgJp:
ちょっと場所は辺鄙だが
一見平和そうな村に見えるだろう
――最初はただの空き屋だったなんて
俺も信じられない
MsgEn:
The location is a bit remote, but at first
glance, it may seem like a peaceful village.
I can't believe that it was just an abandoned
house.

MsgJp:
疲れてるなら、小屋の中で
休んでいくといい
ここまで来るのも大変だったろう
MsgEn:
If you're tired, it's a good idea to rest inside
the hut.
It must have been tough to come all the way here.

MsgJp:
そこにいるデニスって子なんだが――
すすまみれでトボトボ歩いてるのを
俺が保護してきたんだ
MsgEn:
There's this kid named Dennis over there---
I found him walking slowly, covered in soot, and
brought him under my protection.

MsgJp:
家族とはぐれたのが堪えたらしくて
どうにも元気が出ないみたいだ
まだ子供なのに、可哀想にな――
MsgEn:
It seems like they are feeling down because they
have been separated from their family, and they
can't seem to muster up any energy. Even though
they are still a child, it's quite pitiful.

MsgJp:
ああ、デニスって子は
ナヤジークさんが展望城に連れてったよ
そっちの方が家族も見つかりやすいだろうからってね
MsgEn:
Ah, that child Dennis, Nazik took him to
Lookout Castle.
They said it would be easier to find a family
there.

MsgJp:
家族、無事に見つかるといいんだが――
あの子も期待してたみたいだからな
MsgEn:
I hope the family is found safe and sound.
That child seemed to have high expectations too,
so...

MsgJp: なになに？　私に何か用？
MsgEn:
What is it, what is it? Do you have something you
need from me?

MsgJp:
この村、すごいよねぇ
色んなところから逃げてきた人たちが
それぞれに働いてこんなにうまく回ってるんだって
MsgEn:
This village, isn't it amazing?
People who have escaped from various places are
all working and it's running so smoothly.

MsgJp:
ナヤジークさんって
昔は大女優だったらしいよ～
確かに、今もそんな感じだよね
MsgEn:
Nazik, I heard she used to be a famous actress
back in the day.
Honestly, she still has that kind of presence
even now.

MsgJp:
私も弓の腕はなかなかなんだよ
ま、今はまだそれを見せつける時
じゃないかな～なんて
MsgEn:
My skill with a bow is not bad either, you know?
Well, now is probably not the time to show it off.
Or so I think～

MsgJp:
え？　どうしてこんなところにって――
いやあ、ここら辺なんか怪しいな～って
勘なんだけどね、勘！
MsgEn:
Huh? Why am I in a place like this...?
Well, I have a feeling that this area is a bit
suspicious, you know～ Just using my intuition,
that's all!

MsgJp:
それで、今日はどんな感じにする？
戦技を変えるんでしょ？
MsgEn:
So, how are we going to approach it today?
Are we going to change our tactics?

MsgJp:
展望城も取り返せたことだし
これからグイグイいけそうな気がしてるんだ
――君がいるからかな？
MsgEn:
Now that we've reclaimed Lookout Castle, I feel
like we can go full steam ahead from here....
Is it because you're here?

MsgJp:
まだ立ち直れない人もいれば
慎重な人もいるけど、あたしはちょっとでも
希望を見つけて喜んでいきたいよ
MsgEn:
There are still some people who haven't been able
to recover,
and there are also cautious individuals, but as
for me,
I want to find even a glimmer of hope and embrace
it joyfully.

MsgJp:
状況に応じて戦技を付け替えてるのね
感心感心！　それってとっても重要だよね
MsgEn:
It seems like you're changing your combat
techniques depending on the situation. I'm really
impressed!
That's extremely important, isn't it?

MsgJp:
あら、覚者様じゃない
今日はどうしました？
MsgEn:
Oh, it's not the Arisen, is it? What can I do for
you today?

MsgJp:
ぐっすり眠ると、心も体も癒されますものね
適切な休養って大切なんですよ
ああ、お代は<VAL PRICE_INN>です
休んでいかれるでしょう？
MsgEn:
When you sleep soundly, both your heart and body
are healed, you know.
Proper rest is really important. Ah, the cost is
<VAL PRICE_INN>.
Will you be taking a rest?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: OK

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
そうですね――今はベッドにも空きがあるし
自由に眠っていってもらって大丈夫です
こういう日があってもいいじゃないですか
MsgEn:
I see...
Well, we have plenty of beds available right now,
so feel free to sleep as long as you need.
It's okay to have days like this, you know.

MsgJp:
覚者さんじゃないですか！
城内の散策ですか？
MsgEn:
You are an Arisen, aren't you?
Enjoying a stroll around the castle?

MsgJp:
ずっと落ち込んでたんです
だけど、ここへ来てからは空を眺める
余裕ができました
――覚者さんのおかげですよ！
MsgEn:
I was depressed for quite some time, but since
coming here and looking at the sky, I have gained
some peace of mind.
It's all thanks to you, Arisen!

MsgJp:
この場内には様々な人がいますね
そういえば、盗賊みたいな服を着た
女の子もウロウロしてたなぁ
MsgEn:
All sorts come to this hall, huh.
Oh, by the way, there was a girl about dressed
like a bandit.

MsgJp:
展望城の塔のてっぺんには
もう行かれましたか？
いい眺めですよ
MsgEn:
Have you already been to the top of the Tower of
Lookout Castle?
It's such a great view.

MsgJp:
あら、覚者さんも
景色を眺めに来たの？
MsgEn:
Oh, did you come to view the scenery, too, Ser
Arisen?

MsgJp:
ここっていいところね
ちょっと覗くだけのはずだったんだけど
もうちょっとここに居るつもり
MsgEn:
This place is nice, isn't it?
I was supposed to just take a quick look, but I
think I'll stay here a little longer.

MsgJp:
ふぅ
高いところって空気が澄んでる気がしない？
風が吹いてるせいかな
MsgEn:
Phew. Don't you feel like the air is clearer up
high?
Perhaps it's due to the wind.

MsgJp:
はやく戦、終わらないかなぁ
楽しく盗みに入りたいよね
MsgEn:
I wish the war would end already.
I want to get back to having fun stealing things.

MsgJp:
おおっ、覚者さん！
こんなところでどうした？
MsgEn:
Oh, an Arisen! What are you doing in a place like
this?

MsgJp:
こうしてオークに奪われた村も
取り返せるものなんだな
俺の故郷もいつか――
MsgEn:
As it stands, even a village taken by Orcs can be
reclaimed.
Someday, my hometown too—

MsgJp:
地元では酒場をやってたんだ
戦が落ち着いて、解放軍が解体されたら――
またあの頃の常連を集めて飲みたいよ
MsgEn:
I used to run a tavern in my hometown.
Once the war settles down and the Liberation Army
disbands... I want to gather the regulars from
those days and have a drink together again.

MsgJp:
この村のベイザばあさん
やたらおっかない顔してないか？
オーク相手にもあの調子だったのかな
MsgEn:
Grandma Beza of this village looks very scary,
doesn't she?
I wonder if she was like that with the Orcs.

MsgJp:
――なに？
言いたいことがありそうな顔ね
MsgEn:
...What is it?
You look like you have something to say.

MsgJp: あなたのおかげで、この村はもう安心ね
MsgEn: Thanks to you, this village is safe now.

MsgJp:
私の地元？
まだ無事なはずだけど――
便りが無いからわからないわ
MsgEn:
My hometown? It should still be safe, but... I
don't know because there's no news.

MsgJp:
村人が生きた状態で囚われていたのは
本当に幸運だったわ
MsgEn:
It is truly fortunate that the captured villagers
are still alive.

MsgJp: ん、どうも
MsgEn: Aye, many thanks.

MsgJp:
解放された村人もだけど
最近は軍の雰囲気もちょっと変わったよ
MsgEn:
Not only among the liberated villagers, but even
the atmosphere within the army has changed
recently.

MsgJp:
暇なら俺の
"なんでもないものコレクション"でも見てく？
MsgEn:
If you're not busy, why don't you check out my
"Collection of insignificant things"?

MsgJp:
あんたに希望っての？
そういうのを見つけたんだよな
それでちょっと落ち着いて眠れるように
なったってやつも多いと思うぜ
MsgEn:
You, do you have hope? That's what I have found.
I think it's made a lot of people able to sleep a
little more peacefully.

MsgJp: やぁ、変わりないかい？
MsgEn: Hi there, how goes it?

MsgJp:
ここら辺も少し落ち着いたからか
たまに小鳥を見かけるようになったよ
オークに怯えて隠れてたんだろうね
MsgEn:
It may be due to things calming down around here,
but I've started to see small birds again.
They must have been hiding, scared of the Orcs.

MsgJp:
朝早い時間に、クラッカーやパンを
少し砕いて小鳥にあげてるんだ
癒されるよ
MsgEn:
Early in the morning, I crumble some crackers or
bread and feed the little birds.
It's deeply soothing.

MsgJp:
周辺の警備やら鍛練やら――
毎日緊張することも多いからね
その合間に楽しみは持っておきたいんだ
MsgEn:
Security around the area and training, you
know...
There are many things to be tense about every
day, you know.
So I want to have something enjoyable in between.

MsgJp:
これは覚者様
ご用はなんでしょうかね？
MsgEn:
Ah, Arisen.
What can I do for you?

MsgJp:
一度潰された村ですからね
これから急いで立て直して、覚者さんや
兵士の皆さんのお役に立てるようにしますよ
MsgEn:
It's a village that's been pillaged once before,
you see.
We'll hurry to rebuild it and make ourselves
useful to Ser Arisen and all the soldiers.

MsgJp:
この村が元通りになったら
行き場の無い人たちに住まいを
用意することもできるでしょう
ここからはあたしたちが頑張らないとね
MsgEn:
Once this village is restored to its former
state, we will be able to provide housing for
those who have nowhere else to go.
We'll have to work hard from here on out.

MsgJp:
もうあたしも年なもんだから
後は若い人たちに任せようかと
思ってたけど――
MsgEn:
Since I'm getting older now, I thought I should
leave it to the young ones, but...

MsgJp:
休めるのはもう少し先みたいですよ
やることがたくさんありますからね
MsgEn:
It seems rest will have to wait a little longer.
There's plenty to do, you see.

MsgJp:
これはこれは
まだ何も無い村ですが
ゆっくりしていってください
MsgEn:
Well, well, this village may not have much yet,
but please, make yourself at home and take it
easy.

MsgJp:
魔軍に囚われていた時は
もう自分に明日は無いんだと
毎晩思ってましたよ――
MsgEn:
When I was captured by the demon army, I used to
think every night that tomorrow might not come...

MsgJp:
どうにか私も覚者さんたちの
お力になりたいものです
MsgEn:
I hope to somehow be of assistance to you,
esteemed Arisen.

MsgJp:
――今はまだ、身の回りのことを
どうにかするので精一杯ですけどね
MsgEn:
But right now, I'm doing my best to care for my
personal affairs.

MsgJp:
猟師をやってたんですが
狩りと戦いは違いますから
私が兵士として戦えるかは――
MsgEn:
I used to be a hunter, but hunting and fighting
are different.
Whether I can fight as a soldier...

MsgJp: ああ、覚者さま――
MsgEn: Oh, Ser Arisen--

MsgJp:
囚われて思ったんです
わたしみたいに、戦うこともできない者は
ただ殺されるのを待つしかできないんだって
MsgEn:
Being captured made me realize that someone like
me, who can't even fight, can only wait to be
killed.

MsgJp:
わたしの人生も燃え溶けていくみたい
解放はされたけど、戦が終わったわけじゃないもの
これからもきっとたくさんの辛いことが――
MsgEn:
It seems like my life is also burning away, I may
be liberated, but the war is not over yet.
Surely, there will be many more hardships to
come...

MsgJp:
どうしたらいいのかしら
こんなはずじゃなかったわ
幸せってどうやって見つけるものだったかしら
MsgEn:
What should I do? This isn't how it was supposed
to be.
I wonder how you're supposed to find happiness.

MsgJp:
覚者様は僕たちのこと
いつまで助けてくれるの――？
MsgEn:
Master Arisen, how long will you continue to help
us?

MsgJp:
もうずっと体の具合がよくないんだ
ううん、戦争が始まる前からだけどね
MsgEn:
My physical condition hasn't been good for a
while now.
Not since before the war started, indeed.

MsgJp:
きっとこれから大変だよね
村を作り直すんだもん
僕の居場所はあるのかな
MsgEn:
I'm sure it's going to be tough from now on,
since we have to rebuild the village.
I wonder if there's a place for me.

MsgJp:
魔軍から生きて解放されたし
兵士さんもたくさん来てくれたけど――
MsgEn:
I was released from the demon army, and many
soldiers came to help, but...

MsgEn: Hello, temporary

MsgJp: 雑談１・仮
MsgEn: Small talk 1, temporary

MsgEn: Small talk 2, temporary

MsgEn: Small talk 1, temporary

MsgEn: Small talk 3, temporary

MsgJp: はい、何か
MsgEn: Aye, what is it?

MsgJp:
地下に隠れ潜んでいても
情報収集は怠っておりません
この地区のことであれば、何なりと
MsgEn:
Even while hiding underground, I haven't
neglected to gather information.
If it's about this area, feel free to ask
anything.

MsgJp:
新たな情報でしょうか、それとも
何かお困りのことでも――？
MsgEn:
Is there any new information, or is there
something troubling you?

MsgJp:
メガドシスにおいて
アッカー家と覚者様をお支えすることが
第一の使命と考えております
MsgEn:
In Megado, our first and foremost mission is to
support the Acre family and the esteemed Arisen.

MsgJp:
まったく頭が痛くなることばかりですね
――いえ、頭痛持ちというわけでは
ありませんが
MsgEn:
Seems like nothing but headaches, doesn't it?
--Well, I don't mean I suffer from headaches, but
you get the idea.

MsgJp:
残念ながら、この状況です
十分な情報を提供できないのは
私も遺憾に思っています
MsgEn:
Unfortunately, this is the current situation.
Regretfully, I've naught else to provide.

MsgJp:
やるべきことをやるのみ
兵士とはそういったものです
MsgEn:
We do what we have to do.
That's what being a soldier is all about.

MsgJp:
メガドを取り戻せたのは僥倖です
――はやく王宮を奪還したいものです
私たちは、本来あそこにいるべきなのです
MsgEn:
It is a stroke of luck that we were able to
reclaim Megado.
I hope we can retake the Royal Palace soon.
That's where we should be, where we truly belong.

MsgJp:
王族を、王都をお守りするのが
我らメガド王宮近衛隊の使命――
一度その名が折れた悔しさを糧に
明日を切り開くのみです
MsgEn:
Our mission as the Megado Royal Guard is to
protect the Royal Family and the capital.
We must use the regret of our past failures as
fuel to carve out a path towards a brighter
future.

MsgJp:
王子を守りぬかねばなりません
何としても――
MsgEn:
We must protect the prince.
At all costs--

MsgJp:
覚者様のお噂、この北の地まで響いてまいりました
王子を――ネド王子を救い出してくださったとのこと
我々近衛隊一同、心よりの感謝を――
MsgEn:
Word has reached us, esteemed Arisen, that you
have come to this northern land and rescued Prince
Nedo.
The entirety of the Royal Guard expresses our
heartfelt gratitude for your noble deed.

MsgJp:
何かお力となりたいのですが、負傷者が多く
この場を動くことが叶わないのです
MsgEn:
I would like to be of assistance, but there are
many injured individuals, and I am unable to leave
this location.

MsgJp:
くっ――
倉庫から日用品の類をかき集めてまいります
せめてもの支給品とさせていただきたく――
MsgEn:
Hngh...
I shall gather some supplies from the warehouse
and provide them as at least some form of
support...

MsgJp:
無いよりはまし、といった程度かも
しれませんが――これが今お渡しできる品々です
どうかご武運を
MsgEn:
It may be little better than nothing, but this is
the extent of what I can offer you at the moment.
Please accept these items and may you have good
fortune in battle!

MsgJp:
ちょうど良いところにおいでくださいました
今週の支援品を準備していたのです
まだ十分とはいえませんが
ある程度は使えるかと――
MsgEn:
You have come at just the right time.
I was preparing this week's supplies.
It may not be enough, but should be useful to
some extent...

MsgJp:
覚者様、ぜひこちらをお持ちください
微力ながら、日々貴方を支援することが
王家の再興に繋がるとかたく信じております
MsgEn:
Dear Arisen, please take this with you.
I firmly believe that supporting you every day,
to the best of my abilities, will contribute to
the revival of the Royal Family.

MsgJp:
ハァ――各地にて苦境にある者からの
報告が絶えず舞い込んでくるのです
とはいえ、我々もこの有様――
MsgEn:
Haah... We are constantly receiving reports of
distress in various regions.
But even we are in this predicament...

MsgJp:
覚者様、どうか彼らにも
手を差し伸べてはいただけませんか？
その代わりにという訳ではありませんが、
稀少な素材が採れる場所をお伝えしましょう
MsgEn:
Dear esteemed Arisen, would you kindly extend a
helping hand to them as well?
It is not meant as compensation, but allow me to
share with you a location where rare materials can
be found.

MsgJp:
メガドを奪還するのであればニルビリス大橋を
確保すべきでしょう
この橋は城塞都市としての要の一つでもあります
MsgEn:
If we are to reclaim Megado, we should secure the
Great Nilviris Bridge.
This bridge is also one of the key points in our
fortress city.

MsgJp:
しかし、魔軍の連中もそのことは承知の上と見え
橋の防衛を強化しているようです
我々の戦力では突破は叶いませんが
覚者様であれば、あるいは――！
MsgEn:
However, it seems that the demon army is well
aware of this and has strengthened the defense of
the bridge.
With our current forces, breaking through is
impossible.
But if it's the Arisen, perhaps...!

MsgJp:
戦場にて共に戦えず、申し訳ありません
少しでも支援品を増やせるよう
兵たちにも物資の節約を呼びかけている次第です
MsgEn:
We regret that we cannot fight with you on the
battlefield.
We are also asking our soldiers to conserve
supplies so that we can increase our relief
supplies as much as possible!

MsgJp:
覚者様、ご無礼を承知で申し上げますが
見たところ、覚者様の武具はこの地の魔物には
少々不向きなご様子――
MsgEn:
Dear Arisen, please forgive my impoliteness, but
it seems that your equipment may be a little
unsuitable for the creatures of this land...

MsgJp:
良い素材が採れる場をご案内いたしましょう
魔物が徘徊する薄暗き水路ではありますが
覚者様であれば問題にはならないはずです
MsgEn:
Allow me to guide you to a place where you can
gather good materials.
It is a dimly lit waterway where monsters wander,
but it should not be a problem for an Arisen like
yourself.

MsgJp:
実は、悪しき竜による襲撃があった日――
同時にメガド市街に大勢のオークが姿を現したのです
城壁の外と内からの攻撃に、メガドは
一日と持ちませんでした
MsgEn:
On the day of the evil dragon's attack, a large
horde of Orcs simultaneously appeared in the
streets of Megado.
The city fell within a day, overwhelmed by
attacks from both inside and outside the walls.

MsgJp:
今思い返しても、それが妙でして――
悪しき竜の襲撃こそ突然だったものの、それまで
街の防衛に問題はなかったのです
MsgEn:
Even looking back on it now, it was strange—
The attack of the Evil Dragon was sudden, but
until then, there were no problems with the
defense of the town.

MsgJp:
いえ、仮に何者かが魔軍の侵入を手引きしたとして
それを察知できなかった近衛隊の落ち度ということに
変わりはありませんが――
MsgEn:
Even if someone aided the Demon Army's
infiltration, the fact remains that it was a lapse
in judgment on the part of the Royal Guard that
they failed to detect it.

MsgJp:
しかし、我々の情報収集能力とて
低くはないと自負しています
この規模となった今も、魔物が集まりつつある場は
把握しているのですから
MsgEn:
However, we take pride in our ability to gather
information.
Even now, at this scale, we are aware of the
areas where monsters are gathering.

MsgJp:
――我々は"メガド王宮近衛隊"
この都市と、王族をお守りするため編成されました
自力での奪還こそ叶いませんでしたが
再びここに立つことができ、感慨無量です
MsgEn:
We are the 'Megado Royal Palace Royal Guard',
organized to protect this city and the Royal
Family.
Although we were unable to recapture it on our
own, being able to stand here once again fills us
with overwhelming emotions.

MsgJp:
近衛隊元隊長ベイジル
そしてこれまでに散っていった隊員たちの魂も
我々と共に、今ここにあることでしょう
MsgEn:
Former Captain of the Royal Guard, Basil.
And the souls of the noble departed here with us,
now, in this very moment.

MsgJp:
時に――メガドには、王家の命により封鎖している
隠し扉がいくつか存在します
MsgEn:
By the way—Megado has several hidden doors sealed
by the orders of the Royal Family.

MsgJp:
しかし、この非常事態です
覚者様のお力無しに状況を打開できぬことは明白
王宮近衛隊隊長の名に於いて、全てを解放いたします
MsgEn:
However, in this state of emergency, it's clear
that we cannot overcome the situation without the
Arisen's power.
In the name of the Royal Guard's Captain, I
hereby release everything to you.

MsgJp:
城塞都市メガドが完全に"王都"として戻るまで
どうかお力をお貸しください
MsgEn:
Until the fortress city of Megado returns
completely to the "Royal Capital," please lend us
your strength.

MsgJp:
先日覚者様もご覧になったメガド回廊には
さらなる深部が存在します
MsgEn:
In the Megado Corridor, which the esteemed Arisen
has recently witnessed, there exists even deeper
sections.

MsgJp:
脅威となる魔物が跋扈していますが
それだけ、今まで調査の手が入らなかった
場でもあります――
つまり、それだけ貴重な素材が手に入るのです
MsgEn:
There are rampant threats from dangerous
monsters, which is why there hasn't been much
investigation in these areas until now.
In other words, it's an opportunity to obtain
valuable materials.

MsgJp:
異国の覚者様
これよりお話することは
他言無用にお願いいたします
MsgEn:
Master Arisen of a foreign land.
I implore you to keep what I am about to divulge
to you, a secret.

MsgJp:
王家――アッカー家の方々は
代々アッカーシェランを守護してこられました
しかし、輝かしき統治には――
陰となる部分があるのです
MsgEn:
The royal family, the Acres, have protected Acre
Selund from generation to generation.
However, even in the midst of their glorious
rule, there exists a shadow.

MsgJp:
無事のご帰還、お喜び申し上げます
アッカー家の統治無くしてアッカーシェランは無し
王家を守ることは、我らの国を守ることに
他なりません
MsgEn:
We are delighted to welcome your safe return.
Without the rule of House Acre, there would be no
Acre Selund.
Protecting the Royal Family is tantamount to
protecting our nation, nothing less.

MsgJp:
過去の古き傷ともいうべき魔物の征伐
王家に仕える者として最大の感謝を――
MsgEn:
Conquering the ancient wounds, so to speak, of
the monsters.
As a servant of the Royal Family, I am most
grateful--

MsgJp:
覚者様――我々も、再び困難に
立ち向かう覚悟はできています
MsgEn:
Master Arisen, we too are prepared to face
difficulties once again.

MsgJp:
悲観する者もいるでしょうが
ネド王子がご健在です
MsgEn:
There may be some pessimism about, but Prince
Nedo is alive and well.

MsgJp:
それに、我々兵士とて数は減ったものの
厳戒態勢を解いたわけではありません
すぐに動くことができますから
MsgEn:
Furthermore, although the number of soldiers may
have decreased, we have not lifted our state of
high alert. We can still move quickly.

MsgJp:
この世には、理解も及ばぬほどの
圧倒的な力があるのでしょうね
あの渦を見ていると、そう思わされます
MsgEn:
In this world, there is an overwhelming power
that eludes comprehension.
When I behold at that vortex, that's all I can
say.

MsgJp:
メガドの民は強いものです
――不安はあるでしょうが
生きようとしています
MsgEn:
The people of Megado are strong.
――Though they may have fears, they fight to
survive.

MsgJp:
ここまでよく来てくれた
薄暗いところだが、今のところは安全だ
少し足を休めていくといい
MsgEn:
You've come here quite far.
It's dimly lit, but for now, it's safe.
Take a moment to rest your legs.

MsgJp:
こんなことを言うのも気が引けるが
隠れ潜むのも楽なことではない――
寝床の代価として<VAL PRICE_INN>を
貰えないだろうか
MsgEn:
While I may be hesitant to say such things, it is
also not easy to beat around the bush—
Could I receive <VAL PRICE_INN> as compensation
for the use of my sleeping quarters?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
魔軍だらけのなか、よくぞ無事で
エリ警備塔まで辿り着いてくれた――
我々も数が減って寝床が余っている状態だ
自由に休んでいってくれ
MsgEn:
Amidst the sea of demon soldiers, it is truly
remarkable that you have safely made it to the Eli
Guard Tower.
We, too, have fewer numbers and more empty beds.
Please feel free to rest.

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
《弱化の治療》か――
治療には物資を使わねばならない
<VAL PRICE_WEAK>あれば
準備できるが、それでもいいのか？
MsgEn:
"Treat Weakness?"
Alas, the procedure requires resources.
If <VAL PRICE_WEAK> is available we can prepare,
but is that acceptable?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
《弱化の治療》は必要ないな
ここへ来るまでに治ったんだろう
MsgEn:
There is no need to "Treat Weakness."
You must have recovered before coming here.

MsgJp:
――シッ
外は魔物だらけだ
少し声を落としてくれ
MsgEn:
Shh, there be demons out there.
Lower your voice a little.

MsgJp:
王宮が――メガドが魔軍の手に堕ちた時――
一刻も早く周辺領の諸侯たちに伝えなければと
ひたすらに走ったんだ
MsgEn:
The Royal Palace—when Megado—fell into the hands
of the demon army, I ran tirelessly, knowing that
I had to inform the feudal lords of the
surrounding territories as soon as possible.

MsgJp:
だが、そうする必要も無いことに
すぐに気付いた
MsgEn: But soon I realized that I didn't have to.

MsgJp:
危機にあったのはメガドだけではなく――
戦火はアッカーシェラン全土から
上がっていたからな
MsgEn:
It was not just Megado that was in crisis -
the flames of war were rising from all over Acre
Selund.

MsgJp:
何が起ころうとも
メガドを見放さないと決めたのは
ドリス副隊長だ
――俺も同じ気持ちだった
MsgEn:
No matter what happens, Vice Captain Doris made
the decision to never abandon Megado.
I felt the same way.

MsgJp:
必要な物があれば手配しますよ
ここで手に入るものに限りますがね
MsgEn:
If there's anything you need, I can arrange it
for you.
It's limited to what we can get here, though.

MsgJp:
メガドが襲撃された際の戦闘で
足を負傷しまして――
未だに立っていられないんです
歩く時も支え無しでは難しいですね
MsgEn:
During the battle of Megado, I sustained an
injury to my leg--
I still can't stand, and even walking is
difficult without support.

MsgJp:
――私がいなければ
皆もっと身軽に動けるのかもしれません
こんなところでじっとしていなくても――
MsgEn:
...If I weren't here, everyone might be able to
move more freely.
We wouldn't have to stay still in a place like
this...

MsgJp:
王宮近衛隊の隊士として
選ばれた日のことは忘れません
――今後剣を持って戦える日は来ないでしょう
MsgEn:
As a member of the Royal Guard, I won't forget
the day I was chosen.
—But, it seems the day to wield a sword and fight
won't come again.

MsgJp:
体調が悪けりゃ隣のおばちゃんな
で、戦技についての相談なら俺だ
MsgEn:
If you're not feeling well, you can talk to the
lady next door.
And if you need advice on combat techniques, I'm
your guy.

MsgJp:
おっと、勘違いするなよ
一応俺も癒しの術は使えるんだ
これでもプリーストの端くれだからな
MsgEn:
Oops, I should clarify.
I can also use healing magic, you know.
After all, I'm still a priest, in a way.

MsgJp:
だけど、メガドまで帰ってきたんなら
ごちゃごちゃやるより
一眠りすりゃいいんだよ、何かと
MsgEn:
But if you've made it back to Megado, instead of
messing around, just take a nap or something.

MsgJp:
危険な任務に同行させられることが多くてさ
こうやってメガド守ってればいいってなると
逆にどうしていいかわからなくなるんだよなぁ
MsgEn:
I end up being sent off on dangerous missions a
lot.
When it comes to simply guarding Megado like
this, I start to feel lost, not knowing what to do
instead.

MsgJp:
――ってわけで
とりあえず戦技の相談に乗ってるんだ
まぁこれはこれで楽しいけど
MsgEn:
--For now, I'm just helping with tactics
discussions.
Well, it's fun in its own way though.

MsgJp:
まさかとは思うけど
同じアビリティを
いつでもどこでも付けっぱなし――
なんてしてないよな？
MsgEn:
I don't think so, but you're not constantly
keeping the same Augment on at all times, right?

MsgJp:
状況に合わせて付け替える！　これが鉄則！
じゃないと前線で生き残れないぞ
MsgEn:
Change it according to the situation! This is the
ironclad rule!
Otherwise, you won't survive on the front line.

MsgJp:
大変なことになっちまったよな
空が歪むなんて――
MsgEn:
It's become rather dire, hasn't it?
The sky distorting like this...

MsgJp:
俺もまた戦闘部隊に配属されるのかな
ここの手伝いも慣れてきたところなんだけど
MsgEn:
I guess I'll be assigned to a combat unit again.
I'm just getting used to helping out here.

MsgJp:
――ま、俺なんかが考えて
どうこうなるわけじゃない
MsgEn:
--Well, it's not like thinking about it will
change anything.

MsgJp:
俺は従うよ
あんたとか、うちの隊長とか
王家の人とかにさ
MsgEn:
I will obey, whether it's you, our captain, or
someone from the Royal Family.

MsgJp:
そこのおばちゃんが全然気にしてないっぽいから
なんか俺も気楽でいられるよ
MsgEn:
That old lady over there doesn't seem to be
bothered at all.
Somehow, that puts me at ease.

MsgJp:
覚者さま――
防具をお探しなら
いくつか見立てましょうか？
MsgEn:
Dear Arisen,
If you are looking for armor, shall we consider a
few options?

MsgJp:
メガドが王家の元に戻ったとはいえ
まだ、一般市民の生活を
取り戻すとまではいきませんね
MsgEn:
Although Megado has returned to the Royal Family,
we still have a long way to go before we can
restore the lives of our citizens.

MsgJp:
覚者さまも、居住層をぐるりと
散策されてはいかがでしょう
店も一通りは開いているようです
MsgEn:
How about taking a stroll around the Residential
Level, Ser Arisen?
It seems that most of the shops are open as well.

MsgJp:
私の他にもロスギルから
派兵されている兵士がいるはずです
何人残っているのかはわかりませんが
MsgEn:
There should be other soldiers deployed from
Rothgill besides me.
I don't know how many are left, though.

MsgJp:
あ、覚者さま――
やはり、空の渦のことで
アッカーシェランに――？
MsgEn:
Ah, Master Arisen...
So, it's about the vortex in the sky.
To Acre Selund, then?

MsgJp:
わからないことがありすぎて――
信じるしか、ありませんよね
MsgEn:
There are too many things that I don't
understand...
I have no choice but to believe, right?

MsgJp:
ロスギルからは、何の指示もありません
きっとこれまで通りメガドの再興に
協力せよとのことなのでしょう
MsgEn:
We've received no instructions from Rothgill.
I suppose it means that we should continue to
support the revival of Megado as we have been
doing.

MsgJp:
空の渦、少しずつ広がっていると聞きます
いずれ全てを飲み込むつもりなのでしょうか
MsgEn:
I hear that the vortex in the sky is slowly
spreading...
Will it soon engulf all that we know?

MsgJp:
――誰か詳しく説明してくれたら
いくぶんかは安心できると思うのですけど
MsgEn:
If someone could tell me what's going on, I think
I'd be able to relax.

MsgJp:
やぁ、覚者さんじゃないですか
僕にできることあればお手伝いしますよ
例えば人を集めてくるとか――
MsgEn:
Hey, are you not Arisen?
If there's anything I can do, I'll help you out.
For example, I'm good at getting people together!

MsgJp:
ふふ、いいですよねメガド
お姉さんもお兄さんも可愛がってくれるし
何かと――便利だし
MsgEn:
Hehe, Megado is really great, isn't it?
Everyone dotes on me and it's really convenient.

MsgJp:
覚者さんと話してみたいって人
多いんですよ――知ってました？
メガドを取り戻せたのも覚者さんの
お陰って、皆知ってますから！
MsgEn:
Did you know that there are many people who want
to talk to an Arisen?
It's because everyone knows that it's thanks to
Arisen like you that we were able to reclaim
Megado!

MsgJp:
覚者さんも飲みます？
何か取ってきましょうか？
MsgEn:
Something to drink, Arisen?
Shall I get you something?

MsgJp:
すみません、あの空の渦見てると
イライラしてきちゃうんです
大変なのに、僕なんかじゃ何もできないから――
MsgEn:
Sorry, but looking at that swirling vortex in the
sky just makes me feel frustrated.
It's so daunting, and I feel like I can't do
anything about it...

MsgJp:
メガドはどうなっちゃうんでしょう
――いや、メガドというより
アッカーシェランはどうなっちゃうんでしょう
MsgEn:
What will happen to Megado?
--No, nevermind Megado, what will happen to Acre
Selund?

MsgJp:
はぁ、せっかくここまで来たのに
あの渦に全部吸い込まれて
何もかもなくなって――なんて
ごめんですよ！
MsgEn:
Ah, even though we've come all this way, to be
sucked into that vortex and lose everything...
Ah, sorry!

MsgJp:
変な魔物、増えてるらしいですね
知り合いのお兄さんたちも
討伐に駆り出されていきましたよ
MsgEn:
I've heard that strange monsters are increasing
in number.
Even my friends' older brothers have been sent
out to defeat them.

MsgJp:
やっ、こんにちは
何か売る？　それとも買う？
MsgEn:
Oh, hello there!
Looking to trade?

MsgJp:
「あっ、アレが１個足りない！」なんて時に
わざわざ自力で調達しにいくなんて
ばからしいでしょ
買えばいいんだよ、買えば
MsgEn:
When you find yourself saying, "Oh, I'm missing
one of those!"
Why go to the trouble of procuring it yourself?
That's ridiculous, right?
Just buy it, that's all you have to do, just buy
it.

MsgJp:
あーうんうん、なるほど
ちょっと手持ちが足りないって顔してるね
そんなら売ろう、何か要らない物あるでしょ
それをバザーで売っちゃえばいいよ
MsgEn:
Ah, I see. You're making a face like you're a bit
short on funds.
If that's the case, why not sell something?
I'm sure you have something you don't need.
You can just sell it at the Bazaar.

MsgJp:
倉庫の整理にもバザー活用！
半端に残ったものはサクッと売っちゃってさ
必要な時に買えばいいんだよ
MsgEn:
Utilize the bazaar for organizing your storage!
Quickly sell off the leftover items, then just
buy what you need when necessary.

MsgJp:
なぁ、何か知ってたら教えてくれよ
怖い噂ばっか聞くんだよなぁ
MsgEn:
Hey, if you know anything, let me know.
All I hear are these fearful rumors.

MsgJp:
大丈夫だよ、きっと大丈夫
あ、倉庫の整理とかしとく？
ほら、万が一の時に――
ってすべてが滅んだらそれも意味ないか――
MsgEn:
It's okay, I'm sure everything will work out.
Ah, should I take care of organizing the storage?
You know, just in case something happens.
Although it wouldn't really matter if everything
is destroyed...

MsgJp:
空の渦が全部巻き込んで、中で
粉々に砕かれるんだって噂あるでしょ
あれ、本当だと思う？
俺は――まぁそんな感じだなって思うよ
MsgEn:
Rumor has it that the vortex sucks things up and
crushes it to pieces.
Do you think it's true?
I... kind of believe it.

MsgJp:
怖い噂は色々聞こえてくるけど
それを利用してやろうって奴が出てこないのは
やっぱアレかね、ドリスたちのおかげなのかね
MsgEn:
I hear all kinds of scary rumors, but I don't
hear anyone trying to take advantage of them.
I guess that's thanks to Doris and her friends.

MsgJp:
工房を使いたいんだって？
いいとも、ポーンの技術ってのを
間近で見るまたとない機会だからね
今日は何を作るんだ？
MsgEn:
You want to use the workshop, huh?
Well, it's a rare opportunity to see the skills
of the Pawns up close.
What are we going to make today?

MsgJp:
武具をきっちり準備して
技を磨き上げて戦場に出る！
やるべきことはそれだけ！
MsgEn:
Prepare your equipment meticulously, hone your
skills to perfection, then step bravely onto the
battlefield!
That's all you need to do!

MsgJp:
死ぬ気でやれば何とかなる！
ならない時は死ぬだけ！
MsgEn:
If you give it your all, you can make it work!
If you don't, you'll just end up dead!

MsgJp:
しかし、ポーンと人間の違いって何なんだ？
私なんかは相手が言葉を話すってだけで
人間として扱いたくなるんだけど
MsgEn:
But what's the difference between Pawns and
humans, really?
For me, just their conversation makes me inclined
to see them as humans.

MsgJp:
ん？　ああ、工房なら好きに使っていいよ
あの不気味な渦のことが気になってさ――
MsgEn:
Huh? Oh, if it's about the workshop, feel free to
use it however you like.
I'm just curious about that eerie vortex...

MsgJp:
魔物が攻めてくるっていうなら
やるべきこともわかるけど
空の渦なんて――やれること、あるのか？
MsgEn:
If it's an enemy attack I know what needs to be
done, but that vortex in the sky...
Is there anything we can do?

MsgJp:
まぁ、考えてもどうにもならないな！
死ぬ時は死ぬ、それだけ！
MsgEn:
Well, there's no use dwelling on it!
When it's time to die, it's time to die.
Simple as that!

MsgJp:
ここでじっとしてるのもなぁ
いっそ戦場に出たいくらいの気持ちだ
MsgEn:
Just sitting around here feels... well, I almost
wish I could be out on the battlefield.

MsgJp:
あら～、覚者さま
わたしに何かご用かしら
MsgEn: My, Arisen, what can I do for you?

MsgJp:
メガドに派兵されている人員は
それなりに戦える人ばかりだって話ですよ～
もう二度と、王都を落とされるわけには
いきませんものね
MsgEn:
The personnel being deployed to Megado are all
capable fighters, or so the story goes～
We can't afford to have the Royal Capital fall
again, after all.

MsgJp:
うふふ、覚者さまと
こうしてお話できるなんて光栄です
MsgEn:
Hehe, it's an honor to be able to talk with the
esteemed Arisen like this.

MsgJp:
え？　わたしの戦績？
これまでに始末してきた薄汚いオークの数――
数える趣味無くって
MsgEn:
Huh? My military record?
I've killed a lot of filthy Orcs--
I didn't have time to count.

MsgJp:
う～ん、これからも数えないと思います
そんな暇も無いですから
MsgEn:
Hmm, I don't think I'll have time to count from
now on.
I'm too busy for that.

MsgJp: また大変なことになりましたねぇ～
MsgEn:
Once again, things have become quite troublesome,
haven't they?

MsgJp:
諦めちゃだめだっていうのもわかりますけど
どうしようも無いことに
いつまでも抗って苦しむのも――
MsgEn:
I understand that giving up is not an option, but
constantly fighting and suffering over something
that cannot be changed...

MsgJp:
あの渦に巻き込まれて死ぬっていうのも――
オークに殺されるよりかはマシですから
MsgEn:
Dying by being caught up in that whirlpool...
It's better than being killed by an Orc, I
suppose.

MsgJp:
明日この世が終わるとしたら、ですよ
覚者さまなら何をします～？
MsgEn:
If tomorrow were the end of the world, what would
you do, Ser?

MsgJp:
ううん、覚者さまなら最後まで
竜のために戦ってそうですねぇ
MsgEn:
Well, Arisen, you'd fight for the dragon until
the bitter end, wouldn't you?

MsgJp:
――あんたもメガドにいられる間に
次の戦いへの備えを整えておくべきだな
MsgEn:
While you're at Megado, you ought to prepare for
the next battle.

MsgJp:
この辺りが一番門の状況を把握しやすい
あまり近くにいても、急な襲撃の時に
巻き込まれて戦えなくなるかもしれん
MsgEn:
This area is the best place to monitor the
situation at the gate.
Though if you're too close, you might get
ambushed.

MsgJp:
弟の仇討ちができるなら
どこにでも行くつもりだ
MsgEn:
If I can avenge my little brother's death, I'll
go anywhere.

MsgJp:
メガドを守っているより
オークを打ちのめしに行きたいんだが――
MsgEn:
Rather than protecting Megado, I want to go
pulverize the Orcs—

MsgJp:
あの空を見ろ！
落ち着いていられるか！
MsgEn:
Look at the sky!
How can I stay calm?!

MsgJp:
クソッ！
弟の仇討ちもできないままに
俺も死ぬのか！？
MsgEn:
Damn it all!
Am I going to die too without my revenge?

MsgJp:
あんたは何で涼しい顔してるんだ！？
いざとなった時には何か策でもあるのか！？
MsgEn:
Are you not affected!?
Have you a plan when the time comes!?

MsgJp:
今すぐ外に飛び出して
一匹でも多くオークを殺しに行きたい気分だ
ドリスが外に出ることを禁止してるらしいが
知ったことか！
MsgEn:
Right now, I must kill as many Orcs as I can.
Doris forbids us sortie, I don't care!

MsgJp:
はぁ――
あ、覚者様！　いえ、なんでもありません！
MsgEn:
Haah...
Oh, Ser Arisen! No, it's nothing!

MsgJp:
うぅ――また余計なことを言ってしまった――
どうしていつもこうなんだ――
MsgEn:
Ugh... I've gone and said something unnecessary
again... Why does this always happen...

MsgJp:
どうして後で気付くんでしょうね
「やっちまった」ってことに――
その場で気付けばまだやりようがあるのに
MsgEn:
Why do we always realize it later?
That we've made a mistake—
If only we had noticed it in the moment, there
would still be a way to fix it.

MsgJp:
はぁ――い、いえ、本当に大丈夫です
戦いとなれば気持ちを切り替えて
誰よりも敵を射抜いてみせますよ
MsgEn:
Haah... Yes, I assure you, everything will be
alright.
If it comes to battle, I will switch my mindset
and show you that I can strike through the enemy
better than anyone else.

MsgJp:
か、覚者様！　申し訳ございません！
自分、少々混乱しているようで
MsgEn:
Oh, esteemed Arisen! I deeply apologize for the
confusion.

MsgJp:
ああ～、このまま終わるのは嫌だ――
でも今から何ができるっていうんだ
MsgEn:
Ah, I don't want it to end like this...
But what can I do now?

MsgJp:
うぅ――あの空の渦に吸い込まれて
全部終わるだなんて――
そうとわかっていたら、もっと勇気を出して――
MsgEn:
Ugh... being sucked into that swirling vortex and
having it all end...
If only I'd known, I would've mustered up more
courage...

MsgJp:
彼女に嫌な奴だって思われたまま
死にたくない――うぅ――
MsgEn:
I don't want to die with her thinking I'm a
jerk-- Ugh--

MsgJp: はい、用件はなんです？
MsgEn: Yes, what can I do for you?

MsgJp:
何か異変があれば
この身に代えても周りに知らせる――
それが役目ですから
MsgEn:
If there's any disturbance, even if it costs me
my life, I'll make sure to alert everyone...
That's my duty.

MsgJp:
まぁ、居住層には子供も多いでしょう
あまり彼らを不安にさせたくはないですね
MsgEn:
Well, there will be a lot of children in the
Residential Level.
I don't want to alarm them too much.

MsgJp:
職人や商人も、メガドを諦めなかった
今ここに戻ってきている彼らを見ると
それを実感します
MsgEn:
The artisans and merchants didn't give up on
Megado either.
I realize that when I see them back here now.

MsgJp: "滅びの渦"というのですか、あれは
MsgEn:
The "Vortex of Stagnation," is that what you call
it?

MsgJp:
さすがは覚者さま
いかなる時も泰然としていらっしゃる
MsgEn:
As expected of the Arisen, always calm and
composed no matter the situation.

MsgJp:
我々護衛兵が慌てふためいては
民が不安がりますから
「何事も無いかのように振る舞え」と
隊長に言われています
MsgEn:
If us guards were to panic, the people would
become anxious.
So we have been told by the captain to behave as
if nothing is amiss.

MsgJp:
ネド王子やメイロワ将軍も
解決のために動いていらっしゃるのでしょう
であれば、信じて――これまで通り
メガドを守るのみです
MsgEn:
Prince Nedo and General Meirova are also surely
working towards a resolution.
Believe in them, and we shall protect Megado as
we have always done.

MsgJp:
何だよ――
英雄の覚者サマが俺に何か用か？
MsgEn:
What is it――
Ser Arisen, do you have something you need from
me?

MsgJp:
一般市民に見えるような服に
着替えた方がいいのか？
どうもこの服が気に入らねぇやつが
大勢いるみたいだな
MsgEn:
Should I change into clothes that make me look
like an ordinary citizen?
Seems like there are quite a few people who don't
like this outfit.

MsgJp:
このメガドで盗みを働こうなんて思ってねぇよ
何とか力になれってここに送られてきたんだ
その位の誇りはあるぜ
MsgEn:
I ain't looking to steal from Megado.
I was sent here to help somehow.
I have that much pride at least.

MsgJp:
どこで何してようが俺の勝手だろ
あんた俺を見張ってんのか？
MsgEn:
It's my business wherever I am and whatever I do,
isn't it?
Are you spying on me?

MsgJp:
闇に覆われるってどういうことだ！？
そうなったら俺たち――死ぬのか！？
MsgEn:
What does it mean the darkness will cover us?!
Does that mean we're gonna die?!

MsgJp:
なぁ、どっか逃げた方がいいのか！？
あんた、良い場所知ってたら教えてくれよ
そこのチビ連れて逃げるからさ
MsgEn:
Hey, should we run away!?
If you know a good place, tell me! I'll take the
kids there!

MsgJp:
こういう時、兵士だったら
情報が入ってくるのかも知れねぇけど
MsgEn:
If I were a soldier, maybe I'd have some
information coming in.

MsgJp:
一般市民には何も知らされないままだ
逃げた方がいいのかもわかんねぇよ
MsgEn:
The public is left in the dark.
I don't even know if I should run.

MsgJp:
一旦アジトに戻ろうか、それとも
その時間すらないのか――
MsgEn:
Shall we go back to the hideout, or do we even
have time for that...?

MsgJp:
ああ、あんたかい
調子どう？
MsgEn:
Oh, hey you.
How's it going?

MsgJp:
賑わってるようにも見えるけど
元のメガドに戻るまで
何年かかるんだろうね
MsgEn:
It may look bustling, but I wonder how many years
it will take to return to the original Megado.

MsgJp:
王子とあんたのためなら
もう一度命を懸けてもいいよ
MsgEn:
For the Prince and for thee, I shall gladly risk
my life again.

MsgJp:
アッカーシェランは火山の国だから
日によっては灰が降ってたり
空気が煙たかったりするだろ？
でも、体に悪影響は無いものだから安心して
MsgEn:
Acre Selund is a volcanic country, so there are
days when ash falls and the air is smoky.
But don't worry, it doesn't have any negative
effects on the body.

MsgJp:
"闇"って一体何なんだい？
あんたは"闇"の正体やら原因やら、知ってる？
MsgEn:
What exactly is the "darkness"?
Do you know what it is or what causes it?

MsgJp:
実のところ、ものすごく怖いよ
こうしている間にも状況が悪化して
何もわからないままに死ぬかもしれない――
MsgEn:
To be honest, it's really scary.
While we're doing this, the situation may worsen
and we might die without knowing anything--

MsgJp:
それに対して、何にもできないだろうって
わかってるのも怖いんだ
――こんなこと、あんたにしか言えないけどね
MsgEn:
It's also scary to know that there's nothing I
can do about it.
――I can only tell you this.

MsgJp: なにも、これからって時に――
MsgEn:
Right when it feels like there's nothing left to
do...

MsgJp:
あんたの顔見たら、少しだけ安心したよ
今回も何とかなるかもしれないって
思わせる不思議な何かがあるよね
MsgEn:
When I saw your face, I felt a little relieved.
There's an air about you that makes me think that
we might be able to make it through this time too.

MsgJp:
はぁ、傷の具合が――
しかし――この程度のこと――
MsgEn:
Haah...
the extent of the wounds...
But... something of this degree...

MsgJp:
負傷したところの近くを
また切られてしまい――
それからというもの、なかなか傷が
塞がらないのです
MsgEn:
Near the wounded area, I got cut again...
Since then, the wound just hasn't been healing
well.

MsgJp:
いえ、動けないほどの傷では――
しばらくゆっくりしていれば
またすぐ前線に出られます
MsgEn:
No, it's not a wound severe enough to
incapacitate me...
If I rest for a while, I'll be back on the front
lines soon enough.

MsgJp:
覚者殿は傷の治りが早くて
羨ましいことです
それもやはり竜の加護のおかげなのですか？
MsgEn:
Ser Arisen, it is truly enviable how quickly your
wounds heal.
Is it also thanks to the divine protection of the
dragon?

MsgJp:
ああ、覚者殿
やはり来てくださったのですね
MsgEn:
Oh, Master Arisen.
I knew you'd come.

MsgJp:
覚者殿はきっと私には想像もつかないほど
たくさんのものを
ご覧になってきたのですよね
MsgEn:
Master Arisen, you must have seen so many things
that I can't even imagine.

MsgJp:
――竜が不在のまま
うまくいっている大陸を
ご覧になったことはありますか？
MsgEn:
--Have you ever witnessed a continent thriving
without the presence of dragons?

MsgJp:
この大陸を護ってくださる竜がいないから
こんなことが起きるのだと
――そう思ってしまうこともあります
MsgEn:
Because there are no dragons protecting this
continent, such things happen.
Sometimes, I can't help but think that.

MsgJp:
オークどもとの戦いで受けた傷が
いまだに塞がらないのです
気持ちが落ち込んでいるせいでしょうか
MsgEn:
The wounds I sustained in the battle against the
Orcs are still not healing.
Could it be due to my lack of spirit?

MsgJp:
はい――な、なんでしょう
何か不手際でも――
MsgEn:
Yes? W-What is it?
Did I make a mistake or something?

MsgJp:
オークが怖いとか、戦場に出たくないという
わけじゃないんですけど――
MsgEn:
It's not that I'm scared of Orcs or that I don't
want to be on the battlefield, but...

MsgJp: あの、特に面白い話もできませんが――
MsgEn: Pardon, I've naught to say...

MsgJp:
唯一、剣技だけは人よりできるのが
救いでしたね、僕の場合は
MsgEn:
The only thing I excel at is swordsmanship.
That was my saving grace, in my case.

MsgJp:
か、覚者さま！？
やっぱり、状況はそれほどに悪いんですか！？
MsgEn:
Oh ser, are you an Arisen!?
Is the situation really that bad!?

MsgJp:
このままだと世界が滅ぶって聞きました
あまりに恐ろしくて――
恐ろしすぎて、よくわからないんです
MsgEn:
I heard that if things continue like this, the
world will be destroyed.
How terrifying...
It's all too much, I really don't understand.

MsgJp:
この前は「国が滅ぶ」だったのに
今度は「世界が滅ぶ」って言われても――
MsgEn:
Last time it was "the country is dying" and now
they're saying "the world is dying"--

MsgJp:
はぁ、こんなことなら
故郷でひっそりと畑でも耕していればよかった
MsgEn:
Haah... if only I had quietly cultivated a field
in my hometown instead.

MsgJp: どうした、何か気になることでもあるのか？
MsgEn: What's wrong? Something bothering you?

MsgJp:
メガドが戻ったとはいえ
外は魔物だらけ、王宮層も壊滅状態だ
気が抜けないな
MsgEn:
Even though Megado has returned to us, the
outside is filled with enemies, and even the Royal
Palace is in a state of devastation.
I can't let my guard down.

MsgJp:
――メガドの観光案内でもしてほしいのか？
すまんが、手が空くまで待ってくれ
MsgEn:
...You want me to show you the sights of Megado?
Sorry, you'll have to wait until I'm available.

MsgJp:
そういえば、盗賊がウロウロしているんだ
持ち物には気を付けた方がいい
MsgEn:
Come to think of it, there are bandits hanging
about.
Take stock of what you bring with you.

MsgJp: こんなことになるとは――
MsgEn: I never thought it would come to this...

MsgJp:
悪しき竜の次は、空の渦か
すまない、あんたにメガドの案内を
する暇も無かったな
MsgEn:
First an evil dragon, now a vortex in the sky.
Sorry, I don't have time to give you a tour of
Megado.

MsgJp:
住民の混乱が起こらないように――
これを第一に行動すべし、とのお達しだ
MsgEn:
The directive is clear: the first priority is to
prevent panic amongst the residents.

MsgJp:
自分が兵士であることは承知の上だが
何とか此度も生き残りたい――
圧倒的な力を前にすると、そう思ってしまう
MsgEn:
I know that I'm a soldier, but I still wish to
live...
When faced with such overwhelming power, I cannot
help this.

MsgJp:
まずは一杯いかが？
料理も手軽につまめるものから
しっかり食べられるものまで！
MsgEn:
How about a drink first?
We offer a wide variety of dishes, from easy
snacks to well-prepared meals!

MsgJp:
今って、ちょっとした屋台や
食堂なんかも無いから
お腹が減った人は皆ここに来るわね
お陰で顔が広くなったわ
MsgEn:
Nowadays, there aren't even small food stalls or
cafés around.
Anyone hungry comes here to me.
Thanks to that, I've gained quite the notoriety.

MsgJp:
うちで扱ってるお酒は
強めのものが多いから
飲みすぎには気を付けてね
MsgEn:
I serve many a strong brew, so be careful not to
drink too much!

MsgJp:
私のおすすめは《特選キノコディップ》ね
手軽に食べられて、つまみにもなるの
MsgEn:
I recommend the 《Special Mushroom Dip》
It's easy to eat and makes a great snack!

MsgJp:
あら――今、それどころじゃ――
ううん、こんな時だからこそ
食べて力を付けてもらわないとね
MsgEn:
Oh... Right now, that's not the...
No, it's precisely because of times like these
that we need to eat well and gain strength.

MsgJp:
みんなとっても怖がってるわ
空にあんなものがあったんじゃ
どこかへ逃げるってわけにもいかないもの
MsgEn:
Everyone is really scared.
Having something like that in the sky...
We can't just run away somewhere.

MsgJp:
不安なのか、常連さんたちもピリピリしてて
ちょっとしたことで口げんかになることもあるの
おかげで仲裁が上手くなっちゃったわ
MsgEn:
They seem anxious, but the regulars are all on
edge these days.
They argue over the smallest things.
Because of that, I've gotten pretty good at
mediating disputes.

MsgJp:
もしも口げんかから
殺し合いになんてなったらと思うと――
それはそれで、手が震えるほど恐ろしいわ
MsgEn:
If a simple argument were to escalate into a
deadly fight...
I can't help but tremble at the thought...
'Twould be dreadful.

MsgJp:
ここに顔を出してくれてありがとう
なんだかほっとしちゃった
あなたがいるんだもの、まだ大丈夫よね
MsgEn:
Thank you for showing up, somehow it put my mind
at ease.
With you here, everything will be alright, won't
it?

MsgJp:
覚者様――
さて、どういったお話で？
MsgEn:
Ser Arisen--
Well, what's the story?

MsgJp:
メガドの傷はまだ癒えてはおりませんな
――どこかに膿でも溜まっているかもしれません
MsgEn:
The wounds of Megado have not yet healed...
There may still be bile springing up somewhere.

MsgJp:
生き残った若者たちが
怨みの感情だけで命を散らすようなことの
ないように――そのためにこの老いぼれが
いるのやもと思っております
MsgEn:
I believe that this old fool is here is trying to
prevent the surviving youngsters from giving up
their lives due to feelings of resentment alone...

MsgJp:
メガドは大きな街です
ここで暮らしてきたわし自身
この街を知り尽くしてはおりません
MsgEn:
Megado is a large place.
Despite living here myself, I don't know this
city inside out.

MsgJp:
おお、覚者様――
滅びの渦が、メガドにも――
MsgEn:
O, Arisen...
The Vortex of Stagnation has reached even
Megado...

MsgJp:
この老いぼれの身など、どうでもいいのです
ただ若者たちが心配で――
あの渦に狂わされないと良いのですが
MsgEn:
I don't care what happens to this old body.
I just worry about the young people--
I hope that vortex doesn't drive them crazy.

MsgJp:
覚者様、お忙しいことは承知の上で申し上げます
どうか、どうか、街の者にお声掛けください
それだけでいくらかは落ち着くでしょうから
今、滅びの渦を恐れぬ者はおりません――
MsgEn:
Ser Arisen, I understand that you're busy, but
please, please, reach out to the people of the
city.
Just that would bring some peace of mind.
Right now, there's no one who isn't afraid of the
Vortex of Stagnation...

MsgJp:
禍々しい空です
街では、渦に大陸ごと飲み込まれるのだとか
渦から強大な魔物が現れるのだとか
そういった噂が流れております
MsgEn:
The sky looks ominous.
There are rumors in the city about the continent
being swallowed by the vortex, and that powerful
monsters are emerging from it.

MsgJp:
実際のところは、どうなのでしょう
覚者様ならば何かご存じなのでは――
MsgEn:
In fact, I'm sure the Arisen would know something
about it...

MsgJp:
あっ、覚者さま
こんなところでどうしたんですか？
MsgEn:
Ah, Arisen.
What brings you to this place?

MsgJp:
覚者さまには助けていただきましたから！
僕も何かしたくてメガドに来たんです
MsgEn:
Due to your aid, Arisen, I have come to Megado
because I wanted to help too!

MsgJp:
解放軍に入ってもいいかなと思ったんですけど
やっぱりああいうのって向いてなくて――
MsgEn:
I thought about joining the Liberation Army, but
I realized that it's just not suited for me...

MsgJp:
――この街、意外と子供が多いですよね
親はいるのかな
MsgEn:
――There are a lot of children in this town,
aren't there?
I wonder if they have parents.

MsgJp:
覚者さま！
あの空の渦、消えますよね？！
MsgEn:
Ser Arisen!
That vortex in the sky, it will disappear, won't
it?

MsgJp:
どっ、どうしよう
今から故郷に帰っても間に合うと思いますか？
最後に親の顔を見ておきたいんですが――
MsgEn:
Oh no, what should I do?
Do you think I can make it back to my hometown in
time?
I really want to see my parents' faces one last
time...

MsgJp:
覚者さまみたいになりたくて
それでメガドに来たんです
何もできないまま終わりたくない！
MsgEn:
I wanted to be like the Arisen.
That's why I came to Megado.
I don't want to end up doing nothing!

MsgJp: 僕、何をしたらいいですか！？
MsgEn: What should I do?!

MsgJp: ――ん？　あんた、覚者さまか
MsgEn: Oh? Are you an Arisen, perhaps?

MsgJp:
俺は田舎の出だが
もう十年はメガドで暮らしている――
MsgEn:
I'm from the country, but I've been living in
Megado for a decade now--

MsgJp:
俺の築いたもの全てがメガドにあるんだ
メガドを諦めるつもりはない
どんな状況になろうとな
MsgEn:
Everything I have built is here.
I have no intention of giving up on Megado, no
matter what the conditions may be.

MsgJp:
――顔色が悪い？
気にしないでくれ
MsgEn:
... I look pale?
Don't worry about it.

MsgJp:
溜息を吐いて初めて、自分が
疲れ果てていることに気付いたよ
MsgEn:
It wasn't until I let out a sigh that I realized
I was completely exhausted!

MsgJp: 失礼、少し考え事を――
MsgEn: Excuse me, I was lost in thought for a moment...

MsgJp:
逃げられなかった者たちは
一体どうなったのか――
MsgEn: What happened to those who couldn't escape--

MsgJp:
考えたくはありませんが
我々は向かい合わねばならないのです
MsgEn: I hate to think about it, but we have to face it.

MsgJp:
前を向いて進むために
敢えて振り返らなくては――
MsgEn: To look forward, we must dare to look back--

MsgJp: 今できることを、やろうと思います
MsgEn: I'm going to do what I can right now.

MsgJp:
あ、覚者さん
こんにちは――
MsgEn: Oh, hello, Arisen--

MsgJp:
盗賊のお兄さんがメガドに
連れてきてくれたんです
あたしの村は焼けちゃったから
MsgEn:
My bandit brother brought me to Megado because my
village was burnt down.

MsgJp: 雑貨屋さんなら、店番で雇ってくれないかなぁ
MsgEn:
I wonder if a general store would hire me as a
shopkeeper.

MsgJp:
これからどうするのか、なんて聞かないで
ううん――覚者さんがパパやママの代わりを
してくれるなんて思ってないから、大丈夫
MsgEn:
Don't ask what I'm going to do from now on.
No, I don't expect you, Arisen, to replace my
parents.
It's okay.

MsgJp:
ハ～イ、ステキな覚者さん
もっと輝いてみない？
気分転換にもいいわよぉ
MsgEn:
Hey there, lovely Arisen.
How about I help you shine even brighter?
It's good to keep it fresh, you know.

MsgJp:
人のお洒落をお手伝いするのって
とってもワクワクするの
MsgEn: Helping others refashion is always so exciting!

MsgJp:
だって、あたしの技術で"人"が変わるのよ
ふふっ、スリルあるでしょぉ？
――わからない？
MsgEn:
After all, my techniques change people.
Hehe, isn't that thrilling?
-- You feel me?

MsgJp:
今の気分やお気に入りの装備に合わせて
メイクや髪型を変えてみない？
お洒落はトータルバランスが大事なのよぉ
MsgEn:
Why don't you try changing your makeup and
hairstyle to match your current mood and favorite
equipment?
In fashion, overall balance is important, you
know.

MsgJp:
似合わないスタイルがあるって――諦めてない？
ちょっと調整するだけで
似合うようになるんだからぁ！
MsgEn:
Have you given up on a style that doesn't suit
you?
Just a little adjustment is all it takes to make
it look good!

MsgJp:
"諦め"はお洒落ゴコロの敗北よ
"挑戦"こそお洒落の真髄ってねぇ
MsgEn:
"Giving up" is the defeat of stylish spirit,
while "taking on challenges" is the very essence
of style, you know.

MsgJp:
うんうん、もっとイイ感じにしちゃいましょ！
スタイリングは<COL b92828><UNTN GS></COL> <VAL PRICE_PARLOR_GP>よ
声やポーンの喋り方なんかはオマケするから
気軽に変えてみてねぇ
MsgEn:
Yeah, yeah, let's make it better!
The styling is <COL b92828><UNTN GS></COL> <VAL PRICE_PARLOR_GP>.
I'll do the voice and Pawn speech as a freebie.
Feel free to change it!

MsgJp:
うんうん、もっとイイ感じにしちゃいましょ！
スタイリングは<COL b92828><UNTN GS></COL> <VAL PRICE_PARLOR_GP>よ
今なら特別に<COL b92828><UNTN TK></COL> <VAL PRICE_PARLOR_TK>でも大丈夫！
声やポーンの喋り方なんかはオマケするから
気軽に変えてみてねぇ
MsgEn:
Alright, alright! For styling, you can pay with
<COL b92828><UNTN GS></COL> <VAL PRICE_PARLOR_GP>.
And for a limited time only, you can also get it 
for <COL b92828><UNTN TK></COL> <VAL PRICE_PARLOR_TK>!
We'll even throw in voice and Pawn dialogue
changes as a bonus, so feel free to customize to
your heart's content!

MsgJp:
えっ、どこどこ？
――ねぇ、あなたポーンと契約してないんじゃない？
ポーンって確か、リムストーンを集めて
契約の儀式しないといけないのよぉ
MsgEn:
Huh, where now?
Hey, you haven't contracted a pawn, have you?
I think you have to gather Riftstones and perform
a ritual to contract a pawn.

MsgJp:
ポーンと契約したら、いつかその子のことも
あたしにスタイリングさせてねぇ
MsgEn:
If you sign a contract with a pawn, you should
let me style them someday, ok?

MsgJp:
わかるわ！　いいわよねぇ、燃えるわよねぇ
<COL b92828><UNTN GS></COL> <VAL PRICE_REBORN_GP>ポッキリで
とびきりステキになるようにお手伝いしちゃう！
MsgEn:
Alright! It's great, isn't it?
It's so exciting!
Let me help you become absolutely fabulous, it's
only <COL b92828><UNTN GS></COL><VAL PRICE_REBORN_GP>!

MsgJp:
わかるわ！　いいわよねぇ、燃えるわよねぇ
いつもは<COL b92828><UNTN GS></COL> <VAL PRICE_REBORN_GP>もらってるんだけど
今だけ特別に<COL b92828><UNTN TK></COL> <VAL PRICE_REBORN_TK>でも大丈夫よ
とびきりステキになるようにお手伝いしちゃう！
MsgEn:
Alright! Great, right? It's burning up in here!
I usually take <COL b92828><UNTN GS></COL> <VAL PRICE_REBORN_GP>,
but for now, it's also okay to use <COL b92828><UNTN TK></COL> <VAL PRICE_REBORN_TK> as a special offer.
I'll help you become absolutely fabulous!

MsgJp:
あはは、<COL b92828>男性か女性専用のアイテム</COL>を装備したままだと
転生したところで合う服が無くなっちゃう！
専用品ははずしてから来てねぇ
MsgEn:
Haha, if you leave your <COL b92828>male or
female</COL> exclusive items equipped, they won't
fit when you reincarnate!
Take off the exclusive items before you come!

MsgJp:
大変よね、わかるわぁ
こんな時こそ気合入れなきゃ、でしょぉ？
MsgEn:
It's tough, I know.
It's times like this when you have to keep your
spirits up, right?

MsgJp:
まかせて！
いつも以上に気合が入るように
ばっちりコーディネートしちゃうんだから
MsgEn:
Leave it to me!
I'll give it my all, more than ever before, and
coordinate everything perfectly.

MsgJp:
ポーンのメイクや髪型なんかも
変えていかない？
気合の入ったポーンを連れていれば
力が湧いてくるかもしれないわよぉ
MsgEn:
Why don't you change your pawn's makeup and hair?
Having a pawn with some spunk might give you a
boost!

MsgJp:
いついかなる時でも、おしゃれは必要よぉ
"その時々に合わせたおしゃれ"ってやつ！
MsgEn:
No matter when, fashion is always necessary, you
know!
It's all about dressing for the occasion!

MsgJp:
ああ、珍しい物を持ってるね
鑑定交換してみないかい？
MsgEn:
Ah, you have something rare.
Would you like to exchange appraisal items?

MsgJp:
珍しいものを欲しがる貴族は多いんだよ
役に立たないものでもやたらと集めたがったりね
おかしな人たちだろ
MsgEn:
There are a lot of aristocrats who want rare
things, even if they're not useful.
They're funny people, aren't they?

MsgJp:
若い頃に貴族の屋敷で世話になってたんだ
お陰で見る目だけは養われたよ
MsgEn:
I was raised in a nobleman's mansion when I was
young, and it gave me a good eye for this line of
work.

MsgJp:
鑑定の結果が君の気に入るものに
なるかはわからないけど――
でも、価値のわからないまま
持ち続けるよりはいいと思うな
MsgEn:
I don't know if the result of the appraisal will
be to your liking, but...
I think it's better than holding onto something
without knowing its value.

MsgJp:
――"滅びの渦"か
ああ、ごめん
いつもの鑑定交換かな？
MsgEn:
"Vortex of Stagnation," huh?
Ah, sorry. Is this our usual appraisal exchange?

MsgJp:
すべてが滅びてしまうって言われてるね
本当かな――確かに、あの空は不気味だけど
MsgEn:
I've heard it said that everything will perish.
I wonder if it's true... Certainly, 'tis a woeful
sky.

MsgJp:
この際、滅びた方がいいものも
あるかもしれないよね
MsgEn:
In these circumstances, perhaps there are some
things that are better off destroyed.

MsgJp:
真価を発揮させないまま
諸共に消え失せてしまうなんて
もったいないと思わないかい
MsgEn:
'Twould be a shame to let them all disappear
without realizing their full potential.

MsgJp:
白き竜の覚者よ
あなたとあなたの竜のため、祈りましょう
MsgEn:
Arisen of the White Dragon, let us pray, for you
and the dragon.

MsgJp:
白き竜――
とても長い間生きている竜のよう
MsgEn:
The White Dragon—
it seems to have lived for a very long time.

MsgJp:
アッカーシェランの竜とは
生まれ方が異なるのですね
MsgEn:
The Dragon of Acre Selund seems to have a
different origin.

MsgJp:
《復活力》の加護は
1度に3回分授けられます
大切になさってください
MsgEn:
The Divine Protection of "Revival Power" can be
bestowed 3 times at once.
Cherish it well.

MsgJp:
かすかに――白き竜以外の竜力も感じます
どうしてでしょう、不思議な方ですね
MsgEn:
Faintly... I can feel Dragon Force, not just from
the White Dragon.
Why could that be? You're quite mysterious.

MsgJp:
竜よ、覚者を加護する竜よ
三たびの苦難に見舞われようと
立ち上がる力をこの者に――
MsgEn:
