O dragon, bestow your divine protection upon the
Arisen.
Even if they are struck by adversity thrice,
Grant them the strength to stand once more—

MsgJp:
今のあなたには、さらなる
《復活力》の加護は不要でしょう
ご武運を――
MsgEn:
You have no need of more "Revival Power" at this
point.
Good fortune to you.

MsgJp:
今この時に新たな復活力を授かるということは
残っている復活力を捨てることになります
それでも良いのですね？
MsgEn:
Accepting the grace of "Revival Power" at this
moment will mean discarding any remaining charges
you have.
Are you sure you want to proceed?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
白き竜の覚者よ
残念ですが、すでに本日の《復活力》の加護を
受け取っておいでですね
MsgEn:
O Arisen of the White Dragon.
Unfortunately, it seems that you have already
received today's Divine Protection of "Revival
Power".

MsgJp:
では、今日も大いなる竜のご加護が
あらんことを――
MsgEn:
May the great Divine Protection of the Dragon be
with us today as well...

MsgJp:
覚者様、こちらが本日分の
任証スタンプと支給品でございます
どうぞお受け取りください
MsgEn:
Ser Arisen, here are today's stamps and supplies.
Please accept them.

MsgJp:
ええ、覚者様は本日分の
任証スタンプと支給品を
すでにお持ちのご様子――
ご武運を
MsgEn:
Yes, it appears that you, Ser Arisen, already
have today's stamp and supplies in your
possession.
May the fortunes of war be with you.

MsgJp:
おめでとうございます！
覚者様の日頃のご活躍に対し
特別な任証スタンプと支給品が届いております
MsgEn:
Congratulations and thank you for your daily
support!
You have received a special stamp and supplies
for your continued service.

MsgJp:
さぁ、どうぞお受け取りください
覚者様の旅路にさらなる竜の祝福があらんことを
MsgEn:
Now, please take it.
May there be further blessings of the dragon on
the journey of the esteemed Arisen.

MsgJp:
今、アッカーシェランを守護する竜はおりません
白き竜の覚者よ、この地の者は
あなたを頼るほかないのです
MsgEn:
There is no longer any dragon protecting Acre
Selund.
Arisen of the White Dragon, the people of this
land have naught else to turn but you.

MsgJp:
私にできることは祈ることのみ
絶え間なくあなたの勝利を――
理の勝利を祈りましょう
MsgEn:
The only thing I can do is pray.
Unceasingly, I pray for your victory—
I pray for the victory of order.

MsgJp:
大いなる加護が
あなたにあらんことを
MsgEn: May the great Divine Protection be with you.

MsgJp:
どんな武器をお望みで？
色々と取り揃えてはおりますから
いくつか手に取ってみてください
MsgEn:
What kind of weapon you looking for?
We have a wide selection, feel free to heft them.

MsgJp:
地方の拠点からも、メガドを護るためと
兵士が派遣されてきているんです
おかげで早々に店を立て直すことができましたが――
MsgEn:
Even from our regional bases, soldiers have been
sent to protect Megado.
Thanks to them, we were able to get the store
back up and running as soon as possible, but--

MsgJp:
良品を扱っているつもりですが
覚者さまほどの方に
気に入っていただける品があるかどうか
MsgEn:
I believe I handle quality products, but I wonder
if there are items that would please even a person
of your caliber, Ser Arisen.

MsgJp:
メガドは――どうです？
異国からいらした覚者さまから見て――
MsgEn:
Megado, how do you like it?
From the perspective of a wise visitor from a
foreign land...

MsgJp:
覚者さま！
あの渦は――アッカーシェランは
どうなってしまうのでしょう
MsgEn:
Ser Arisen!
That vortex - what will happen to Acre Selund?

MsgJp:
メガドがかつてのようなにぎわいを
取り戻す日を、心待ちにしていたんです
MsgEn:
I've been looking forward to the day when Megado
will return to the bustling atmosphere it once
had!

MsgJp:
こんなことになるなんて――
言葉がありません
MsgEn:
I can't believe it has come to this... I have no
words.

MsgJp:
店を開けてはいるものの
空のことばかりが気になります
MsgEn:
Although the shop is open, I can't help but be
preoccupied with the sky.

MsgJp:
ん？　なんだなんだ
武具をもっと強くすることに
興味があるのか？
MsgEn:
Huh? What's this about?
Are you interested in making your equipment
stronger?

MsgJp:
ふっふっふ！
人間の鍛冶屋として
「ポーンのクラフト技術が最高」と
言われているのがしゃくでな
MsgEn:
Heh heh heh!
As a human blacksmith, it chafes me to hear that
'Pawn craftsmanship is the best.'

MsgJp:
ポーンにできないことをやってやろうと
あらゆる鍛冶の知識を漁ってきたんだわい
MsgEn:
I've been scouring every bit of blacksmithing
knowledge I could find to do what pawns can't.

MsgJp:
ドワーフオークは鍛冶に長けとるでな
もちろん奴らの技術も研究したぞ
――だが《戦甲》については予想外だったなぁ
MsgEn:
Dwarf Orcs sure have a knack for blacksmithing,
ya know.
Of course, I've also studied their techniques.
But I must say, their "Battle Armor" was quite
unexpected.

MsgJp:
あんたにも
"思い入れがあって捨てられない武具"
ってやつがあるだろう
そういう武具にもう一度陽の目を見せてやらんか？
MsgEn:
There must be equipment that you've grown
attached to and cannot simply discard, right?
Wouldn't you like to give such equipment another
chance to see the light of day?

MsgJp:
ほうほう、なかなかの武具だ
こいつを土台にするんだな！
MsgEn:
Ah, this is quite a formidable piece of
equipment. We'll use this as our foundation!

MsgJp:
慌てるな、慌てるな――
まずは手の届く範囲、目に見える範囲から
そう、武具の強化だわい
MsgEn:
Don't panic, don't panic—
First, start with what's within reach, what you
can see.
Yes, it's about strengthening your equipment.

MsgJp:
大地の竜力は吸い上げられ
恐ろしい魔物が現れているそうだな
太刀打ちできる武具を鍛えねばなるまい
MsgEn:
The Dragon Force is being siphoned from the land,
and fearsome creatures are emerging.
We must forge weapons capable of standing against
them.

MsgJp:
あんたを信じているからな
逃げも隠れもせん
ここで、今までどおり武具を鍛えるまで
MsgEn:
I trust you, so I won't flee or hide.
I'll stay here and forge weapons just as I always
have, until the end.

MsgJp:
これまでで一番の武具が必要になる
そして、そのためにはわしの力が必要
――そうだろう？　ワッハッハ
MsgEn:
The need for the best weapons we've ever had
arises, and for that, my strength is required—
Am I right? Wahahaha!

MsgJp: どうした、何か不都合でもあるのか？
MsgEn: What's wrong, something the matter?

MsgJp:
具合が悪いならそう言え
タダでとはいかないが
<VAL PRICE_INN>で寝床を用意してやる
どうだ、休んでいくのか？
MsgEn:
If you're feeling unwell, just say so.
It won't be for free, but I can provide you with
a place to sleep at <VAL PRICE_INN>.
So, will you take a rest?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
具合が悪いなら寝床を用意してやる
ま、あんたみたいな人間が普段寝てるような
静かで柔らかい寝床じゃあないがな
――それでもいいか？
MsgEn:
If you're feeling unwell, I'll prepare a sleeping
area for you.
Well, it won't be the kind of quiet and soft bed
that someone like you usually sleeps in, though.
Is that still alright?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
《弱化の治療》か
<VAL PRICE_WEAK>払えるっていうなら
ここで治してやるぜ
手持ちの金は十分か？
MsgEn:
If you can pay <VAL PRICE_WEAK>, then I'll treat
your weakness right here.
Have you that on hand?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
――面白くもない冗談はやめろ
そういうことをやってると
本当に《弱化》した時に困るぞ
MsgEn:
--Stop with the unfunny jokes.
If you keep doing things like that, you'll really
be in trouble when you're actually weakened.

MsgJp:
ここで寝ようと思ったら
人の話し声や足音は絶えねぇうえに
誰かが食ってる飯の臭いはするしで
最初は苦労するかもしれねぇな
MsgEn:
If you're thinking of sleeping here, know this.
You'll be hearing conversation and footsteps all
through the night, and you'll catch the smell of
someone eating.
It may be tough at first.

MsgJp:
でも、慣れるとそれが
"安心する物音"になるんだ
不思議だろ
MsgEn:
But once you get used to it, that becomes a
"reassuring sound".
Strange, isn't it?

MsgJp:
おい、外に出たら
また魔軍との戦いだろうが
準備は万端にしていけ
MsgEn:
Hey, listen up!
Once you step outside, you'll be facing the demon
horde again.
Make sure you're fully prepared.

MsgJp:
言っておくが、お前の心配をしてるんじゃない
アッカーシェランの心配をしてるんだ
お前には万全の状態で出発してもらわないと困る
MsgEn:
I'll tell you this, but I'm not worried about you.
I'm worried about Acre Selund.
I need you departing in perfect condition.

MsgJp:
ん？　何か欲しいものでもあるのか？
きっちり金を払っていくってんなら
いくらでも分けてやるよ、へへへ
MsgEn:
Hm? What is it you desire?
If you're willing to pay, I've plenty to share
with you, hehehe.

MsgJp:
ハハハ――
俺たちから盗もうなんて思うなよ
そうなったら、盗り戻すまでだからな
MsgEn:
Hahaha!
Don't even think about stealing from us 'cause if
you do, we'll take it right back.

MsgJp:
まぁ、くつろいでいけよ
セロがあんたを受け入れたんなら
俺らがどうこう言うものでもないからさぁ
MsgEn:
Well, just relax and make yerself at home.
If Cyril's good with ya, then we've no right to
say nothing.

MsgJp:
普段何をして暮らしてるか？
へへ、あんた面白いこと言うじゃないか
盗賊にそんなこと聞くもんじゃないよ
MsgEn:
What do you do for a living?
Heh, you're funny.
You shouldn't ask such things to a thief.

MsgJp:
同行する仲間が必要なのか？
俺が手配してやってもいいが――
お前が俺を信じるなら、だな
MsgEn:
Need a companion to accompany you?
I can arrange it for you--
if you trust me.

MsgJp:
何も盗賊を集めてきて
お前と一緒に旅をさせようってんじゃない
安心しろ
MsgEn:
I'm not gathering a bunch of bandits to go on a
journey with you.
Don't worry.

MsgJp:
アーシェって娘を見たか？
あの子はセロの実の娘でな――
見かけたら様子を見てやってくれ
MsgEn:
Have you seen Ashe, Cyril's daughter?
She's not actually his biological daughter
though.
If you happen to see Ashe, keep an eye on her.

MsgJp:
何をうろうろしてる
そこらの椅子に座ってもいいんだぞ
盗賊のねぐらなんかじゃ
落ち着いてられないってか？
MsgEn:
What are you wandering around for?
You can sit on any chair around here, you know.
Can't relax in a den of thieves, huh?

MsgJp:
えーっと、なに？
あたし、顔に何か付いてる？
MsgEn:
Uhm, what?
Do I have something on my face?

MsgJp:
あたしたちだって
アッカーシェランの人間だよ
火竜さまの恩恵を受けて生きてきてるんだから
MsgEn:
We're people from Acre Selund too, you know.
We've been living under the blessing of the Fire
Dragon.

MsgJp:
――ちょっと"事情"がある人だらけだけど
ええと、その――火竜さまへの気持ちは
街の人たちとちょっとも変わんないってこと！
MsgEn:
There are a lot of people with "circumstances"
here, but well, my feelings towards Lord Fire
Dragon are no different from the people in town!

MsgJp:
ウチの人たちって目つき悪い人、多いでしょ？
でもみんな優しい人たちなんだよ
あんまり悪く思わないで
MsgEn:
I know our people might seem a bit intimidating
at first, with their stern expressions.
But they're all genuinely kind-hearted
individuals.
Judge them not too harshly.

MsgJp:
うーん――
何、あたしだって悩むことくらいあるよ
MsgEn:
Hmmm--
What? I have problems too!

MsgJp:
物資ならいくらか持ってきてやった
何が必要か、言ってみろ
MsgEn:
If it's supplies you require, I can bring some.
Just tell me what you need.

MsgJp:
こんなところ近付きたくはないが
――何でも、お前らにかかってるらしいじゃねえか
物資くらいなら運んできてやる
MsgEn:
I'd rather not be around this place...
-- But I hear it's all up to you guys, huh?
I'll at least keep you supplied.

MsgJp:
感謝するならうちの頭領にしとけ
俺は言われて運んできてるだけだ
MsgEn:
If you want to thank me, you should thank our
chieftain.
I only bring it as instructed.

MsgJp:
うちの奴らだけじゃなく
ベルタんとこの奴らにも気に入られてるらしいな
あんた、こういう稼業にも向いてるんじゃないか
MsgEn:
It seems like not only my crew but also Bertha's
lot are fond of you.
You might have a knack for this kind of work, you
know.

MsgJp:
先に進む覚悟は――どう？
一緒に行く相手がいないなら
アタシが声かけてこようか？
MsgEn:
Are you ready to head on?
If you don't have anyone to accompany you, I
could suggest some folks.

MsgJp:
なるようにしかならないもんさ
あんまり気負わずにいけばいい
――なんて言っても
結局はあんたにかかってるんだけどね
MsgEn:
What will be, will be.
Don't get too worked up.
... Even though that's what they say, in the end,
it all depends on you.

MsgJp:
火垂れ山の中は暑いだろうけど
頭の方は冷静さを心掛けな
熱と緊張でイカれて命を落とさないように
MsgEn:
It must be hot inside the Firefall Mountain, but
keep a cool head.
Stay your mind under the duress of heat and you
may end up keeping your life.

MsgJp:
そうだ――
戦技を見直してから行きなよ
ユセフが相談にのってくれるからさ
MsgEn:
That's right...
Reevaluate your combat skills before you go.
Youssef will give you advice, so consult with him.

MsgJp:
体調と戦技、それから装備――
覚者殿には万端の状態でいていただかねば
MsgEn:
Physical condition, combat skills, and equipment—
It is essential for the Master Arisen to be in
perfect condition.

MsgJp:
ここでお休みになるならば<VAL PRICE_INN>です
この荒れ地で寝床を確保するために必要でして――
覚者殿、どうかご了承ください
MsgEn:
If you wish to take a rest here, the price is
<VAL PRICE_INN>.
It is necessary to secure a place to sleep in
this barren land...
Master Arisen, please understand.

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
寝心地がいいとはお世辞にも言えぬ寝床ですが
どうぞお休みください
体調を整えていただくことが最優先です
MsgEn:
While I can't exactly call this bed comfortable,
please rest well.
Your well-being is our top priority, so please
take the time to recover.

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
《弱化の治療》でしょうか
治療に必要な物資にも限りがあるため
どうしても<VAL PRICE_WEAK>ほど
いただかねばならぬこと、お許しを――
MsgEn:
Is it "Treat Weakness"?
Because there is a limited supply of resources
for treatment, there is no choice but to ask for
<VAL PRICE_WEAK>.
Please, understand, and forgive me――

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
覚者殿、申し上げにくいことですが
《弱化》されていないようです
ええ、間違いなく《弱化》されていません
MsgEn:
Master Arisen, 'tis difficult for me to really
say, but it seems that you have not been weakened.
Yes, without a doubt.

MsgJp:
"あの時"メガドを護りきれなかった我らです
"今"できることをやらせてください
MsgEn:
We couldn't protect Megado back then.
Let us do what we can do now!

MsgJp:
火垂れ山へもお供したいのは山々ですが
――我らでは足手まといになるだけでしょう
ここでお待ちしております
MsgEn:
While we would love to accompany you to Firefall
Mountain, we fear we would only hinder your
progress.
--We shall await your return here.

MsgJp:
突然の怪我や物資不足――
他にも、何かあった時には
すぐにこのキャンプへお戻りください
そのために我々がいるのですから
MsgEn:
Sudden injury or lack of supplies--
If you have any other problems, please return to
this camp immediately.
That's what we're here for!

MsgJp:
――お前さん
なかなか見どころがありそうじゃの
MsgEn:
--You've got something special about you, I can
tell.
I'm intrigued.

MsgJp:
その気があるならワシのとっておきを
教えてやらんでもないが
MsgEn:
If you're interested, I could share some of my
insider knowledge with you.

MsgJp:
海竜リンドブルムに座礁船
ここからでも浜辺の様子はよぉ見えるわい
お前さんが来る様子もな
MsgEn:
Ship stranded on Lindwurm.
I can see the beach just fine from here.
And I can see you coming, too.

MsgJp:
このモルトバ灯台はな、今でこそ
神殿から出る洋撃船専用みたいに
なっとるが、もっと昔の時代からあったそうじゃ
MsgEn:
The Moltova Lighthouse now seems to be
exclusively for the ocean-bound ships leaving from
the temple, but apparently, it has been around
since ancient times.

MsgJp:
外洋が穏やかでヒュージブルもおらず
数多の船が浜の村から出ていた時代にな
MsgEn:
In the era when the open sea was calm and there
was no Brine, many ships used to depart
from the village on the beach.

MsgJp:
んん？
何じゃ、わざわざこんな所に
何をしにきた、特にもてなしもできんぞ
MsgEn:
Huh? What brings you all the way here?
Can't offer much hospitality in a place like this.

MsgJp:
ほう――
そっちの話か、良かろう
MsgEn:
Oh, that's what you're after.
Alright then.

MsgJp:
ワシはルドルフォ
見ての通り灯台守じゃが、かつては白騎団で
《シールドセージ》の教官をしておった
MsgEn:
I am Rudolfo.
As you can see, I am the lighthouse keeper.
Formerly, I used to be an Instructor of the White
Knights, teaching the ways of the Shield Sage.

MsgJp:
お前さん、《シールドセージ》として経験を積み
護りのイロハは体得したようじゃの
MsgEn:
Seems you've gained experience as a Shield Sage,
and mastered the basics of protection.

MsgJp:
大盾で敵の攻撃を受けとめ、それを反撃の力たる
フォースへ転化する――
MsgEn:
With the Greatshield, you can intercept the
enemy's attacks and convert them into the power to
counterattack--

MsgJp:
そして、敵の注目を一身に集めることで
仲間の攻撃機会を増やす
MsgEn:
And by drawing the enemy's attention to oneself,
increase the opportunities for your allies to
attack.

MsgJp:
もう分かっているだろうが
その大盾は、お前さんのみを守るものにあらず
仲間のための砦でもある
MsgEn:
You should already have grasped this.
That Greatshield is not only for your protection,
but is also a fortress for your comrades.

MsgJp:
力量はもう十分じゃ
ワシの出す試練を乗り越え、さらなる精進を
してみんか？
MsgEn:
Your strength is already enough.
How about overcoming the trials I present and
striving for further improvement?

MsgJp:
よしよし
護りのイロハは体得したようじゃの
MsgEn:
Good, good, it seems you've mastered the basics
of protection.

MsgJp:
では、《シールドセージ》として
本格的に鍛錬を積むがよい
MsgEn:
Then, it's time to undergo some rigorous training
as a Shield Sage!

MsgJp:
お前さん、かなり護りの術に
長けてきたようじゃの
MsgEn:
You're getting pretty good at the art of
self-defense, aren't you?

MsgJp:
よし――
ではそろそろ、もう一歩踏み込んだ
技を覚えてみるか
MsgEn:
Alright――
Then, it's about time to learn a more advanced
technique.

MsgJp:
うむ、《シールドセージ》に興味があるのか？
――シールドセージはもともと騎士団と戦に
赴いたプリーストの一団が、防護術に特化し
開いた職と言われていてな
MsgEn:
Ah, are you interested in the Shield Sage?
The Shield Sage is said to be a vocation that was
originally formed by a group of priests who joined
the Knights Order and specialized in defensive
magic.

MsgJp:
もっとも大きな差は、自身の精神力だけでなく
敵が攻撃に使う力そのものを、護りの力に転化
したという点じゃ
MsgEn:
The biggest difference is that we have converted
not only our own mental power, but also diversion
of the enemy's attack into the power to protect.

MsgJp:
敵の攻撃を防ぎ、かつ力として吸収する大盾は
あれで呪具でもある
MsgEn:
The Greatshield that blocks enemy attacks and
absorbs them as power also serves as a tool of
magic.

MsgJp:
ロッドと対で使うことで
力を《フォース》として蓄積し、制御するのじゃ
――む？　ちょっと難しかったかの？
MsgEn:
Used in conjunction with a rod, it stores and
controls power as "Force".
-- Hmm?　Shall I reiterate?

MsgJp:
要するに、じゃ
敵の力すら利用し、己自身が皆を守る盾となる者
それがシールドセージということじゃよ
MsgEn:
In short, a Shield Sage is someone who not only
harnesses the power of their enemies, but also
becomes a shield to protect everyone.

MsgJp:
お前さん
《エンチャント》は使っておるか？
MsgEn: Are you using "Enchant" abilities?

MsgJp:
火や氷、雷、そして聖に闇
魔物どもには弱点というべき
苦手属性があることが多くてな
MsgEn:
Fire, ice, lightning, as well as holy and dark—
many monsters have weaknesses or attributes they
are vulnerable to.

MsgJp:
そこを突けるかどうかで、戦いの流れは
全く変わると言っても過言ではない
弱点属性をエンチャントしてやれば
味方の火力は一気に上がるじゃろう
MsgEn:
It is not an exaggeration to say that the flow of
battle can completely change depending on whether
or not you can exploit that weakness.
By enchanting the right attribute, your allies'
firepower will increase significantly.

MsgJp:
《フォース》に属性の力を帯びさせ
武器へ付与する
それがシールドセージのもう一つの
大きな役割じゃな
MsgEn:
Infusing the power of enchantments from "Force"
and applying it to weapons—
that's another significant role of the Shield
Sage.

MsgJp:
ふううむ、目を見張る成長じゃ
お前さんに、ワシのとっておきを
伝授する時がきたようだの
MsgEn:
Hmm, your growth is truly remarkable.
It seems that the time has come for me to impart
my special knowledge to you, my dear apprentice.

MsgJp:
《シールドセージ》の真髄とは
己自身が仲間を守る砦となること
そして戦いの行方を導く、確かな
灯台となることじゃ
MsgEn:
The essence of the "Shield Sage" is to become a
fortress that protects one's comrades, and to be a
reliable beacon that guides the course of battle.

MsgJp: それを心して、この技を修得するがよい
MsgEn: Keep that in mind as you master this technique.

MsgJp:
なんじゃお前さん
戦技についての話か？
MsgEn:
What's on your mind, stranger?
Are you here to discuss combat skills?

MsgJp:
そうじゃな――ならまずは――
《シールドセージ》となり
ジョブレベル１８を目指すといい
MsgEn:
Well, then, first of all, you should become a
"Shield Sage" and aim for job level 18.

MsgJp:
その後、神殿の訓練官――
たしかレンテンとかいったかのう
あの者から正式にワシへの修練紹介を
出してもらうがよい
MsgEn:
After that, the temple trainer-- I think it's
Renton or something like that-- can give you a
formal introduction to my training.

MsgJp:
その時こそ直伝の技を教えてやろう
それまではよく護り、鍛えるのじゃ
MsgEn:
Only then will I teach you the techniques
directly.
Until then, protect and train well.

MsgJp:
ほほぉ、シールドセージとして
なかなか励んでおるようじゃの
そのレベルであれば、より高度な技術を
学んでよい頃かもしれん
MsgEn:
Oh, so you're working hard as a Shield Sage I see.
At your level, it might be a good time to learn
more advanced techniques.

MsgJp:
とはいえ、急にワシが修練してやるのは
筋違いじゃな
覚者であれば神殿の訓練官――
レンテンとか言ったかのう？
MsgEn:
That said, it wouldn't be right for me to
suddenly start training you.
If you're an Arisen, you should seek out the
Temple's Training Officer -- I believe his name
was Renton.

MsgJp:
まずはあやつに一報を入れてから
この道を深めるかどうか
今一度考えてみるとよい
MsgEn:
I suggest you contact that individual first and
then reconsider whether to delve further into this
path.

MsgJp:
あらぁ、わざわざこんな所に何の用？
魔女が住んでるって噂でも
聞いてきたのかしら？　ふふふ
MsgEn:
Oh my, what brings you all the way here?
Did you come to inquire about the rumors of a
witch residing here? Hehehe.

MsgJp:
術士として見込みがありそうなら
特別に教えてあげてもいいわよ
MsgEn:
If you show promise as a sorcerer, I might
consider teaching you something special.

MsgJp:
ソーサリーと呼ばれる
今やこの地から失われゆく魔術の極意をね
あなた、興味ある？
MsgEn:
Are you interested in learning the secrets of
Sorcery, a form of magic that has all but vanished
from this land?

MsgJp:
魔術の真髄は森羅万象への理解
自然の中で一体となり
頭と身体で感じる事が大切なのよ
MsgEn:
The essence of magic lies in understanding the
vastness of nature.
It is crucial to become one with nature, to feel
it with both your mind and body.

MsgJp: あらぁ、わざわざこんな所に何の用？
MsgEn: Oh, what are you doing all the way out here?

MsgJp:
――あら、パトリシアからの紹介？
なら、見込みある人みたいね
MsgEn:
Oh, Patricia sent you?
Well, it seems like you have potential.

MsgJp:
あたくしはエメラダ、《ソーサラー》よ
大きすぎる破壊の力ゆえ
今は神殿で禁じられた術――魔術を伝えているの
MsgEn:
I am Emerada, a "Sorcerer."
The Temple has deemed Sorcery too dangerous, they
have banished it from their teachings.
Yet, I continue to instruct those who seek to
harness its power.

MsgJp:
世界を包む霊、質、量、法則を知り
望む力を生みだす技、その根源は
生死や世界そのものの成り立ちにまで
深く繋がっているわ
MsgEn:
Knowledge in the spirits, essences, quantities,
and laws that envelop the world, the technique
that produces the power you seek is deeply
connected to the very foundation of life, death,
and the origins of existence itself.

MsgJp:
ふふ、もしかしたら神殿が禁じたのは
そういう所が、例のあの学問と似ているから――
かもしれないわね
MsgEn:
Hehe, perhaps the reason the temple forbade it is
because such knowledge cuts too close to the vein,
so to say...

MsgJp:
激しい魔力の本流を感じ、魔法陣を練って
解き放つの――！
その快感、あなたも味わってみない？
MsgEn:
Feel the intense flow of magickal power, weave
the spell, and unleash it—!
Wouldn't you like a taste of that?

MsgJp:
あたくしの出す試練を見事こなせたら
《ソーサラー》への入門を認めてあげるわよ
MsgEn:
If you can successfully overcome the trials I
present to you, I shall grant you entry into the
world of the Sorcerer.

MsgJp:
魔術師のこと、知りたいの？
あたくし達《ソーサラー》はスペルと理律
によって万物を理解し紡ぎ、精錬するの――
MsgEn:
Curious about Sorcerers?
We, the Sorcerers, comprehend and weave the
fabric of existence through spells and principles,
refining it to our will.

MsgJp:
神官の術とは全く異なるものなのよ
簡単に言うと、学問に近い術体系かも
しれないわね
MsgEn:
It's very different from the priestly arts.
Simply put, it's a system that may be closer to
academia.

MsgJp:
世界を包むさまざまな力の法則を知り
紡ぎ、操る技なの
そしてその力は、生死や世界そのものの
成り立ちに深く繋がっているわ
MsgEn:
It's about knowing, weaving, and manipulating the
laws of various powers that envelop the world.
And that power is deeply connected to the very
foundation of life, death, and existence itself.

MsgJp:
魔術の多くが破壊の力として顕れるのは
そのせいかしらね？　ふふふ
MsgEn:
I wonder if the destructive nature of many a
spell stems from the same underlying principles?
Hehehe.

MsgJp:
どう？
少しは興味を持ってもらえたかしら
あなたに相応の実力と信頼があれば――
もっと深く教えてあげるわ
MsgEn:
How about it?
I wonder if I've managed to pique your interest a
little.
If you have the appropriate skills and trust—
I will teach you more in depth.

MsgJp:
ソーサラーにとって、《スペリング》の
習熟が一つの大きなポイントね
MsgEn:
For a Sorcerer, mastery of "Chanting" is a major
point.

MsgJp:
同じ魔法でも、詠唱中に魔力を練る人と
そのまま詠唱する人では
実戦での威力はかなり変わってくる
MsgEn:
Even with the same magick, the difference in the
power during combat can vary greatly between those
who refine their magick while chanting and those
who simply chant it as is.

MsgJp:
才能もあるかもしれないけれど
スペリングは基本、努力と練習で
身に付けるものなの
MsgEn:
There may also be talent involved, but chanting
is fundamentally something that can be acquired
through effort and practice.

MsgJp: ふふふ、練習を怠ってはダメよ
MsgEn: Hehehe, don't be lazy in practicing.

MsgJp:
ふふふ
あなたの素養、確認させてもらったわ
合格よ
MsgEn:
Hehehe.
I have confirmed your aptitude.
You have passed.

MsgJp:
ようこそ、魔術の世界へ！
新しき《ソーサラー》として
あなたを歓迎するわ
MsgEn:
Welcome to the world of Sorcery!
Allow me to extend a warm welcome to you,
neophyte Sorcerer.

MsgJp:
でもまだ魔の扉は開かれたばかり
あなたがこの先、魔術をどれほど識り
求め、体得できるかどうかは修練次第よ
MsgEn:
Yet, the door to Sorcery has just been unlocked.
Just how far you can delve into the depths of
magic, just how much you can grasp and master,
lies solely in your dedication to your practice.

MsgJp:
その師として魔女の血脈である
あたくしが、直々に導いてあげるわ
MsgEn:
With Witch blood flowing freely through my veins,
I will personally guide you.

MsgJp: ふふふ――感謝しなさい
MsgEn: Hehehe... Be grateful.

MsgJp:
あなた、魔術師としてそこそこ腕を
上げてきたようね
そろそろ頃合いかしら
MsgEn:
You've become quite skilled as a sorcerer,
haven't you?
I suppose it's about time.

MsgJp:
さらに一歩
魔の深淵に近づく術を授けてあげる
さぁ、すぐにスペリングの修行を始めなさいな
MsgEn:
I will give you a technique to peer into the
abyss of magic even further.
Now, start practicing your spell immediately.

MsgJp:
あぁ、あなたがここまでの域に
到達するなんて、あたくしも嬉しいわ
MsgEn: Ah, I'm so glad that you've reached this level.

MsgJp:
魔術の極意、あなたに授けてあげましょう
《ソーサラー》の魔術とは、己の身を
世界にあまねく大いなる力と一体化させる術
MsgEn:
Let me bestow upon you the essence of sorcery.
The magic of the "Sorcerer" is the art of
integrating oneself with the vast power of the
world.

MsgJp:
人であることを忘れ、力に身を委ねなさい
そして、深淵に踏み込みなさい――
ふふふ
MsgEn:
Forget that you are human, surrender yourself to
power, and step into the abyss--
Hehehe

MsgJp:
あらぁ、パトリシアからの紹介があった人じゃない
魔の深淵へ近づく覚悟を決めたのね
MsgEn:
Oh, you're the one Patricia referred, aren't you?
You've decided to approach the abyss of magic.

MsgJp:
いいわ、まずは改めて自己紹介といこうかしら
あたくしはエメラダ、《ソーサラー》よ
大きすぎる破壊の力ゆえ
今は神殿で禁じられた術――魔術を伝えているの
MsgEn:
Okay, first of all, let me introduce myself again:
I am Emerada, a "Sorcerer."
The Temple has deemed Sorcery too dangerous,
banishing it from their teachings.
Yet, I continue to instruct those who seek to
harness its power.

MsgJp:
世界を包む霊、質、量、法則を知り
望む力を生みだす技、その根源は
生死や世界そのものの成り立ちにまで
深く繋がっているわ
MsgEn:
Knowledge in the spirits, essences, quantities,
and laws that envelop the world, the technique
that produces the power you seek is deeply
connected to the very foundation of life, death,
and the origins of existence itself.

MsgJp:
ふふ、もしかしたら神殿が禁じたのは
そういう所が、例のあの学問と似ているから――
かもしれないわね
MsgEn:
Hehe, perhaps the reason the temple forbade it is
because such knowledge cuts too close to the vein,
so to say...

MsgJp:
――見たところ、あなたはまだ
魔の扉を開いたばかりのようね
あなたがこの先、魔術をどれほど識り
求め、体得できるかどうかは修練次第よ
MsgEn:
--It seems that you have just opened the door to
the realm of sorcery, haven't you?
Just how much you can understand and master magic
in the future depends on your dedication.

MsgJp:
その師として魔女の血脈である
あたくしが、直々に導いてあげるわ
MsgEn:
With Witch blood flowing freely through my veins,
I will personally guide you.

MsgJp:
たくさん課題を出して、磨いて――
もっとずっと強くて魅力的な
《ソーサラー》に仕上げてあげる
MsgEn:
I'll give you plenty of tasks to hone your
skills--
and turn you into a much stronger and more
captivating "Sorcerer."

MsgJp: ふふふ――感謝しなさい
MsgEn: Hehehe... Be grateful.

MsgJp:
《ソーサラー》として
あなたはまだ可愛いヒナ鳥――
MsgEn:
As a "Sorcerer," you're just a cute little baby
bird.

MsgJp:
せめて、基礎魔法程度は
自分の力で使えるようになりなさい
MsgEn: At least learn to use basic magic on your own.

MsgJp:
そうね
ジョブレベルが１８になって
せめて神殿の訓練官さんから巣立ち
の許可が貰えたなら――
MsgEn:
I see.
Once your job level reaches 18 and you at least
get permission to leave from the temple
instructor, then—

MsgJp:
もう少し大人の魔法を
教えてあげてもいいわ
MsgEn:
I wouldn't mind teaching you a bit more advanced
magic for adults.

MsgJp:
あら、あなた
ヒナ鳥から若鳥くらいまでには
成長しているじゃない
MsgEn:
My, a fledgling now, aren't you?
You've grown well.

MsgJp:
神殿の訓練官さんに、本格的に
魔術を習ってもいいかの確認は
してくるのよ
MsgEn:
You're going to check with the temple instructor
to see if you can start learning sorcery in
earnest.

MsgJp:
あたくしもパトリシアとの信頼もあるし
一応神殿の顔は立ててあげないとね
MsgEn:
With my trust in Patricia and all, I should at
least maintain good standing with the temple.

MsgJp:
精神を集中し、狙い穿つ
元素と精の声に耳を傾けていれば
魔矢はおのずと的を射る
MsgEn:
Focus your mind and aim true.
Listen to the voices of elements and spirits, the
magick arrow will naturally hit its target.

MsgJp:
狩人の弓とは違う
エルフの弓は霊を放つ弓よ
MsgEn:
The Elven bow is different from the Hunter's bow.
The Elven bow is a bow that unleashes spirits.

MsgJp:
失われたエルフの民
その記憶と技術――
MsgEn:
The lost elven people, their memories and
techniques—

MsgJp:
私達兄妹は、それを残し
レスタニアに留めることを目指しているの
MsgEn:
My brother and I are determined to preserve this
history and ensure that these precious artifacts
remain within the borders of Lestania.

MsgJp:
この森を訪れた君が、その一役と
なってくれるなら、喜んで力を貸すわ
MsgEn:
If you, who have visited this forest, are willing
to lend a hand, I would gladly offer my
assistance.

MsgJp: 今日は少し森が騒がしいようね
MsgEn: Looks like the woods are a little noisy today.

MsgJp:
疲れてるんなら泊ってってもいいわよ
<VAL PRICE_INN>出してもらうけどいい？
あっ、足元見てるんじゃないよ
研究出費も馬鹿にならなくてね
MsgEn:
If you're tired, you can stay overnight.
Can I charge you <VAL PRICE_INN>?
Oh, I'm not just looking out for myself. Research
expenses are no joke, you know.

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
でも君、《弱化》ではなさそうだね
心配しすぎなんじゃない？
MsgEn:
But you don't seem to be weakened, huh?
Aren't you worrying too much?

MsgJp:
ロンドジ―ルから君のことは聞いたわ
この森のこと、かなり詳しくなったみたいね
MsgEn:
I heard about you from Rondejeel.
Sounds like you've learned quite a bit about
these woods.

MsgJp:
紹介が遅れたけど、私はリングディール
この地で《エレメントアーチャー》
について研究しているの
どう？　君も学んでみない？
MsgEn:
Although I'm a bit late in introducing myself, I
am Ringdeel, a researcher studying the Element
Archer in this land.
What do you think? Would you like to learn as
well?

MsgJp:
《エレメントアーチャー》はもともと
エルフ族の技なの
私みたいに、修行を積めば
エルフじゃなくても使えるから心配しないで
MsgEn:
"Element Archer" is originally a technique of the
Elven race.
Even if you're not an elf, you can still use it
if you train like me, so don't worry.

MsgJp:
魔道弓と魔矢は、普通の弓矢とは違うわ
自身の生命力を力とし、放つ――
MsgEn:
The Magick Bow and bolts are different from
normal bows and arrows.
They harness one's own life force and fly forth—

MsgJp:
念じることで魔矢は、敵を穿つ刃にも
仲間を守る輝きにもなる
どれほど敵が多く、護るべき者がいようとも――
MsgEn:
By focusing your thoughts, magick arrows can
become blades that pierce through enemies, or
radiance that protects allies. No matter how many
enemies there are or how many you must protect—

MsgJp:
もしその気があるなら課題に挑戦してみて
君なら体得できるんじゃないかな
MsgEn:
If you're willing to put in the effort, why not
give the challenge a try?
I believe you have the potential to master it.

MsgJp: ふぅ――あら人間？
MsgEn: Phew... Oh, a human?

MsgJp:
私の弓はエルフの弓術師
《エレメントアーチャ―》のものよ
MsgEn:
My bow is that of an elven archer, an "Element
Archer" to be precise.

MsgJp:
魔道弓という特殊な弓で、鉄矢ではなく
霊的な魔矢を放つの
そして敵の身体ではなく、そうね
霊を捉えて狙いを定める――ってとこかしら
MsgEn:
Instead of iron arrows, this specialized bow,
known as the 'Magick Bow,' fires spiritual magick
arrows.
And instead of targeting the enemy's physical
body, it aims for their spirit.

MsgJp:
うーん、言葉で説明しにくいけれど
やってみれば自然に解ると思うわ
MsgEn:
Hmm, it's difficult to explain in words, but I
think you'll understand naturally once you try it.

MsgJp:
あと、魔矢で射るのは敵だけじゃないのよ
霊的な矢だからね。味方を思う念を込めれば
活力を上げてあげることもできるわ
MsgEn:
Oh, and the magic arrows aren't just for
attacking enemies.
Since they're spiritual arrows, you can imbue
them with thoughts of healing and support to
revitalize your allies.

MsgJp:
精と霊による攻撃と支援
誇り高いエルフが残した弓術
君にも、もっと知ってほしいわ
MsgEn:
Attacks and support using spirit and soul, proud
archery techniques left behind by the noble elves.
I want you to know more about them.

MsgJp: 君がこの森のため、力を貸してくれるならね
MsgEn:
Only if you are willing to help us for the sake
of this forest.

MsgJp:
君、だいぶこの森に慣れてきたみたいね
課題は合格よ
そろそろ君にもエルフの弓――
魔道弓を持ってもらおうかな
MsgEn:
You seem to have gotten quite accustomed to this
forest.
You've passed the challenge.
I think it's time for you to have an elven bow――
a magick bow.

MsgJp:
エルフの弓師は《エレメントアーチャ―》
と呼ばれていたの
生命力を矢として放つ
ハンターのとは異なる弓術よ
MsgEn:
Elven archers were known as 'Element Archers.'
Their archery differed from that of hunters, as
they fired life force as their arrows.

MsgJp:
君が私と一緒に、エレメントアーチャ―として
エルフが遺した神秘の技を探求して
くれるなら、私も心強いわ
MsgEn:
If you join me as an Elemental Archer, and seek
out the mysterious techniques left behind by the
elves, I'll feel much more confident.

MsgJp: 彼らの技、私達で取り戻しましょう
MsgEn: Let's reclaim their techniques together.

MsgJp:
《エレメントアーチャ―》の魔矢はね
狙いを定めて、より長く獲物を見据えるほどに
強さが増すの
MsgEn:
The magick arrows of the Elemental Archer, you
see, grow stronger the longer you aim and focus on
your prey.

MsgJp:
《魔眼の集中》――私は、そう呼んでいるの
集中力が矢の霊的強度に比例するみたい
MsgEn:
I call it "Concentration of the Magick Eye."
It seems that the intensity of the arrow's
spiritual strength is proportional to the
concentration.

MsgJp:
魔矢の調子はどう？
聞くまでもなく、上達してるようね
MsgEn:
How are your magick arrows performing?
It's apparent that you've elevated your archery
prowess.

MsgJp:
そうだ、少し前、新しい技を発見したの
ちょっと難しいから置いてたんだけど
今なら君にもできると思うわよ
試してみて
MsgEn:
Indeed, I recently discovered a new technique.
I've been putting it aside since it's a bit
tricky, but I believe you're ready for it now.
Give it a try.

MsgJp:
うん、さすがね！
目で見て解るくらい君の霊力
強くなってるわ
MsgEn:
Hmm, as expected!
Your spiritual power has definitely grown
stronger, to the point where I can see it with my
own eyes.

MsgJp:
エルフの中でも一握りの者しか
扱えなかったという、《エレメントアーチャ―》
の極意――
MsgEn:
Among the elves, only a handful of individuals
were able to wield the secret techniques of the
"Element Archer."

MsgJp:
私もまだ安定して扱えないんだけど
君ならできるかも
この技、試してみない？
先を越されるのは悔しいけど
MsgEn:
I'm still working on perfecting my own execution,
but I'm confident you could pull it off.
Care to give this technique a try?
It would be a shame to be outdone, though.

MsgJp:
ロンドジールから君のことは聞いたわ
魔道弓のことを詳しく学びたいんだってね
MsgEn:
I heard about you from Rondejeel.
You said you wanted to learn more about the
Magick Bow, right?

MsgJp:
紹介が遅れたけど、私はリングディール
この地で《エレメントアーチャー》
について研究しているの
MsgEn:
Although I'm a bit late in introducing myself, I
am Ringdeel, a researcher studying the Element
Archer in this land.
What do you think? Would you like to learn as
well?

MsgJp:
《エレメントアーチャー》はもともと
エルフ族の技なの
君や私みたいに、素質のある人が修行を積めば
エルフじゃなくても使えるんだけどね
MsgEn:
"Element Archery" was originally an elven
technique.
With training and the right aptitude, individuals
like you and me can wield it, even if we're not
elves.

MsgJp:
魔道弓と魔矢は、普通の弓矢とは違うわ
自身の生命力を力とし、放つ――
MsgEn:
The Magick Bow and bolts are different from
normal bows and arrows.
They harness one's own life force and fly forth—

MsgJp:
念じることで魔矢は、敵を穿つ刃にも
仲間を守る輝きにもなる
どれほど敵が多く、護るべき者がいようとも――
MsgEn:
By focusing your thoughts, magick arrows can
become blades that pierce through enemies, or
radiance that protects allies. No matter how many
enemies there are or how many you must protect—

MsgJp:
君が私と一緒に、エレメントアーチャーとして
エルフが遺した神秘の技を探求して
くれるなら、私も心強いわ
MsgEn:
If you join me as an Element Archer, and seek out
the mysterious techniques left behind by the
elves, I'll feel much more confident.

MsgJp:
練習や課題はあるけど――
これから一緒にがんばっていこうね
MsgEn:
There may be practice and assignments, but...
let's do our best together from now on, okay?

MsgJp:
どう？　魔道弓の調子は
最初は自分でさぐりつつ
手になじむまで試してみてね
MsgEn:
How's the Magick Bow feeling?
At first, experiment on your own a bit and try it
out until you get used to it.

MsgJp:
《エレメントアーチャ―》として
ジョブレベルが１８になったらさ
難しい技にも挑戦したらいいよ
MsgEn:
Once you reach Job Level 18 as an Element Archer,
you should start trying out more challenging
techniques.

MsgJp:
でも君は覚者だし、神殿の訓練官にも
エレメントアーチャ―としてより難しい
戦技を学ぶなら、私からになるっていう
確認はとっておいてね
MsgEn:
But you're the Arisen, and you train at the
temple.
As an elemental archer, it's more difficult.
If you want to learn the more difficult skills,
you'll have to start with me.
Just make sure you get confirmation first.

MsgJp: その時がきたら、一緒にがんばりましょう
MsgEn: When the time comes, let's do our best together.

MsgJp:
あ、泊ってく？
森の探索って大変だし、休みたい時は
いつでも言ってね
MsgEn:
Ah, do you want to stay overnight?
Exploring the forest is tough, so whenever you
want to take a break, just let me know.

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
《弱化の治療》？　多分できると思うけど
<VAL PRICE_WEAK>くらいは出してもらう
ことになるわ、それでもいい？
MsgEn:
"Treat Weakness?"
I think I can probably do it, but I'll have to
get <VAL PRICE_WEAK> or so out of you.
Is that okay with you?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
もうかなり魔道弓が馴染んで
きたんじゃない？
さまになってきてるわ
MsgEn:
I think you're getting pretty comfortable with
your Magick Bow by now.
It's starting to look natural on you.

MsgJp:
レベル的には私と一緒に難度の高い術を
練習していけそうだけど
君は覚者だしね
MsgEn:
In terms of level, it seems like we can practice
difficult techniques together.
You are an Arisen, after all.

MsgJp:
一応、その前に神殿の訓練官には
話を通しておいてね
それから本格的にエルフの戦闘術を
磨いていきましょう
MsgEn:
For now, please inform the temple trainer
beforehand.
Then, let's polish our elven combat techniques in
earnest.

MsgJp: 何だ、何か欲しい物あるか
MsgEn: What, need something?

MsgJp: 筋ある奴、弓教える悪くない
MsgEn: You look strong, I teach you archery.

MsgJp:
ここ獲物多い
大物狙い、森の奥
MsgEn:
Lots of prey here.
Big game, deep in the woods.

MsgJp:
――あぁ、ん――？
お前、まだ未熟
《ハンター》として半人前
MsgEn:
Ahh, hm...?
You, not ready.
Only half-baked "Hunter".

MsgJp:
《ハンター》、弓を使う
敵の弱点――空の敵――
MsgEn:
"Hunters" use bows.
Hit weak point -- flying enemies --

MsgJp:
だが、それだけ違う
弓と矢の使い方
MsgEn: That's not all ways to use bow and arrow.

MsgJp:
撃ち方、狙う距離、矢の種類――
射る、奥深い
MsgEn:
How to shoot, target distance, types of arrows--
Lots to archery.

MsgJp:
お前、《ハンター》見込みある
わざ、磨くか？
MsgEn:
You, do you have potential as a Hunter?
Come polish your skills?

MsgJp:
オレ、イヴァン、教えてやる
それでお前の矢、もっと強くなる
MsgEn:
I, Ivan, teach you well.
Your arrows will grow stronger.

MsgJp:
イニアス湖、この湖
知ってるか
MsgEn: Lake Inias, do you know about this lake?

MsgJp:
生き物たくさんいる
特に多い、ブルーニュート
MsgEn:
Many critters.
Especially Blue Newts.

MsgJp:
たまに手強い群、出てくることある
お前、気をつけろ
MsgEn:
Sometimes tough groups emerge.
You, be careful.

MsgJp:
湖の北、危ない
密猟者多い
気味悪い廃墟ある
MsgEn:
North of the lake, dangerous.
Many poachers.
Many eerie ruins.

MsgJp: オレ、あのあたり行かない
MsgEn: I don't go to that area.

MsgJp:
森の南、大物多い
遺跡に白獅子出たことある
かなりの強敵
MsgEn:
South of the forest, a lot of big game.
I've seen a white lion in the ruins, strong enemy.

MsgJp:
巨人も出たことある
相当の乱暴者
MsgEn: There are giants, incredibly violent.

MsgJp:
もし現れたら、戦うか逃げるか
迷わず決めろ
判断遅れ、命取り
MsgEn:
If you see them, fight or flee at once.
Waiting can kill you.

MsgJp: ――ん？　あぁ
MsgEn: ... Hm? Ah.

MsgJp: お前、筋良い
MsgEn: You have good instincts.

MsgJp: 大丈夫、もう立派な《ハンター》
MsgEn: Don't worry, you are already a fine Hunter.

MsgJp:
お前、まだ未熟
弓の使い方、もっと覚えろ
MsgEn:
You, still green.
Learn the proper way to use a bow.

MsgJp:
それでお前の弓
ずっと鋭く速くなる
MsgEn:
With that, your bow will become sharp and swift,
forever.

MsgJp:
お前、もう弓、身体の一部
十分解ってる、弓のこと
MsgEn:
You and your bow are already one;
you understand the bow thoroughly.

MsgJp:
だから、教えてやる
オレの十八番
MsgEn: So, I'll teach you my specialty.

MsgJp: 《ハンター》、弓うつ、獲物狙う
MsgEn: The Hunter, bow drawn, aims at their prey.

MsgJp: 剣届かないやつ、弓届く
MsgEn:
The one who can't reach with a sword, can reach
with a bow.

MsgJp:
矢、いくつか種類ある
知ってるか？
MsgEn:
Arrows, there are several types.
Know about them?

MsgJp:
固い大物狙う、矢じりに爆薬仕込む
威力強くなる
MsgEn:
When aiming for sturdy large prey, put explosives
on arrow to make it more powerful.

MsgJp:
他にも毒や睡眠薬、塗った矢もある
お前、選んで使え
MsgEn:
There are also poison and sleep-inducing arrows,
and more.
You, choose and use them as you see fit.

MsgJp:
お前、まだまだ
弓、練習もっとしろ
MsgEn:
You, still a long way to go.
Practice the bow more.

MsgJp:
《ハンター》続ける
ジョブレベル１８なる――
MsgEn:
Continue as a "Hunter."
Reach job level 18—

MsgJp:
神殿の訓練官、お前の腕認めれば
オレに紹介くる
MsgEn:
If the temple instructor recognizes your skill,
he will introduce you.

MsgJp:
それから教えてやる
もっと強い、速い弓
MsgEn:
Then I will teach you.
Stronger, faster bow.

MsgJp:
お前、レベルいい線きた
もっと強い弓そろそろ教えてやる
MsgEn:
You, you're getting pretty good.
I'll teach you a stronger bow soon.

MsgJp:
だけど、義理大事
お前見てきた神殿の訓練官に
挨拶してこい
MsgEn:
But, duty is important.
Go greet the temple instructor.

MsgJp: オレ教える、その後
MsgEn: After that, I teach you.

MsgJp:
長くザンドラに滞在し見聞を深めるも
未だ知れぬこと多し
MsgEn:
Even after spending a long time in Zandora and
deepening my knowledge, there is still much I
don't know.

MsgJp:
ザンドラが禁域と呼ばれるは
白竜と神殿の意と伝え聞く
MsgEn:
I have heard that Zandora is called a forbidden
zone because of the White Dragon and the will of
the temple.

MsgJp:
封じられるべき禁術に人を寄せ付けんがため
しかし、封じられるものを開こうとするもまた
人と知の性
MsgEn:
Forbidden techniques are sealed away to prevent
people from using them.
Yet, the very nature of humanity and our thirst
for knowledge compels us to seek what's forbidden.

MsgJp:
不慣れであれば、標の祠に向かうのがよい
さすれば、この地の探索も思いのほか
捗ろう
MsgEn:
If you're not familiar with the area, heading
towards the shrine is a good idea to make better
progress in your exploration.

MsgJp: ほう、何を求めここへ来たるか
MsgEn: Oh, what brings you here?

MsgJp:
壁に梯子に岩山にサイクロプスに
まぁ、登るってもいろいろあるけどさ
MsgEn:
On the wall, on the ladder, on the rocky
mountain, and even the Cyclops...
Well, there are various ways to climb, you know.

MsgJp:
あんた、何に登りたいの？
俺はある程度なんでもイケるぜ
MsgEn:
What do you want to climb, my friend?
I can handle pretty much anything.

MsgJp:
高いとこ最高だよな！
そのうち、ボルド鉱山の山頂目指してやろうと
思ってんだよね
MsgEn:
Being up high is the best, isn't it?
I'm thinking of aiming for the summit of Volden
Mines someday.

MsgJp:
真面目に登ろうとするなら
ロープとダガ―は必須でしょ
MsgEn:
If you're serious about climbing, you'll need a
rope and a dagger.

MsgJp:
あんたもどう？
登りのノウハウ、教えてもいいぜ
MsgEn:
How about you?
I could teach you how to climb.

MsgJp:
へえ――
ヘイデンのおっさんに紹介されたのか
《シーカー》のこと知りたいってか？
もちろん、歓迎するぜ
MsgEn:
Heh--
You were introduced to me by old man Hayden?
You want to know about the "Seeker"?
Sure, you're welcome.

MsgJp:
そうだな、《シーカー》と言えばまずは
ダガ―を使った素早い連続攻撃――
それからロープを使った
立体移動が特徴だな
MsgEn:
Well, the "Seeker" is characterized first of all
by a quick succession of attacks using daggers--
and then by three-dimensional movement using
ropes.

MsgJp:
オレ達にとっちゃロープは体の一部
自由に伸びる第三の手、みたいなモンさ！
MsgEn:
For us, the rope is a part of our body, like a
third hand that extends freely!

MsgJp:
ヒット＆アウェイ、そして何より
デカイ魔物に取りつくロマン！
MsgEn:
Hit & Away, and above all, the romance of facing
off against colossal monsters!

MsgJp:
まるで自分が敵を切り刻む
風にでもなったみたいで気持ちいいぞ？
MsgEn:
It's like you're the wind chopping up your
enemies, and it feels good, doesn't it?

MsgJp:
オレはチェスター、あらためてよろしくな
自由な《シーカー》生活を楽しんでみないか？
課題のクリア、待ってるぜ！
MsgEn:
I'm Chester, and it's nice to meet you again.
Enjoy the freedom of the Seeker's life!
I'll be waiting for you to complete your
assignments!

MsgJp:
よっ！　調子はどうだ？
今日も登ってるか？
MsgEn:
Yo! How you doing?
You climbing today?

MsgJp:
おっ！　いいねぇいいねぇ！
あんた、解ってきたみたいじゃないか
MsgEn:
Whoa!　That's good, that's good, that's good!
You're really starting to get it, aren't you?

MsgJp:
そうさ
《シーカー》ってのは、単に登るだけ
じゃないんだぜ
MsgEn: Yes, "Seekers" are more than just climbers.

MsgJp:
求めるものを手に入れるため
道の形に縛られることなく
目的を手繰り寄せる者のことなんだ
MsgEn:
It's about those who achieve their goals,
unconstrained by the form of the path, by carving
their own way forward.

MsgJp:
広い世界を自由に、好きなように
オレやあんたみたいにな
MsgEn:
To roam the world freely, as one pleases, like
people who live life on their own terms.

MsgJp:
さぁ、これからはそのロープとダガ―を
思うがまま、お前の目的めがけて
振るってやればいいさ！
MsgEn:
Now, wield those ropes and daggers as you please,
reaching for your target however you see fit!

MsgJp:
おぉ！
あんた、あちこち登ってるみたいじゃないか
見りゃ解るぜ
MsgEn:
Oh!
It seems you've been climbing around quite a bit,
eh?
I can tell just by looking at you.

MsgJp:
じゃあよ、一つ新しいコツを教えてやるよ
できるようになるまで、ちょっとばかり
練習が要るかもしれないけどな
MsgEn:
Alright then, I'll teach you a new trick.
It might require a bit of practice until you can
do it, but don't worry.

MsgJp:
おぉお、あんた！
気がつけば、初めて会った時とは
雰囲気が全然違うな
MsgEn:
Oh, hey there!
I must say, you've changed a lot since the first
time we met.

MsgJp:
よぉし、一人前の《シーカー》になったあんたに
オレの得意技を教えてやるよ
それでさらに、あんたは自由を
手に入れられるようになるはずさ
MsgEn:
Alright, I'll teach you my special technique
since you've become a full-fledged Seeker.
With that, you should be able to attain true
freedom.

MsgJp:
どれほどの高みを目指せるか
これからは自分との勝負になるぜ
MsgEn:
Let's see how high you can go.
From now on, you're in a race against yourself.

MsgJp:
ああ、オレのやってること？
《シーカー》ってんだけどさ
興味ある？
MsgEn:
Ah, what am I doing?
I'm called a "Seeker," you know.
Are you interested?

MsgJp:
シーカーはロープとダガ―で
険しい足場にデカイ魔物、縦横無尽に登って
走ってを追求する奴さ
MsgEn:
The Seeker climbs the treacherous terrain with
ropes and daggers.
Scaling towering enemies with ease, chasing after
them relentlessly.

MsgJp:
身ごなしに自信があるなら
きっと合ってると思うぜ！
MsgEn:
If you're confident in your agility, then I'm
sure it suits you perfectly!

MsgJp:
オレは純粋に登るのが好きだけど
速さに高さ、魔物に宝に――
何を追求するかは人次第だな
MsgEn:
I genuinely like to climb, but speed, height,
demons, treasure--
it's up to the person to decide what they want to
pursue.

MsgJp:
あんたがヘイデンのおっさんが認めるくらい
渓谷に詳しくなれりゃ、《シーカー》として
更なるテクも目指せると思うぜ
MsgEn:
If you become knowledgeable about the valley to
the extent that even Hayden recognizes you, I
think you can aim for even greater techniques as a
Seeker.

MsgJp:
でっかい魔物、見たら登りたくなるよな？
特に二本足で立ってる巨人とか
MsgEn:
When you see a huge enemy, like a giant standing
on two legs, don't you feel the urge to climb it?

MsgJp:
あいつら怒らせた時、よじ登って《揺さぶって》
やったらよ、面白いように体勢崩すんだよな
MsgEn:
When you provoke them and then climb up and
"shake" them, they lose their balance in an
amusing way.

MsgJp: スリルあるから、やってみてくれよ！
MsgEn: It's thrilling, you should try it!

MsgJp:
おっ！？
あんた、かなりあちこち登ってきたシーカー
みたいだな！
MsgEn:
Oh!?
You seem like quite the Seeker, having climbed
all over the place!

MsgJp:
――さては、ヘイデンのおっさんが言ってた
"紹介したい覚者"ってあんたのことだな？
《シーカー》のこと、もっと知りたいってなら
もちろん、歓迎するぜ！
MsgEn:
Well, you're that Arisen Hayden was talking about.
If you want to know more about the 'Seekers,' I
definitely welcome it!

MsgJp:
そうだな、《シーカー》と言えばまずは
ダガ―を使った素早い連続攻撃――
それからロープを使った
立体移動が特徴だよな
MsgEn:
Well, when it comes to the "Seeker", first of
all, it's characterized by a quick succession of
attacks using daggers, and then by
three-dimensional movement using ropes.

MsgJp:
オレ達にとっちゃロープは体の一部
自由に伸びる第三の手、みたいなモンさ！
MsgEn:
For us, the rope is a part of our body, like a
third hand that extends freely!

MsgJp:
ヒット＆アウェイ、そして何より
デカイ魔物に取りつくロマン！
MsgEn:
Hit & Away, and above all, the romance of facing
off against towering foes!

MsgJp:
技を磨いて戦場を縦横無尽に
飛び回るベテランのシーカーを目指そうぜ！
まるで自分が敵を切り刻む
風にでもなったみたいで気持ちいいぞ
MsgEn:
Let's aim to become skilled Seekers, flying
freely across the battlefield!
It feels great, as if we've become the wind
cutting through our enemies with ease.

MsgJp:
オレが出す課題をこなせば、
もういっちょ上のテクってヤツを
教えてやるからさ
きっちりついてこいよ？
MsgEn:
If you can complete the tasks I assign, I'll
teach you some even higher-level techniques.
So pay close attention and follow along, okay?

MsgJp:
なーに、あんたならできるさ！
自由のための投資ってやつだ
MsgEn:
Hey now, you can do it! It's an investment for
freedom.

MsgJp:
お、なになに？
オレみたいなシーカーになりたいって？
MsgEn:
Oh, what is it?
You want to be a Seeker like me?

MsgJp:
ま、そう焦ることはないって！
まずは１人で色々やって
思うまま体を動かしてみろよ
MsgEn:
Well, don't be in such a hurry!
Do some things on your own first.
Move your body as the mood takes you.

MsgJp:
そうだな、《シーカー》として
ジョブレベルが１８になったら
もういっちょ上のテクを教えてやるぜ
MsgEn:
Yeah, once you reach Job Level 18 as a Seeker,
I'll teach you another higher-level technique.

MsgJp:
おっと、その前に神殿にいる訓練官に
挨拶を忘れるなよ
ちゃんと紹介されてからなら
いくらでも教えてやるからさ
MsgEn:
Oh, before that, don't forget to greet the
Trainer in the Temple.
Once you've been properly introduced, I'll be
happy to teach you as much as you want.

MsgJp:
おお、あんた結構登ってるみたいだな！
な、シーカーとして次のステップに
進んでみる気は無いか？
そろそろ更なるテクが欲しい頃だろ？
MsgEn:
Oh, it seems like you've been climbing quite a
bit!
Well, as a Seeker, do you have any intention of
taking the next step?
It's about time you wanted to learn some more
advanced techniques, right?

MsgJp:
その気があるなら、神殿にいる訓練官に
ちゃんと紹介もらってくれよ
でなきゃ、ヘイデンのおっさんや神殿から
小言いわれるんだわ、オレ
MsgEn:
If you're serious about it, get an introduction
from the Training Officer at the Temple.
Otherwise, I'll get an earful from old Hayden and
the Temple staff for bringing you here
unannounced.

MsgJp:
ミスリウ森林深部に
ほとんど人はおりません
MsgEn:
Deep within Mysree Grove, there are hardly any
people.

MsgJp:
私はここで一人、静かな森に身を任せ
祠を守っております
MsgEn:
Alone in this place, I entrust myself to the
serenity of the forest, protecting the shrine.

MsgJp:
岸辺の小屋には立ち寄られましたか？
イヴァンという狩人が暮らしております
MsgEn:
Have you stopped by the hut on the shore?
A hunter named Ivan lives there.

MsgJp:
あの方は少し会話が不器用ですが
素晴らしい弓の名手
きっと覚者さまの力となってくれるでしょう
MsgEn:
That man is a bit clumsy in conversation, but he
is a wonderful bow master, and I'm sure he will be
a great help to you, Ser Arisen!

MsgJp:
この森には、古き民――
エルフに縁ある遺跡が点在しています
優しく美しい、今なお息吹ある建物です
MsgEn:
In this forest, there are scattered ruins with a
connection to the ancient people - the elves.
They are gentle and beautiful buildings that
still have a breath of life.

MsgJp:
中に入った者いわく
ところどころに、不思議な青い床石があり
その意味を理解しなければ
先に進むことができないのだとか――
MsgEn:
According to those who have entered inside, there
are mysterious blue floor stones scattered
throughout, and it seems that one cannot proceed
without understanding their meaning.

MsgJp:
このような祠でも、旅の疲れを取るくらいなら
できましょう、辺境ゆえ<VAL PRICE_INN>ほど
ご負担いただきますが
MsgEn:
Even in a humble shrine like this, we can provide
some respite from your travels.
However, due to our remote location, we cannot
offer the same level of comfort.
Therefore, we must ask for a modest fee of <VAL PRICE_INN>
.

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
このような木々の迷路――
そのまた奥までご苦労さまです
よくぞ迷わずにいらっしゃいました
それとも――迷ったあげくにここへ？
MsgEn:
This labyrinth of trees... And you've made it all
the way to the back.
My compliments. You must have a good sense of
direction.
Or perhaps... you got lost and stumbled upon this
place?

MsgJp:
いずれにしても
私が貴方さまのお役に立てましょう
MsgEn: Either way, I am at your service.

MsgJp:
私はクリスティーヌ
ミスリウの、深き森のエリアマスターで
ございます
MsgEn:
I am Christine, the Area Master of the deep
forest of Mysree.

MsgJp:
ミスリウ深部には――
イニアス湖を中心として、エルフに由来する
遺跡が数多くあります
お時間が許すならば、どうぞお訪ねください
MsgEn:
In the depths of Mysree, there are numerous ruins
that originated from the elves, centered around
Lake Inias.
If you have the time, please feel free to visit.

MsgJp:
しかし森はかつてないほど騒がしく
また獣たちも騒いでおります
場合によっては、覚者さまを頼りと
させていただくこともあるでしょう
MsgEn:
However, the forest is more noisy than ever
before, and the animals are also making a
commotion.
Depending on the situation, we may have to rely
on the Arisen for assistance.

MsgJp:
どうか、それをお心に留めおきください
森はいつでも貴方さまを歓迎いたします
MsgEn:
Please keep that in mind.
The forest welcomes you as always.

MsgJp:
ささやかながら、貴方さまの
来訪時にお納めできる
品を用意いたしました
MsgEn:
Modest as they may be, I have prepared offerings
for your arrival.

MsgJp:
これからもどうかこの地へ
お立ち寄りください
MsgEn: I hope you will continue to visit these grounds.

MsgJp:
覚者さま、イニアス湖北のほとりに
《密猟者のキャンプ》があるのは
ご存知でしょうか
MsgEn:
Ser Arisen, do you happen to know that there is a
"Poachers' Camp" on the shores of Lake Inias?

MsgJp:
そこに出入りする者達は、獣のみならず
人をも狩りの対象にする、悪しき者達です
MsgEn:
Those who enter and leave that place are wicked
people who hunt not only beasts, but also people.

MsgJp:
どうぞ周囲を散策する時は
ご注意ください
MsgEn: Please take care when you are about.

MsgJp:
覚者さま、お願いがございます
エルフの遺跡の一つ
通称《蒼葉のテラス》についてなのですが――
MsgEn:
Master Arisen, I have a favor to ask.
It's about one of the elven ruins, commonly known
as "Greenleaf Terrace"...

MsgJp:
あの遺跡は手つかずの姿を保つため
入り口を封じていたのです
MsgEn:
The entrance was sealed to maintain its untouched
state.

MsgJp:
しかし、その一角にグリフィンが住みつき
周囲を狩り場にするようになってしまいました
MsgEn:
However, a griffin has taken up residence in one
of the corners and has turned the surrounding area
into a hunting ground!

MsgJp:
そのせいで、ディナン深層林へ続く山道の
ガレキ撤去作業も滞っているようなのです
MsgEn:
Due to that, the removal of debris on the
mountain path leading to the Deenan Woods is also
being delayed.

MsgJp:
入り口は開放いたします
どうか、その対処を頼めないでしょうか
MsgEn:
We will open the entrance.
Please, can you take care of that for us?

MsgJp:
覚者さま
湖の西側、《イニアス湿地帯》にて
ブルーニュート達の中に、より強力で
人を脅かす者が現れたそうです
MsgEn:
Arisen, it seems that a more powerful and
menacing foe has appeared among the Blue Newts in
the western side of the lake, in the Inias
Wetlands.

MsgJp:
コバルト色の電光を纏ったトカゲ――
イヴァンも注意するよう言っておりました
MsgEn:
Lizards adorned in cobalt lightning—
Ivan also advised to be wary of them.

MsgJp:
どうか、近くを通る時は警戒を
そして可能であれば退治をお願いいたします
MsgEn:
Please, exercise caution when passing by nearby.
And if possible, I kindly request that you
exterminate them.

MsgJp:
覚者さま
かような深き森にある私どもへのお心遣い
感謝しきれるものではありません
ありがとうございます
MsgEn:
Arisen, your kindness in reaching out to us who
dwell in these deep woods is beyond our capacity
to express.
Thank you.

MsgJp:
また、ささやかではございますが
お納めできる品を良質なものに
させて頂きました
MsgEn:
Furthermore, although it may be modest, we have
made sure to provide high-quality items for your
humble offering.

MsgJp: どうか、今後ともよろしくお願いいたします
MsgEn:
Pray, we stand grateful for your continued
efforts.

MsgJp:
覚者さま、エルフの地《ディナン深層林》に
続く山道が開通いたしました
MsgEn:
Master Arisen, the mountain path leading to the
Elven lands, "Deenan Woods," has been cleared.

MsgJp:
覚者さまが、魔物を退治してくださったお陰で
ガレキ撤去作業の進捗が
良くなったそうです
MsgEn:
Thanks to the efforts of Master Arisen, who
defeated the enemies, the progress of the debris
removal work has improved.

MsgJp: 私から、あらためてお礼申し上げます
MsgEn: I would like to express my gratitude once again.

MsgJp:
さらに深き森、エルフ達の故郷を
どうぞご自身の目で確かめて来て下さい
ディナン山道は森林の最南部にございます
MsgEn:
Please venture out and see the deeper forest, the
homeland of the elves, with your own eyes.
The Deenan Mountain Road is located at the
southernmost part of the forest.

MsgJp:
覚者さま
イニアス湖東北にある《名もなき廃村》にて
おそろしき恨みの声を聞いたと
イヴァンから報せがありました
MsgEn:
Arisen, I have received a report from Ivan that
he heard a voice of terrible hatred in the
"Nameless Deserted Village" located northeast of
Lake Inias.

MsgJp:
あの方は、魔物や獣にはお強いのですが
幽霊、亡霊の類は大変苦手のご様子――
MsgEn:
That man is strong against demons and beasts, but
he is very bad with ghosts and spirits--

MsgJp:
どうか、イヴァンに代わり
亡者の類がさまよい出ることあらば
浄化いただけないでしょうか
MsgEn:
Pray, for Ivan's sake, purify any undead
creatures that might emerge, won't you?

MsgJp:
覚者さま
この森にとって、あなたはすでに大事な方
MsgEn:
Master Arisen.
To this forest, you are already an important
figure.

MsgJp: そして、私にとっても――
MsgEn: And, for me as well...

MsgJp:
あなたの尊き行いが
レスタニアのすべてに行きわたりますよう
MsgEn: May your noble deeds reach all of Lestania.

MsgJp:
私も、可能な限りの支援にて
あなたのお役に立ちたいと思います
どうぞこれからも、この森へおいで下さい
MsgEn:
I, too, will do my best to support and be of help
to you.
Please continue to visit this forest from now on.

MsgJp:
覚者さま、少し前
この森に白きキメラが姿を現したのです
MsgEn:
Arisen, a while ago, a Chimera white as snow
appeared in these woods.

MsgJp:
おそらく、あれは森小人達が聖獣と
崇める恐ろしの魔獣
《白獅子アルバス》――
MsgEn:
Perhaps it's the dreaded demonic beast that the
forest dwarves worship as a holy beast,
《White Lion Albus》----.

MsgJp:
放置したならば、この森のみならず
リンウッドにまで被害をもたらす
かもしれません
MsgEn:
If left unchecked, it could cause damage not only
to this forest but also to Lynwood.

MsgJp:
森の奥から姿を現したかの獣を
幸いにもイヴァンが撃退してくれました
MsgEn:
Fortunately, Ivan was able to repel the beast as
it appeared from deep within the forest.

MsgJp:
そして今獣が居るのは、《霊泉のテラス》奥
――《聖獣の間》
そこで力を蓄えている様子
MsgEn:
And now, the beast is here, deep within the
Sacred Spring Terrace - the Lair of the Holy
Beast.
It seems to be gathering its strength there.

MsgJp:
貴方さまにも魔獣の封じ込めに
ご助力いただけないでしょうか
MsgEn: We are in need of your aid to quell the beast.

MsgJp:
覚者さま、急いでお伝えしなければ
ならないことがあるのです
MsgEn:
Master Arisen, there is something urgent that you
must know.

MsgJp:
ディナン山道の手前、森の南部にて
恐るべき巨人が姿を現したのです
MsgEn:
Just before the Deenan Mountain Road, in the
southern part of the forest, a fearsome Giant has
appeared.

MsgJp:
その巨人の名は《ヨトン》
ハンターを襲い、多くの覚者を亡きものにした
残忍なモルトロールです
MsgEn:
The name of that giant is "Jotun."
It is a cruel Mole Troll that attacks hunters and
has claimed the lives of many Arisen.

MsgJp:
森のため、《ヨトン》の討伐を――！
どうかわたしからのこの依頼
お聞き入れくださいませ
MsgEn:
For the sake of the forest, we must defeat Jotun!
Please accept my request!

MsgJp:
《弱化の治療》ですね、承りました
<VAL PRICE_WEAK>ほどご負担いただきますが
MsgEn:
I understand that you would like to receive the
procedure for "Treat Weakness."
It will incur a fee of <VAL PRICE_WEAK>.

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
あら、覚者さまは《弱化》ではありませんね
治療の必要はないようです
MsgEn:
Oh, Master Arisen, you are not weakened.
There is no need for treatment.

MsgJp:
覚者さま、あなたはこの深き森にとっても
大事なお方
どうぞお体の疲れを取っていって下さい
MsgEn:
Master Arisen, you are a very important person to
this forest.
Please take the time to rest and rejuvenate your
body.

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
ようこそ標の祠へ
お待ちしておりました覚者さま
MsgEn:
Welcome to the Shrine.
We have been eagerly awaiting your arrival,
Master Arisen.

MsgJp:
覚者さま、この深き森に置かれた《辺境の礎》も
このたび全て解放されたそうでございます
MsgEn:
Master Arisen, it seems that all the "Sub
Portcrystals" placed in this deep forest have been
released at this time.

MsgJp:
《辺境の礎》はイヴァンの山小屋の近くにも
置かれているとのこと
MsgEn:
It is said that "Sub Portcrystals" are also
placed near Ivan's Lodge.

MsgJp:
貴方さまの訪れを、きっとイヴァンも喜ぶはず――
ぜひ、お時間の許す際には
お顔を見せに行ってやってください
MsgEn:
Surely Ivan will be pleased to see you.
Prithee, whenever you have the time, pay him a
visit.

MsgJp:
あの無愛想な顔の下で、
あの方も貴方さまのことを
ずいぶん気に入っているようなのです
MsgEn:
Even under that gruff demeanor, it seems he has
taken a liking to you!

MsgJp:
覚者さま、今日は折り入って
ご相談したいことがございます
MsgEn:
Arisen, there is something I would like to
discuss with you today.

MsgJp:
イニアス湖の近辺、南の方角に
霞んだような人影が現れたと
イヴァンから報告がありました
MsgEn:
In the southern vicinity of Lake Inias, a hazy
figure has emerged, as reported by Ivan.

MsgJp:
あの方は幽霊、亡霊の類が大の苦手とのこと――
それ以降、あの辺りには
近寄れないようなのです
MsgEn:
He doesn't do well with ghosts or spirits--
and since then, he won't go near that area!

MsgJp:
どうか、イヴァンに代わり
この人影を打ち払ってはいただけないでしょうか
MsgEn:
Prithee, in Ivan's stead, could you kindly
dispatch this figure?

MsgJp:
詳しくご説明いたしますので
ご出発の前には再度、私にお声掛けください――
MsgEn:
Please call upon me again before you depart, and
I will offer a thorough explanation.

MsgJp:
ここからディナン深層林へと進む途中に
新しく見つかりました《霧幻のテラス》――
MsgEn:
On the way to the depths of the Deenan Woods, a
new discovery has been made - the "Misty Illusion
Terrace".

MsgJp:
中から冷気が漏れ出でてくるような
不思議な遺跡です
冷たい霧に覆われていたせいで
今まで見つからなかったのかもしれません
MsgEn:
It is a mysterious ruin from which cold air leaks
out.
Perhaps it remained undiscovered until now
because it was covered in a freezing mist.

MsgJp:
何か未知の危険があるかと思い
封鎖してまいりましたが、貴方さまならば
中を調べることも可能かと――
MsgEn:
I have sealed it, as I thought there might be
some unknown danger.
But if it is you, Ser, it may be possible to
examine the inside...

MsgJp:
足を踏み入れられる際は
くれぐれもご注意くださいませ――
MsgEn: Upon entering, please remain cautious――

MsgJp:
覚者さま、度々申し訳ございませんが
今回もお力をお借りできないでしょうか――
MsgEn:
Master Arisen, I apologize for the frequent
inconvenience, but would it be possible to borrow
your strength once again?

MsgJp:
実は先日、突如としてこの祠の前に
ミストドレイクが現れたのです
MsgEn:
In fact, the other day, a Mist Drake suddenly
appeared in front of this shrine!

MsgJp:
幸い、イヴァンが訪れている時だったので
あの方が応戦してくださり
事無きを得ましたが――
MsgEn:
Fortunately, it was when Ivan was visiting.
He graciously fought it back, and we were able to
avoid any harm.

MsgJp:
退けられた竜は、《霧幻のテラス》へと
去っていったとのこと
MsgEn:
The repelled dragon has retreated to "Misty
Illusion Terrace."

MsgJp:
どうか、竜が再びこの祠を
襲うことのないよう
あの遺跡内への封じ込めに
ご協力いただけないでしょうか
MsgEn:
Prithee, could you lend your assistance in
sealing off the ancient ruins so that the dragon
will not attack this shrine again?

MsgJp:
覚者さま
この森にとって、あなたはすでに大事な方――
MsgEn:
Master Arisen.
To this forest, you are already an important
figure.

MsgJp: そして、私にとっても――
MsgEn: And, for me as well...

MsgJp:
あなたの尊き行いが
レスタニアのすべてに行きわたりますよう
MsgEn: May your noble deeds reach all of Lestania.

MsgJp:
あなたのお役に立てるよう
私も最大限の支援をお約束いたしましょう
どうぞこれからも、この森へおいでください
MsgEn:
I will ensure that I support you to the best of
my abilities.
Please do not hesitate to return to this forest
in the future.

MsgJp:
覚者さま
この森にとって、あなたはすでに大事な方
MsgEn:
Master Arisen.
To this forest, you are already an important
figure.

MsgJp: そして、私にとっても――
MsgEn: And, for me as well...

MsgJp:
あなたの尊き行いが
レスタニアのすべてに行きわたりますよう
MsgEn: May your noble deeds reach all of Lestania.

MsgJp:
かような深き森にある私どもへの
お心遣い、感謝しきれるものではありません
ありがとうございます
MsgEn:
Master Arisen.
Your kindness in reaching out to us who dwell in
these deep woods is beyond our capacity to
express.
Thank you.

MsgJp:
覚者さま
数々のご協力、痛み入ります
MsgEn:
Master Arisen,
We are deeply grateful for your numerous
contributions.

MsgJp:
覚者さま
ここを訪れて下さり――嬉しく存じます
MsgEn:
Master Arisen,
I am delighted that you have come to visit.

MsgJp:
何かできることはと思い
この品を用意しました
気に入って頂けると良いのですが――
MsgEn:
I have prepared this item, hoping that there is
something I can do.
I hope you will like it...

MsgJp:
覚者さま、これをお持ちください
イヴァンがあなたにと用意してくれたものです
MsgEn:
Master Arisen, please bring this with you.
It is something that Ivan has prepared for you.

MsgJp:
あの無愛想な方が、にこにことして
持ってきてくれました
MsgEn: That unsociable man brought it to me with a smile!

MsgJp:
覚者さま、これをお持ちください
わずかでも旅の助けとなりましょう
MsgEn:
Master Arisen, please bring this with you.
I hope it can help you, even just a little bit.

MsgJp:
白竜様が貴方様を覚者としたは
レスタニアにとって大いなる僥倖――
MsgEn:
It is a great fortune for Lestania that the White
Dragon has recognized you as an Arisen, Ser.

MsgJp:
いえ、白竜様は見抜かれておいでだった
のかもしれませぬ
貴方様の、"理の器"たる可能性を
MsgEn:
No, perhaps the Lord White Dragon had foreseen it
all along...
The possibility of you being the "vessel of
order."

MsgJp:
では、こちらをお持ちください
貴方様の旅に、理の導きがありますよう
MsgEn:
Please bring this with you.
May the guidance of order be with you on your
journey, Ser.

MsgJp:
ようこそ覚者様、果てたる地へ
祠の守番として貴方様にお力添えを
いたしましょう
MsgEn:
Welcome, Ser Arisen, to the land's end.
As the guardian of the shrine, I shall offer you
my assistance.

MsgJp:
《ザンドラ禁域》は閉ざされた忌まわしき地
ゆめゆめそのこと、忘れられますな
MsgEn:
The "Zandora Wastelands" is a forbidden, accursed
land.
Never forget that fact.

MsgJp:
覚者様のご活躍ぶり
この祠よりリムを通じて拝見しております
MsgEn:
I have been observing your valiant deeds, Arisen,
through the Rift, from this shrine.

MsgJp:
こちらをどうぞ
貴方様のため、僅かであれ力添えとなれば
良いのですが
MsgEn:
Please take this.
If it can be of even a little assistance to you,
then it is good.

MsgJp:
《クエストボード》にある
神殿からの令書をご確認ください
中には重要なる件もございますゆえ
MsgEn:
Please review the decrees from the Temple on the
"Quest Board."
There are some matters of great importance within.

MsgJp:
覚者様のお働き、お見事でございます
こちらをどうぞ
神殿からの報償でございます
MsgEn:
Master Arisen, your labor is truly commendable.
Please accept this as a token of gratitude from
the Temple.

MsgJp:
私は古き世のポーン
我が主はかつてこの地を訪れ、命を落としました
MsgEn:
I am a Pawn from a bygone era.
My master once visited this land and lost their
life.

MsgJp:
それからは神殿と覚者様の標として
この祠を守り続けております
MsgEn:
From then on, as a symbol of the Temple and the
Arisen, I have continued to protect this shrine.

MsgJp:
覚者様
どうぞ、こちらの品をお持ちください
MsgEn: Ser Arisen, here, take this with you.

MsgJp:
本来ならば貴方を主とし
ポーンとしてお仕えしたいところでは
ありますが、ままなりませんゆえ
せめてもの奉仕にございます――
MsgEn:
In truth, I would prefer to serve you as your
pawn, but it is not possible.
I can only offer what assistance I can--

MsgJp: 険しき旅にある貴方様に、これを
MsgEn:
To you, noble traveler on a perilous journey, I
present this.

MsgJp:
ここから私めにできる奉仕は
このくらいのことでございますゆえ
MsgEn:
This is the extent of the assistance I can
provide from here.

MsgJp:
わざわざのお立ち寄り、感謝いたします
どうぞこれを――
旅のお役に立ててください
MsgEn:
I appreciate your visit here, going out of your
way.
Please, take this... May it find use on your
journey.

MsgJp:
休憩でしたら規定にて
<VAL PRICE_INN>をお支払いいただきますが
よろしいでしょうか
MsgEn:
If it's for resting, according to regulations,
<VAL PRICE_INN> will be required as payment.
Is that acceptable?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
ここはかつてレスタニアの都であり
黄金郷と呼ばれたメルゴダが栄えた地――
MsgEn:
This is the former capital of Lestania, where
Mergoda, once called the Golden Lands, flourished.

MsgJp: 私は――
MsgEn: I am...

MsgJp:
今はザンドラ禁域と呼ばれるこの地の
エリアマスターを拝命しております
ダイオンと申します
MsgEn:
I am currently serving as the Area Master of this
land, now known as the Zandora Wastelands.
My name is Dian.

MsgJp:
お気づきかどうか――
私はポーン――
遠き昔に、主をなくしたポーンです
MsgEn:
Whether you've noticed or not—
I am a pawn—
a pawn who lost my master in a distant past.

MsgJp:
我が主はこの禁域にて古き知識を求め
戦い、そして命を奪われてしまいました――
メルゴダが残した忌まわしき遺物によって
MsgEn:
My master sought ancient knowledge in this
forbidden wasteland, fought, and had their life
taken—
by the accursed relics left behind by Mergoda.

MsgJp:
主の無念と遺志を継ぎ
また、白竜様と神殿の命を伝えるべく
ご奉仕させて頂いております
MsgEn:
Carrying on the legacy of my former master, I am
honored to serve once more, to convey Lord White
Dragon and the Temple's will.

MsgJp:
理を歪めしメルゴダが、再び同じ災禍を
レスタニアにもたらさぬよう――
MsgEn:
In order to prevent the twisted Mergoda from
bringing the same calamity to Lestania once
again...

MsgJp: どうか、よろしくお願い致します
MsgEn: Pray, I'm counting on you.

MsgJp: 覚者様のお働き、お見事でございます
MsgEn: Master Arisen, your work is truly magnificent.

MsgJp:
神殿からの補給物資にて
支援いたしましょう
MsgEn:
We shall provide support with supplies from the
temple.

MsgJp: これからもどうぞ、任務にお励みください
MsgEn: Please continue to do your best in your mission.

MsgJp:
覚者様、亡都メルゴダを守る
古き錬魔の一団が、《双輪の谷》にて
いまだ徘徊しているようでございます
MsgEn:
Ser Arisen, it appears that a group of ancient
alchemists, guardians of the fallen capital
Mergoda, are still roaming in the "Twin Wheel
Valley."

MsgJp: 付近を通行の際は、どうぞご注意を――
MsgEn: Please be careful when passing through the area.

MsgJp: 覚者様のお働き、お見事でございます
MsgEn: Master Arisen, your work is truly magnificent.

MsgJp:
神殿からの補給物資にて
支援いたしましょう
MsgEn:
We shall provide support with supplies from the
temple.

MsgJp: これからもどうぞ、任務にお励みください
MsgEn: Please continue to do your best in your mission.

MsgJp:
覚者様、かつてセラー湖より都へと
水を運んだ大地下水路――
《メルゴダ大水網》という場所がございます
MsgEn:
Ser Arisen, there is a place called the Mergoda
Flood Channels, which is a great underground
waterway that once transported water from Lake
Cera to the capital--

MsgJp:
かの水路は、わが主が命を落とした場所
長らく封鎖しておりましたが
貴方様であれば、あの場所の探索も
可能かもしれませぬ――
MsgEn:
That watercourse is where my master met their end.
It has been closed off for many years, but
perhaps with you, exploration may be nigh
feasible.

MsgJp:
入り口の封印を解いておきましょう
ただし、探索されるかの判断は
貴方様ご自身で――
MsgEn:
Let me unseal the entrance for you.
However, whether to proceed with the exploration
is a decision for you to make yourself.

MsgJp:
覚者様、とりいそぎ対処を
お願いしたき儀がございます
MsgEn:
Ser Arisen, there is an urgent matter that
requires your immediate attention.

MsgJp:
フロックヴァルト大橋へと至る道に
《バンデッドホーント》という蛮族の
関所がございます
MsgEn:
On the road leading to Flocwald Bridge, there is
a checkpoint called "Ironclad Haunt" that belongs to
a barbaric tribe.

MsgJp:
そこに出現した古の巨人兵を
破壊いただきたいのです
これは神殿よりの重要な任務――
MsgEn:
I would like you to destroy the ancient giant
warriors that have appeared there.
This is a crucial mission from the Temple.

MsgJp:
では、準備ができましたらあらためて
私にお声掛けください
MsgEn: Once you are ready, please talk to me again.

MsgJp:
覚者様、ザンドラの南部
セラー湖の岸辺にオークの残党が
宿営しているようでございます
MsgEn:
Ser Arisen, it seems that remnant Orcs are
encamped on the shores of Lake Cera in southern
Zandora.

MsgJp:
それも、モゴックめに近いオークの将が
率いている様子――
MsgEn:
It also appears to be led by an Orc General with
ties to Mogok.

MsgJp:
オークは長らく、そして今も
レスタニアにとっての脅威そのもの
MsgEn:
Orcs have long been, and still are, a threat to
Lestania itself.

MsgJp:
彼らが再び勢いを取り戻す前に
手を打たれるが得策かと存じます
MsgEn:
I think it would be a good idea to take action
before they regain momentum.

MsgJp:
覚者様のご活躍ぶり
この祠よりリムを通じて拝見しております
MsgEn:
I have been observing your valiant deeds, Arisen,
through the Rift, from this shrine.

MsgJp:
補給物資をさらに良きものと
なるよう、手配をいたしました
MsgEn:
We have made arrangements to further improve the
quality of the supplies.

MsgJp:
すでに戦いを共にできぬこの身を
歯がゆく思います
MsgEn:
I'm already feeling a bit bitter that I cannot
see battle with you.

MsgJp:
覚者様、ここより南東
東部ザンドラへ至る道中《南メルゴダ遺跡群》
を根城にするヒトの一団をご存知でしょうか
MsgEn:
Ser Arisen, do you know of a group of individuals
who have established their base in the "South
Mergoda Ruins," along the path to the Eastern
Zandora?

MsgJp:
彼ら、そしてあの関所を築いたのは
《ザンドラ・バルバロイ》という者達です
古き時代より文化を捨て、蛮行を働き
生き続けてきた、人ならざるヒト――
MsgEn:
They, as well as those who built the checkpoint,
are individuals known as the "Zandora Barbarians."
Since ancient times, they have forsaken culture
and committed atrocities, living on as inhuman
beings.

MsgJp:
その廃墟群に、巨人兵から逃れたためか
かの蛮族が集まり勢力を強めている様子
MsgEn:
In that ruin, it seems that the savage tribes
have gathered and strengthened their forces,
perhaps to escape from the Giant Warriors.

MsgJp:
彼らに言葉は無意味
ゆめゆめ、お忘れなきよう
MsgEn:
Words are meaningless to them.
Never, ever forget.

MsgJp:
覚者様、凶報にございます
レスタニアにとって新たな脅威の芽と
なりうる事案が発生したのです
MsgEn:
Master Arisen, I bring grave news.
A new potential threat to Lestania is apparent.

MsgJp:
《黒淵谷》に古の悪しき魔獣が
姿を現しました
MsgEn:
An ancient and evil demon beast has made its
appearance in the Black Abyss Valley!

MsgJp:
《嘆きのモーラ》と呼ばれる
黒き翼のナイトメア――
３００年以上前、白竜様御自らが
追い払ったという魔鳥にございます
MsgEn:
It is called "Wailing Mora", The Black-Winged
Nightmare...!
An evil winged creature that the White Dragon
himself drove away more than 300 years ago!

MsgJp:
あの魔獣がハイデルへ飛来すること
あらば、騎士や覚者隊では足止めにすら
なりますまい
MsgEn:
If that magical beast were to come flying to
Hidell, even the knights and the Arisen forces
would not be able to stop it.

MsgJp:
かの魔獣の討伐をお願いいたします
準備ができましたら、今一度お声掛けを――
MsgEn:
I kindly request your assistance in slaying that
demonic beast.
Once you are ready, please talk to me once again.

MsgJp:
白竜様が貴方様を覚者としたは
レスタニアにとって大いなる僥倖――
MsgEn:
It is a great fortune for Lestania that the White
Dragon has recognized you as an Arisen, Ser.

MsgJp:
いえ、白竜様は見抜かれておいでだった
のかもしれませぬ
貴方様の、《理の器》たる可能性を――
MsgEn:
No, perhaps Lord White Dragon had foreseen it all
along...
the possibility of you being the "vessel of
order."

MsgJp:
補給面で私にできる最大の支援を
させていただきます
MsgEn:
I shall provide you with the utmost support in
terms of supplies.

MsgJp: 貴方様の旅に、理の導きがありますよう
MsgEn: May Order guide you on your journey, Ser.

MsgJp:
《弱化の治療》でしたら、規定にて
<VAL PRICE_WEAK>をお支払いいただきます
よろしいでしょうか
MsgEn:
If it's for the treatment of "Weakness,"
according to regulations, you will be required to
pay <VAL PRICE_WEAK>.
Is that acceptable?

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
覚者様、ここは禁域における貴方様の住居
どうぞごゆるりとお体をお休め下さい
MsgEn:
Dear Arisen, this is your residence in the
forbidden wasteland.
Please take some time to recuperate here.

MsgJp: はい
MsgEn: Yes

MsgJp: いいえ
MsgEn: No

MsgJp:
されど、貴方様に《弱化の治療》は
不要にございます
MsgEn:
There is no need to "Treat Weakness" for you,
good ser.

MsgJp:
ようこそ標の祠へ
お待ち申し上げておりました、覚者様
MsgEn:
Welcome to the Shrine.
We have been eagerly awaiting your arrival,
Master Arisen.

MsgJp:
覚者様、神殿よりの伝令がありました
ザンドラ禁域一帯の《辺境の礎》が
全て使用可能とされたそうです
MsgEn:
Ser Arisen, we have received a message from the
Temple.
It seems that all the Sub Portcrystals in the
Zandora Wastelands are now functional.

MsgJp:
これも覚者様がこの地にて積み重ねられた成果が
神殿に認められてのこと――
MsgEn:
This is also the result of the achievements that
Master Arisen has accumulated in this land,
recognized by the Temple.

MsgJp:
これからもどうぞ、任務に励んでくださるよう
お願いいたします
MsgEn:
Please continue to do your best in fulfilling
your duties.

MsgJp:
覚者様、取り急ぎ
お願いしたき儀がございます
MsgEn:
Ser Arisen, there is an urgent matter that
requires your immediate attention.

MsgJp:
《狂信者の潜伏地》と呼ばれていた場所に
黒大鷲が舞い降りたのです
MsgEn:
A jet-black griffin descended upon the place
known as the Fanatic's Hiding Ground.

MsgJp:
かの地は錬金の秘術に傾倒した者が数名集まり
我流にて研究を繰り返していたという場所です
MsgEn:
It is said that a group of individuals obsessed
with the arcane arts of alchemy once gathered in
that land, dedicating themselves to relentless
research.

MsgJp:
神殿からの調査が入るまで
あの地をそのままに残しておきたいのです
MsgEn:
My deepest desire is to preserve that land in its
current state, undisturbed, until the
investigation from the Temple commences.

MsgJp:
なにとぞ、あの黒大鷲を追い払ってくださいませんか
ご準備が整いましたら、再び声をおかけください――
MsgEn:
I beg of you, will you drive away that black
griffin?
When you are ready, please talk to me again -

MsgJp:
覚者様、この場より北西の方角
《狂信者の潜伏地》にある井戸をご存知でしょうか
MsgEn:
Ser Arisen, are you familiar with the well found
in the "Fanatic's Hideout" to the northwest of
this place?

MsgJp:
《叫びの竪穴》と呼ばれるあの井戸は
中から恐ろしい魔物の叫び声が響いたので
封鎖していたのですが、近頃は静まり返っています
MsgEn:
The well known as the "Pit of Screams."
'Twas sealed well off as terrifying shrieks of
monsters could be heard from within, but it has
fallen silent as of late.

MsgJp:
問題の魔物は立ち去ったようですので
封鎖を解くことにいたしました
MsgEn:
The demon in question seems to have gone away, so
we've decided to release the blockade.

MsgJp:
叫び声の主は去ったようですが
中を魔物が徘徊していることは確実です
探索に向かわれる際は重々ご注意を――
MsgEn:
It seems that the source of the screams has
departed, but it is certain that there are
monsters wandering inside.
Please take great care when heading out to
explore.

MsgJp:
覚者様、どうか今一度
お力をお貸しください――
《叫びの竪穴》に新たな魔物が巣食ったようなのです
MsgEn:
Ser Arisen, please lend us your strength once
again.
It seems that new enemies have taken up residence
in the Pit of Screams.

MsgJp:
数日前の夜、あの井戸から
獣の断末魔のような声が何度も聞こえました
そして、魔物同士で争うような物音も――
MsgEn:
A few days ago, in the night, I heard the sound
of a beast's dying screams multiple times.
And I also heard the sounds of creatures fighting
each other.

MsgJp:
このままでは、元々あの井戸に
棲みついていた魔物たちが
地上に溢れ出てくるやも知れませぬ
MsgEn:
If things continue as they are, the demons that
originally inhabited that well may flee onto the
surface.

MsgJp:
中の様子を確認し、騒ぎを起こしている
魔物を退治していただきたいのです
準備が整いましたら、今一度お声掛けを――
MsgEn:
I would like you to confirm the situation inside
and dispatch the monsters causing the disturbance.
Once you are ready, please speak to me again.

MsgJp:
白竜様が貴方様を覚者としたは
レスタニアにとって大いなる僥倖――
MsgEn:
It is a great fortune for Lestania that the White
Dragon has recognized you as an Arisen, Ser.

MsgJp:
いえ、白竜様は見抜かれておいでだった
のかもしれませぬ
貴方様の、《理の器》たる可能性を――
MsgEn:
No, perhaps Lord White Dragon had foreseen it all
along...
the possibility of you being the "vessel of
order."

MsgJp:
白竜様のご意志に従い
私も貴方様への支援を惜しむことはないでしょう
MsgEn:
Following the will of Lord White Dragon, I will
spare no effort in supporting you as well.

MsgJp: 貴方様の旅に、理の導きがありますよう
MsgEn: May Order guide you on your journey, Ser.

MsgJp:
まったく、君には世話になりっぱなしだな
ここまで手助けしてもらったら
なんだか申し訳なくなってくるよ
MsgEn:
Honestly, I've been relying on you for help all
this time.
It's starting to make me feel a little guilty.

MsgJp:
僕ら兄妹から、心を込めて礼をさせてもらう
君がこの森に来てくれて本当に良かった
ありがとう
MsgEn:
We, as siblings, sincerely express our gratitude
to you.
It is truly wonderful that you came to this
forest.
Thank you.

MsgJp:
ああ、君にはずいぶん色々と任せてしまったね
それに手際もなかなかのものじゃないか
妹も喜んでいるよ
MsgEn:
I've assigned you many responsibilities, haven't
I?
And you handle them quite efficiently.
My sister is happy about it too.

MsgJp:
さすがに言葉だけというわけにはいかないから
またお返しを用意したよ
気に入って貰えるといいんだけど
MsgEn:
Naturally, I can't just leave it at words, so
I've prepared a little something for you.
I hope you'll enjoy it.

MsgJp:
いくつか僕らの仕事を片付けておいて
もらえたみたいだね、助かるよ
少ないけどお返しを用意したんだ
MsgEn:
It seems like you were able to take care of some
of our work for us.
I really appreciate it.
I prepared a small token of gratitude, even
though it's not much.

MsgJp:
君が来てくれて嬉しいよ
好きなだけゆっくりしていってくれ
MsgEn:
I'm glad you're here.
Take your time and relax as much as you like.

MsgJp:
あ、忘れるところだった
これ、リングディールと僕からさ
いつも世話になってるからね
MsgEn:
Ah, I almost forgot.
This is from Ringdeel and me.
We're always grateful for your help, you know.

MsgJp:
君のお陰で少し暮らしが華やかになった
気がするよ
ここは静かすぎるから
MsgEn:
Thanks to you, my life has become a little more
vibrant, I feel.
It's much too quiet here.

MsgJp:
よく来てくれたね
ああそうだ、君にこれをと思ってね
MsgEn:
Glad you could make it.
Oh yeah, I thought I'd give you this.

MsgJp:
君がこうして訪ねてくれることで
僕らも人との接し方を思い出せるんだ
MsgEn:
Your visits like this help us remember how to
interact with people.

MsgJp:
お客さん、遠いところ、せっかく来てくれたし
これを受け取ってくれ
またときおり訪ねてくれたら嬉しいな
MsgEn:
Hey there traveler, you've made quite the
journey!
Take this as a token of appreciation.
I'd be happy to see you drop by occasionally.

MsgJp:
僕はロンドジール
このディナンの森でエリアマスターを
しているんだ
MsgEn:
I am Rondejeel, working as an Area Master in this
forest of Deenan.

MsgJp:
どうだい？　ここは静かな所だろう
木々の声に耳を傾けながら
僕とリングディールは二人でエルフの
残した知識と技術を探し続けているのさ
MsgEn:
How about this? It's a quiet place, isn't it?
While listening to the voices of the trees,
Ringdeel and I are searching for the knowledge and
techniques left behind by the elves.

MsgJp:
エルフがどう生き、何を考え、そして
生き続けていたのか――
彼らに少しでも近づきたくて、僕ら二人は
ここに移り住んだんだ
MsgEn:
How the elves lived, what they thought, and what
kept them alive--
We both moved here to be a little closer to them.

MsgJp:
おかしいかい？
――いいさ、気にしないよ
MsgEn:
Does it seem strange to you?
It's good, doesn't bother me.

MsgJp:
とにかく、覚者の君が来てくれて嬉しいよ
最近は以前より魔物が増えてね
MsgEn:
Anyway, I'm glad you, the Arisen, are here.
Lately, there have been more monsters than before.

MsgJp:
僕らだけだと、手が足りなかったんだ
君が力を貸してくれるなら、僕らも相応の
礼はさせてもらうよ
MsgEn:
It was just us, and we didn't have enough hands.
If you lend us your strength, we'll be glad to
thank you well.

MsgJp:
いくつか僕らの仕事を片付けておいて
もらえたみたいだね、助かるよ
MsgEn:
It seems like you were able to take care of some
of our work for us.
I really appreciate it.

MsgJp:
お返しに、君に渡せそうなものを
考えてみたんだ
少しは喜んでもらえるといいんだけどね
MsgEn:
In return for your assistance, I've been thinking
well on what I might offer you.
I hope it brings you some joy.

MsgJp:
そうそう、君にも伝えておこう
《グローン・ノス》――森の東にある淵辺は
エルフの言葉で"森の淀み"と呼ばれる
ところなんだけどね
MsgEn:
Oh, by the way, I should also tell you; "Groan
Nos" is what the eastern edge of the forest is
called in the language of the elves.
It means "still forest."

MsgJp:
そこに、淀みが原因で生まれた魔物が
たまに湧くんだよ
MsgEn:
Occasionally, monsters borne from stagnation
emerge there.

MsgJp:
僕らも気が付いたら倒すようにしてるけど
最近増えてきたみたいなんだ
できれば君も手伝ってくれないかな
MsgEn:
We've been trying to defeat them, but it seems
like they've been increasing lately.
If possible, could you lend your aid?

MsgJp:
この間は遺跡の件、本当に助かったよ
ずいぶんこの森に慣れてきた君に
僕ら兄妹から提案があるんだ
MsgEn:
I really appreciate your help with the ruins
incident the other day.
You've become quite accustomed to this forest,
haven't you?
My siblings and I have a proposal for you.

MsgJp:
君もリングディールと共に
《エレメントアーチャ―》として
研究を深めてみないかい？
失われつつあるエルフの戦闘術についてさ
MsgEn:
Would you like to deepen your research on the
combat techniques of the dwindling elven warriors,
as an "Element Archer," along with Ringdeel?

MsgJp:
試す気になったら、リングディールに
声を掛けてくれ
MsgEn:
If you feel like trying, please talk to Ringdeel
and let them know.

MsgJp:
きっと君と研鑽しあった方が
妹も得るものが大きいと思うんだ
MsgEn:
I believe that surely, by mutually sharpening our
skills together, both you and my sister will gain
something great.

MsgJp:
そうだ、君にも伝えておこうかな
エルテ・ディナンへ続く路の脇に
《森民の地下道》っていう古い自然洞窟が
あるんだ
MsgEn:
I suppose I should tell you too.
Beside the road leading to Erte Deenan, there is
an old natural cave called the "Forest People's
Tunnel".

MsgJp:
かつて、エルフがミスリウ森林深部とディナンを
行き来するのに使っていた道さ
MsgEn:
Once, the elves used it as a path to travel
between the deep parts of Mysree Grove and Deenan.

MsgJp:
だけど、彼らの都が滅んだ時かな――
昔のエリアマスターによって、その地下道は
ずっと封鎖され続けていたんだ
多分敵に道を利用されないためだろうね
MsgEn:
That underground passage was permanently sealed
by an Area Master of old.
Perhaps it was around the time their city fell.
Likely, it was to prevent enemies from exploiting
the path.

MsgJp:
最近、その封鎖の解き方が分かってね
一応通れるようになったから、必要なら使うといい
MsgEn:
I recently figured out how to break that blockade.
I've got a way through, so you can use it if you
need to.

MsgJp: もう、今は完全にただの洞窟だけど
MsgEn: Now, it's just a mere cave.

MsgJp:
ああ、君にはずいぶん色々と任せてしまったね
それに手際もなかなかのものじゃないか
妹も喜んでいるよ
MsgEn:
I've assigned you many responsibilities, haven't
I?
And you handle them with efficiency.
My sister is happy about it too.

MsgJp:
さすがに言葉だけというわけにはいかないから
またお返しを用意したよ
次からはもっと良い物を渡すから
楽しみにしててよ
MsgEn:
Naturally, just words won't do, so I've prepared
a little something for you.
I hope you'll enjoy it.

MsgJp:
そう言えば、森の南西に聖なる泉が
あるのは知ってるかい？
《エルネア・スプリング》という生命力を
強める泉さ
MsgEn:
By the way, did you know that there is a sacred
spring in the southwest of the forest?
It's called the "Elnea Spring" and it invigorates
one's life force.

MsgJp:
その周囲に、白い人影が彷徨っている
ことがあるんだ
泉の生命力に魔が宿ったものなのか
それともエルフの亡霊なのか――
MsgEn:
There are times when white shadows wander around
its surroundings.
Could it be that some kind of magic has taken
hold of the vitality of the spring, or are they
the spirits of the elves?

MsgJp:
あれが"白い災厄"の正体じゃ
ないとは思うんだけど
MsgEn:
I don't think that is the true identity of the
"White Scourge," but...

MsgJp:
彼らは手強いし、意思疎通もできない
もし遭遇したらすぐその場を
離れたほうがいい
MsgEn:
They are strong opponents and we cannot
communicate with them.
If you encounter them, you should make yourself
scarce!

MsgJp:
そうだ、もし君がこの森やエルフの文化と
もう少し関わるつもりなら
ひとつ頼みを聞いてくれないかな？
MsgEn:
You know, if you're planning to get more involved
with this forest and the culture of the elves,
could I ask you for a favor?

MsgJp:
エルフ達の遺跡の一つ
《神花のテラス》という遺跡にいる
魔物退治をしてほしいんだ
MsgEn:
My request is this.
There's a place called the Divine Blossom
Terrace, one of the elven ruins.
It seems to be overrun with monsters.
Could you clear them out?

MsgJp:
僕はそれほど戦えないし
リングディール一人だとあそこの魔物は
手に余るものでね
どうかな？
MsgEn:
I'm not much of a fighter, and dealing with the
monsters there, especially alone, is quite
overwhelming for me.
What do you think?

MsgJp:
やってくれるというなら
きちんと依頼したいんだ
MsgEn:
If you're willing take this on, I'd like to make
a proper request.

MsgJp:
まったく、君には世話になりっぱなしだな
ここまで手助けしてもらったら
なんだか申し訳なくなってくる
MsgEn:
Honestly, I've been relying on you for help all
this time.
It's starting to make me feel a little guilty.

MsgJp:
僕ら兄妹から、心を込めて礼をさせてもらう
君がこの森に来てくれて本当に良かった
ありがとう
MsgEn:
We, as siblings, sincerely express our gratitude
to you.
It is truly wonderful that you came to this
forest.
Thank you.

MsgJp:
この件は、君にも伝えておいた
ほうがよさそうだな
MsgEn:
It seems like it would be a good idea to inform
you about this matter as well.

MsgJp:
ディナンの森の最奥――
《サーズ・ディナン》付近で
妹が銀毛の鬼人に襲われたんだ
MsgEn:
My sister was attacked by a silver-haired demon
near Sazu Deenan, deep within the depths of Deenan
Forest.

MsgJp:
シルバーロアという危険な魔物なんだけど
どうやらあの辺りを縄張りにするつもりらしい
MsgEn:
It's a dangerous demon called Silver Roar.
Apparently, it's marking that area as their
territory.

MsgJp:
用心に越したことはない
川辺の方へ行くのなら十分警戒してくれ
MsgEn:
It's better to be safe than sorry.
If you're heading towards the riverside, please
be extra cautious.

MsgJp: 一つ君に相談があるんだ
MsgEn: --I need to talk to you about something.

MsgJp:
エルフの都、エルテ・ディナンに
《レ・カルバス・アーマ》という区画があるのは
知ってるかい？
MsgEn:
Do you know that in the elven city of Erte
Deenan, there is a district called "Le Karvas
Arma"?

MsgJp:
今度頼みたいのは
その区画の探索なんだ
MsgEn:
What I want to ask for this time is an
exploration of that area.

MsgJp:
前に話しただろう？
エルフを脅かし続けてきた"白い災厄"の話
その答えがどうもアーマ区画にあるらしい
MsgEn:
Did I talk about this before?
The story of the "White Scourge" that was
threatening the elves.
It seems that the answer lies in the Arma section.

MsgJp:
どうかな、無理にとはいわないよ
もし協力してくれるなら
あらためて話し掛けてくれ
MsgEn:
What do you think? I won't force you.
If you're willing to help, just talk to me again.

MsgJp:
できることならぜひ――
いや、君に頼まなければならない
そんな気がするんだ
MsgEn:
If possible, please―
No, I feel like I have to ask for your help.
That's just how I feel.

MsgJp:
この森にはね、エルフ達が特別な意味を込めて
残した地名がいくつかあるんだ
MsgEn:
In this forest, there are several places with
names that the elves left behind that have special
meanings.

MsgJp:
《グローン・ノス》、《エルネア・スプリング》
なんかだね
MsgEn: Groan Nos, Elnea Spring, and so on.

MsgJp:
それぞれの場所には言葉の由来となる
魔物や現象があるから、そういう所に
足を踏み入れるなら注意するといい
MsgEn:
In each location, old history and language ring
about.
Monsters and strange phenomena are there too, so
if you endeavor to enter such places, it is
advisable to be cautious.

MsgJp:
ディナンの森にようこそ
大したもてなしはできないけどね
MsgEn:
Welcome to the Forest of Deenan.
We may not be able to offer much hospitality,
though.

MsgJp:
そこのボードに、僕らの《やることリスト》を
貼ってある
暇なら手伝ってもらえると助かるな
MsgEn:
I've posted our 《To Do List》 on the board there.
If you're not busy, I'd appreciate it if you
could help.

MsgJp:
――たまに、身に覚えのない紙も
あるんだけどね
MsgEn:
--Sometimes, there are also papers that I don't
remember.

MsgJp:
この森に居付いて何年――いや、もっとか
あまりそんな気はしないんだが
MsgEn:
How many years have I been here in this forest?
...No, it must be more than that.
Yet, it feels like just yesterday.

MsgJp:
ここは時の流れが少し違うのかもしれないな
――それとも、時の流れが違うのは
身体の方なのかな
MsgEn:
Perhaps the passage of time here is different.
Or perhaps... it is my own body that is out of
sync with time.

MsgJp:
